title: Engineering Projects Execution Manager (Fixed Term - 2 Years)
description: Join the Magic Are you passionate about shaping the future of food? At Puratos, we turn bold ideas into lasting impact through innovation, expertise, and a commitment to well-being. To strengthen our team in Izmir, we are looking for: Engineering Projects Execution Manager (Fixed Term – 2 Years) ( Izmir-Tire ) Your Mission As a result of our rapid growth, you will play an important role in Operations. Lead the end-to-end delivery of our chocolate factory construction project. What You Will Do Lead the planning, development, and execution of the chocolate factory construction project in line with scope, budget, timeline, quality, safety, and environmental requirements. Coordinate all architectural, civil, mechanical, electrical, and utilities designs, ensuring fit-for-purpose and compliant technical solutions. Manage CAPEX processes, including budget preparation, cash flow forecasting, approvals, and cost control throughout the project lifecycle. Act as the main interface with Group teams, ensuring alignment with global engineering standards and transparent progress reporting. Coordinate and manage external partners such as designers, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and local authorities. Define technical requirements and support procurement and tender processes, including bid evaluations and collaboration with Purchasing and Legal teams for contract preparation. Ensure that factory design and construction activities are aligned with sustainability principles, energy efficiency targets, and environmental best practices. Coordinate sustainability-related requirements, including LEED Silver (or equivalent) certification criteria, during design, construction, and commissioning phases. Work closely with designers, consultants, and contractors to ensure that materials, utilities, building systems, and construction methods support sustainability and certification objectives. Ensure full compliance with engineering standards, HSE regulations, quality systems, and local legislation during all project phases. Closely monitor on-site execution, proactively manage risks, resolve issues, and take corrective actions to avoid delays or cost overruns. Lead installation, commissioning, and handover activities to ensure operational readiness and successful project completion. Prepare and present regular project updates and reports covering progress, financials, risks, and key milestones to senior management and Group stakeholders. What We Expect From You Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related disciplines). Minimum 5–8 years of experience in engineering project execution, preferably including factory construction or large industrial CAPEX investments. Proven experience in project management, including budget, cash flow, and contractor management. Experience in FMCG and/or multinational manufacturing environments is a strong advantage. Experience with sustainable industrial or building projects, including exposure to LEED Silver certification (or equivalent green building standards), is a strong asset. Solid understanding of construction works, utilities, production environments, and industrial engineering standards. Strong ability to manage multiple stakeholders in a matrix and international organisation. Excellent command of English (written and spoken) for effective communication with Group and global teams. Willingness to work on-site and travel as required by the project. Location is in Tire, İzmir Our Mission At Puratos, we believe that food has extraordinary power in people’s lives. As the global leader in bakery, patisserie and chocolate ingredients, we turn innovation and food culture into opportunities for our customers’ success. We continuously improve the way we work by being curious about digital innovation — including data, automation and AI — to learn, collaborate and create impact together. We want to move the planet forward by creating innovative food solutions for the health and well-being of people everywhere. With over 11,000 employees in over 85 countries and turnover of 3.6 billion euros (2025), Puratos thrives on innovation, a pioneering spirit, and a unique culture. Our strong growth and commitment to local communities make working at Puratos truly special." “*Under the Personal Data Protection Law, you can access the Employee Candidate Privacy Notice from the link below. title: Production Shift Lead
description: Overview At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Pepsi, Doritos and Lipton Ice Tea, our work touches millions of people every day. At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve. Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you. The role is responsible for end-to-end shift leadership, driving operational performance across Safety, Quality, Service, Cost, and People, while coordinating cross-functional teams to achieve business objectives. The Production Shift Lead provides direct leadership to frontline employees through performance management, capability development, employee engagement, and talent growth. This position is accountable for manufacturing performance, food safety, EHS compliance, operational decision-making, and continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring effective execution of plant priorities in the absence of site functional leaders. Responsibilities Lead and coordinate all manufacturing activities during the assigned shift to ensure the safe, efficient and compliant execution of production plans while delivering targets across Safety, Quality, Service, Cost and People. Assume direct leadership responsibility for all shift-based Frontline Employees (FLEs), including workforce deployment, performance management, coaching, capability development, engagement and succession planning. Serve as the senior operational leader during the shift, making timely operational decisions and ensuring effective coordination between Production, Quality, Maintenance, Warehouse, Planning and EHS functions. Drive shift performance through daily management systems, KPI reviews, QCDM processes and structured problem-solving activities to achieve operational excellence targets. Ensure full compliance with PepsiCo Food Safety, Quality, GMP, FSSC, AIB, Environmental and Occupational Health & Safety standards, taking immediate action to mitigate operational risks. Lead continuous improvement, productivity, waste reduction and cost optimization initiatives, ensuring effective implementation of Lean Manufacturing and Operational Excellence programs. Monitor production plan attainment, equipment performance and resource utilization, ensuring optimal manufacturing efficiency and timely delivery of customer demand. Lead frontline communication processes including shift handovers, team meetings, performance reviews and employee feedback discussions to drive alignment and engagement. Develop organizational capability by identifying skill gaps, supporting training execution and strengthening technical and leadership competencies across frontline teams. Maintain end-to-end accountability for plant operations during evenings, nights, weekends and periods when site functional leaders are not present, ensuring business continuity and escalation management. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Proven experience leading manufacturing operations and frontline teams within a fast-paced production environment. Strong people leadership capabilities with demonstrated experience in performance management, coaching, employee engagement and talent development. Ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams, driving alignment and execution across Production, Quality, Maintenance, Warehouse, Planning and EHS functions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret operational data, identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions. Solid knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence and Daily Management Systems. Strong understanding of Food Safety, Quality, GMP, FSSC, AIB, Environmental and Occupational Health & Safety requirements within a manufacturing environment. Demonstrated ability to make sound operational decisions under pressure, manage competing priorities and effectively respond to escalations. Excellent communication, stakeholder management and presentation skills with the ability to influence at multiple organizational levels. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment while maintaining a strong focus on business results and people development. Experience leading shift-based operations with accountability for operational performance, workforce management and business continuity. Fluent in English, both written and verbal.

title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
description: About Sezzle: With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping! Compensation : For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is $12,500 - $20,800 USD based on location and experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience About the Role: We are seeking an exceptional Principal Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, operate, and scale the platform that powers Sezzle. Your focus will be the hardest infrastructure problems: increasing throughput, reducing latency, removing capacity bottlenecks, strengthening resilience, and making production operations more automated and predictable as the business grows. You will own complex technical initiatives from architecture and prototyping through implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operation. Your impact will come from the systems you build, the problems you solve, and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and cost efficiency. Our stack runs on AWS , with workloads orchestrated on Kubernetes and data anchored in Aurora RDS (MySQL and Postgres) . You should know these technologies deeply and be comfortable moving between cloud architecture, networking, cluster internals, database performance, and application behavior to understand how the entire system scales. You will write code and infrastructure-as-code, debug production systems, and deliver changes that hold up under real traffic and failure conditions. Operational ownership is part of the job. You will participate in the on-call rotation and take a hands-on role in recovering from major incidents, including full outages. We need someone who can form and test hypotheses using logs, metrics, and traces, make sound mitigation decisions with incomplete information, and turn incident findings into lasting engineering fixes. You will also build and apply AI-assisted infrastructure and SRE tooling for incident investigation, capacity analysis, runbook automation, and toil reduction. You will evaluate these tools through practical results and apply appropriate access controls, validation, and auditability to their use in production. This role reports to engineering leadership and works closely with application engineers, Security, and Compliance. You will develop a deep understanding of how Sezzle's business operates and how customer journeys, transaction patterns, and product decisions shape infrastructure demand and behavior. You will use that understanding to identify and deliver improvements across teams and technical domains, connecting infrastructure decisions to better customer outcomes and business performance. What you’ll do: Own the technical architecture and evolution of core infrastructure: identify system limits, prioritize technical improvements, and implement changes that support increasing traffic, data volume, and workload complexity. Connect business understanding to improvements across the system: learn how key business workflows behave in production, trace their impact across applications, data, and infrastructure, and partner across teams to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency beyond any single service or team's scope. Engineer for scale and performance: build capacity models, run load and stress tests, diagnose bottlenecks across compute, networking, Kubernetes, and databases, and validate improvements against throughput, latency, saturation, and cost per workload. Design and build AWS infrastructure: implement resilient account, IAM, network, and service architectures; address service quotas, fault isolation, and multi-AZ or multi-region requirements as workloads grow. Build and operate the Kubernetes platform: improve cluster architecture, lifecycle automation, workload isolation, resource allocation, autoscaling, safe upgrades, and deployment reliability. Scale and optimize Aurora RDS for MySQL and Postgres: tune queries and indexes, address connection and replication bottlenecks, plan capacity, improve failover behavior, and implement safe schema changes and database migrations with application engineers. Improve reliability through engineering: define and instrument service-level objectives and error budgets with service owners; implement failure isolation, backpressure, load shedding, and safe retry behavior where needed to prevent cascading failures. Participate in on-call and drive technical recovery during serious incidents: use evidence-based triage, execute mitigations, communicate findings, and implement corrective actions from postmortems. Implement and test disaster recovery: design backup, restore, and failover mechanisms against agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives; run recovery exercises and document measured results. Build infrastructure-as-code and operational automation: make provisioning, configuration, deployments, upgrades, and recovery reproducible, reviewed, testable, and recoverable. title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: About The Job Mechanical Design Engineer Design the future of EV charging You are an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer who enjoys turning ideas into reliable, production-ready products. At Siemens eMobility, you'll help develop next-generation EV charging solutions that support the transition to sustainable transportation. From concept design to industrialization, you'll play a key role in delivering innovative, high-quality products used worldwide. What You'll Do Design mechanical components, assemblies, and charger enclosures. Create and maintain 3D CAD models, drawings, BOMs, and documentation. Support thermal management and cooling concepts for power electronics. Drive Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA). Support prototype builds, testing, validation, and certification activities. Collaborate with hardware, manufacturing, quality, compliance, and supplier teams. Solve technical issues throughout the product lifecycle. Required What You'll Bring BSc or MSc in Mechanical Engineering or a related field. 5+ years of mechanical product development experience. Strong CAD skills (Siemens NX preferred). Experience with sheet metal, plastics, castings, and assemblies. Solid knowledge of GD&T, tolerance analysis, materials, and DFM/DFA. Experience working in multidisciplinary hardware development teams. Fluent in English. Nice to Have Experience with EV charging, power electronics, or industrial equipment. Thermal design and CFD experience. Teamcenter or PLM experience. Knowledge of CE, IP-rating, and product compliance requirements. What Success Looks Like Within your first year, you will: Deliver robust and manufacturable mechanical designs. Improve product quality, reliability, and cost performance. Support successful product certifications and releases. Become a trusted mechanical design expert within the Product Design team. Why Siemens eMobility? Contribute directly to the energy transition. Work on innovative products with global impact. Enjoy ownership across the full product lifecycle. Collaborate with experienced multidisciplinary teams. Grow your career in a technology-driven, international environment. Ready to make an impact? DeLaval is a leading developer, manufacturer, and supplier of solutions for dairy farmers around the world. As a company built on innovation, we constantly work to find ways of helping our customers do more with less. Role And Responsibilities As a Production Engineer, you are responsible for leading and developing production processes with a strong focus on quality, efficiency, safety, and manufacturability. You play a key role in introducing new products, improving assembly solutions, and driving continuous improvement initiatives in close collaboration with cross-functional teams. Key Responsibilities Drive Manufacturing Safety, Quality and Operational Excellence - Ensure manufacturing operations deliver high levels of safety, quality, productivity, and cost efficiency through continuous improvement and robust processes. Lead Investment and Industrialization Projects - Manage manufacturing investment (CAPEX) projects from concept and feasibility through implementation, commissioning, validation, and handover to production. Optimize Production Performance - Analyze manufacturing performance, identify bottlenecks and improvement opportunities, and implement sustainable solutions that enhance productivity, quality, and operational efficiency. Ensure Safe and Sustainable Operations - Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with safety requirements, eliminating risks, and supporting environmental sustainability objectives. title: Engineering Manager

Do you have experience in technical coordination and leadership—particularly within discipline lead piping ? If so, the position of Engineering Manager / Discipline Lead Piping could be the next step in your career. JOIN US IN CONSTRUCTION AND CIVIL ENGINEERING IN GOTHENBURG Our department of approximately 60 employees includes piping designers, structural engineers, calculation engineers, and system administrators working on the design of various industrial and energy facilities. We are engaged throughout the entire project lifecycle—from feasibility studies, conceptual design, and detailed engineering to procurement, construction management, inspections, and final commissioning. Our major clients operate in petrochemicals and refineries, energy production, and the pulp and paper sector. We support them with deep technical expertise, ensuring compliance with the latest industry standards. COWI’s strong reputation has led to several large, long-term project wins, primarily delivered as EPCm assignments for both national and international customers. LEAD THE DEVELOPMENT OF INDUSTRIAL ENGINEERING As an Engineering Manager / Discipline Lead Piping , you will have overarching technical responsibility in our projects and will become part of our global expert community. You will work closely with division management, multidisciplinary engineering teams, project managers, and clients. In addition to the general responsibilities of an Engineering Manager, you will bring specialized competence in piping engineering , ensuring high technical quality and coordination within your discipline. RESPONSIBILITIES Lead and control the overall design and engineering work Coordinate technical deliverables across all disciplines Ensure schedule, budget, and quality compliance Plan activities together with project managers and discipline leads Provide continuous reporting to the project manager Participate in internal and external project meetings Lead technical forums and facilitate key technical decisions Review drawings, calculations, and technical specifications Participate in technical reviews and design discussions with clients Contribute personally with discipline-specific tasks Review and approve piping-related documentation and deliverables ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES AS DISCIPLINE LEAD PIPING Drive the piping discipline strategy and ensure alignment with project requirements Secure integration between piping design, structural design, equipment layout, and process engineering Oversee piping layout development, material selection, stress analysis, and interface management Ensure adherence to relevant piping codes, standards, and best practices Mentor and support piping designers and engineers within the project Guarantee quality and consistency across all piping deliverables YOUR DEVELOPMENT AT COWI Our people are our greatest asset. At COWI, you gain the opportunity to develop professionally through collaboration with top experts in the field—locally and globally. Together with your manager, you will create a personalized development plan to grow your expertise and shape the future of industrial engineering. YOUR EXPERIENCE. OUR TEAM. TOGETHER WE SHAPE THE FUTURE To succeed in this role, you should enjoy being the central technical coordinator with multiple points of contact. You are confident in your technical decision-making and driven by delivering robust engineering solutions. As a person, you are a communicative, detail-oriented team player who thrives in technically complex industrial projects. title: Senior Elkonstruktör till Göteborg
description: Är du redo för ett flexibelt och dynamiskt arbete som präglas av stark gemenskap och samarbete? Vi söker en elkonstruktör som vill arbeta med tekniskt avancerade projekt tillsammans med spännande kunder inom olika branscher. Hos oss får du vara med och skapa en hållbar industri! Din framtida roll Det händer mycket hos oss inom affärsenheten Industri och vi söker nu en senior elkonstruktör som vill vara med på vår resa framåt. Som elkonstruktör hos oss är du involverad i många spännande projekt där du med din erfarenhet och kompetens behövs! Hos oss kommer du att arbeta både in-house och på plats hos våra uppdragsgivare i regionen. Vi hjälper våra kunder i alla faser av projekten och du får därför möjlighet att arbeta brett och vara involverad i allt från rådgivning, utredning, förstudier, detaljkonstruktion och genomförande. Hos oss på Sweco kommer du att arbeta med tekniskt avancerade projekt och använda de mest aktuella verktygen inom branschen. Efterfrågan på våra tjänster är stor och vi ser en fortsatt positiv tillväxt! Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att innefatta Utredningar, förstudier, projektgenomförande och idrifttagningar Ställverkslösningar, motorstyrningar, skåpskonstruktion och dimensionering Kalkyler och tekniska beskrivningar Offerter och kundkontakt Om du är intresserad finns det även möjlighet att ta rollen som uppdragsledare, vilket innebär egen kundkontakt och budgetansvar. Varför jobba hos oss? Här får du möjlighet att arbeta tillsammans med många kompetenta och erfarna kollegor i spännande projekt över hela landet. Vårt kontor i Göteborg ligger centralt placerat i stan och här sitter kollegor från olika divisioner inom Sweco. Utöver Göteborg är även Varberg, Halmstad, Jönköping och Linköping möjliga placeringsorter. Vår kultur präglas av nyfikenhet, hållbarhet, utveckling och samarbete. På el- och automation arbetar du med 120 specialister inom el och automation för industriella projekt. Vi är verksamma inom flera branscher såsom energi, livs- och läkemedel, kemi, petrokemi, papper och massa, VA, samt tillverkningsindustri. Hos Sweco blir du en del av en stark gemenskap där relationen till varandra och våra kunder är kärnan. Vi erbjuder dig en flexibel arbetsplats med frihet under ansvar, stöttande kollegor och en positiv arbetsmiljö. Sweco finns på Allbrights gröna lista över jämställda börsbolag och rankas högst av teknikkonsultbolagen av yrkesverksamma ingenjörer. Hos oss finns plats för nya idéer, kreativitet och personlig utveckling. Den vi söker – är det du? Vi söker dig som har Erfarenhet av elkonstruktion inom industrisektorn För tjänsten relevant utbildning alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet Goda kunskaper i svenska, både tal och skrift Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av ställverkslösningar, motorstyrning, skåpkonstruktion och beräkningar samt arbete med elkraftsanläggningar. För att trivas i rollen som elkonstruktör hos oss tror vi att du är en person som tycker att mötet med andra människor är både spännande och stimulerande. Du vill ha roligt på jobbet och ser samarbetet med kollegor och kunder som en naturlig del av vardagen. Vi söker dig som trivs med att arbeta strukturerat och har god förståelse för måluppfyllelse och lönsamhet. Ansökan Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdatum. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail, utan hänvisar samtliga ansökningar till ansökningsformuläret nedan. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! Kontakta oss För mer information om tjänsten och arbetet i Region Väst, kontakta Stefan Ottosson stefan.ottosson@sweco.se, 072-535 46 26 Jonas Norlin jonas.norlin@sweco.se, 070-727 02 90 Mats Berg mats.berg@sweco.se, 070-307 82 88 Vill du vara med och forma framtiden? Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! På Sweco vill vi vara en arbetsplats präglad av mångfald. Vi tror att fler perspektiv breddar vår förmåga att fortsätta nå våra mål och eftersträvar mångfald i våra rekryteringsprocesser. Sweco planerar och utformar morgondagens hållbara samhällen och städer. Med den samlade kunskapen hos våra 23 000 arkitekter, ingenjörer och andra experter arbetar vi tillsammans med våra kunder för att möjliggöra den gröna omställningen, maximera digitaliseringens potential och stärka Europas konkurrenskraft och resiliens. Sweco är Europas ledande konsultföretag inom arkitektur och teknik med en omsättning på cirka 32 miljarder SEK under 2025. Företaget är noterat på Nasdaq Stockholm.

Product Design Engineer (NPD) Global Floorcare, part of TTI, is home to two iconic floorcare brands: Vax and Hoover. We're looking for someone who can deliver robust, manufacturable mechanical designs while taking increasing ownership of project delivery and technical decision-making. You'll develop innovative solutions that meet product performance objectives, proactively identify and challenge performance gaps, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and PRC throughout the development process. Our values define who we are and what we stand for; Trust – We’re experts and everything we do is based on brilliant knowledge. title: Lead Secondary Design Engineer
description: Job Description Summary L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production. Responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution des opérations du département ou axé sur l'exécution d'activités professionnelles au sein d'une discipline technique. Fonctions dotées d'une certaine autonomie, mais guidées par les politiques établies ou l'analyse des résultats finaux. Ce poste est autorisé à modifier les procédures et les pratiques en relation avec les tâches dans la mesure où les résultats finaux répondent aux normes d'acceptabilité (qualité, volume, respect des délais, etc.). Job Description Rôles et responsabilités Facilite la conception, la construction et la maintenance de l'environnement physique et naturel, comprenant des travaux tels que : la mécanique des sols, l'analyse sismique, incluant également les fondations des équipements fournis par GE Vernova. Indique la feuille de route de conception et des exigences pour tous sous sol et au-dessus des travaux de génie civil, et précise l'entrepreneur civil en charge pour les mêmes (nivellement, fondations, dalles, etc.). Il doit également inclure l’estimation des coûts de l’AC, les évaluations de la constructibilité et le séquençage, la compréhension des codes et des normes de génie civil locaux, ainsi que l’application des principes de l’acier de construction, du génie civil et de la géotechnique. Analyse et conception des structures industrielles qui supportent ou résistent aux charges statiques et dynamiques. L'ingénierie des structures comprend généralement la conception et l'analyse de structures composées de matériaux tels que l'acier de construction, le béton armé, le béton précontraint, les ossatures de bois et la maçonnerie, afin de prendre en compte les charges requises par le code et les combinaisons de charges afin de garantir l'adéquation de la structure aux défaillances. Se fonde sur une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique, un esprit d'analyse et une expérience technique pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie. Possède une connaissance approfondie des meilleures pratiques et de la manière dont son propre domaine s'intègre aux autres. Possède une connaissance pratique de la concurrence et des facteurs qui les différencient sur le marché. Se fonde sur son expérience technique et un esprit d'analyse. Fait appel à des ressources limitées internes et externes en dehors de ses propres équipes pour l'aider à prendre une décision. Agit en tant que ressource pour ses collègues moins expérimentés. Peut piloter de petits projets avec des risques et des besoins en ressources faibles. Explique les informations. Développe des compétences pour amener les membres de l'équipe à un consensus autour de sujets relevant du domaine. title: JUNIOR MECHANICAL ENGINEER

La risorsa si occuperà delle seguenti attività: Sviluppare e ingegnerizzare soluzioni meccaniche per assiemi complessi (shelter, rack, unità integrate per sistemi EW), dalla fase concettuale al dettaglio costruttivo. Eseguire analisi strutturali (FEM) e termo-fluidodinamiche (CFD) per validare i progetti, ottimizzare le performance e garantire l’operatività dei sistemi in condizioni ambientali critiche. MIL-STD-810G) e compatibilità elettromagnetica (es. MIL-STD-461). Redigere la documentazione tecnica completa: specifiche tecniche, disegni costruttivi secondo normative UNI-ISO, distinte base (BOM) e documentazione per la qualifica. Gestire l’interfaccia tecnica con fornitori esterni per la produzione dei componenti, assicurando qualità e conformità delle forniture. Collaborare attivamente con team interfunzionali (ingegneri elettronici, sistemisti, produzione, qualità) per l’integrazione ottimale delle componenti meccaniche e la risoluzione di problematiche tecniche. Il profilo ideale deve avere le seguenti caratteristiche: Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Meccanica o Aeronautica (Study Level: Laurea Magistrale; Study Area: Ingegneria Meccanica, Ingegneria Aerospaziale e Astronautica). Esperienza minima di 1-2 anni nella progettazione e/o analisi meccanica di assiemi complessi (shelter, rack, unità integrate per elettronica), preferibilmente in ambito Difesa, Aerospaziale o settori con elevati standard di robustezza e affidabilità. Solida conoscenza dei principi di progettazione meccanica, tecnologie dei materiali e processi di lavorazione meccanica. Esperienza nella progettazione di soluzioni per l’integrazione di apparati elettronici. Buona padronanza di almeno uno dei seguenti software di simulazione: Ansys Suite (Mechanical/Fluent/Icepak), FloTHERM, FloEFD. Conoscenza degli standard per la qualifica ambientale in campo militare (es. MIL-STD-810G, MIL-STD-461) e delle normative UNI-ISO per il disegno tecnico. Esperienza nella progettazione e sviluppo di soluzioni termo-meccaniche (dissipatori, heat pipe, ventilazione forzata, raffreddamento a liquido). Capacità di redigere documentazione tecnica di progetto (specifiche, disegni, BOM, report di analisi e qualifica). Attitudine al lavoro in team multidisciplinari e orientamento alla risoluzione di problemi complessi in ambito militare. Costituiscono titolo preferenziale: Conoscenza approfondita di normative militari specifiche aggiuntive (es. MIL-STD-1472 Human Engineering). Esperienza nell’utilizzo di software CAD 3D parametrici (es. PTC Creo, CATIA V5). Conoscenza di sistemi PLM (Windchill, Teamcenter). Esperienza diretta nella progettazione di shelter militari o rack avionici/navali. Familiarità con processi di integrazione e collaudo di sistemi elettronici complessi. description: Mechanisms Engineer - Solar Arrays Location: Germering, on-site About the hiring company: Dcubed is a fast-growing space engineering company with the mission to make space engineering and exploration easy and accessible. You will design, prototype, test, and qualify the hardware that allows spacecraft to generate power once they reach orbit. We are looking for an engineer with a builder's mindset: someone who can move seamlessly from CAD models and FEM analyses to the workshop and test lab, turning ambitious ideas into reliable flight hardware. If you are motivated by ownership, speed, and the challenge of making space mechanisms work where repair is impossible, you'll fit right in. Responsibilities Mechanism Design & Development: Design, analyze, and develop space-qualified deployment mechanisms and motion systems for Solar Array products, from concept through flight hardware delivery. Technical Expertise: Provide expert guidance on mechanism design, materials selection, lubrication, coatings, thermal effects, motorization margins, tolerancing, and reliability for space applications. Manufacturing & Prototyping: Apply Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles, generate production-ready technical drawings, and support rapid prototyping and manufacturing activities using additive manufacturing and conventional machining techniques. System Integration: Ensure seamless integration of mechanisms with structural, electrical, and deployment subsystems while balancing performance, manufacturability, cost, and schedule requirements. Testing & Qualification: Define, support, and execute development, qualification, and acceptance test campaigns, including deployment, vibration, thermal vacuum, shock, and lifetime testing. Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement: Investigate anomalies, perform root-cause analysis, and implement design improvements to enhance mechanism performance, reliability, and manufacturability. Documentation: Maintain engineering documentation including CAD models, technical drawings, specifications, analyses, test procedures, and qualification reports. Candidate requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline. 5+ years of experience in mechanism design, aerospace engineering, precision mechanical systems, or related fields. Strong knowledge of space mechanisms, including bearings, gears, springs, hinges, release systems, lubrication, coatings, wear mechanisms, thermal effects, and motorization sizing and margins. Expert-level CAD proficiency (SolidWorks preferred) and familiarity with FEM tools (ANSYS preferred). Strong understanding of materials, manufacturing processes, GD&T, tolerancing, and technical drawing generation. Experience applying Design for Manufacturing (DfM) and Design for Assembly (DfA) principles. Hands-on experience with prototyping and fabrication methods including 3D printing, milling, turning, laser cutting, CNC machining, and hardware assembly. Familiarity with space qualification methods and standards, including vibration, shock, thermal vacuum, deployment, and lifetime testing. Knowledge of ECSS, NASA, or equivalent aerospace standards is highly desirable. Fluent English skills. Eligibility to work in Germany. title: Docteur en Simulation numérique & IA – H/F
description: Dans le TOP10 des Sociétés de Conseil en Ingénierie en France , le Groupe SCALIAN intervient sur des activités de services en management de projets industriels, supply chain, architecture et développement de systèmes numériques embarqués, applicatifs de systèmes d'information et d'Intelligence artificielle dans des secteurs d’activité aussi variés que l’aéronautique, le spatial, l’automobile, le ferroviaire, les services, le luxe ou le retail etc. Créée en 1989, SCALIAN compte aujourd’hui plus de 5500 collaborateurs répartis dans 11 pays et 15 implantations en France pour un chiffre d’affaires de 550 millions d’euros. SCALIAN travaille pour des grands Groupes du CAC40 sur des projets en AT ou au forfait. Labellisée Great Place to Work, SCALIAN connait une croissance de 20% chaque année. Pourquoi SCALIAN ? Parce que Scalian vous accompagne dans le développement de votre carrière : programme d'onboarding complet sur 1 an avec votre manager et votre RH, programmes de formation personnalisés, communautés techniques, événements internes Parce que Scalian favorise la Qualité de Vie au Travail : certifications Great Place to Work® et Best Workplaces for Women, prime de cooptation, prime vacances, accord télétravail Parce que Scalian développe une politique RSE concrète et ambitieuse : mobilité durable, actions environnementales, accord Handicap et mission handicap avec temps dédié Description Du Poste CDI à Rennes / Statut cadre / Télétravail 2 jours par semaine Expérience minimum : être titulaire d'une thèse en simulation numérique et IA Rémunération : 35 à 42K€ bruts annuels (hors avantages Scalian) Poste à pourvoir à compter de novembre 2026 Quel sera votre rôle ? Vous mènerez des travaux de recherche et développement sur l’utilisation de techniques de simulation, de machine learning, de traitement d’images et du signal, appliquées notamment au domaine de l’environnement, du spatial et de la défense. Vous analyserez et implémenterez les dernières méthodes de l’état de l’art en collaboration avec les experts du pôle Simulation & IA, ses clients et un réseau de partenaires académiques et industriels à à travers les projets RedLUM et SIGMA. Vos missions seront les suivantes : Proposer des méthodes et outils, ainsi que des cas d’applications industriels Réaliser un état de l’art sur les méthodes d’asservissement par l’IA Concevoir les outils de configuration et de supervision de l’entrainement (Vous vous intéresserez aux pratiques « MLOps ») Explorer particulièrement les solutions offertes par NVIDIA Isaac SIM et Unreal Engine en termes de Framework d’apprentissage et de modélisation Concevoir les outils de configuration et de supervision de l’entrainement (Vous vous intéresserez aux pratiques « MLOps ») Déployer l’IA sur du hardware en assurant sa compatibilité avec les contraintes du système Participer au développement de code open source utilisé par la communauté scientifique Européenne Implémenter et comparer les derniers algorithmes de machine learning pour la génération et la prédiction de systèmes dynamiques Mettre à l’échelle le code ITHACA-FV pour le big data et le rendre modulaire afin d’intégrer divers phénomènes physiques Améliorer la visualisation graphique des résultats avec Paraview ou Unreal Engine Publier et présenter vos résultats Le Projet SIGMA Ce projet interne s’attèle à l’utilisation de techniques de Machine Learning afin de développer des algorithmes de guidage de véhicule par IA, le cas des lanceurs réutilisables sera particulièrement étudié. Vous travaillerez sur un produit, développé en interne, dont la finalité est de modéliser les lois de commande d’un véhicule par un réseau de neurones, entraîné par un algorithme d’apprentissage par renforcement dans un environnement simulé . L’IA une fois entrainé est ensuite voué à être déployé sur une carte embarquée , où elle réalisera les opérations de guidage du véhicule. Vous rejoindrez une expertise historique et grandissante qui consiste à développer des environnements simulés complexes permettant d’entrainer des IA qui sont ensuite utilisées dans le monde réel. Ces travaux ont déjà mené lieu à des projets tels que COLIBOT qui consiste à guider un colis aérolargué à l’aide d’un réseau de neurone entrainé via des simulations. Le Projet RedLUM En collaboration avec des laboratoires académiques (Inria et INRAE), vous serez amené à implémenter en C++ des nouvelles méthodes de mathématiques appliquées en couplage modèle/données pour le contrôle et le monitoring de systèmes aérodynamiques (éoliennes, foils de bateau, tours antigel, lanceurs réutilisables pour le spatial, …). Pour s’attaquer à des applications temps réel, Scalian Insights développe des « modèles d’ordre réduits intrusifs » (couplage modèle/donnée), c’est-à-dire des approximations d’équations aux dérivées partielles pour des cadres d’application spécifiques, construits à partir de jeux de données. De plus, lors du fonctionnement opérationnel du système (par exemple une éolienne), les simulations du modèle d’ordre réduit sont corrigées, en temps réel, grâce aux mesures des capteurs embarqués et à la résolution d’un problème inverse bayésien ( assimilation de données ). Pour ce projet, un code C++ a été développé en se basant sur OpenFOAM et la librairie de modèles d’ordre réduit ITHACA-FV. Une présentation du projet peut également être retrouvée à ce lien : https://redlum.mathnum.inrae.fr/ . title: Commissioning Engineer (Mechanical)
description: Who We Are? Founded in 1993, Rönesans Holding operates today as a main contractor and investor across a wide geography spanning Türkiye, Europe, Central Asia, and Africa, with activities in construction, real estate, energy, industrial facilities, and healthcare. With more than 40,000 employees and a global team representing over 60 nationalities, Rönesans ranks among the world’s largest contracting companies and continues to deliver innovative engineering projects on a global scale, driven by its vision of building a sustainable future. What You’ll Do? Lead and execute pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up, and performance testing activities for rotating mechanical equipment. Review engineering drawings, vendor documentation, and contractual requirements to ensure commissioning requirements are incorporated into the project. Prepare and review commissioning procedures, method statements, execution plans, and schedules. Manage mechanical completion through to facility handover using Completion Management Systems. Coordinate with vendors, clients, construction, and multidisciplinary commissioning teams during commissioning and start-up. Supervise equipment preservation, flushing, cleaning, alignment verification, lubrication, and mechanical run testing. Support troubleshooting, performance testing, reliability runs, and punch list close-out. Prepare commissioning progress reports, final dossiers, turnover packages, and handover documentation. Ensure compliance with HSSE requirements and promote a strong safety culture throughout all commissioning activities. What We Expect from You? Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering (mandatory). Minimum 5–7 years of commissioning experience in the Oil & Gas industry. Strong hands-on experience with: Centrifugal Gas Compressors, Gas Engine Generator Packages, Centrifugal and Positive Displacement Pumps, Air Compressors, Cooling Water Systems, Lube Oil and Seal Gas Systems, Utility and Process Mechanical Equipment, Rotating equipment alignment, vibration monitoring, and performance testing. Good understanding of compressor auxiliaries, piping systems, lubrication systems, and mechanical troubleshooting. Hands-on experience with Completion Management Systems such as Aconex, GoTechnology (GoTech), Go Completion System , or equivalent. Proven experience in mechanical completion, commissioning, start-up, performance testing, and facility handover. Strong knowledge of commissioning documentation, turnover dossiers, and final handover packages. Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to work effectively with clients, vendors, and multidisciplinary teams. What We Offer? Performance-based bonus practices that recognize and reward success Comprehensive benefits and employee support programs Private Health Insurance benefits designed to support employee health and well-being Training and development programs that foster professional and personal growth Our Diversity and Equality Statement Rönesans Holding is among the signatories of the United Nations Global Compact, which calls on companies to align their strategies and operations with universal principles on human rights, labor, environment and anti-corruption, and to take actions that advance societal goals. Rönesans Holding adopts the universally accepted principles based on the declarations recognized within the framework of the United Nations Global Compact. Rönesans Holding is an employer that aims to ensure equality in its human resources practices by upholding transparent and ethical values, without compromising its core principles of integrity, competitiveness and innovation. All applications are evaluated based on equal opportunity, regardless of gender, language, religion, race or ethnic origin, and no discrimination is applied.

title: Bakım ve Yardımcı İşletmeler Mühendisi
description: Sütaşkımız Sizinle Birlikte Büyüyor Sütün iyiliği ve bereketini yayma misyonu ile çalışan ve her biri işinin uzmanı 5.000 çalışma arkadaşımızın yanı sıra satış dağıtım grubundaki iş ortaklarımız ile birlikte 7.500 kişilik büyük bir aileyiz. Her geçen gün büyüyen Sütaş Ailesi’ne, yaratıcı, yenilikçi, heyecanı yüksek, uluslararası platformlarda çalışabilecek, takım çalışmasını seven çalışma arkadaşları katmak istiyoruz. Misyonumuzu benimseyen, vizyonumuzu paylaşan, değerlerimizi kendi değerleri ile örtüştüren, “Çiftlikten Sofralara” entegre iş modelimiz doğrultusunda gıda mühendisliği, makine mühendisliği, endüstri mühendisliği, veterinerlik, elektrik elektronik mühendisliği, işletme, iktisat, bilgisayar mühendisliği, yazılım mühendisliği gibi pek çok farklı bölümden mezun geleceğin Sütaş'lıları ile tanışma heyecanı içindeyiz. Siz de bu aileye katılarak Sütaş'lı olmaya ne dersiniz? Tarfaş, Bingöl lokasyonumuzda Hayvancılık Grup Müdürlüğü bünyesinde görevlendirilmek üzere “Bakım ve Yardımcı İşletmeler Mühendisi” pozisyonunda aramıza katılmanız için başvurunuzu bekliyoruz. Nasıl Bir Takım Arkadaşı Arıyoruz? Üniversitelerin Makine, Mekatronik, Elektrik ve Elektronik Mühendisliği, Biyosistem Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, En az 2 yıl deneyimli, İletişim becerileri güçlü, ekip çalışmasına yatkın ve çözüm odaklı, MS Office, SAP, AutoCAD uygulamalarına hakim, İyi derecede İngilizce bilen, Bingöl’de ikamet eden / edebilecek olan. Takım Arkadaşımızdan Neler Bekliyoruz? İşletmedeki tüm makine, ekipman ve teknik sistemlerin bakım planlarını hazırlamak, Periyodik bakım faaliyetlerinin zamanında gerçekleştirilmesini sağlamak, Arıza analizlerini yapar ve tekrar eden arızaların kök nedenlerini belirleyerek kalıcı çözümler geliştirmek, Plansız duruşları azaltmaya yönelik iyileştirme projeleri yürütmek, Çiftlik altyapısı ve teknolojik sistemlerin takibini yapmak, Teslim sürecine kadar makinelerin şartname ve plana uygunluğunu kontrol etmek, Makine yerleşim planları, montaj, yer değiştirme ve imalat değişimlerini planlamak, Proses akış diyagramlarının güncelliğini sağlamak, veri tabanı ile uyumlu hale getirmek, Devreye alınan sistemlerde operasyon, bakım ve iş güvenliği eğitimlerini organize etmek. Sütaş‘ta sizin için neler var? Çalışma arkadaşlarımızın potansiyellerini en üst seviyede gerçekleştirebilmeleri için kişisel gelişimlerini, bilgi, beceri ve yetkinliklerini destekler, fikir ve önerilerine değer verir, kazanımlarını, kariyer beklentilerini, iş sonuçlarını ve organizasyonun ihtiyaçlarını değerlendirerek onlara kariyer yolculuklarının ilerleyen yıllarında da farklı lokasyon ve iş kolları arasında geçiş imkanı sunarız. "6698 sayılı Kişisel Verilerin Korunması Kanunu kapsamında, kişisel verilerinizin işlenmesinden doğan haklarınıza ve bu konudaki detaylı bilgiye Sütaş KVKK Aday Aydınlatma Metni | Sütaş adresinde yer alan aydınlatma metnimizden ulaşabilirsiniz ."

title: Devreye Alma Mühendisi
description: Hakkımızda ARITES METAL olarak; misyon, vizyon ve temel değerlerimiz doğrultusunda hedeflerimize ortak olacak, Ankara Malıköy Anadolu OSB’de yer alan fabrikamızda görev alacak, üretim gücümüze değer katacak deneyim ve yetkinliklere sahip "Devreye Alma Mühendisi" arayışımız bulunmaktadır. Görev Ve Sorumluluklar Tasarımı ve imalatı tamamlanan sistemlerin sahada mekanik ve elektrik projelerine uygunluğunu denetlemek, Fabrika Kabul (FAT) ve Saha Kabul Testi (SAT) prosedürlerini yürütmek, Saha devreye alma süreçlerinde oluşabilecek teknik aksaklıkları ve uygunsuzlukları soğukkanlılıkla, analitik ve hızlı bir şekilde çözüme kavuşturmak (Troubleshooting), Sistemlerin çalıştırma, fonksiyonel test ve performans testlerini gerçekleştirmek; devreye alma raporlarını ve punch list (eksik/hatalı işler) takibini eksiksiz olarak tüm dokümantasyon süreçlerini yönetmek, Müşteri ve saha ekipleriyle etkili iletişim kurarak, teslimatın zamanında, eksiksiz ve yüksek müşteri memnuniyetiyle gerçekleşmesini sağlamak, Sahadaki tüm operasyonları İSG (İş Sağlığı ve Güvenliği), çevre mevzuatları ve uluslararası kalite standartlarımıza (ATEX, ISO vb.) tam uyum içinde yürütmek. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Makine, Endüstri, Elektrik-Elektronik, Mekatronik veya Otomasyon Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun, Endüstriyel tesislerde, Petro Kimya, Savunma Sanayi, Maden ve Metal Sanayi sektörlerinde Saha / Devreye Alma (Commissioning) süreçlerinde deneyimli, İşveren, idare, şantiye yönetimi arasındaki teknik koordinasyonu sağlayabilen, Mekanik/elektrik projelerini, P&ID şemaları gibi ve teknik dokümantasyonları ileri düzeyde okuyabilen, hazırlayabilen ve takip edebilen, Mekanik montaj takibi ve uygunluğunun denetim süreçlerini eksiksiz yürüten, I/O testleri, PLC Otomasyon parametrelerini bilen Fonksiyonel ve saha testleri süreçlerine hakim, PnID proje kontrolleri ve proses akışına hakim, Multitasking (Çoklu Görev Yürütme) yetkinliğine sahip; sahadaki paralel test ve operasyon süreçlerini aynı anda yönetebilen, Saha şartlarında, kriz anlarında ve zaman baskısı altında analitik düşünme, problem çözme, riskleri tespit etme ve bunların dokümantasyon süreçlerini yönetmek ve uygunsuzluklarını bildirme sorumluluğuna sahip, ISO, ATEX, vb. kalite standartları ve saha İSG kuralları konusunda bilinçli, Müşteri ilişkilerinde şirketimizi temsil edebilecek güçlü iletişim ve temsil yeteneğine sahip, Seyahat temposuna ve esnek saha çalışma saatlerine uyum sağlayabilen, B sınıfı sürücü belgesine sahip ve aktif araç kullanabilen, Yurt içi ve Yurt dışı seyahat engeli olmayan, Hakkımızda; ARITES Metal olarak, 40 yılı aşkın süredir, endüstrinin ihtiyaçlarını karşılama hedefimizle, ağırlıklı olarak paslanmaz çelik kullanarak makine ve ekipman tasarlamakta ve üretmekteyiz. Standartlara uygun, yüksek dayanıklılığa sahip imalatlarımız, projeye özel teknik çözümlerimiz ve müşteri ihtiyaçlarını karşılayan tasarımlarımızla öne çıkmaktayız. 1980'li yılların başında sanayicilerimiz için yeni bir malzeme olan paslanmaz çelik, imalatta küçük miktarlarda kullanılmaya başlandı. Bu yeni pazarın ortaya çıkmasıyla beraber 1986 yılında, çubuk, sac, boru, bağlantı ekipmanları gibi paslanmaz çelik hammadde ticareti yapmak üzere ARITES Metal Ticaret ve Sanayi Ltd. şirketi kurulmuştur. İlerleyen yıllarda sanayicinin bu yeni malzeme kullanılarak üretilen ürünlere olan talebinin artmasıyla birlikte yerli üretim arzı azalmaya başlamış, ithal makine ve teçhizata bağımlılık artmıştır. Yerli sanayicilerin yerli üretim arayışları ile şirketimizin büyüme hedefleri örtüştüğünde, hammadde ticaretini bir kenara bırakıp, 1991 yılı itibariyle çeşitli endüstrilere, altyapılarını güçlendirecek özel üretim makine ve ekipman tasarımı – imalatı yapmaya başlandı. Çözüm ortağı olduğumuz sektörlerin bazıları; Kurulduğu andan itibaren çeşitli sektörlere imalat yapan firmamız; daha önce mimari ve dekoratif ürünler imalatı, gıda / çikolata imalat hatları, doğalgaz tesis bacaları üretimi, tarihi yapı güçlendirme / restorasyon ve hidroelektrik santral deşarj boruları üretimi gibi alanlarda çalışarak bilgi, beceri ve deneyimini arttırdı. Artan bilgi, beceri ve deneyimimizle sadece bu sektörlere hizmet vermekle yetinmeyerek ayrıcalıklı projelerle farklılaşmak ve çeşitliliğimizi arttırmak istedik. Bu doğrultuda çözüm ortağı olduğumuz sektörleri genişleterek; Savunma Sanayi Değerli Maden İşleme Kimya / Petrokimya Enerji Arıtma gibi sektörlerin aranan çözüm ortağı olduk. 2006’lı yılından itibaren tasarım süreçlerini de yetkinliğimize ekleyerek hizmet alanımızı daha da genişlettik ARITES Metal olarak standartlara uygun, yüksek dayanıklılığa sahip imalatlarımız, projeye özel teknik çözümlerimiz ve müşteri ihtiyaçlarını karşılayan tasarımlarımızla öne çıkmaya başladık. ISO 3834 – 2:2021 Metalik Malzemelerin Füzyon Kaynağı için Kalite Gereksinimleri ve TSE EN IS0 9001:2015 Kalite Yönetim Sistemi, TSE EN ISO 14001 :2015 standartlarına uygunluğun yanında, CE ve ATEX ZONE sertifikaları ve ayrıca ASME, AD MERKBLATT ve ATEX standartlarına uygunluk için üretim denetimleri adına bağımsız denetim kurumlarıyla da çalışmaya başladık. Misyonumuz: Müşteri memnuniyeti için standartları kullanarak projelere özel - standart dışı ürünler üretmek bilinci ile, müşteriye özel çözüm önerileri sağlıyoruz, çünkü biliyoruz ki ihtiyaçların giderilmesi her ölçüye uyan standart çözümlerle değil kendisine özel çözümlerle giderilebilmektedir. Vizyonumuz: Yerel sermayeli bir şirket olarak bize ilham veren ideal, Türkiye’deki çeşitli endüstrilerin makine ve ekipman ihtiyaçlarıyla sektörlerin gelişmesine, ürettiği bilgi ve sunduğu çözümlerle öncülük eden uluslararası düzeyde başvurulan bir mühendislik markası olmaktır. Temel Değerlerimiz: ARITES Metal olarak, müşteriye özel çözümleri, doğru ve zamanında teslimatı, kaliteli hizmet anlayışının merkezine koymaktayız; bu kapsamda sektörümüze de örnek olmak bilinciyle çalışmalarımızı sürdürmekteyiz. Temel değerlerimiz, tüm çalışmalarımızın özünde yer alacak ve kısa vadeli kazançlar

Görev Tanımı Mağaza ve depo yatırımlarına ilişkin mimari, inşai ve mekanik uygulamaların şirket standartlarına, onaylı projelere, sözleşmelere ve teknik şartnamelere uygun şekilde yürütülmesini sağlamak, İnşaat, mekanik ve yatırım projelerine ilişkin teknik şartname, keşif, metraj ve kabul kriterlerini hazırlamak, İnşaat ve mekanik işlere yönelik ihale ve teknik satın alma süreçlerini uçtan uca yönetmek, Tedarikçi ve yüklenicilerin teknik yeterliliklerini değerlendirmek, teklifleri teknik açıdan incelemek ve süreçlerini takip etmek, Mağaza ve depo uygulamalarında saha kontrolleri ve kalite denetimleri gerçekleştirmek, Açılış öncesinde inşai ve mekanik uygulamaların kontrolünü ve gerekli teknik kontrollerin tamamlanmasını sağlamak, Saha kaynaklı inşaat ve mekanik problemlere teknik çözümler geliştirmek, tekrarlayan sorunlara yönelik kalıcı çözüm ve standartlar oluşturmak, Soğutma, klima, havalandırma, soğuk oda ve diğer mekanik sistemlerin teknik uygunluğunu, enerji verimliliğini ve sürdürülebilirliğini takip etmek, Garanti kapsamındaki eksiklik, kusur ve arızaları takip ederek gerekli aksiyonların alınmasını sağlamak, Sorumluluk alanındaki projelerde ilgili departmanlarla koordineli çalışmak. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin inşaat veya makine bölümlerinden mezun, İnşaat, mekanik ve yatırım projeleri alanlarında en az 7 yıl deneyimli, İnşaat veya mekanik uygulamalar, yatırım projeleri ve saha yönetimi konusunda deneyimli, İhale, teknik şartname, keşif ve metraj süreçlerine hakim, Proje ve zaman yönetimi konusunda yetkin, Tedarikçi ve yüklenici yönetimi konusunda deneyimli, Analitik düşünme, problem çözme ve sonuç odaklı çalışma becerisine sahip, Ekip çalışmasına ve güçlü iletişim becerilerine sahip, MS Office ve ilgili teknik programları etkin kullanabilen, İngilizce bilen, Ankara’da ikamet eden veya edebilecek.

title: Field Service Engineer
description: At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world. This Position reports to: Service Workshop Manager The work model for the role is: {onsite} Your Role And Responsibilities Perform workshop tasks such as troubleshooting, maintenance, repair, assembly and testing. Conducting through inspections and assessments of equipment to identify and diagnose electrical and mechanical issues. Utilizing specialized tools and equipment for vibration analysis to assess the condition of motors and generators, performing vibration analysis to identify potential faults, defects or abnormalities in the equipment Applies safety rules and safe practices as well as environmental responsibilities. Proactively executes work on first-time right approach and ensures the job is done on time and on quality Contributes to customer satisfaction by executing workshop orders according to workshop processes and guidelines. Checks bill of materials and other documents to identify required parts for needed for service activity and ensures that all materials, parts, and equipment are available. Preparing comprehensive reports documenting service activities, including findings, recommendations and actions taken. Frequent domestic travelling will be required, as the role will require hands-on support at customer sites. International travelling might also be required for field services and training purposes. Qualifications For The Role Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electrical/Electronic engineering. Minimum 2 years of experience in servicing, maintaining, commissioning and repairing of Electrical Machines and applications. Knowledge of AC/DC Motors/ Generators. Good level of English, both written and spoken. Turkish knowledge is a must. Proven leadership skills, with a collaborative, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills. Flexibility and quick adaptation to frequent scheduling updates. Valid driving license (type B). We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: SENIOR SALES ENGINEER / HVAC
description: We are looking for a Senior Sales Engineer / Equipment who will be responsible for developing trusting customer relationships and maximizing account share. The person will be working closely with customers to understand their needs and deliver value-driven HVAC solutions that support their business objectives. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential clients. Provide knowledge and consultation in the form of developing HVAC system related solutions for the customer's problems, including financial and performance-based considerations. Experience working with designers/consultants and a solid technical understanding of HVAC applications. Strong communication skills. Fluent in English. Valid driver's license and active driving experience. Job Offer Great career opportunity in a leading global company.

title: Field Service Engineer/Saha Servis Mühendisi Adana - Turkey
description: Are you… Interested in working for an international and diverse company? Interested in developing your career in a leading Printing, Coding and Marking industry? Looking to use your troubleshooting skill? If so, read on! It’s likely you have purchased or used a product touched by Videojet Technologies this week. From freshness dating to track and trace coding, our technologies help ensure products sold across the globe are authentic and safe for consumers to use in the food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and industrial marketplaces. We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is a key to innovation and excellence. Therefore, we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions. The Field Service Engineer at Videojet Technologies plays a key and vital role in supporting our Customers and ensuring that our ‘Up Time Peace of Mind’ goal is achieved. They are responsible for installing, repairing, and servicing the range of Videojet Equipment. The position will be located in Adana, Turkiye. In this role, a typical day will look like: Install and commission new Videojet solutions Maintain and Service our customers’ installed base of Videojet equipment Work closely with sales to support Videojet trials and demonstrations Maintain and grow customer relationships through excellent customer service and communication. The essential requirements of the job include: Field Service Experience at customer sites or remotely via phone Experienced within 2-3 years the marking and coding industry, industrial automation or related industry Experienced within automation / PLC communication Demonstrated success in overachieving on personal targets Preferably fluent in written and spoken English Willingness to travel within the Turkiye Videojet is proud to be a Product Quality & Innovation company in Veralto (NYSE: VLTO). Imagine a world where everyone has access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. That is the tomorrow Veralto is creating today. Veralto is a $5B global leader in essential technology solutions made up of over 16,000 associates across our Water Quality and Product Identification segments all united by a powerful purpose: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources. Siz de… Uluslararası ve farklı kültürlerden profesyonellerin yer aldığı bir şirkette çalışmak ister misiniz? Baskı, kodlama ve markalama sektörünün lider şirketlerinden birinde kariyerinizi geliştirmeyi hedefliyor musunuz? Problem çözme ve teknik arıza giderme becerilerinizi kullanabileceğiniz bir pozisyon mu arıyorsunuz? Cevabınız evet ise, okumaya devam edin! Muhtemelen bu hafta satın aldığınız veya kullandığınız ürünlerden en az biri Videojet Technologies'in teknolojileriyle işaretlenmiş durumdadır. Son kullanma tarihi uygulamalarından izlenebilirlik (track & trace) kodlamalarına kadar sunduğumuz çözümler; gıda, içecek, ilaç ve endüstriyel sektörlerde dünya genelinde satılan ürünlerin orijinalliğini ve tüketiciler için güvenliğini sağlamaya yardımcı olmaktadır. Farklı deneyimlere ve yeteneklere sahip insanların başarıya katkı sağladığına inanıyoruz. Deneyim, bilgi birikimi ve tutkuyla birleşen çeşitlilik; yenilikçilik ve mükemmelliğin temelini oluşturur. Bu nedenle, farklı geçmişlerden gelen tüm adayları açık pozisyonlarımıza başvurmaya davet ediyoruz. Sürdürülebilirliği nasıl desteklediğimizi gösteren Videojet tanıtım videomuzu izleyebilirsiniz! Videojet Technologies bünyesindeki Saha Servis Mühendisi (Field Service Engineer) , müşterilerimize destek sağlamak ve "Up Time Peace of Mind" hedefimizi gerçekleştirmek açısından kritik bir rol üstlenir. Bu pozisyonda görev alacak kişi, Videojet ürünlerinin kurulumu, devreye alınması, bakımı ve onarımından sorumlu olacaktır. Pozisyonun çalışma yeri Adana , Türkiye 'dir. Bu rolde sizi neler bekliyor? Yeni Videojet çözümlerinin kurulumunu ve devreye alınmasını gerçekleştirmek, Müşterilerimizde kurulu bulunan Videojet ekipmanlarının bakım ve servis hizmetlerini sunmak, Satış ekibiyle yakın çalışarak ürün denemeleri ve demonstrasyon süreçlerine destek vermek, Üstün müşteri hizmeti ve etkili iletişim ile müşteri ilişkilerini sürdürmek ve geliştirmek. Aradığımız nitelikler Müşteri sahasında veya uzaktan telefon desteğiyle servis deneyimine sahip olmak, Markalama ve kodlama, endüstriyel otomasyon veya benzer sektörlerde 2-3 yıl deneyim sahibi olmak, Otomasyon sistemleri ve Plc haberleşme konusunda deneyimli olmak, Kişisel hedeflerini düzenli olarak aşan başarılı bir performans geçmişine sahip olmak, Tercihen yazılı ve sözlü İngilizce bilgisine sahip olmak, Türkiye genelinde seyahat engeli bulunmamak. Veralto bünyesinde faaliyet gösteren Videojet Technologies olarak, gıda, ilaç ve temel ihtiyaç ürünlerinin güvenliğinin herkes için vazgeçilmez bir hak olduğuna inanıyoruz. Ürün tanımlama teknolojilerinde dünya liderlerinden biri olarak geliştirdiğimiz yenilikçi kodlama ve markalama çözümleri sayesinde müşterilerimizin ürün güvenliğini sağlamalarına ve verimliliklerini artırmalarına destek oluyoruz. Videojet, Veralto (NYSE: VLTO) çatısı altında faaliyet gösteren, ürün kalitesi ve inovasyon odaklı bir şirkettir. Herkesin temiz suya, güvenli gıdaya, güvenilir ilaçlara ve temel ihtiyaç ürünlerine erişebildiği bir dünya hayal ediyoruz. Veralto bugün, yarının bu dünyasını inşa ediyor. Yaklaşık 5 milyar dolar büyüklüğünde küresel bir teknoloji şirketi olan Veralto, 16.000'den fazla çalışanıyla , Su Kalitesi (Water Quality) ve Ürün Tanımlama (Product Identification) iş kollarında faaliyet göstermekte ve tek bir ortak amaç doğrultusunda çalışmaktadır: Dünyanın en değerli kaynaklarını korumak. title: Field Service Specialist – Laboratory Automation (Türkiye)
description: Overview At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible. We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams. We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you. At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact. Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery. ‎ About The Opportunity Join QIAGEN as a Field Service Specialist supporting our advanced automation platforms and molecular diagnostic solutions across Türkiye. In this customer-facing role, you will ensure high performance and reliability of laboratory instrumentation while building strong partnerships with clinical and research customers. Based in Türkiye, you will travel extensively to provide expert on-site technical support, contributing directly to customer success and service excellence. Your Tasks Deliver on-site installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of QIAGEN automation systems and analytical instruments as well as a wide variety of industry leading Partner instruments such as the Element Biosciences Aviti, Elitech Begenius, Diasorin Luminex systems, Seegene Nimbus. Provide technical support across hardware, software, and application usage for laboratory devices and collaborate with internal teams (service, sales, application support) to resolve complex technical cases. Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with customers and key stakeholders representing QIAGEN professionally in all customer interactions and act as a brand ambassador. Support service KPIs and contribute to customer satisfaction, retention, and business growth. Ensure accurate, timely documentation in CRM systems and compliance with regulatory requirements. Actively promote Field Service products and assist Sales in lead generation using Salesforce CRM software to improve efficiency of repairs and service satisfaction. Manage stock inventory, test equipment and vehicle maintenance. Provide cross-border/ district/ region support when required. Your Profile Please submit your application in English Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Biomedical Engineering, or a related field; molecular biology knowledge is a plus. Proven experience in field service, technical support, or instrumentation maintenance (minimum ~3 years preferred). Experience servicing laboratory or medical devices within clinical diagnostics, MDx, IVD, or related environments. Solid IT knowledge including networking, system integration, or LIMS (preferred). Proven ability to build and maintain positive relationships with customers. Fluent Turkish and professional English communication skills (written and spoken). Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel extensively (up to ~85%) within Türkiye and occasionally internationally. Has already completed military service (male candidates). What We Offer Bonus/Commission Local benefits Referral Program Volunteer Day Internal Academy (QIALearn) Employee Assistance Program Hybrid work (conditional to your role) Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking. QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.

title: Retail Designer
description: Retail Designer, (In Market) Location – Istanbul, Turkey Reports to: Account Manager, Client Services Tag seeks an retail designer, to join our Middle East team! Are you self-motivated with a “can do” attitude? Are you experienced and love working in the Permanent POS space? Do you possess world class project management skills? How would you like to work for a global marketing production services organisation with a client base of blue chip FTSE100 and Fortune 500 companies within the Retail, FMCG, eCom, Beauty and CPG sectors? Sound good so far? Then this is the perfect position for you, and you are just the individual that we are looking for! The Job: As Retail Designer, you will contribute to Tag’s success by delivering outstanding retail designs, strategy, and implementation across the region you work within. The work you undertake will cover the end to end design process and will uphold the high levels of service, design and delivery Tag has built since its inception. Tag now as part of a larger marketing and communications business and has opportunities to rapidly grow its offering in multiple markets. You will be expected to capitalise on these opportunities when they arise. You will work in close partnership with other peers and the larger Tag team to ensure client expectations are exceeded and Tag continues in its mission to become a global leader in shopper-based design. As retail designer, you will be: - A 3D Designer: You will develop unique design solutions in response to a client’s brand design direction. You will have a strong 3D design mindset, and execute a variety of designs that fulfil, elevate, and add value to the customer’s brief. You will effectively present ideas and share design work with a clear, logical and understandable narrative. You will have a positive attitude to overcome road blocks and challenges, striving to always improve the offering to Tag’s clients. It will be key to see the opportunities within each project to stretch the client’s thinking while also maintaining a real-life mindset around budgets and execution. - A Strategist: You will be expected to work with the senior Tag team to create market and client specific strategies on a project by project basis to ensure Tag can attract, win, and maintain client relationships that are profitable and cost effective. As part of the larger organisation Tag sits within you will also from time to time be expected to help strategize how Tag’s offering can work within the larger business for both new and existing customers. - A Professional: You will fully own the design of each project from concept to design development, developing visuals and production ready drawings to support the execution of it. You will have responsibility for the structural design of all projects and be able to efficiently organise the production process with Tag’s network of internal and external stakeholder. You will prioritize your work, in order to execute multiple projects at one time, including the management of the production of design projects with the larger network of designers, creatives, and engineers within Tag’s global team. - A Leader: You will be expected to lead the Tag mission within your market and over time as the workload requires look to build a team to support you on this mission. You will be assisted with this to ensure Tag remains profitable and continues its sustainable growth. You will have the opportunity to create your own specific role within Tag over time to ensure you gain satisfaction from your work and feel you are best utilising your skill set. - A Team Player: With a diverse and multidisciplinary team around the globe, you will collaborate and work side by side with industrial designers, graphic designers, developers, consultants, and suppliers on projects. Your work will contribute to global development business goals by achieving targeted deliverables and KPIs as agreed. - A Storyteller and Representative: Your will share the Tag ethos and value proposition both internally within the larger business organisation and with external clients. You will represent the Tag brand within the market you operate and be expected to champion the Tag process always. - An Explorer: You will participate in periodic market tours, to learn and stay tuned with market and industry trends. You will embark in your own journey, where you will constantly be expected to learn and develop your knowledge of both retail and the greater design field to ensure Tag remains industry relevant and a leader in design and production. Qualifications & skills required: · Degree in Interior Architecture, Product/Industrial Design, or equivalent design discipline. · Design experience, preferably in retail, POSM, shopper marketing, or brand activation design. · Experience in creating 3D structural design solutions across a range of project types and scales. · Experience in producing visual design content and delivering design documentation, including technical drawings, dimensions, material specifications, and production details. · Strong understanding of production processes, materials, technical feasibility, logistics, and implementation. Proficiency in: -Autodesk 3ds Max -V-Ray -AutoCAD -Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) -Microsoft Office 365 -Windows -Tag (Client Specific) server locations, naming conventions, setup, and procedures -File management and cloud-based collaboration platforms Please note: Due to the high volume of responses received for this role we will not be able to contact all applicants directly. If you have not heard from us in four weeks, please consider your application unsuccessful. *As an ethical employer, Tag will never ask job applicants to provide private, sensitive information upfront or make offers of employment contingent on financial requests or responsibilities from any candidate. *

From autonomous cars to life-saving robots, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same. Joining Capgemini's Hardware team You will be joining a team of passionate engineers working at the cutting edge of high-tech mechanical design. This is a role for a driven, experienced engineer who is ready to take full ownership of their work, raise standards around them, and take the next step towards a Lead Engineer position. Facilitate knowledge sharing, contribute to improving engineering methods and team ways of working, and take ownership of specific technical topics or work packages. You are adaptable across different project types, reliable in execution, and capable of driving work independently while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary teams. Education & Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, or a related field, with at least 5 years of experience in mechanical design and development within a high-tech environment. Proven experience working in multidisciplinary project teams and delivering high-quality design work independently, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
