title: Senior / Systems Engineer (Battery & Energy Storage Systems)
description: Senior / Systems Engineer – Battery & Energy Storage Systems As Altınay Savunma Teknolojileri , we are looking for a Senior / Systems Engineer to join our Battery and Energy Storage Systems (BESS/ESS) projects developed for the defense industry. In this role, you will play an active part throughout the entire product lifecycle, from concept design and system integration to testing and validation, mass production, field commissioning, and product lifecycle management . Responsibilities Analyze requirements and develop system requirements for battery and energy storage systems designed for land, naval, aerial, and unmanned platforms . Ensure traceability of system and subsystem requirements. Contribute to the design, integration, testing, and validation processes of BMS, high-/low-voltage power distribution systems, and thermal management systems . Conduct testing, commissioning, and platform integration activities in both laboratory and field environments. Support the resolution of technical issues encountered during mass production processes. Contribute to the preparation of production and assembly instructions and apply Design for Manufacturing (DFM) principles. Conduct ECR/ECO, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and technical sustainability activities throughout the product lifecycle. Prepare and execute test plans in accordance with MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461 , and relevant battery safety and validation standards. Work collaboratively with Mechanical, Electronics, Software, Quality, and Production teams. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Control & Automation Engineering, Systems Engineering , or a related field. At least 3 years of experience in battery systems, Li-ion cell technologies, BMS, or high-voltage power distribution systems. Strong knowledge of systems engineering processes, including requirements analysis, V-Model, architectural design, testing, and validation . Good understanding of the operating principles, types, and electrical/chemical characteristics of lithium-ion cells . Ability to perform practical energy, power, and electrical sizing calculations . Knowledge of communication protocols such as CAN Bus, Modbus, Ethernet , etc. Experience with system modeling and simulation tools . Knowledge of MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461 , or relevant military battery safety and validation standards. Good command of English , particularly for technical documentation and communication. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a collaborative and team-oriented mindset. Willingness to take an active role in field activities. No restrictions on travel and ability to adapt to flexible working conditions. Preferred Qualifications Experience working on energy storage system projects for land, naval, aerial, or unmanned platforms . Field experience in FAT and SAT processes. Experience with DFMEA/PFMEA and Root Cause Analysis activities. Knowledge of battery safety standards and safe design solutions . Strong interest in and awareness of current battery and energy storage technologies . Why Altınay? At Altınay Savunma Teknolojileri , we offer the opportunity to work on projects shaping the future of defense technologies, at the intersection of high technology, systems engineering, and advanced energy solutions . If you are looking to take technical responsibility in the development of battery and energy storage systems, collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, and contribute to end-to-end product development processes in defense industry projects , we would be pleased to welcome you to our team. Location: Istanbul / Pendik - Teknopark Istanbul We look forward to receiving your application and welcoming you to our team.

title: Senior RFIC Validation Engineer
description: Job Description: As a Sr. RFIC Validation Engineer in mmwave/RF IC group, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of RF & mmwave products (such as beamformers, up/downconverters, LNAs, PAs, etc.) through comprehensive final test implementation. You will be responsible for the ATE final test development of mmWave/RF projects and be the leading force in the development cycle of Axiro’s innovative test solutions. Primary Responsibilities: Delivering high-quality test solutions for complex RF/mmWave front-end ICs. Developing and implementing test plans, test cases, and test procedures based on RF/mmwave product specifications and requirements. Designing and executing test setups using automated test equipment (ATE), probe stations, oscilloscopes, and other testing tools. Programming and scripting in languages such as Python, C, or C++ to automate test processes and analyze test data. Conducting thorough test validation and verification to ensure accurate and reliable testing results. Collaborating with cross-functional teams including design engineers, manufacturing teams, and quality assurance (QA) teams to address technical issues and optimize testing processes. Analyzing test results, identifying trends, troubleshooting issues, and generating detailed test reports and documentation. Planning and overseeing the loadboard hardware development for RF & mmwave IC products. Staying updated with industry trends, advancements, and best practices in semiconductor testing methodologies. Qualifications: Test Engineer with 3+ Years experience developing hardware and software at Wafer Sort and Final Test for RF & mmwave IC products. Experience using Advantest 93k, Teradyne MicroFlex, and other establish automated tester solutions. Previous experience and product track record with high performance RFIC test development (experience on beamformer IC is a big plus). Fundamental RF knowledge including main RF performance specifications such as Gain, Return loss, NF, P1dB, IP3, ACPR, EVM, etc. Experience using I2C, I3C, and SPI protocol. Understand procedures such as GR&R, HTOL, Characterization. Prior experience leading external contractors for test hardware and software development. Self-starter, motivated, takes initiative, and able to work independently.

description: Yetiştirilmek Üzere Üretim Personeli ( Mühendislik Hariç) Genel Nitelikler Elektronik malzemelere ilgi duyan, Meslek Lisesi veya Meslek Yüksekokullarının; Elektronik, Elektrik-Elektronik, Elektrik, Mekatronik, Makine, Bilişim Teknolojileri, Uçak Teknolojisi, Biyomedikal Cihaz Teknolojileri veya ilgili diğer teknik bölümlerinden mezun, Elektronik ve üretim alanında kendisini geliştirmek isteyen, Erkek adaylar için askerlik hizmetini tamamlamış veya askerlik hizmetinden muaf, İletişim becerileri güçlü, Ekip çalışmasına yatkın, Dikkatli ve detaylı çalışabilen, gözlem yeteneği gelişmiş, Sorumluluk sahibi ve disiplinli çalışma düzenine uyum sağlayabilecek, Mesleki gelişime ve eğitimlere açık, Ankara'da ikamet eden, Vardiyalı çalışma düzenine ve gerektiğinde fazla mesaiye uyum sağlayabilecek. İş Tanımı Yürütülen projelerde prototip üretim, montaj, el dizgisi ve test çalışmalarına destek olmak, PCB ve kablo dizgisi, lehimleme, montaj ve test işlemlerini gerçekleştirmek, Üretim hattında kendisine verilen görevleri zamanında, eksiksiz ve üretim talimatlarına uygun şekilde yerine getirmek, Parça montajı, ürün birleştirme, makineye ürün besleme, manuel montaj, yarı mamul ve son ürün kontrolü, paketleme gibi üretim süreçlerinde görev almak, Ürünlerin doğrulama, üretim ve kalite süreçlerinde kullanılacak testleri gerçekleştirmek, Seri üretime devredilen ürünlerin üretim ve kalite kontrol faaliyetlerine destek olmak, Eğitim ve işbaşı öğrenme sürecinde kendisine verilen teknik görevleri öğrenmek ve uygulamak. title: Sr. Solutions Engineer
description: At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation. Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive. The Sr. Solutions Engineer at F5 is responsible for driving new business and revenue growth by helping customers identify the products, solutions, and services that best meet their needs. This role involves setting sales strategies and policies, managing the execution of plans, and providing technical expertise throughout the sales process. In this position, the Sr. Solutions Engineer supports architectural designs and implementation strategies of complex products and solutions to address challenging customer problems. Leveraging deep product knowledge, they provide technical guidance to both sales teams and customers through proof-of-concepts (POCs), solution design, and architecture services. They collaborate with sales staff to assess potential applications of F5 products. Additionally, the role may include creating detailed design plans after thoroughly understanding the customer’s application journey. This can involve designing solutions and product demonstrations to validate feasibility. Solutions Engineers may also consult prospective users and assess or validate product capabilities to ensure the solution meets customer requirements. What You’ll Do: Develop and implement technical strategies that support the overall sales objectives of the organization. Act as a thought leader in the industry, representing the company at conferences, webinars, and industry events. Lead the design of highly complex, integrated solutions that address the unique challenges of strategic clients. Mentor other solutions engineers, providing guidance on complex technical and strategic issues. Engage with strategic clients at the executive level to understand their long-term goals and align solutions accordingly. What You’ll Bring: Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related areas, or equivalent level of experience. 8+ years’ pre-sales experience in the IT industry, expertise in networking, application delivery, security, cloud and SaaS etc. technologies. Considered an internal subject matter expert within the function. Consistently acts as a resource for other functions such as sales engineering, sales management, and inside sales. Requires conceptual thinking to understand advanced issues and implications. Ability to select and improve processes to sell across F5’s product portfolio. Expert level understanding of Web Protocols and application architectures (HTTP/TLS/SSL), programming languages (Python, JavaScript, Golang, etc.), and Kubernetes concepts and architectures. Advanced knowledge of Networking, Data Center, Virtualization, Cloud computing environments, Solution Performance, and Sizing. Expert in Solution designs for large-scale environments and Vertical Market solutions. Native-level or business-fluent proficiency in English is highly preferred. What You’ll Get: Hybrid working mode Career growth and development opportunities Recognitions and Rewards Employee Assistance Program Competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and cool perks Culture of Giving Back Dynamic Diversity & Inclusion Interest Groups The Job Description is intended to be a general representation of the responsibilities and requirements of the job. However, the description may not be all-inclusive, and responsibilities and requirements are subject to change. Please note that F5 only contacts candidates through F5 email address (ending with @f5.com) or auto email notification from Workday (ending with f5.com or @myworkday.com) . This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, discipline, and termination. F5 offers a variety of reasonable accommodations for candidates. Requesting an accommodation is completely voluntary. F5 will assess the need for accommodations in the application process separately from those that may be needed to perform the job. Request by contacting accommodations@f5.com.

title: Senior Quotation Engineer
description: Unlock Your Potential at Eaton: Where Diversity Drives Innovation. No matter where you come from, your aspirations matter to us. We believe in the power of different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds to ignite innovation and drive success. We're in the business of empowering people, and that includes you. Your journey here is not just about a job; it's about a shared vision for a brighter, more sustainable future. We are seeking a Senior Quotation Engineer to join our team. As a Senior Quotation Engineer for Medium Voltage solutions, you will play a key role in delivering accurate, competitive, and technically compliant quotations for customers across EMEA, focusing on utility, data center, and industrial segments. Your primary responsibility is to analyze customer requirements, identify the most suitable Eaton solution, and prepare optimized techno-commercial offers for Medium Voltage switchgear applications. Working closely with Sales, BDMs, Application Engineers, and other plant stakeholders, you will manage assigned quotations from RFQ receipt through handover to execution teams. The role requires strong technical expertise, commercial awareness, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver customer-focused solutions, support profitable business growth, and effectively manage deal risks. What You’ll Do Deliver high-quality quotations within agreed timelines, ensuring technical accuracy, commercial competitiveness, and compliance with customer requirements. Review and analyze customer specifications, single-line diagrams, datasheets, schedules, and project/tender documentation to identify technical and commercial requirements. Select, configure, and optimize Medium Voltage switchgear solutions in line with customer requirements, applicable standards, and Eaton product capabilities. Own the preparation of complete techno-commercial offers by coordinating technical and commercial inputs from relevant stakeholders and ensuring delivery of high-quality customer proposal packages. Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to ensure proposed solutions are technically compliant, feasible to execute, and aligned with customer requirements. Develop competitive quotations by balancing customer expectations, technical requirements, lead times, project/tender risks, and profitability objectives. Identify, assess, and communicate technical, commercial, and execution risks, while supporting mitigation actions throughout the quotation process. Manage quotation revisions, customer clarification requests, and support the successful handover of awarded projects to execution teams. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, knowledge sharing, and lessons learned activities while maintaining awareness of market trends, competitor offerings, and product developments. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent. Minimum 5 years of experience in quotation and tendering activities within the electrical power distribution industry, with proven knowledge of Medium Voltage (MV) switchgear solutions and exposure to international projects. Skills Strong knowledge of Medium Voltage (MV) switchgear products, applications, and power distribution systems. Commercially aware, with the ability to balance technical compliance, competitiveness, profitability, and risk. Knowledge of transformers, E-House solutions, and Low Voltage (LV) power distribution systems is considered an advantage. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities. Customer-focused, with strong attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Commitment to Eaton Culture Model principles and behaviors. What We Offer Competitive compensation and benefits package Challenging projects in dynamic collaborative team Flexible working solutions We make your aspirations matter – Eaton encourages internal promotion, whenever possible We make your growth matter - We invest in our employees for the long term – not just with salary and benefits, but with ongoing learning and development opportunities made available through Eaton University We make your contributions matter - reliability, safety, efficiency, and sustainability are at the core of our dedication to improving people’s lives and the environment through power management technologies. We make your wellbeing matter – We put your health and safety first. Wellness at Eaton is more than a program, it’s about changing the environment by offering the right tools to help empower employees to make that happen. All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.\

title: TEKNİK SATIŞ VE İŞ GELİŞTİRME UZMANI
description: Danışmanlığını yürüttüğümüz Next Layer, endüstriyel 3D baskı ve eklemeli imalat alanındaki büyüme stratejisi doğrultusunda ekibini güçlendiriyor. Multi Jet Fusion (MJF) teknolojisiyle seri imalat, fonksiyonel nihai parça ve prototipleme alanlarında faaliyet gösteren Next Layer için; teknik satış deneyimine sahip, B2B müşteri ilişkilerini geliştirebilen, yeni iş fırsatları yaratabilen ve satış süreçlerini sonuç odaklı yönetebilecek bir Teknik Satış ve İş Geliştirme Uzmanı arıyoruz. İlan Detayları : Eklemeli İmalat | MJF NextLayer olarak, endüstriyel Multi Jet Fusion (MJF) üretim altyapımızla; prototiplemeden fonksiyonel nihai parçalara, düşük ve orta adetli üretimlerden seri imalata kadar farklı üretim ihtiyaçlarına yönelik çözümler sunuyoruz. Büyüyen üretim kapasitemizi yeni müşteriler, yeni projeler ve sürdürülebilir ticari ilişkilerle buluşturmak üzere; eklemeli imalat sektörünü tanıyan, teknik ihtiyaçları anlayabilen, yeni müşteri kazanımı konusunda güçlü ve bu ihtiyaçları satış fırsatına dönüştürebilen deneyimli bir Teknik Satış ve İş Geliştirme Uzmanı arıyoruz. Bu pozisyonda yalnızca mevcut talepleri veya hazır bir müşteri portföyünü yönetmek değil; sektörel deneyim ve ilişkilerden yararlanarak yeni müşteriler bulmak, yeni uygulama alanları keşfetmek, sıfırdan satış fırsatları yaratmak ve bunları sürdürülebilir ticari ilişkilere dönüştürmek temel beklentimizdir. Görev ve Sorumluluklar NextLayer’ın endüstriyel MJF ve eklemeli imalat hizmetlerinin B2B satış ve iş geliştirme faaliyetlerini yürütmek, Savunma sanayii, havacılık, otomotiv, medikal, makine ve otomasyon başta olmak üzere hedef sektörlerde yeni müşteri ve proje fırsatları geliştirmek, Sektörel deneyim ve mevcut profesyonel ilişkilerden yararlanırken aktif saha çalışmalarıyla yeni müşteri portföyü oluşturmak, Potansiyel müşterilerde teknik ve ticari karar vericilere ulaşmak; müşterinin üretim ihtiyacını, mevcut üretim yöntemini ve karşılaştığı problemleri doğru analiz etmek, Teknik ekiple koordineli çalışarak MJF teknolojisinin müşterinin ihtiyacına uygun kullanım alanlarını ve çözüm alternatiflerini belirlemek, MJF teknolojisinin kalıpsız üretim, kısa termin, tasarım esnekliği, mekanik performans ve seri üretim kabiliyetlerini doğru uygulamalarda müşteri açısından somut bir ticari avantaja dönüştürmek, Satış fırsatlarını ilk temastan ihtiyaç analizine, teknik değerlendirmeden teklif ve fiyatlandırmaya, müzakereden siparişe kadar uçtan uca yönetmek, Kazanılan müşterilerde tekrar sipariş hacmini artırmak ve uzun vadeli ticari ilişkiler geliştirmek, Pazar, rakip, müşteri ve sektör hareketlerini takip ederek yeni iş ve uygulama alanlarının geliştirilmesine katkı sağlamak, Müşteri ziyaretlerini, görüşmeleri, teklifleri, devam eden satış fırsatlarını ve planlanan aksiyonları düzenli olarak kayıt altına almak; satış pipeline’ını güncel tutmak ve yönetime periyodik, ölçülebilir ve sonuç odaklı satış raporları sunmak, Sahadan edinilen müşteri, pazar ve rekabet bilgisini ilgili ekiplerle zamanında ve düzenli olarak paylaşmak. Aradığımız Nitelikler Üniversitelerin lisans veya ön lisans programlarından mezun, Eklemeli imalat / 3D baskı sektöründe aktif B2B satış ve iş geliştirme deneyimine sahip olmak (bu pozisyon için temel kriterdir) , Sektörde müşteri ilişkileri ve profesyonel temas ağı bulunan; mevcut ilişkilerini geliştirebilmenin yanı sıra sıfırdan yeni müşteri ve proje fırsatları yaratabilecek, Savunma sanayii, havacılık, otomotiv, medikal, makine, otomasyon veya benzeri endüstriyel sektörlerde müşteri ilişkileri geliştirebilecek, MJF, SLS veya benzeri endüstriyel eklemeli imalat teknolojileri hakkında bilgi sahibi, PA12 ve benzeri mühendislik polimerlerinin temel özelliklerine ve endüstriyel kullanım alanlarına aşina, Teknik bir ihtiyacı anlayabilecek ve bunu ticari bir fırsata dönüştürebilecek analitik düşünce yapısına sahip, Mühendislik, Ar-Ge, üretim, satın alma ve yönetim ekipleriyle farklı seviyelerde etkin iletişim kurabilecek, Teklif hazırlama, fiyatlandırma ve ticari müzakere süreçlerinde deneyimli, Yeni müşteri araştırma, ilk temas oluşturma, müşteri ziyareti ve aktif saha satışından güç alan, İletişim, sunum, müzakere ve ikna becerileri güçlü, Müşteri ve fırsat takibini sistematik biçimde yürüten; düzenli raporlama ve bilgi paylaşımını satış disiplininin doğal bir parçası olarak gören, Hedef ve sonuç odaklı, takip yeteneği ve sorumluluk bilinci yüksek. Bu Rolde Başarıyı Nasıl Tanımlıyoruz? NextLayer’da bu pozisyonun başarısını yalnızca gerçekleştirilen satış tutarıyla değerlendirmiyoruz. Yeni müşteri kazanımı, oluşturulan nitelikli satış fırsatları, tekliflerin siparişe dönüşme oranı, tekrar sipariş hacmi, geliştirilen müşteri ilişkilerinin sürdürülebilirliği ve satış sürecinin düzenli olarak takip edilerek raporlanması rolün temel performans göstergelerini oluşturacaktır. Aradığımız ekip arkadaşımızdan yalnızca satış gerçekleştirmesini değil; ölçülebilir, takip edilebilir ve sürdürülebilir bir satış portföyü oluşturmasını bekliyoruz. NextLayer’da Sizi Ne Bekliyor? NextLayer’da bu rol yalnızca mevcut talepleri karşılayan bir satış pozisyonu değil; şirketin büyümesine doğrudan etki eden, yeni müşteriler ve yeni uygulama alanları geliştiren aktif bir sorumluluk alanıdır. Endüstriyel eklemeli imalatın gelişen kullanım alanlarında çalışma; savunma sanayii, havacılık, otomotiv, medikal, makine ve otomasyon gibi farklı sektörlerde teknik ve ticari karar vericilerle ilişki geliştirme; güçlü bir MJF üretim altyapısını sahada temsil etme ve müşterinin ilk ihtiyacından projenin siparişe dönüşmesine kadar sürecin tamamında etkin rol üstlenme fırsatı sunuyoruz. Teknik ekibimizle yakın çalışırken kendi müşteri ve fırsat havuzunuzu geliştirebileceğiniz; yarattığınız yeni işin ve ticari etkinin doğrudan görülebildiği bir çalışma ortamının parçası olacaksınız. Pozisyon kapsamında sabit ücretin yanı sıra satış performansına dayalı prim sistemi uygulanmakta; saha ve müşteri ziyaretleri için gerekli ulaşım desteği şirket tarafından sağla

title: Engineer / Scientist / Technical or Mechanical Expert

As a patent examiner, you'll assess whether inventions meet the criteria for patent protection, and in doing so support innovation that improves lives, drives industries and shapes the future. We are an inclusive, purpose-driven organisation committed to sustainability, fairness and excellence – diversity is part of our DNA. Whether you come from research, academia or industry, if you're curious, open to learning and looking for a meaningful intellectual challenge you'll find your place at the EPO. Key areas include electromechanical contact design, busbar assemblies, termination technologies (crimping, IDC, welding), board-to-board and cable-to-board interconnects, electromagnetic shielding (EMI/EMC), and mechanical latching and environmental sealing. Video Engineering: digital video coding and compression (MPEG, HEVC, VVC, point cloud), video transmission (DVB, ISOBMFF, HbbTV), digital cameras, image sensors and camera control Mechanical Engineering: Tobacco processing and aerosol generation, Air Conditioning, Heating Systems, Conveyors, Furniture and Hand Tools Medical Device Engineering: Medical Mechanics - design, development, testing or manufacture of medical devices and surgical technologies. Minimally invasive devices: catheters, guidewires, delivery systems; Drug delivery: microneedles, injectors and related devices; Surgical devices: surgical instruments, powered and robotic surgical systems; Spinal implants: pedicle screws, rods, intervertebral cages, disc prostheses Semiconductors: Semiconductor manufacturing technology, Lithography Technologies, Magnetic Applications and Electromagnetic Components, Lithography Chemistry (Photoresists & Photomasks), Physical aspects of OLED displays, lighting devices and organic photovoltaic devices, Semiconductor devices and manufacturing technology Telecom & Wireless : Messaging, Topology, Access, Multiple Access & Transmission Lines, Network Management, PowerSaving, Sync, SatCom, Resource Allocation, Wireless & Data Networks You will thrive with us if you have a solid background and relevant expertise in the specified fields, built up during your studies, in projects, and/or as a result of professional experience enjoy deep technical analysis, reading technical drawings and solving intellectual puzzles are genuinely curious about technology and enjoy continuously learning about new scientific developments, emerging technologies and patent law are analytical, detail-oriented and open-minded are confident using digital technologies and AI-supported tools to analyse information while applying own critical thinking value both independent work and team collaboration are comfortable making structured, evidence-based decisions and exercising sound professional judgement No prior IP (intellectual property) experience? No problem, we provide full training to get you started. Our minimum requirements for this post diploma of completed studies at master's level covering one or more technical fields mentioned above excellent knowledge (at least C1) of one of our official languages (English, French and German) and the ability to understand the other two; alternatively, excellent knowledge (at least C1) of English (in such cases, the willingness to learn the missing languages and to reach level B2 within a set time frame would be required) work experience in industry would be an advantage citizenship of one of the member states of the European Patent Organisation What we offer competitive salary: €7 076 to €10 164 net/month (depending on location and experience) 30+ days of annual leave + flexible working arrangements generous remote work policy: work from anywhere in the country of employment; up to 60 days from abroad (EPC states) family-friendly policies: childcare, education and relocation support pension and insurance: excellent socia

title: Mechanical engineer

Je zorgt ervoor dat ontwerpen worden geïndustrialiseerd: van een technisch goed concept naar een gestandaardiseerde, reproduceerbare en efficiënt te bouwen machine. Daarbij houd je rekening met maakbaarheid, assemblage, materiaalkeuzes en de praktische toepassing in productie. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor technische projecten, optimaliseert bestaande ontwerpen en zorgt dat kennis, keuzes en werkwijzen goed worden vastgelegd en gedeeld. Daarnaast ondersteun en coach jij jouw minder ervaren collega’s in hun groei. Over Flikweert Vision Flikweert Vision ontwikkelt geavanceerde optische sorteermachines voor aardappelen en uien. In onze machines komen vision, software, AI, mechanica en elektrotechniek samen. Onze manier van werken is nuchter en praktisch: aanpakken, hard werken, verantwoordelijkheid nemen en elkaar helpen. We gaan voor een goed resultaat, maar vinden gezelligheid en plezier in het werk minstens zo belangrijk. Wie zoeken wij? Je hebt ervaring als engineer, beschikt over technische diepgang én een praktische blik: dat is wat deze rol vraagt. Je overziet de gevolgen van ontwerpkeuzes, pakt zelfstandig projecten of deelprojecten op en durft beslissingen te nemen wanneer iets beter, slimmer of efficiënter kan. Afwachten past niet bij je. Met initiatief, samenwerking en daadkracht zorg je ervoor dat goede ideeën niet blijven liggen, maar daadwerkelijk worden uitgevoerd. Jij brengt mee Hbo werk- en denkniveau in Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechanical Engineering of een vergelijkbare richting. Meerdere jaren ervaring als Mechanical Engineer, bij voorkeur binnen machinebouw of apparatenbouw. Ruime ervaring met 3D-CAD, technische tekeningen, stuklijsten, toleranties en maakbaarheid. Ervaring met conceptuitwerking, projectontwikkeling, prototyping en optimalisatie van bestaande machines. Een zelfstandige, analytische en praktische werkwijze en het vermogen om kennis te delen en collega’s mee te nemen. Wat bieden wij jou? Een inhoudelijk sterke rol met veel invloed op onze machines en technische ontwikkeling. Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, verbetering en professionalisering van de afdeling. Een groeiende, innovatieve organisatie met korte lijnen en een praktische mentaliteit. Een goed salaris tussen € 3600,- en € 5000,- bruto per maand o.b.v. fulltime, 38 uur, afhankelijk van je kennis en werkervaring 25 vakantiedagen en 13 adv-dagen bij een fulltime dienstverband. DACS is een geavanceerd luchtsmeringssysteem dat een luchtlaag onder het schip creëert. Hierdoor neemt de weerstand in het water af, wat leidt tot een lager brandstofverbruik en minder emissies. Develop mechanical solutions that maintain antenna alignment, dimensional stability, RF clearances, grounding, shielding, cable routing, connector accessibility, and other mechanical conditions required to achieve the intended electromagnetic performance. title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Mission Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives. We're looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer to close the gap between development and production. A design that's finished on screen isn't yet a design that's ready to be made. About the role The work is finding practical ways to test and evaluate that readiness while changes are still easy, fast and cheap to make, and before a design is locked behind a controlled change process: that the design does what it's meant to do, and that it can be assembled and produced at scale. The output is a corrected design, not a report. You either make the change yourself or work it through with the designer who owns it. It runs the other way too. When production finds something after release, you turn that feedback into a corrected design quickly. Mechanical design is five engineers today and you'd be the sixth. We work in small teams on hardware that moves quickly between development and production, so priorities shift and what a product needs changes with it. The responsibilities below describe where the focus sits today, and the boundary moves. You'll be comfortable with a degree of ambiguity and flexibility about the work in front of you. What you'll do Design readiness before release Decide what needs proving before a design is released, and how to prove it quickly. Judging which risks are worth testing early is the core of the role Design and build the prototypes and test setups that answer the question at hand: function, dimensional behaviour, robustness in use and how the subsystems come together Assess manufacturability and assemblability, both directly and by drawing on input from manufacturing Work hands-on with the other design engineers, devising the builds, measurements and trials that shorten the loop between a design question and an answer Make full use of our in-house prototyping — workshop, machine shop and printers — alongside sourcing and our manufacturers to get prototype parts in early, and shape how we pull development prototypes together across both routes Develop how we assess readiness, so each product benefits from what the last one taught us Design feedback from production Work alongside production engineering on issues found in production, and own what the fix requires on the design side Correct CAD and drawings and take them through release quickly, so production isn't held up waiting on a design fix Work within design control, including the medical device change process where it applies, and find ways to turn feedback around quickly inside that constraint Product design ownership Principal product ownership is what the other mechanical design engineers do today, and your main scope is to work alongside them and close the manufacturing readiness gap. Full ownership of a product's mechanical design is open to you where it fits: a smaller product, bandwidth alongside your main scope, or a shift in priorities that means a product needs an owner. What you bring Mechanical design and CAD depth, proven on products you've taken from design into production Hands-on build and rapid prototyping experience Time spent on a production floor, close to how products are built and assembled Design for manufacturing and design for assembly, applied in practice Devising and running practical tests, and judging what's worth testing and when Fluent in drawings, tolerancing and tolerance stack-up Comfortable working inside a controlled release and engineering change process Self-driven. The role largely sets its own agenda: working out where the risk sits and going after it without being directed Works well with manufacturing and sourcing, and can take critical feedback on a design and act on it Bonus points Experience of regulated products, medical devices or another regulated industry Familiarity with ISO 13485 or EU MDR design control Why join this team You set the agenda. You decide what needs proving before a design goes out, then build the prototypes and setups and prove it. What comes out is a released drawing production can build and an honest read on how mature and feasible the design really is — and that read is what gives everyone else the confidence to release. You sit alongside the other design engineers and bring insight back to them early, while a design is still conceptual and there's still time to change it. Testing assumptions quickly is where you shape what a device becomes. You don't only find things either: you decide how we find them, how we fix them, and you verify the fixes yourself. The loop is short. Products move between development and production quickly here, so you follow a design from the first prototypes into production and see your own work land. You work directly with manufacturing on whatever is giving them trouble, so your changes show up fast in how well and how quickly we can build. Manufacturing, procurement, electronics, firmware, optics and verification all sit in the same hardware organisation, so the people whose constraints you're designing around are a conversation away. And all of it ends up in clinics, in front of real people getting answers they wouldn't otherwise have.

description: Placering Piteå, SE Ett hållbart arbetsliv På SCA har du möjlighet att göra skillnad på riktigt. Våra uppdrag kan därför sträcka sig från konstruktion och produktutveckling till produktion, strategiska inköp, compliance, försörjningskedjor, service och eftermarknad. title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Data Centres
description: Job Description Are you excited about Data Centres, and working with state-of-the-art technology? Are you motivated by challenging the ordinary and creating more sustainable solutions? Do you thrive when you work in a multicultural team with international talents? If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Data Centre Facilities department as our new Senior Mechanical Engineer and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future. Your new role As our new Senior Mechanical Engineer, you will work to create Data Centre solutions for our clients. You will be part of our Nordics group for Data Centre Facilities in Sweden, Finland, Denmark and Norway. You will work as part of passionate teams filled with talents from all over the world, your core colleagues are in locations across all four Nordic countries, but you’ll also become part of our Global Data Center Spearhead and will benefit from +150 Data Center specialists in the U.K., U.S.A., India, Germany and Asia as your new colleagues. We have a flexible and hybrid working model where we work from within Ramboll’s offices, from home and online. We travel as needed but also respect family and other personal responsibilities to support a strong work-life balance for everyone. Our team is growing, and we are shaping it together as we grow to become stronger. We see our continuously improvement as team responsibility. We celebrate wins, milestones and our colleague’s special occasions, so when you join you can expect a very open, friendly and social atmosphere ready to welcome your own ideas and preferences. Your key responsibilities will be: Liaison with clients to identify business goals and optimise technical requirements. Communicate with third parties to frame constraints and solution spaces. Develop mechanical concepts and design solutions for data centres. Lead and oversee mechanical design teams across the Nordics to ensure implementation. Participate in the continued development of our business in the Nordics in general and in respect to mechanical. About You From the moment you start at Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you can continue to grow with the company. Whilst we look forward to supporting your continued learning and development, for this role we have identified some qualifications, skills, experience and capabilities that will set you up for success: Experience with leading mechanical design teams and collaborating in multidisciplinary teams where the best overall solution for the client may not be the optimal mechanical design. Proven experience with designing or constructing data centre facilities. Experience working as a consulting mechanical engineer. A thorough understanding of digital design delivery through Revit/BIM 360. Excellent communicator capable of explaining complex technical concepts to our clients and project team partners in plain language, verbally and in writing. What We Can Offer You Flexible working. The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company combined with the opportunity to shape our local approach to the data centre industry. Leaders guided by our Leadership Principles focused on people and work-life balance. Investment in your continued professional development. A culture that welcomes you as the unique person you are. Inspiration focused on data centres from colleagues, clients, and projects across the globe. Ready to join us? Please submit your application and CV online. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply. We recognise that some candidates only apply when they tick every box. However, passion and potential often outweigh a perfect resume and Ramboll’s supportive learning culture can help you grow. So if this role resonates with you but you don't meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for this opportunity or another within our team. Deadline: 31 October 2026 - however, we review applications continuously, so please do not hesitate to submit yours if you are interested. If you have any questions please feel free to contact Head of Department, Jason Olrod, +46 76 865 39 77. Thank you for considering this opportunity with Ramboll. We look forward to receiving your application. Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll employs more than 18,000 people globally across 35 countries. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, Management Consulting, and Architecture & Landscape. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we help shape the societies of tomorrow. Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion Equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do. At Ramboll, we believe that diversity is a strength and that different experiences and perspectives are essential to creating truly sustainable societies. We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone is able to flourish and reach their potential. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds and characteristics. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ra

title: Senior Rörkonstruktör / Senior Piping Engineer
description: Job Description Introduktion Vill du vara med och hitta lösningar för framtidens energitekniska- och industriella utmaningar? Då ska du jobba tillsammans med oss i Energy and Industry Engineering på WSP. Hos oss kommer du vara med och påverka en av vår tids viktigaste frågor för att nå ett hållbart samhälle och bidra till den gröna omställningen inom industrin. WSP:s kunder inom industri och energi kräver en mängd insatser med hög ingenjörskompetens. Nyckeln till framgång är att ha en kostnadseffektiv och hållbar process. Detta kräver många olika kompetenser under de olika faserna såsom framtagning av strategiskt koncept, planering & upphandling, konstruktion och besiktning. Våra konsulter har den spetskompetens som krävs för att lyckas med projekten och hög kännedom om olika typer av verksamheter. WSP erbjuder flexibla, heltäckande och skräddarsydda lösningar för alla projektfaser. Nu söker vi en Senior Rörkonstruktör (Senior Piping Engineer) till vårt nationella team! Ansvarsområde I rollen som Senior Rörkonstruktörblir du en nyckelperson hos oss. Du arbetar i projektform med allt från systemdesign och detaljprojektering till dimensionering, beräkningar samt tekniskt stöd vid montage och idrifttagning. Du får en central roll där du driver och utvecklar din disciplin i våra uppdrag. Arbetet sker både självständigt och i nära samarbete med kollegor i större, multidisciplinära projekt. Här får du använda din tekniska kompetens, lösa komplexa utmaningar och bidra till att höja kvaliteten i våra leveranser. Rollen innebär även möjlighet att handleda och stötta kollegor som är i början av sin karriär. Hos oss är du mer än en konsult – du blir en del av ett team som tillsammans formar framtidens lösningar. På WSP får du utrymme att påverka, utvecklas och vara med och skapa hållbara resultat som gör skillnad. Kvalifikationer Vi söker efter dig som har en bakgrund inom maskinteknik och med minst 8 års erfarenhet av rörkonstruktion. För att lyckas i rollen, söker vi dig som har erfarenhet av att jobba i en ledande roll inom rörkonstruktion. Du bör ha arbetat i Autodesk Plant 3D och det är meriterande om du även har jobbat med något av följande projekteringsverktyg: Aveva E3D Cadmatic Spänningsanalys i Rohr2 och/eller Caepipe Då de handlingar vi levererar till kund och kommunikationen i stort sker på svenska, behöver du ha mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift. Även kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift är av stor vikt, då arbete med WSP-kollegor och kunder internationellt förekommer. Vi söker dig som bor i närheten av något av WSP's kontor i Sverige. Kontakt Om du har frågor kring rollen, kontakta gärna någon av oss! Vi tar dock inte emot ansökningar via mail, utan via vårt rekryteringssystem. Ida Blixter, Unit Lead Energy & Industry Engineering ida.blixter@wsp.com Sofie Grettve, Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist sofie.grettve@wsp.com Sista ansökningsdag Urval sker löpande men vi vill senast få in din ansökan 2026-10-15. Under sommarperioden och stundande ledighet kan urvalsprocessen komma att dra ut på tiden, varför återkoppling kan dröja något. Kontakt från rekryteringsföretag, CV- och annonssäljare undanbedes. OM WSP I SVERIGE WSP är en av världens ledande teknikkonsulter. Med en enastående bredd av ingenjörer, rådgivare och forskare förenas våra globala talanger för att utveckla lokala lösningar. WSP är verksamma i över 50 länder och har cirka 83 000 medarbetare, eller som vi säger Visionärer. På WSP i Sverige jobbar cirka 3 800 konsulter med att leverera innovativa projekt inom transport, infrastruktur, byggnation, miljö, industri, projektledning, strategisk rådgivning och energi. Följ oss gärna på WSP Sverige (LinkedIn), WSP Sverige (Facebook), eller @wspsweden (Instagram) för en närmare inblick i vår verksamhet samt hur en dag i arbetet kan se ut för våra medarbetare. About Us At WSP , we exist to shape communities to advance humanity. It’s why we bring people together who are wired to solve complex challenges - engineers, scientists, advisors, and technical experts who are driven by a common passion - to redefine what’s possible and shape what comes next. We are Visioneers. As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, we partner with clients across transportation, infrastructure, environment, buildings, energy, water, mining and metals. We pair deep local knowledge with global insights to pioneer solutions designed to leave a lasting, positive impact. At WSP , you’ll join a community of brilliant minds that push boundaries every day - applying deep expertise and fuelling innovation to help create a more connected and resilient future. Here, your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and you are encouraged to bring your authentic self to work. We empower our people to collaborate across disciplines, challenge the status quo, and shape a career with purpose. Join us. Please Note: Health and Safety is a core paramount value of WSP. Given the importance of keeping one another safe it is expected that you comply with our Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) policy at all times as well as client HSE policies when working at client locations. Full details here . Some safety-sensitive positions involve fieldwork and may include work in a variety of environmental conditions, such as remote or isolated areas, working alone, and in inclement weather (within safe and reasonable limits). WSP welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. WSP is committed to the principles of employment equity. Only the candidates selected will be contacted. WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Full details here .

title: Design Engineer (Drivetrain & Transmissions)
description: Career Area Engineering Job Description Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Job Title: Design Engineer (Drivetrain & Transmissions) Salary: £49,500 rising to £61,000 depending on skills demonstrated Contract : Full time & permanent Location: Desford, Leicestershire - Domestic relocation support may be considered for exceptional candidates The Opportunity Help shape the drivetrain and transmission systems powering Caterpillar’s wheel loaders, telehandlers and backhoe loaders. As a Design Engineer , you’ll turn customer and functional requirements into robust solutions, from concept through to production release. Combining mechanical design, computer-aided engineering and technical problem-solving, you’ll influence product quality, durability and performance while delivering reliable solutions for customers worldwide. What You Will Do As a Design Engineer , you are accountable for, but not limited to: Translate customer and functional requirements into robust drivetrain component and transmission system designs. Create, analyse and release three-dimensional models, components, assemblies and engineering documentation using computer-aided design tools. Investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes and develop solutions that balance performance, quality, durability and cost. Evaluate design risks and use findings from prototype builds, verification, testing and validation to refine engineering solutions. Collaborate with manufacturing, suppliers, purchasing and global engineering teams to deliver new products and product improvements. Plan and prioritise concurrent engineering activities, communicating progress, technical findings, risks and recommendations clearly. NB. The panel cannot make assumptions when shortlisting therefore please demonstrate your qualifications and experience on your CV relevant to the criteria outlined. What You Can Demonstrate Education: A degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent applied engineering knowledge. Applies engineering principles, analysis and technical data to deliver reliable, production-ready solutions. Level: Extensive Experience Computer-Aided Design & Engineering: Creates, analyses and communicates complex mechanical components, assemblies and three-dimensional designs using specialised engineering tools. Applies advanced design methods to produce accurate solutions suitable for manufacture, validation and release. Analytical Thinking: Breaks complex technical challenges into manageable parts, identifies potential root causes and evaluates risks, benefits and alternative solutions. Selects appropriate analytical methods to reach balanced, evidence-based decisions. Level: Working Knowledge Product Design & Development: Translates customer and functional requirements into practical engineering solutions, supporting components and systems from concept through to validation and production release. Uses appropriate engineering tools to create or modify designs and contribute to prototype development. Managing Multiple Priorities: Plans and co-ordinates concurrent engineering activities while responding effectively to changing demands. Maintains progress and quality across multiple assignments, escalating risks and priority conflicts where appropriate. What You May Have Drivetrain Knowledge: Applies knowledge of transmissions, gears, shafts, bearings, housings, wet clutches or hydraulic integration to understand component and system interactions. Uses this knowledge to identify design risks and improve performance, durability and reliability. Product Validation & Launch: Uses findings from prototype builds, testing and design verification to refine engineering solutions. Considers manufacturability, assembly, quality and production requirements to support successful product release. Pending the number of applications, the criteria for the position may be enhanced to facilitate shortlisting. What You Will Get One Company, Limitless Opportunities Caterpillar is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. We do business on every continent, principally operating through three primary segments – Construction Industries, Resource Industries, and Energy & Transportation – and providing financing and related services through our Financial Products segment. Careers at Caterpillar are limitless, we have opportunities in Engineering, Human Resources, Manufacturing, Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain and so much more. You can create the career you want. It’s your time and talent, make it count. Our Sustainability Commitment Caterpillar has a long-standing commitment to sustainability, one of our five Values in Action. It is part of who we are and what we do. We actively lead sustainable green initiatives to preserve the environment, help reduce poverty with the Caterpillar Foundation and stay involved in the communities we help build. Benefits : 27 days annual leave + bank holidays , opportunity to buy additional holiday, 10% Bonus , contributory pension scheme - Caterpillar will double the employee's contribution up to 10% , contributory share scheme - Caterpillar will match 50% of the employee's contribution, Employee Support Networks – join groups that offer support, connection , and a sense of community , optional flexible benefits including access to private health and dental care plans, EV car lease etc Travel : up to 10% travel to include international

RJM International is a world-leading, engineering technology business that enables energy producers to transition to efficient, reliable and cost-effective low carbon generation - and we looking to expand our team to meet market demand. RJM’s twin-track approach is to support existing assets which have decades of operating life remaining, by reducing their emissions and carbon footprint and to support the biomass and Energy from Waste sector to improve reliability and performance. We are actively working with our customers in their efforts to reduce their carbon footprint, whether that is by improving efficiency, fuel switching such as from coal to gas or biomass co-firing / conversion. Our projects require bespoke solutions which demand technical and commercial creativity in order to meet our customers’ needs. We are also very active within the biomass and Energy from Waste markets where we resolve issues encountered in bubbling bed combustors/gasifiers and grate combustion units. Bouw- en realisatiefase Toezien op de constructieve kwaliteit tijdens de bouw en productie van schepen. Beoordelen van bouwdocumentatie, technische wijzigingen en leveranciersproducten. Signaleren van technische risico's en aandragen van verbetermaatregelen. Ondersteunen bij FAT-, HAT- en SAT-testtrajecten. Vertegenwoordigen van het projectteam tijdens technische overleggen met werven, leveranciers en andere betrokken partijen. Bijdragen aan voortgangsrapportages, evaluaties en technische besluitvorming gedurende het project. Wat breng je mee? Opleiding Minimaal een afgeronde hbo-opleiding Maritieme Techniek of vergelijkbaar. Ervaring Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring met het ontwerpen, engineeren, begeleiden en opleveren van complexe scheepsbouwprojecten. Kennis van schok-, trillings- en geluidsaspecten binnen maritieme systemen. Ervaring met Systems Engineering en het specificeren, verifiëren en valideren van complexe technische systemen. Ervaring met 3D CAD-software zoals Siemens NX, Shipbuilder, CATIA, Cadmatic of Rhino. Ervaring met FEMAP of vergelijkbare analysepakketten. Kennis van PDM-systemen en Microsoft Office. Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Persoonlijke eigenschappen Je bent een analytisch sterke engineer die complexe technische uitdagingen weet te vertalen naar praktische oplossingen. Daarnaast beschik je over: Sterk technisch inzicht Analytisch vermogen Besluitvaardigheid Goede communicatieve vaardigheden Samenwerkingsgerichtheid Proactieve en resultaatgerichte instelling Wat bieden wij? Al 98 jaar werken wij met staal in de wereld van bruggen, sluizen, hoogbouw, stadions en raffinaderijen. In binnen- en buitenland staan wij bekend om spraakmakende projecten zoals het Wembley stadion, de Hollandsche IJsselkering en de nieuwe zelfsluitende waterkering in Steyl-Maashoek. We zetten in op verduurzaming en innovatie om Nederland droog en in beweging te houden. Zo dragen we bij aan een veilige en betrouwbare infrastructuur voor miljoenen mensen. Hollandia Infra is gespecialiseerd in het ontwerpen, produceren en installeren van complexe staalconstructies. Met een sterke focus op beweegbare bruggen, sluizen en waterkeringen in het binnen- en buitenland. title: Protective Design Engineer (Structural / Blast Engineering)
description: Joining Arup Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. The Opportunity Our risk, security and resilience practice has helped organisations to understand their exposure to threats and make better risk-informed decisions since it was formed in the mid-1990s. Our team of experts are trusted advisors to private and public-sector clients, providing strategic risk management, technical risk assessment, operational planning, security engineering and counter-terrorism design measures that suit their business needs. Our team apply their knowledge, critical thinking and experience to help our clients to understand and anticipate what could go wrong, and we help with finding better solutions to ensure that risks are effectively managed and controlled. Our team has consistently delivered high-quality advisory and engineering services to clients across a range of markets and industries, including Rail, Energy, Data Centres, Highways, Healthcare, Property and Scientific research facilities. You will join Arup as a Consultant working in our protective design engineering team with a focus on sustainable development across a range of market and industries. The types of projects you will be involved range from advisory to engineering solution based blast engineering and hostile vehicle mitigation across a range of project lifecycle stages (such as research & development, feasibility to concept and detailed design). At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective- in which we encourage individuality to thrive. Our strength comes from how we respect, share and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives and ideas. You will have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning - to Arup, to your career, to our members, and to the clients and communities we serve. In this role you will: Utilise your knowledge of mainstream structural engineering design practice and develop your understanding of how to model such structures against transient dynamic loading Provide technical input across a broad range of projects across the resilience, security and risk practice Support the preparation of threat and vulnerability risk assessments for malicious threats (including terrorism, crime and civil disruption) Develop coherent, risk-based security strategies and integrate protective design and/or blast engineering measures from concept through detailed design to construction Carry out blast modelling using engineering software including computational fluid dynamic modelling and finite element methods Undertake the structural blast engineering design of a wide range of structures in common and novel engineering materials Undertake the façade blast engineering design of a wide range of glazed and non-glazed façade systems Undertake the design of Hostile Vehicle Mitigation measures Is this role right for you? We are seeking talented structural engineers who have a broad knowledge of structural engineering design and an interest in specialising in resilient structural design, to join our team but possibly to be deployed to projects being led from other centres and to further the development of our blast engineering services globally. Arup has one of the most significant protective design teams globally, with teams in London, Manchester, New York, San Francisco, Melbourne and Singapore working together as one global team. Unlike traditional codified design, blast engineering requires a very different approach to the design but requires a designer’s empathy with regard to aesthetic, form and function of any proposed facility. As such, this is a great opportunity for an existing practitioner to build their professional and tactical position in the industry, or for a talented structural engineer to provide strategic input and undertake first-principles design as traditional forms of mainstream structural engineering design are increasingly being automated and undertaken by code-compliant software. The successful candidate will be able to confidently and articulately communicate concepts of threat, risk and risk mitigation, supported by our threat specialists, will be able to develop and present conceptual ideas, understand the planning, design and construction process in the development of design solutions in a multi-disciplinary design environment and will be able to manage the detailed analysis, design and specification of structures and façade subject to blast loads. Furthermore, the role will involve the development of Hostile Vehicle Mitigation measures as an essential part of protective design strategies. Experience in blast engineering or a related discipline is desirable but not essential. You will work closely with design team disciplines both within and outside Arup on a regular basis including architecture, SMEP, façade engineering, transport and logistics, civil and highways engineering, fire engineering and computational structural mechanics. The candidate has an opportunity to gain a breadth of experience from a broad range of projects in a range of geographic locations, including opportunities for travel where desired. You will undertake the blast engineering design of a variety of projects, and will quickly developing both technical and business-orientated competencies. Our priority is to attract quality staff who have the ability to work in a collaborative, challenging environment, and who show the potential for technical excellence in their field. The candidate will be based in the Arup London or Manchester offices and travel out of the UK to meet project requirements will be necessary upon occasion. You will be a Structural Engineer with a strong background in mainstream structural design. You will be working towards chartership with the Institution of Civil Engineers, the Institution of Structural Engineers or an equivalent professional institution. Build, validate and refine CFD and thermal models using experimental and prototype test data. Design, build and evaluate functional prototypes to investigate and validate new technologies and product concepts. Develop analytical tools, simulation methodologies and automated workflows using Python and engineering software. Desirable Experience developing consumer products, consumer electronics, domestic appliances or handheld devices. Knowledge of heating technologies, sensors, control systems and thermal management. Merging science and innovation, with luxury beauty and style; ghd combines cutting edge technologies and beautiful designs to create the most technically advanced hair tools in the world. Developed by leading scientists and engineers in the dedicated ghd R&D laboratories in Cambridge, ghd tools deliver “safer for hair” heat styling that have become an essential part of the daily lives of professional hair stylists and consumers globally. Renowned for game changing innovation and superior performance, at ghd we are on a mission to transform lives with the power of a good hair day! About The Role We are looking for an experienced Senior Project Engineer Civil/Structural to join our growing Infrastructure Department and play a key role in the design and delivery of major projects across Ireland. We are open to candidates from either a civil or structural engineering background. You do not need to specialise in both. What is important is a strong technical foundation in your chosen discipline, combined with an interest in working on varied and challenging infrastructure projects. Few roles offer this breadth of experience. Our project portfolio ranges from major urban regeneration schemes such as Cork Docklands, to water and wastewater infrastructure, schools and hospitals, sports facilities, airports, public realm, energy infrastructure and a wide variety of civil and structural engineering projects. You will join a young, ambitious and growing team where engineers are given genuine responsibility and encouraged to take ownership of their projects. You won't be limited to one small element of a larger design. You will have opportunities to work directly with clients, influence key engineering decisions and see projects develop from initial concept through to construction on site. The role offers exposure across the full project lifecycle – including feasibility and optioneering, preliminary and detailed design, multidisciplinary coordination, procurement, construction support and handover. Whether your background is in civil infrastructure or structural engineering, we are looking for someone who wants to continue developing technically while also taking greater responsibility for projects, clients and project delivery. The role can be shaped around your experience, strengths and the direction in which you want to develop your career. Key Duties And Responsibilities The role will be tailored to suit the successful candidate’s civil or structural engineering background, with opportunities to broaden their experience across multidisciplinary infrastructure projects. Lead and coordinate the design and delivery of civil and/or structural elements of major infrastructure projects, from feasibility and concept development through detailed design and construction. For civil engineering projects, develop practical and buildable solutions across roads and site infrastructure, drainage, utilities, earthworks, site development and associated civil works. For structural engineering projects, develop safe, efficient and buildable solutions involving reinforced concrete, structural steel, masonry, foundations, retaining structures and associated temporary and permanent works. Undertake and oversee engineering analysis and design appropriate to your discipline, including the preparation and review of calculations, drawings, specifications, technical reports and tender documentation. Take ownership of projects and design packages, coordinating internal and external resources to deliver high-quality engineering solutions. Work as part of multidisciplinary teams alongside civil, structural, geotechnical, mechanical, electrical, environmental and other specialists. Ensure designs comply with applicable Eurocodes, British Standards, Irish and UK requirements, client standards and health and safety obligations. Manage project programmes, budgets, resources, risks and deliverables to achieve time, cost and quality objectives. Work directly with clients and stakeholders, participating in design and project meetings, providing clear technical advice and helping to resolve engineering and delivery challenges. Provide technical support through procurement and construction, including responding to technical queries, reviewing contractor submissions and attending site where required. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers, graduates and technicians, helping to develop the wider team. Promote high standards of technical quality, sustainability, innovation and client service across all projects. Key Requirements Degree in Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering (BEng, BSc, MEng or equivalent). Chartered Engineer status or actively working towards chartership or professional registration with Engineers Ireland, ICE, IStructE. A minimum of seven years’ relevant experience in civil or structural engineering. Strong technical knowledge within your chosen discipline. This may include civil infrastructure such as roads, drainage, utilities, earthworks and site development, or structural engineering involving reinforced concrete, structural steel, masonry, foundations and retaining structures. Experience delivering civil or structural engineering projects from feasibility and concept development through detailed design and construction support. Strong knowledge of recognised engineering design standards and codes

title: Senior Process Specialist - Additive Manufacturing
description: Innovation starts with curiosity. Meaningful progress starts with execution. Join SKF! We are looking for a Senior Process Specialist – Additive Manufacturing Laser Powder Bed Fusion (L-PBF) As a Senior Process Specialist within Additive Manufacturing, you will play a key role in developing, qualifying, and industrializing Laser Powder Bed Fusion (L-PBF) processes for metallic materials and applications. The primary focus of the role is to bridge technology development with product and manufacturing implementation, ensuring robust, scalable and cost-effective additive manufacturing solutions that support SKF’s growth ambitions. You will act as a technical expert in additive manufacturing, driving process qualification, manufacturing readiness, product introduction and continuous process improvement. In your daily work you will work closely with product development, manufacturing, quality and researchers to support additive manufacturing in large. Your Day-to-day Work/ Key Responsibilities Manage process development activities related to the L-PBF process with a clear focus on process qualification in close collaboration with product development. Develop and implement methodologies for process verification and quality assurance, e.g. by utilizing advanced process monitoring and quality assurance software for in-process control and defect detection. Contribute to the advancement of additive manufacturing capabilities and technologies within SKF. Specific focus will be on running Proof-of-Concept activities with related prototype development. Stay up to date on technical development and know-how with respect to additive manufacturing, and to make sure this knowledge is spread within the organization. We expect you to have/be Master’s degree (or higher) in Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Physics, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or similar with minimum 5 years of hands-on industrial experience with L-PBF technology and metal additive manufacturing. PhD in Additive Manufacturing and Materials Science, or related field, will be considered an advantage. Demonstrated experience in taking additive manufacturing processes and applications from development into industrial implementation, including process qualification, production readiness, and cross-functional product realization activities. In-depth practical experience and a deep understanding of the L-PBF machine and related operation, calibration, troubleshooting, and process development, where optimization for medium- and high carbon steels will be considered an advantage. Experience from process monitoring and quality assurance software used in additive manufacturing. Proficiency in CAD and design tools relevant to additive manufacturing, where experience in Design for Additive Manufacturing (DfAM) will be considered an advantage. Good written and verbal communication skills in English. You will enjoy working here if you Have a curious mindset and a passion for technology development and innovation. Have sound analytical and problem-solving skills and a structured and data-driven approach to engineering challenges. Thrive from working with skilled colleagues from across disciplines with capabilities covering the full manufacturing process chain. What You’ll Love About SKF… A culture of diversity and inclusion! SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued success. Therefore, we only focus on your experience, skills, and potential. Come as you are – just be yourself #weareSKF Fair and transparent compensation! We provide transparent salary information in line with local legislation and base our decisions on objective criteria to ensure fairness and consistency throughout the recruitment process. Some Additional Information This position is located in Gothenburg , Sweden, on a local contract. You will report to the Manager, Steel, Heat Treatment & NDT and Principal Engineer, Manufacturing Technology, who is located in Gothenburg, Sweden. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Kristina Ryttberg by phone/Teams/email. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Katrin Edelmann, Talent Acquisition Partner Europe & Africa who is located in Schweinfurt, Germany at katrin.edelmann@skf.com . Please note that we can't accept applications via email . Is this you? If the answer is yes, submit your application in English no later than October-23-2026 . Please note that we can't accept applications via email . To support a transparent process, we may include assessments and before hiring we can verify the information in your application in compliance with country-specific laws and regulations. About SKF SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: INDUSTRIALIZATION ENGINEER - SCALE UP | ADDITIVE MANUFACTURING
description: Ingenn® è la Search House indipendente , esclusivamente specializzata nell’identificazione e nella valutazione di Ingegneri , Manager ed Executive per il Comparto Manifatturiero e della Produzione Industriale. Committente Ingenn® ha l’incarico di identificare un Industrialization Engineer per un'innovativa scale-up in forte espansione a livello internazionale la cui missione è rivoluzionare l'Advanced Manufacturing attraverso l'utilizzo di tecnologie all'avanguardia applicate a diversi settori, dall'aerospaziale al navale, dall'energia fino al design e all'architettura. Le soluzioni dell'azienda combinano la robotica avanzata con la produzione additiva (additive manufacturing), consentendo una produzione su grande scala ad alte prestazioni con un'efficienza e una sostenibilità senza pari. Perimetro Di Responsabilità All'interno dell'Ufficio Tecnico, la figura lavorerà a stretto contatto con i team meccanici, elettrici, software, di testing e di produzione per tradurre le soluzioni ingegneristiche in configurazioni tecniche affidabili e producibili. Le attività spazieranno dalla documentazione tecnica 2D e 3D alla selezione dei componenti, fino alla conformità delle macchine, al testing e al miglioramento continuo dei processi di industrializzazione. Le responsabilità principali prevedono: Supportare l'industrializzazione dei sistemi Caracol, traducendo i progetti ingegneristici in soluzioni tecniche ripetibili e idonee alla produzione. Sviluppare e aggiornare disegni 2D, modelli 3D, layout e specifiche tecniche, garantendo accuratezza e coerenza lungo tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto. Preparare e mantenere Distinte Base (BOM), istruzioni di montaggio e la documentazione tecnica necessaria per le attività di produzione, collaudo, installazione e assistenza. Supportare la preparazione della documentazione relativa alla conformità delle macchine e alla marcatura CE, inclusi fascicoli tecnici, valutazioni dei rischi, manuali d'uso e manutenzione e dichiarazioni dei componenti. Partecipare alle attività di collaudo e validazione, supportando il troubleshooting (risoluzione problemi), la gestione delle anomalie e l'implementazione di azioni correttive. Supportare la selezione e la valutazione tecnica di componenti e fornitori, considerando prestazioni, compatibilità, producibilità, disponibilità e costi. Contribuire al miglioramento continuo dei processi di industrializzazione, delle pratiche documentali e dei flussi di lavoro dell'Ufficio Tecnico, con particolare attenzione a qualità, efficienza e tracciabilità. Job Requirements Core Requirements: Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, Ingegneria Gestionale/Industriale, Meccatronica o settore tecnico affine. Fino a 3 anni di esperienza nell'industrializzazione di prodotto, ingegneria di processo/produzione, progettazione meccanica o attività di Ufficio Tecnico. Buona padronanza del CAD 3D e del disegno tecnico 2D, con conoscenza delle normative di disegno, tolleranze, BOM e documentazione tecnica. Buona comprensione dei processi di produzione e assemblaggio, dei materiali e della selezione dei componenti. Familiarità con i requisiti di sicurezza dei macchinari e i processi di marcatura CE; la conoscenza dei fascicoli tecnici e della valutazione dei rischi è considerata un plus. Precedente esperienza in attività di collaudo, validazione e troubleshooting in ambiente industriale. La familiarità con l'automazione industriale, i sistemi elettromeccanici e l'interazione con i fornitori è considerata un plus. Forti capacità di problem-solving, comunicazione e collaborazione, con attitudine a lavorare efficacemente tra diverse funzioni tecniche. Other Info Location: Paderno Dugnano. Contract Offered CCNL gomma-plastica.
