title: Ingénieur de recherche / Microparticules déformables, microfluidique & biophysique cellulaire - H/F
description: L’Inserm est le seul organisme public français entièrement dédié à la recherche biologique, médicale et en santé des populations. Il dispose de laboratoires de recherche sur l’ensemble du territoire, regroupés en 12 Délégations Régionales. Notre institut réunit 15 000 chercheurs, ingénieurs, techniciens et personnels administratifs, avec un objectif commun : améliorer la santé de tous par le progrès des connaissances sur le vivant et sur les maladies, l’innovation dans les traitements et la recherche en santé publique. Rejoindre l’Inserm, c’est intégrer un institut engagé pour la parité et l’égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l’accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l’Inserm mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle. L'Inserm a reçu en 2016 le label européen HR Excellence in Research et s'est engagé à faire évoluer ses pratiques de recrutement et d'évaluation des chercheurs. Le Poste Missions Fabrication de particules, caractérisation mécanique, systèmes microfluidiques, culture cellulaire & soutien expérimental Activités principales Développer des méthodes reproductibles pour fabriquer des particules déformables à l’échelle micrométrique, avec une taille, une rigidité, des propriétés de coque et une composition interne contrôlées, y compris des particules solides/chargées et creuses/de type capsule. Caractériser les propriétés mécaniques des particules, principalement par microscopie à force atomique (AFM), complétée, lorsque pertinent, par des mesures de déformabilité en microfluidique ou par d’autres approches. Contribuer à la conception et à la fabrication de dispositifs microfluidiques biologiques comportant des constrictions, des bifurcations et des réseaux de type microvasculaire. Participer aux activités de culture de cellules de mammifères et contribuer au maintien des plateformes expérimentales communes utilisées dans le cadre du projet. Profil Recherché Connaissances Nous recherchons un(e) candidat(e) disposant d’une solide expérience expérimentale en physique, ingénierie, science des matériaux, matière molle, microfluidique, biophysique ou dans une discipline connexe. Le/la candidat(e) doit être titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur, d’un master, d’un doctorat ou d’une qualification équivalente, et faire preuve de solides compétences expérimentales pratiques, d’autonomie dans le développement et le dépannage des protocoles, ainsi que d’une capacité à travailler au sein d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire. Savoir-faire fabrication d’hydrogels, de microparticules ou de microcapsules microfluidique de gouttes, photolithographie ou lithographie douce matériaux mous et physique des polymères AFM ou caractérisation mécanique microscopie optique et analyse quantitative d’images/de données culture de cellules de mammifères et mécanique cellulaire (un atout) Diplôme(s) souhaité(s) Le/la candidat(e) doit être titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur, d’un master, d’un doctorat ou d’une qualification équivalente Unité de Recherche : U1067 dirigé par Monsieur THEODOLY (Campus Luminy)

title: Director Additive & Advanced Manufacturing (m/w/d)- Startup Support
description: Über uns Die TUM Venture Labs sind eine gemeinnützige Initiative der Technischen Universität München (TUM) – Europas bestplatzierter technischer Universität – und der UnternehmerTUM, Europas führendem Zentrum für Innovation und Gründung. Wir bauen einen der führenden europäischen Hubs für Entrepreneurship in Deep Tech und Life Sciences auf. In unseren domänenspezifischen Labs begleiten wir Deep-Tech-Gründungsteams von der ersten Idee bis zur Investment-Readiness – mit Zugang zu erstklassigen Forschungseinrichtungen, Industriepartnern, Mentor:innen und maßgeschneiderten Programmen. Unser Fokus: Die nächste Generation von Wissenschaftler:innen und Studierenden zu befähigen, ihre Forschungsinnovationen in skalierbare, technologiebasierte Unternehmen mit globalem Impact zu verwandeln. Additive & Advanced Manufacturing (AM) ist Europas wirtschaftliches Rückgrat und technologischer Ankerpunkt – und treibt industrielle Souveränität sowie resiliente Lieferketten über alle Domänen hinweg voran. Werde Teil unserer Mission als Director – Additive and Advanced Manufacturing (m/w/d)! Deine Aufgaben Deine Mission: Strategische & operative Leitung (20%) Du übernimmst die strategische und operative Leitung des TUM Venture Lab AM. Du entwickelst das Team am TUM Venture Lab AM weiter und führst es fachlich und disziplinarisch. Venture Building & Spin-off-Förderung (30%) Du unterstützt Forschende bei der Gründung ihres Deep-Tech-Spin-offs und identifizierst Opportunity Fields an der Schnittstelle von Forschung und Marktchancen. Du förderst das Wachstum unserer Deep-Tech-Ventures durch domänenspezifische Angebote und fachlichen Input. Technologie- & Opportunity-Field-Entwicklung (25%) Du identifizierst und treibst zentrale Opportunity Fields voran, in denen das "Additive" in AM den Unterschied macht – von neuartigen Triebwerken für die Luft- und Raumfahrt bis hin zu Nanoskalen-Innovation und Bioprinting. Du identifizierst, welche Innovationen nötig sind, um die Zukunft von NextGen Manufacturing & Industrial Production in Europa zu gestalten, und unterstützt dabei auch die Industrialisierung unserer Venture-Teams. Ecosystem & Netzwerkaufbau (25%) Du arbeitest eng mit unseren angeschlossenen Forschungseinrichtungen, Industriepartnern und Fördermittelgebern zusammen und erschließt neue Kooperationsfelder. Du vernetzt dich mit Investor:innen, Mentor:innen und Expert:innen und baust unser Netzwerk kontinuierlich weiter aus. Im Sinne unserer „One Venture Lab"-Philosophie entwickelst und implementierst du Advanced/NextGen Manufacturing gemeinsam mit unseren Venture Labs Robotics/AI, Mobility und Software/AI als domänenübergreifende Kerninitiative. Dein Profil Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Materialwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Fach abgeschlossen. Eine Promotion ist von Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Du bringst fundierte Erfahrung in Additive Manufacturing, AI x Engineering und dem Aufbau hardwarebasierter Systeme mit. Du blühst in schnell bewegten Start-up- und Innovationsumgebungen auf und bringst Struktur, klare Prioritäten und Umsetzungsstärke in Ambiguität – idealerweise kennst du die Start-up-Journey aus eigener Erfahrung. Du hast bereits Führungsverantwortung übernommen und leitest Teams mit Klarheit, Empathie und respektvoller Kommunikation. Unternehmerisches Denken treibt dich an: Du willst bahnbrechende Technologien nicht nur erforschen – du willst sie zum Leben erwecken und positiven Impact schaffen. Netzwerken ist deine Superkraft. Du triffst gerne neue Menschen, verbindest Ideen und baust wirkungsvolle Netzwerke auf. Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch – ob in Meetings, Präsentationen oder im Austausch mit internationalen Partnern. Customer & Partner Support Work directly with customers and partners during requirements definition, system setup, and process tuning. Fluency with Python or a comparable language for data handling and analysis, increasingly by working effectively with AI coding assistants. Strong, structured technical documentation skills. Excellent proactive team working and technical leadership skills. Fluency in English; German and/or Spanish language skills are a plus . Nice to have: Experience with printhead-based or inkjet material deposition systems. Knowledge of jetting complex materials. Telemetry processing and insight generation. Experience coordinating with external electronics or hardware vendors on integration and rework. Comfort in customer-facing roles. Why us? title: Process Engineer
description: Want to take new light technology from the lab out into the world? About us LunaLEC is a Swedish deep tech company that has mastered printed light. Just like text on a newspaper, the light-emitting structure is printed, forming a thin, patterned, flexible device. The light-emitting electrochemical cell (LEC) technology is built on 30 years of research, during which the team behind LunaLEC became the first in the world to fully print a light source. The technology is protected by several patents. We are now taking the LEC technology from the lab to large-scale roll-to-roll production. You will work closely with a team with deep expertise in the materials and the technology, while contributing with your experience in production. The role is new, and you will have a strong say in how it takes shape. You communicate fluently in English. As a person, you are driven, solution-oriented and enjoy taking responsibility. You take ownership of your areas and have a business-oriented mindset. Above all, you want to help build something new and see a unique technology reach the market. We offer 🚀 The opportunity to become a valued part of a deep tech company on its way out into the world 💡 Plenty of room to make an impact and build a completely new function from the ground up 🌍 An international and dedicated team ✈️ International assignments and close collaboration with customers and partners About the position Employment type: Permanent (with an initial 6-month probationary period) Start: By agreement Scope: Full-time Location: Umeå preferred, but remote work with regular visits to Umeå is possible. title: Junior Mechanical Engineer - Aerospace
description: Ruolo: Junior Mechanical Engineer in ambito Aerospace & Defence. Luogo: Torino, Venegono (VA). ALTEN supporta le strategie di sviluppo dei propri clienti nelle aree dell’innovazione, della R&D e dei sistemi informativi tecnologici. Nato più di 30 anni fa e presente in 30 Paesi, il Gruppo ALTEN si è affermato come leader mondiale nell’ingegneria e nei Servizi IT e leader Europeo per la consulenza nell'industria Life Sciences. Lavoriamo con attori chiave nei settori: Aeronautico &Spaziale, della Difesa & Navale, della Sicurezza, Automobilistico, Ferroviario, dell’Energia, del Life Sciences, Finanziario, del Retail e dei Servizi. Con un fatturato di oltre 4.069 miliardi di euro, abbiamo attualmente più di 57.400 collaboratori in tutto il mondo. In Italia siamo presenti in 13 città lungo tutto il territorio nazionale: Torino, Milano, Gallarate, Brescia, Genova, La Spezia, Modena, Maranello, Bologna, Firenze, Roma, Napoli e Bari. Di cosa ti occuperai? In un’ottica di rafforzamento del team Engineering, dopo un iniziale periodo di affiancamento, potrai iniziare il tuo percorso professionale su diversi progetti in ambito Aerospace & Defence. Le risorse saranno coinvolte in attività legate a: Definizione, compilazione, tempificazione e certificazione attraverso l'utilizzo dei sistemi aziendali, in accordo alla Design Standard e alla DBE rilasciata; Modifica e/o creazione cicli di lavoro e relative distinte base attraverso l’utilizzo dei sistemi aziendali; Creazione della distinte base Manufacturing; Progettazione di attrezzature e tracciati, garantendo la conformità ai requisiti tecnici e produttivi; Definizione dei fabbisogni di materiali e rilascio in produzione. Requisiti: Diploma in Perito meccanico e/o Laurea Magistrale in ingegneria meccanica/dei materiali; Conoscenza dell’impostazione di un ciclo di lavoro, del suo fabbisogno e la relativa tempificazione; Sistemi CAD: Autocad, SolidWorks, Catia, Creo, SolidEdge Attitudine al lavoro di gruppo e al problem solving; Buona capacità di analisi e organizzazione. Salary range: La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 26.000 EUR e 28.000 EUR. Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna. La posizione è inquadrata nell’ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato da ALTEN. "Il ruolo include l’applicazione dei principi di sicurezza delle informazioni e il rispetto delle policy aziendali. Prevede la gestione sicura di credenziali e strumenti, il riconoscimento di minacce come il phishing e la segnalazione di eventuali incidenti. È prevista formazione per supportare queste attività." Perché scegliere ALTEN? Technological challenges Crediamo che la tecnologia abbia un grande potenziale per migliorare il nostro futuro, per questo ricerchiamo talenti che siano motivati a costruire oggi il mondo di domani. Con il nostro portfolio clienti e i diversi progetti di R&D attivi, in ALTEN avrai modo di lavorare su progetti all'avanguardia. La nostra Technical Direction ti accompagnerà e indirizzerà durante il tuo percorso. Avrai la possibilità di metterti alla prova in contesti progettuali diversi e di confrontarti con esperti del settore per ampliare sempre più le tue conoscenze. Potrai unire le tue passioni e metterti in gioco professionalmente. Accetti la sfida? Inspiring Togetherness Ci impegniamo a favorire un ambiente di lavoro sereno e collaborativo organizzando attività di team building, iniziative di aggregazionee, eventi sportivi, per conoscerci meglio e condividere momenti insieme. Il successo di un gruppo si fonda sulla cooperazione e condivisione reciproca del sapere e degli interessi. Fulfilling Opportunities In ALTEN troverai corsi formativi all’avanguardia per accrescere le tue competenze sia tecnologiche, sia linguistiche! Tramite ALTEN Academy potrai ottenere certificazioni con alcuni dei più importanti schemi internazionali come IREB®, ISTQB® e altri. Attraverso Aula Streaming, invece, avrai accesso a corsi di formazione più trasversali relativi a soft skills e potrai scegliere tra 12 corsi di lingua straniera. Sustainable commitment Crediamo che la tecnologia sia a supporto dello sviluppo sociale e della tutela ambientale. Oltre a collaborare a progetti che mirano alla sostenibilità, ci impegniamo a sostenere le cause che più abbiamo a cuore, avendo collaborato e collaborando, tra gli altri, con AISM, AIRC, LILT, Save the Children, Treedom, This Unique. Valorizziamo l'unicità e ci impegniamo a garantire che tutte le nostre persone abbiano pari opportunità all'interno della nostra azienda, fornendo loro gli strumenti per esprimere al massimo il proprio potenziale. Il nostro approccio alla diversità e all'inclusione si fonda sui principi di etica e integrità e rappresenta il fattore determinante per lo sviluppo di orizzonti di crescita personale e aziendale più ampi. Promuoviamo l'inserimento e l'integrazione lavorativa delle persone appartenenti alle categorie protette - in base a quanto disciplinato dalla legge 68/99. I prossimi step Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv, ci prenderemo il tempo necessario per valutarlo attentamente. Se sarà in linea con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, il nostro team Talent Acquisition ti contatterà telefonicamente. L’iter di selezione proseguirà con un colloquio conoscitivo con l'area Business, un successivo colloquio più approfondito, durante il quale potrebbe essere richiesto un test pratico, ed infine un colloquio tecnico. L’ordine e il numero delle interviste potrebbero variare a seconda delle esigenze di selezione. In alternativa, saremo felici di conservare il tuo CV nel nostro gestionale per poterlo rivalutare per opportunità future. Operando in 13 diverse

title: Ingénieur Bureau d'Études - Nucléaire (H/F)
description: Vous êtes sur le point de rejoindre un industriel français reconnu pour la conception et la fabrication de solutions thermiques de haute technicité destinées à des environnements critiques, en tant qu'Ingénieur Bureau d'Études et Méthodes Nucléaire (H/F) ! L'entreprise intervient sur trois marchés exigeants : le nucléaire, l'aéronautique, défense et spatial, et le semi-conducteur. Elle grandit depuis plusieurs années et dispose aujourd'hui d'une visibilité de plusieurs années sur ses projets, en particulier dans le nucléaire. Le bureau d'études compte entre 20 et 30 ingénieurs et techniciens, répartis par marché sur un même plateau. Pour absorber la hausse d'activité et faire évoluer son organisation vers un fonctionnement plus collaboratif, l'équipe nucléaire se renforce. Ici, chacun prend le temps d'expliquer son travail aux nouveaux arrivants, et le partage d'information fait partie du quotidien. Pour nous accompagner dans cette recherche, nous mandatons les équipes Lynkus ! Rattaché.e au Responsable du Bureau d'Études Nucléaire, vous intégrez une équipe de 5 à 6 ingénieurs aux profils variés (jeunes diplômés et experts confirmés), avec une apprentie ingénieure et un technicien méthodes. Vous prenez en charge le suivi technique d'une dizaine de commandes, menées en mode projet sur des durées de 6 mois à 4 ans, de la fin de conception jusqu'à la livraison. Vos missions : * Finaliser la conception des produits : plans, définition du design et des données d'entrée transmises au dessinateur * Choisir les procédés de fabrication et définir comment chaque produit sera fabriqué * Rédiger la documentation technique destinée aux clients et aux ateliers de production * Renseigner les nomenclatures (bill of materials) dans l'ERP * Assurer le suivi technique des fournisseurs, notamment la qualification de nouveaux fournisseurs sur des produits critiques * Résoudre les problèmes techniques en cours de fabrication, directement sur le terrain avec l'atelier * Anticiper les points de blocage sur vos projets et alerter au bon moment * Travailler au quotidien avec le commerce, l'ingénierie amont, la qualité projet, les achats, la logistique et l'atelier, ainsi qu'avec des clients et fournisseurs internationaux (Chine, États-Unis, Allemagne) Le poste est basé à Caligny, sur le site de production. En somme, vous serez le lien technique entre le besoin du client, l'atelier et les fournisseurs, sur des produits où la sûreté nucléaire ne laisse aucune place à l'approximation. Pour vous épanouir et réussir sur ce poste, nous vous demanderons de justifier : * D'un diplôme d'ingénieur (Bac+5) à dominante matériaux, mécanique ou généraliste * D'une première expérience en bureau d'études ou en environnement industriel. Les jeunes diplômé.e.s curieux.ses et les profils confirmés sont tous les bienvenus * De connaissances en procédés de fabrication et d'une première confrontation à l'atelier (soudure, assemblage...) * De bases solides dans plusieurs domaines physiques : métallurgie, mécanique, thermique, électricité, matériaux * D'un bon niveau d'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral * D'une aisance avec la suite Office et les ERP Une expérience dans le nucléaire est un plus, mais elle n'est pas indispensable : un parcours de formation et d'intégration complet est prévu. Au-delà de ces compétences, vous êtes reconnu.e pour les qualités suivantes : * Rigueur et honnêteté : vous partagez l'information, y compris vos erreurs, et ne prenez pas de décision risquée seul.e * Écoute et démarche analytique : vous cherchez la vraie cause d'un problème plutôt que de prendre des raccourcis * Esprit d'équipe et goût du partage * Fibre terrain et sens pratique * Capacité à produire une documentation claire et exploitable RÉMUNÉRATION ET AVANTAGES * Rémunération attractive * Variable, intéressement et participation * Statut cadre, forfait jours * 1 jour de télétravail par semaine * Parcours d'intégration structuré : formations groupe, immersion d'environ un mois dans les ateliers, puis montée en compétence progressive sur les projets * Possibilités d'évolution : niveaux d'expertise internes et mobilité vers les autres marchés (aéronautique, défense, spatial, semi-conducteur) Pour nous rejoindre, c'est très simple : postulez à cette offre, passez un premier entretien avec Mathilde de l'équipe LYNKUS, puis nous vous donnerons rendez-vous chez nous ! Toute l'équipe a hâte de vous voir à bord :) Ref 31115971

title: Ingénieur Intégration Mécanique (H/F)
description: Description de l'entreprise Accélérez votre carrière au sein d’un groupe d’ingénierie mondial à forte croissance. Chez SEGULA Technologies, vous travaillerez sur des projets passionnants et contribuerez à façonner l’avenir au sein d’une entreprise pour qui l’innovation est indissociable de l’ingénierie. Impression 3D, réalité augmentée, véhicule autonome, usine du futur… rythment le quotidien de nos 15 000 ingénieux collaborateurs, pourquoi pas le vôtre ? Votre rôle est de garantir que chaque composant trouve sa place avec précision, tout en facilitant les opérations de production. Interface Fournisseurs & Experts : Piloter les échanges techniques avec les fournisseurs pour valider la faisabilité des pièces et définir les solutions optimales. Expérience : Une première expérience réussie dans le secteur ferroviaire Maîtrise Logicielle : * Expert sur CATIA V5 et Excel. Usage fluide des outils PLM (ENOVIA, Teamcenter ou équivalent) Langues : Anglais professionnel indispensable (échanges techniques quotidiens). Soft Skills : * Esprit collaboratif prononcé : vous aimez échanger avec les méthodes, la production et les fournisseurs. Excellente gestion des priorités et capacité d'adaptation. SEGULA Technologies is a global engineering group, boosting the competitiveness of all major industrial sectors: automotive, aerospace, energy, rail, naval, life sciences, and telecoms. With a presence in more than 30 countries and 140 locations worldwide, the Group prioritizes close relationships with its clients, driven by the expertise of its 15,000 employees. As a leading engineering player putting innovation at the heart of its strategy, SEGULA Technologies manages large-scale projects, ranging from initial studies to industrialization and production. SEGULA TECHNOLOGIES is dedicated to gender balance and diversity, recognizing and recruiting talent of all backgrounds.

title: Ingénieur Recherche et Développement Senior (F/H)
description: At ARaymond, we create cutting-edge fastening and assembly systems for the machines and products that keep the world moving. Founded in Grenoble in 1865, and still headquartered in the city to this day, we’re a family-run business with a proud history of innovation – including the invention of the press stud. Human values have driven our success for over 160 years, embodied by our servant-leadership model of management that empowers employees and puts their wellbeing first. Today we employ more than 8,500 people in 25 countries worldwide. And we’re committed to leading in sustainability for the global fastening and assembly market. ARaymondlife is a French pharmaceutical company and the Healthcare Business Unit of the ARaymond Network. With our expertise in plastics processing, we develop and propose innovative solutions for plastic connectors, complex assemblies and packaging adapted to the Healthcare market. Our ambition: to recruit you! Of course, we rely on your technical skills to help us achieve our objectives, but above all, what matters to us is your attitude and willingness to participate in a collective and collaborative project. Connect with ideas that solve big challenges Join our global engineering team to develop ideas and products that shape a better future. Feel inspired in our culture of innovation and creativity, which generates over 1,000 new fastening solutions every year. A propos du projet Nous sommes une entreprise à taille humaine en phase de développement et de transformation. Nous concevons et produisons des solutions de packaging à destination des industries du secteur de la santé. Grâce à nos connaissances des exigences du marché de la santé et notre savoir-faire dans le domaine de l’injection plastique, nous développons des solutions innovantes au service de nos clients. Notre produit phare est le RayDyLyo® et nous agissons également en tant que CDMO accompagnant ainsi nos clients du secteur pharmaceutique dans la conception et la production de dispositifs sur mesure. Nous venons d’emménager dans notre nouveau site industriel de près de 13 900m² dans le 2nd espace économique de la région Grenobloise sur la zone de Centr’Alp. A propos du poste Afin de nous accompagner dans la réussite de nos nombreux challenges, nous recrutons un(e) Ingénieur R&D (F/H) pour contribuer au pilotage des activités de développement de nouveaux produits en assurant la conformité des délivrables associés dans les délais impartis. Rôles et responsabilités Rattaché(e) directement au Responsable Recherche et Développement et en étroite collaboration, vous contribuez au bon déroulement des activités de développement de nouveaux produits et au maintien du portefeuille produit. Vous supportez l’équipe sur des études techniques dans le cadre du développement de nouveaux produits et des activités de rémédiation sur les produits vie série. Dans ce cadre, vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Développement de nouveaux produits Piloter et contribuer à la conception de nouveaux produits Réaliser les activités de conception et de modélisation (chaînes de côtes, calculs, simulations FEA…) Appliquer une approche DFM (Design for Manufacturing) dès les phases amont Planifier et coordonner les activités de développement produit Pilotage technique & gestion des risques Participer aux analyses de risques Produit & Process et suivre les plans de dérisque Piloter les études techniques en collaboration avec les techniciens R&D Assurer le suivi et la coordination de l’exécution des activités Documentation & reporting Être garant de la documentation technique associée (rapports, dossiers de conception, présentations…) Assurer le reporting projet via les revues de conception et revues techniques Produits en Vie série & amélioration continue Assurer le maintien et l’évolution du portefeuille produit en vie série Gérer les modifications et les activités de remédiation Mener les investigations et piloter la résolution de problèmes Coordination transverse Collaborer étroitement avec les fonctions internes : commerce/marketing, industrialisation, qualité, etc. Profil Formation Ingénieur (mécanique, génie industriel ou équivalent) avec 8 à 10 ans d’expérience minimum dans un environnement normé, idéalement médical / pharma / Dispositifs médicaux. Connaissances solides des méthodes de développement produits et outils (conception, modélisation, design for manufacturing, design for six sigma…) Votre niveau d'anglais vous permet d'échanger professionnellement à l'oral et à l'écrit Qualités personnelles L’esprit d'équipe fait partie de votre ADN, votre pédagogie et votre autonomie sont reconnues Vous avez un bon esprit d’analyse, une approche technique et le pragmatisme adapté à une petite structure ; Vous êtes rigoureux, force de proposition et avez la maîtrise de la planification et la gestion des priorités ; Travailler dans un environnement en développement et mouvant ne vous fait pas peur !

title: Entwicklungsingenieur:in F&E | High-Tech Kompressor Startup
description: Wir machen Heizen und Kühlen radikal effizienter. Ecalia ist ein Deep-Tech-Startup aus Stuttgart, das die Kälte- und Wärmepumpentechnik grundlegend neu denkt. Unsere Innovation sind Scroll-Kompressor-Expander-Systeme, die mit konventionellen Kältemitteln arbeiten und den thermodynamischen Kreisprozess näher an das Optimum bringen als alle derzeit auf dem Markt verfügbaren Systeme. Damit adressieren wir einen der größten Hebel für globale Energieeffizienz, denn Heizung und Kühlung verbrauchen fast die Hälfte der weltweiten Energie. Wir wurden als eines der Top-10 innovativsten Tech-Startups Deutschlands ausgezeichnet (Weconomy Award 2025) und arbeiten am Institut für Kunststofftechnik der Universität Stuttgart an unseren Prototypen und Testanlagen. Wir sind ein kleines eingespieltes Team aus derzeit 4 Personen. Wir wachsen und legen Wert auf ein diverses und hochmotiviertes Team. Unser Anspruch ist es auch bisherige Geschäfts- und Entwicklungsprozesse neu zu denken und KI-Tools sukzessive in die Arbeitsabläufe zu integrieren und sie zu unserem primären Arbeitswerkzeug zu entwickeln. Startdatum: Ab November 2026. Aufgaben Du übernimmst einen Teil der Forschungs- und Entwicklungsarbeit , die aktuell unser CTO allein trägt, und arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Systemarchitektur und Werkstatt. Der CTO definiert die technische Richtung, du legst die Komponenten aus und bringst sie zur Baureife, unser Prototypenbau-Ingenieur baut sie. Dein Fokus: Physikalische Probleme oder Bedürfnisse in funktionierende Entwürfe überführen. Systematisch, KI-gestützt und auf hohem Qualitätsniveau. Konkret heißt das: Komponenten auslegen & dimensionieren: Du berechnest Scroll-Geometrien, Dichtungen, Druckbehälter, Wellen und Lager und stellst sicher, dass alles funktioniert. Designvarianten bewerten: Mehrere Lösungswege durchrechnen, vergleichen, dem CTO eine fundierte Empfehlung vorlegen. Dein Ingenieur:innen-Urteil zählt. Konstruieren: CAD-Entwürfe (Autodesk Inventor o.ä.) erstellen, die direkt in den Prototypenbau gehen. Baubar, fertigungsgerecht, durchdacht, und einfach anzupassen. Physikalische Probleme lösen: Verstehen was in unseren Scroll-Maschinen vor sich geht, und mit KI-Tools und Physik unsere Produkte weiterentwickeln. Ob Thermodynamik, Strömungsmechanik oder Festigkeit, du nutzt das Werkzeug, das am schnellsten zur belastbaren Antwort führt: Handrechnung, Python-Skript, Simulation oder Experiment. Wo dir Know-How fehlt, baust du dir KI Agenten die dich ergänzen. Versuche planen & Daten auswerten: Prüfstandsversuche systematisch designen (DoE), Messdaten analysieren, Schlussfolgerungen ziehen, Designiterationen ableiten. Systematisch entwickeln: Wir entwickeln KI-gestützt, aber nicht chaotisch. Du arbeitest nach klaren Strukturen. Berechnungen, Dokumentation und Ergebnisse werden zielgerichtet und nachvollziehbar abgelegt, nicht als lose Excel-Dateien irgendwo geparkt. Du steuerst die KI, korrigierst sie und stellst sicher, dass die Outputs unseren Qualitätsstandards entsprechen. Dafür brauchst du breites und tiefes Verständnis, um Ergebnisse bewerten zu können. title: LPBF Additive Manufacturing Technician

Tribal knowledge is retiring. Supply chains are fragile. At Factory ONE in Munich, metal laser powder bed fusion produces flight and defense hardware where one bad layer can scrap a part worth weeks of work. As our LPBF Technician, you own the metal printers end to end: from build preparation through powder, machine and post-processing to a part that is ready for inspection. You make sure every metal build runs, and every part can be traced back to its powder lot. The Role Run the LPBF machines. Own the powder. Sieving, storage and lot traceability, with strict safety discipline on reactive powders. Post-process. Depowdering, stress relief, plate and support removal, and handover to machining and metrology. Maintain. Filter changes, cleaning, preventive maintenance and first-level troubleshooting. Recover from failures. Secure the data, find the cause, then restart. Document. Build records and non-conformities per EN9100, traceable to every serial number. What We're Looking For 2+ years hands-on LPBF experience in an industrial environment, ideally aerospace, defense, medical or energy. Machine fluency. You have run and maintained LPBF systems on your own (e.g. EOS, SLM/Nikon, Trumpf, Renishaw, Colibrium Additive). You know what a recoater crash, short feed or a rising oxygen level looks like and what to do about it. Powder safety. You know how to handle reactive metal powders safely: inerting, grounding, ATEX awareness, wet separators, PPE. Process understanding. You understand how orientation, supports and parameters affect distortion, porosity and surface quality. Quality mindset. You document cleanly and treat traceability as part of the job. Experience in an EN9100 or ISO 13485 environment is a plus. Hands-on. You depowder, clean, change filters and saw plates yourself. Language: Fluent German for the shop floor, working English for the team in Zurich. On-site: Based in Munich, working on site at Factory ONE. What We're Not Looking For Operators who press start and walk away. Each build gets your attention until the part is off the plate. Anyone who restarts a crashed job without understanding the cause. People who take shortcuts with powder safety or traceability. Anyone who needs every procedure written out before acting. You help write them. What We Offer Mission: Rebuild the industrial sovereignty of the West. Your builds become mission-critical hardware. Growth path: You work directly with our LPBF lead and grow with the metal AM floor, with the option to lead your own sub-team as it scales. Ownership: You run the metal AM floor from day one and shape how it scales. The Environment: A greenfield factory with metal AM, SLS, 5-axis CNC and in-house metrology, in a data-driven production environment. The Team: Close collaboration with engineering, quality, software and robotics. "Special Forces" model: everyone ships, no politics, no bureaucracy. Compensation: Competitive salary incl. share options. Location: Factory ONE, Munich. Apply Resume: Show us the LPBF systems, materials and parts you have worked with. Cover letter: Why this mission? Why now? And describe a build that failed: what caused it, and what you changed afterwards. About Us SAEKI is building the operating system for autonomous factories. The infrastructure that lets Europe manufacture mission-critical components at software speed.

title: Senior Stress & Thermomechanical FEA Engineer - Propulsion Battery System (all genders)
description: Your Mission: As Senior Stress & Thermomechanical FEA Engineer – Propulsion Battery System (all genders) you will join VÆRIDION’s Technology division within the Mechanical Design & Integration team and lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical finite element analysis (FEA) of the propulsion battery system for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft. You will own the computational modelling of battery packs, power distribution units (PDUs), and their internal hardware, predicting how every component behaves under nominal and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions applied to the pack and PDU as airborne equipment (temperature and altitude, temperature variation, humidity, operational shocks and crash safety, and vibration), flight loads, and durability over service life. Your analysis will provide engineering evidence that the propulsion battery system is structurally robust, thermally safe, and certifiable. Within the Mechanical Design & Integration team, you will collaborate with Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, Test, HV Electrical Systems, Airborne Electronics, Thermal Systems, Aircraft Structures, Certification, Safety, and Quality teams to define analysis methods, apply the material property allowable required for your analyses, and substantiate the qualification of the propulsion battery pack and PDU. You will be the structural and thermomechanical analysis authority for the propulsion battery system, responsible for checking and releasing design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements. Your work will directly contribute to the propulsion battery system that underpins VÆRIDION’s mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation. Your Day-to-Day: Lead the structural, stress, and thermomechanical FEA of propulsion battery packs, PDUs, and their internal components, predicting how they behave under nominal operation and emergency conditions – including thermal runaway, the DO-160 environmental qualification conditions, and flight and inertial loads. Perform room-temperature and elevated-temperature analysis of composites (including sandwich structures), metals, adhesives, and mechanical fasteners, capturing temperature-dependent material behaviour. Build and correlate nonlinear models covering material, geometric, and contact nonlinearity – including cohesive-zone and VCCT delamination, composite progressive failure and damage propagation, metal plasticity and rate-dependent behaviour, crushable foam plasticity and densification, large-deformation and post-buckling response, and frictional contact with bolt pretension, including bearing behaviour at fastener holes (bearing yield, hole elongation, and bearing–bypass interaction). Model the hyper-elastic and viscoelastic behaviour of potting compounds, gap fillers, foams, gaskets, seals, and thermal interface materials to predict contact pressure and interface integrity across the life of the pack. Perform durability and life analysis across the differing service lives of components within the system, covering vibration-induced high-cycle fatigue (DO-160 random and sine sweep), low-cycle fatigue from ground–air–ground and charge/discharge thermal cycling, and fatigue of bonded joints, fasteners, busbars, and interconnects. Assess creep and stress relaxation of seals, adhesives, polymers, potting compounds, and thermal interface materials at elevated temperature, including loss of contact pressure across a pack replacement interval. Analyse thermal runaway response as a coupled thermomechanical event – pressure loads, direct impingement flow, ejecta, and heat transfer to surrounding structure and systems – working closely with the Thermal Systems team on thermal runaway CFD modelling and the resulting heat transfer boundary conditions, in support of containment and continued safe flight and landing. Apply static, fatigue, and creep material property allowable (room and elevated temperature) in the substantiation of the propulsion battery pack and PDU, working to established methodologies such as CMH-17 for composites and MMPDS for metallics, and specify the allowable, material data, and test conditions required from the Materials & Processes and Test teams. Automate and script analysis workflows – model generation, parametric studies, load case sweeps, and post-processing – using Python for Abaqus scripting, and develop closed-form and lower-order analysis methods in Python or MATLAB to size hardware quickly and to verify finite element results. Interface closely with the Mechanical Design, Materials & Processes, and Airborne Electronics teams to translate analysis results into design improvements and robust, certifiable hardware. Check and release design against the applicable stress and thermomechanical requirements, providing the stress sign-off for propulsion battery pack and PDU hardware releases. Define modelling standards, assumptions, load cases, and acceptance criteria, and maintain configuration-controlled analysis models and inputs. Support test planning and post-test correlation of FEA models against coupon, component, and full-scale test data. Author and release certification documentation, including analysis reports and means-of-compliance evidence for structural, environmental, and thermal runaway requirements. Your Profile: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural/Computational Mechanics, or a related field; a PhD in a relevant area is beneficial. 5+ years of experience in structural/stress and thermomechanical FEA, preferably in aerospace, automotive, battery systems, or other high-performance engineering environments. Experience taking analytical responsibility for hardware, including checking the work of others and providing stress sign-off or equivalent release approval within a configuration-controlled environment, is desirable. Strong command of nonlinear FEA across

description: Le Groupe REEL (3000 personnes en France et à l'international) est spécialisé dans la conception, la fabrication et la maintenance de systèmes de manutention et de levage complexes pour des industries variées et à fort potentiel de croissance telles que l'aéronautique, l'énergie (nucléaire, hydroélectrique), l’aluminium, les énergies marines et offshore. Le groupe se distingue par son approche sur-mesure, son engagement envers l'innovation technologique, et sa capacité à fournir des solutions robustes et sécurisées, tout en mettant un fort accent sur la sécurité et la durabilité. Vous souhaitez rejoindre le leader des systèmes de levage et de manutention complexes ? Rencontrez-nous, étonnez-nous, rejoignez-nous ! Poste Dans le cadre de nos projets dans le domaine de la Défense et du Nucléaire Civil, notre bureau d’étude mécanique recherche un: Ingénieur Calcul Défense H/F Au sein d’une équipe de 3 ingénieurs Calculs et rattaché au responsable du Bureau d'Études Calculs du service Levage sécurisé projets, nous recherchons un profil confirmé autonome, capable de prendre des décisions, de proposer des initiatives pertinentes, de travailler en équipe et d’apporter un soutien opérationnel au responsable du service lorsque nécessaire. Vous aurez en charge le dimensionnement de ponts roulants et de machines spéciales dans le milieu nucléaire et défense. Nos projets sont variés et nécessite une forte technicité. Pour cela, vos principales missions sont les suivantes : - Selon la taille des projets, vous piloterez une équipe d’ingénieurs calculs sur les aspects maitrise des risques, respect du budget et des délais liés au projet tout en garantissant la satisfaction du client. - Dimensionner les systèmes et/ou les structures : RDM et calculs de structures par éléments finis sous les logiciels ANSYS APDL et Worbench - Appliquer les règles de calculs statiques et dynamique (vibration des structures, calculs sismiques) dans les domaines linéaire et non-linéaire - Contribuer à l'élaboration des études dans le respect des exigences des projets (coût/délai/performance) et de nombreuses contraintes - Contribuer à la justification des choix et compromis relatifs au cahier des charges, par la rédaction des dossiers justificatifs d'études - Répondre techniquement à un besoin client - Rédaction des documentations techniques : note d’hypothèses présentant les données d’entrée et les méthodologies, notes de calculs EF et RDM présentant les résultats nécessaires à la validation des calculs, …) - Être acteur pour proposer et optimiser des solutions techniques en partenariat avec le Bureau d’Etudes Mécanique - Contribuer au développement et à la montée en compétences du Bureau d'Études Calculs - Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des méthodes, process et outil. Profil De formation Ingénieur, mécanique ou équivalent, vous avez une expérience idéalement de 10 ans en calculs dans le secteur de la métallurgique ou de la construction mécanique. Vous maitrisez les méthodes de calculs à l’aide des logiciels ANSYS ou Worbench. Autonome et rigoureux(se), vous aurez la responsabilité des notes de calculs, en veillant à leur conformité aux besoins clients et aux normes applicables, comme FEM et EN13001. Doté(e) d’un esprit d’analyse, d’une excellente organisation et d’un bon niveau d’anglais technique, vous saurez travailler en mode projet au sein d’une équipe multi-métiers. Engagé dans la diversité et dans le respect de nos valeurs, tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

description: Vulcain Engineering Group est un groupe d’ingénierie et de conseil en forte croissance, présent en France et à l’international. Concrètement, nous aidons à décarboner, optimiser la consommation d’eau et réduire l’empreinte environnementale des procédés industriels. Nous investissons aussi dans la transformation numérique pour renforcer l’innovation et la performance de nos clients. title: Postdoc offer on the physics of mechanical metamaterials H/F
description: Position description Category Condensed Matter Physics, chemistry, nanosciences Contract Fixed-term contract Job title Postdoc offer on the physics of mechanical metamaterials H/F Socio-professional category Executive Contract duration (months) 24 Job Description The successful candidate will be responsible for: Develop the numerical and analytical tools required to design these tunable random architectures and predict the mechanical behavior of the resulting metamaterials (elastic moduli, yield strength, toughness). Use these tools to develop new brick-and-mortar architectures inspired by osteoderms, combining lightness, hardness, and toughness in unprecedented ways. She/he will play a central role in directing and carrying out the above program, drawing on the skills present in the two partner groups. More generally, she/he will also benefit from the ecosystem developed around the PEPR DIADEM and the ADAM project. Its results will be disseminated via scientific publications, conference presentations, and even patenting if the application potential lends itself to this. Applicant Profile Required profile: With a PhD in physics or mechanical engineering, the successful candidate will have acquired solid skills in the mathematical and numerical methods developed in solid and structural mechanics. In the course of their previous experience, they will have developed knowledge in one or more areas of non-linear physics or solid mechanics, such as fracture mechanics, deformation and buckling of slender structures, mechanical instabilities, or architectural materials. Curious and creative by nature, the successful candidate will have a keen interest in conducting collaborative research in an interdisciplinary environment involving students, researchers, technicians, and students with diverse skills. The successful candidate will have demonstrated writing skills, in writing articles in particular. Practical aspects: This postdoctoral research position is funded for two years (one year renewable) with a September/December 2025 start date (to be defined with the successful candidate). Salary level will depend on the experience of the candidate recruited (post-docs who have just completed their thesis are very welcome). It will take place at CEA Saclay's Orme des Merisiers center, located on the Université Paris-Saclay site, 25 km south of Paris, and easily accessible by public transport. How to apply: Candidates should send their application by email to Daniel Bonamy, Valérie Geertsen, and Patrick Guenoun (daniel.bonamy@cea.fr, valerie.geertsen@cea.fr, patrick.guenoun@cea.fr). The application includes a curriculum vitae, a list of publications, and a list of two references to contact (at least two) Contact : M. title: Project Launch Engineer
description: Mubea is a global leader in lightweight engineering solutions, with more than 100 years of history and over 70 manufacturing locations worldwide. Beyond its strong automotive heritage, Mubea has also established itself as a trusted partner in the aerospace industry through Mubea Aviation, delivering advanced components and assemblies for leading aircraft programs. Mubea Türkiye operates manufacturing and engineering facilities in Manisa, Ergene, and Çerkezköy, serving the automotive, aviation, and home appliance industries. The Ergene plant plays a key role in Mubea’s aviation operations, supporting the development and serial production of advanced aerospace components and assemblies in close collaboration with international customers. We are looking for a dynamic, structured, and results-oriented Project Launch Engineer to join our team in Ergene and support the successful launch and execution of customer projects, ensuring seamless coordination from project planning through to serial production. About the Role As a Project Launch Engineer , you will coordinate customer and internal project activities from planning through implementation. You will act as a key interface between customers and internal functions, ensuring projects are delivered in line with agreed targets for schedule, cost, quality, and performance . What You'll Do: Coordinate and lead customer alignment meetings, including meeting documentation, work package definition, and action follow-up, Coordinate activities with customers and internal departments to ensure smooth project execution, Coordinate project activities related to composite component development and manufacturing, from industrialization through serial production, Develop and monitor project schedules, timelines, and budgets, Track project progress and KPIs and initiate corrective actions when required, Prepare project documentation, presentations, status reports, and management reports, Support the preparation and maintenance of D-FMEA and P-FMEA with a focus on composite component design and manufacturing processes,, Plan and coordinate sampling and approval processes in accordance with PPAP, VDA, and customer-specific requirements, Support the implementation of customer requirements and management of engineering changes. What We're Looking For: Technical or commercial education or a Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable field, Professional experience in project and/or process management, preferably in the aviation industry, Knowledge of FMEA methodologies, including D-FMEA and P-FMEA, Knowledge of production part approval processes such as PPAP and VDA, Experience in cross-functional project coordination and customer requirements management, Understanding of composite materials, composite component manufacturing, and related production processes, Excellent communication, coordination, and organizational skills, Very good MS Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, Strong command of English, both written and spoken, Knowledge of ERP systems, Knowledge of OEM production processes and serial aircraft manufacturing is desirable, CAD knowledge, preferably CATIA V5, is an advantage. Core Competencies Strong project management and organizational skills, Analytical and problem-solving mindset, Excellent communication and stakeholder management, Customer and result-oriented approach, Strong coordination and follow-up skills, Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams, Adaptability to dynamic and international environments. Why Mubea? Be part of a global, family-owned engineering company with a people-focused culture, operating across both the automotive and aviation industries, A collaborative, international team culture, Continuous learning and development opportunities, Opportunities for professional growth in a scaling organization.

Candidates should possess Project Management and Project Planning skills to define scope, schedule activities, manage resources, and monitor project progress. Candidates should demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and the capacity to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced setting. Candidates with proficiency in project management tools, CAD or drawing review software, and familiarity with applicable standards and regulations will be preferred.

title: Project Engineer (M/W) (V.I.E Contract)
description: As a global key player in yeasts and fermentation, Lesaffre designs, manufactures and markets innovative solutions for Baking, Food taste & pleasure, Health care and Biotechnology. Family group born in northern France in 1853, now a multi-national and a multicultural company, Lesaffre is committed to working with confidence to better nourish and protect the planet. In close collaboration with its clients and partners, Lesaffre employs 11 700 people in nearly 80 subsidiaries based in +60 countries. Lesaffre achieves a turnover of 3 billion euros. Job Description Why Amasya? Amasya, a growing city in the heart of Turkey, combines modernity, quality of life and cultural openness 🌍. Its economic dynamism attracts many international companies, offering a stimulating professional environment rich in learning opportunities. Choosing a VIE in Amasya means enjoying a rich intercultural experience, a pleasant living environment and real opportunities to boost your career while living a unique adventure ✨. Your Mission You will provide on‑site operational support to the Engineering Project Manager during the implementation of the AMASIS project in Turkey. Reporting to a Project Manager in the Group Engineering Department, your main responsibilities will include: Producing technical documents (drafting technical specifications and terms of reference), Checking that suppliers’ tenders comply technically with the terms of reference or specifications, Reviewing plans and documents issued by subcontractors and verifying their compliance with process plans (PFDs, PIDs), Monitoring contractors on site (technical, equipment, personnel, health and safety, and scheduling aspects) in accordance with the specifications (quality, costs and deadlines), Analyse deviations and report findings, Attend handover procedures for works and equipment, Participate in the commissioning of installations alongside suppliers and production teams, Update the project’s technical file (supplier documentation, as-built plans, etc.) Qualifications 👀 Who we’re looking for : Graduated from an engineering school, Arts & Métiers or equivalent You have gained some initial experience in a design office, project management or industrial site supervision. Skills: Your skills and technical sensitivity enable you to be a true hands-on engineer. Solid knowledge of industrial plant and equipment, ideally in the food and drink sector. Ability to work in a multicultural environment on projects requiring autonomy, initiative and team spirit. Your ability to listen and your sense of responsibility enable you to ensure a project runs smoothly. Fluency in English is essential, fluency in Turkish is a plus. Additional Information 📅 Mission details 📍 Location : Amasya, Turkey ⏳ Duration : 24 months 🚀 Start : Q1 2027 🧪 Recruitment process : Phone screening + 3 interviews : [Group HR, Engineering Project Manager + Industrial capability Director, Local referent + Local RH]. 🎯 Goal : To offer you a long-term worldwide career after your V.I.E ! 🎟️ V.I.E – Eligibility Age: 18–28 years old Citizenship: EU or EEA country Never completed a V.I.E before ℹ️ More info 👉Mon Volontariat International - official VIE | VIA web site [Diversity & Inclusion]: At Lesaffre, diversity is a strength that enriches our culture and our teams. We are committed to offering you a work environment where you can thrive, regardless of your background, gender, age or abilities. We encourage all applications, as we believe that diverse perspectives strengthen our ability to innovate and meet the challenges of tomorrow.

title: Mechanical BIM Technician
description: Shape a future with purpose at Arup in Istanbul Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach have set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. We guide, plan and design the future of the built environment. We are a global consultancy with extensive technical and advisory expertise. Our teams work at the intersection of engineering excellence and digital innovation, delivering complex, high-quality projects through integrated and multidisciplinary design. The Opportunity We are looking for a Mechanical BIM Technician to join our team in Istanbul and support the delivery of complex construction projects. In this role, you will be responsible for preparing designs, drawings and coordination of mechanical systems using computer-aided design (CAD) and BIM tools. The systems include heating, cooling, ventilation, plumbing, hot and cold water, steam, compressed air, fire protection systems and other building services. You will work closely with engineers, architects and other disciplines to develop coordinated and practical solutions for projects. As a Mechanical BIM Technician At Arup, You Will Prepare and develop mechanical BIM models and technical drawings. Coordinate mechanical systems with electrical, structural, civil and architectural disciplines. Support project delivery through accurate and high-quality documentation. Use BIM tools to improve design coordination and project efficiency. Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary project teams. Does this role inspire you? Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in mechanical drafting/BIM design. Preferably graduated from a Technical Drafting programme at a vocational high school, Mechanical Technical Drafting (Heating and Ventilation) programme at a vocational college, or a related technical university programme. Strong knowledge of Revit MEP, MagiCAD for Revit and Navisworks (knowledge of Dynamo is an advantage). Advanced knowledge of AutoCAD and MS Office. Experience preparing coordinated drawings across mechanical, electrical, civil and architectural disciplines. Completed military service (for male candidates). Strong attention to detail, good organisation skills and the ability to work effectively within a team. Why Arup? At Arup, we believe in rewarding our members for their contributions to our shared success. As a trust-owned company, we have the freedom to pursue meaningful work that aligns with our purpose and values. We also offer a unique profit share program, allowing our members to share in the results of our collective efforts. Benefits That Work For You Professional Growth & Development: Benefit from continuous learning opportunities, training programs, and mentorship to enhance your skills and advance your career at Arup. Global Opportunities: Collaborate with colleagues worldwide and explore potential short-term or long-term assignments at other Arup offices and project locations. Financial Well-being & Ownership: Receive a competitive salary and benefits package and share in Arup's success through our global profit-sharing programme. Flexible working: Working from home up to 3 days a week and up to 20 days a year from another country. At Arup, you belong to an extraordinary collective where individuality is encouraged. Our strength comes from how we respect, share, and connect our diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas. You'll have the opportunity to do socially useful work that has meaning – to Arup, to your career, and to the clients and communities we serve. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of the world around us. We actively promote a culture of inclusion where everyone feels welcome, respected, and valued. We welcome applications from talented individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, disability, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible. If you need any assistance or adjustments, please visit our Candidate Support page for contact information and assistance. We're happy to help. Do you want to join us in shaping a better world? Apply – Click ‘Apply for Job’

title: Contract Logistics Customer Solutions Engineer
description: It's more than a job We are seeking a bilingual (Turkish & English) Customer Solutions Engineer to join our Contract Logistics team in Gebze, Istanbul. This is a great opportunity for a logistics and supply chain professionals who enjoy solving complext operational challenges, designing warehouse solutions, and working directly with customers. ‎ You will be part of the Solution Design team within our Contract Logistics business in Turkey, supporting the development of innovative and customer-focused logistics solutions. Working in a fast-paced operational environment with a challenging project agenda, you will design end-to-end operational solutions for customer RFQs, deliver projects utilizing Kuehne+Nagel’s global tools and methodologies, and collaborate closely with national, regional, and cross-functional stakeholders. You will play a key role in translating customer requirements into efficient and scalable logistics solutions while ensuring alignment with Kuehne+Nagel’s strategic vision, values, and organizational culture. How you create impact Analyze and assess logistics processes for existing and new customers; Design and optimize end-to-end warehouse and logistics solutions; Develop warehouse layouts and operational flows using tools such as AutoCAD; Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities across logistics operations; Translate customer requirements into efficient and scalable supply chain solutions; Support RFQs and tenders by preparing solution concepts and activity-based cost calculations; Collaborate closely with Business Development to create competitive customer proposals; Present technical and operational solutions to customers and stakeholders; Support customer onboarding activities and implementation planning; Monitor project implementation to ensure delivery on time and within budget; Coordinate issue resolution and manage challenges during implementation phases; Create customer-focused solutions that balance operational, commercial, and financial requirements. What we would like you to bring Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field; Minimum 2 years of Solution Design experience within warehousing or contract logistics; Strong understanding of warehouse operations and logistics processes; Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset; Fluent Turkish and English communication skills, both written and spoken; Advanced Excel skills, including data analysis and modeling; Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; Advanced AutoCAD skills for warehouse and layout design; Ability to design operationally efficient and customer-focused logistics solutions; Strong business acumen with an understanding of commercial and financial drivers; Excellent stakeholder management, presentation, and collaboration skills; Results-oriented professional with a continuous improvement mindset and the ability to manage multiple projects in a dynamic environment. Because some stages of the hiring process are carried out in English, we kindly ask all applicants to upload their resume in English What's in it for you At Kuehne + Nagel you can demonstrate your personal and professional attributes. And you will have countless opportunities for further development. Benefit from the comprehensive offers provided by a global market leader and contribute your ideas on how we can continue to get a little better every day. You can be sure: Your opinion counts. Who we are Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world. As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine. Any submissions of candidates without prior signed agreement will be considered our property and no fees will be paid.

title: Servo Tasarım Mühendisi
description: ASELSAN Radar ve Elektronik Harp Sistemleri (REHİS) Sektör Başkanlığı bünyesinde Ankara Gölbaşı yerleşkesinde görevlendirilmek üzere bize güç katacak; üniversitelerin Elektrik-Elektronik, Kontrol, Elektrik Mühendisliği bölümlerinden mezun Servo Tasarım Mühendisi çalışma arkadaşları arıyoruz. BU POZİSYONDA EN ÖNEM VERDİĞİMİZ YETKİNLİKLER VE DENEYİMLER Tercihen kontrol ve/veya servo tasarım alanlarında lisansüstü çalışmaları yapmış, Kontrol ve/veya servo tasarım ile ilgili dersleri lisans ve/veya lisansüstü aşamalarında almış, Matlab/Simulink ve/veya benzeri simülasyon araçlarıyla sistem modelleme ve kontrol algoritmaları geliştirmede deneyimli/istekli, Klasik kontrol (PID, Laplace, Bode, Nyquist, loopshaping, frekans tabanlı dizayn) yöntemleri hakkında bilgi sahibi, Servo motorlar, geribesleme elemanları ve motor sürücüleri hakkında bilgi sahibi, Motor (PMSM, BLDC) sürüş algoritmaları (trapezoidal, sinüzoidal, vektör kontrol, FOC) hakkında bilgi sahibi, Tercihen mekanik aktarım elemanları (dişli kutuları, redüktörler, bağlantı sistemleri vb.) hakkında bilgi sahibi, Tercihen gerçek zamanlı gömülü yazılım hakkında bilgi sahibi, Tercihen frekans tabanlı sistem tanımlama (System identification) yöntemleri, FFT ve sistem dinamikleri (rezonans, anti-rezonanslar) hakkında bilgi sahibi. SENDEN NELER BEKLİYORUZ? Sistem gereksinimlerinden başlayarak tasarım ister dokümanlarına görüş vermek, Tasarım isterlerine uyumlu servo tasarım birim mimarisi oluşturmak, Tasarım isterlerine uyumlu komponenetleri seçmek (motor, açı kodlayıcı, motor sürücü vb.) Tasarımın etkileştiği komponentlerin seçimine görüş vermek (redüktör, mekanik aktarım elemanları, birimin takılacağı platform vb.), Farklı disiplinlerle (elektronik, yazılım, mekanik vb.) koordineli çalışmak, Benzetim programlarını kullanarak tasarımı modellemek, Tasarlanan birimi prototip olarak gerçekleştirmek, Prototip birim doğrulama süreçlerine (performans, çevre koşulları, EMI/EMC uyumluluk testlerine) katkı vermek, Tasarlanan birim hakkında teknik dokümantasyon hazırlamak, Tasarlanan birimin üretim, test ve entegrasyon aşamalarında aktif görev alarak iyileştirme çalışmalarını yapmak, Sahadan gelen geri bildirimlere yönelik çözümler oluşturmak, Gerektiğinde birden fazla projede görev alabilmek. *İşe alım kriterlerimizi ASELSAN internet sayfamızda Kariyer Sekmesinde bulunan İşe Alım Sürecimiz alanından inceleyerek iş başvuru formumuzu doldur. Aselsan ailesinin bir parçası olarak yerli ve milli projelerdeki başarımızda senin de imzan olsun. Biz Kimiz? Alanında dünyanın en iyi ürünlerini yapma, oyun değiştirici teknolojiler geliştirme ve ihracat odaklı büyüme hedeflerimizle ülkemize ve dünyanın dört bir yanındaki kullanıcılarımıza değer katan küresel bir markayız.

title: Control Engineer (Remote)
description: Job Description We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Control Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electronic Communication Engineering, Control Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or Mechatronics Engineering. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and implementing advanced control strategies for hybrid and battery electric vehicle (BEV) propulsion systems. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement model-based control strategies for hybrid and BEV propulsion systems Utilize Simulink for control system design and simulation Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure effective integration of control systems Conduct performance analysis and optimization of propulsion control systems Stay up to date with the latest advancements in control theory and propulsion technologies Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Electronic Communication Engineering, Control Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or Mechatronics Engineering Advanced proficiency in English Strong knowledge of control theory Experience in model-based control development and Simulink Familiarity with hybrid and BEV propulsion systems and related software Excellent teamwork and communication skills If you’re excited to contribute to next-generation vehicle technologies and grow within an innovative team, we encourage you to apply today! Amaris Consulting is committed to promoting diversity within its workforce and to creating an inclusive work environment. We consider applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnic origin, beliefs, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic.Special attention will be given to candidates with disabilities. Who are we? Amaris Consulting, part of Mantu is an independent technology consulting firm providing guidance and solutions to businesses. With more than 1,000 clients across the globe, we have been rolling out solutions in major projects for over a decade – this is made possible by an international team of 7,600 people spread across 5 continents and more than 60 countries. Our solutions focus on four different Business Lines: Information System & Digital, Telecom, Life Sciences and Engineering. We’re focused on building and nurturing a top talent community where all our team members can achieve their full potential. Amaris is your steppingstone to cross rivers of change, meet challenges and achieve all your projects with success. At Amaris, we strive to provide our candidates with the best possible recruitment experience. We like to get to know our candidates, challenge them, and be able to give them proper feedback as quickly as possible. Here's what our recruitment process looks like: Brief Call : Our process typically begins with a brief virtual/phone conversation to get to know you! The objective? Learn about you, understand your motivations, and make sure we have the right job for you! Interviews (the average number of interviews is 3 - the number may vary depending on the level of seniority required for the position). During the interviews, you will meet people from our team: your line manager of course, but also other people related to your future role. We will talk in depth about you, your experience, and skills, but also about the position and what will be expected of you. Of course, you will also get to know Amaris: our culture, our roots, our teams, and your career opportunities! Case study : Depending on the position, we may ask you to take a test. This could be a role play, a technical assessment, a problem-solving scenario, etc. As you know, every person is different and so is every role in a company. That is why we have to adapt accordingly, and the process may differ slightly at times. However, please know that we always put ourselves in the candidate's shoes to ensure they have the best possible experience. We look forward to meeting you!

title: Data & Analytics Engineer
description: Role Description This is a full-time role for an Azure Data & Analytics Engineer located in İzmir. The role will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines using Azure technologies and creating Power BI dashboards. Day-to-day tasks include data modeling, ETL processes, data warehousing, and data analytics. The engineer will work closely with other teams to ensure data integrity, performance, and security. Qualifications Preferably, skills in Data Engineering and Data Modeling Proficiency in Extract Transform Load (ETL) processes Knowledge of Data Analytics, Power BI Familiarity with Azure and cloud-based data solutions is a plus Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field Strong communication, requirements gathering, and solution design skills with business stakeholders Working English proficiency; presentation and documentation skills Candidate must have; Developed applications using Microsoft Power Apps or built reports using Power BI. Experienced in big data management, preferably using Azure services such as Azure Data Lake, Data Bricks Microsoft Fabric or Synapse Analytics. Experience using MSSQL (serverless SQL). Professional level proficiency in English (C1 and higher). Responsibilities: Building reports using Power BI. Developing and testing automated flows on Azure Power Automate. Developing dashboards and reports to communicate data insights to stakeholders. Designing high-performance semantic layers with Power BI data modeling (Tabular), DAX, and Power Query (M) Managing data source integrations (SQL, API, Excel/SharePoint), gateway/refresh plans, and RLS/OLS security configurations Implementing design principles, usability, and storytelling standards for enterprise reports and dashboards Also candidate will be responsible for; Conduct ad-hoc data analysis (statistical analysis and modeling) to identify patterns and correlations in the data and deep dives to answer business questions and provide recommendations. Collect, clean, and analyze data from various sources, including internal and external databases, to generate insights and identify growth opportunities.

title: Saha Test Uzmanı (Van)
description: Bir Turkcell grup şirketi olarak 1999 yılında kurulduğumuzda amacımız hep eşsiz bir müşteri deneyimi yaşatmaktı.Yıllar geçse de amacımız hiç değişmedi ve bugün biz yine aynı odak noktası ve artan heyecanımızla; toplam 15 lokasyonda, 16 binden fazla çalışanımızla firmaların müşteri deneyimini iyileştirmeye devam ediyoruz. Telekom sektöründeki köklü tecrübemizin yanı sıra; finans, sigorta, e-ticaret, perakende, ulaştırma, hızlı tüketim, havacılık, otomotiv, teknoloji, enerji ve kamu sektörlerinde hizmet vermekteyiz. Eşsiz müşteri deneyimine ulaşabilmek için geleneksel bir kanal olan ve Ana Hizmetlerimizin altında yeralan çağrı hizmetlerimize; Dijital, Teknolojik ve Danışmanlık Hizmetlerimizi de ekleyerek güçlendirdik. Daha hızlı, tasarruf sağlayan, kolay ulaşılabilen bir müşteri deneyimi sunmak için RPA (Robotik Süreç Otomasyonu), Dijital Yardım Masası, Social Sniffer, Konuşma Analizi, Bulut Santral, Chat & Chat Bot gibi dijital hizmetlerimizi kullanıyoruz. Müşteri deneyimi uçtan uca bir süreç olduğu için; Deneyim Tasarımı, Kalite & Araştırma Yönetimi gibi danışmanlık hizmetlerimiz ile bu deneyimin tasarım aşamasını da analitik bir bakış açısıyla sunuyoruz.Ana hizmetlerimiz içerisinde yer alan çağrı hizmetlerimizi ise sadece ses kanalı ile vermekle kalmayıp, görüntülü görüşme ve otomatik sesli yanıt sistemleri (IVR) ile destekleyerek müşterilerimize eşsiz bir deneyim yaşatıyoruz. ‘’Turkcell İletişim Hizmetleri A.Ş. ve Grup Şirketleri, kişisel verilerinizin hukuka uygun olarak toplanması, saklanması, paylaşılmasını sağlamak ve gizliliğini korumak amacıyla mümkün olan en üst seviyede güvenlik tedbirleri almaktadır. İletmiş olduğunuz özgeçmişiniz doğrultusunda, kişisel verileriniz veri sorumlusu olarak Turkcell ve Grup Şirketleri tarafından toplanarak işlenebilecektir. Kişisel verilerinize ilişkin detaylı bilgi almak, Kanun’un 11. maddesinde düzenlenen haklarınızı kullanmak ve başvuru yöntemlerini öğrenmek için Turkcell Çalışan Adayı Aydınlatma Metni'ni ‘’https://globalbilgi.com.tr/wpcontent/uploads/2023/12/TURKCELL_Calisan_Adayi_Aydinlatma_Metni.pdf’’ internet adresimizden inceleyebilirsiniz.” İş Tanımı Çağrı Merkezi, VIP veya Kurumsal kanallardan gelen radyo şebeke şikayetlerini (ses kesilmesi, çağrı düşmesi, düşük veri hızı vb.) teknik araçlarla incelemek ve kök neden analizi yapmak. Abone bazlı sinyal izleme (trace) kayıtlarını analiz ederek sorunun yaşandığı andaki şebeke durumunu tespit etmek. Şikayet yoğunluğu olan veya kapasite darboğazı yaşanan bölgelerde sinyal kalitesini artırmak amacıyla; hücre parametreleri, anten eğimleri (tilt), yönleri (azimut) ve çıkış güçleri üzerinde revizyonlar planlamak. Hücreler arası geçişlerin sorunsuz olması için komşuluk (handover) ve frekans/kod planlamalarını gerçekleştirmek. Sorumluluk alanındaki hücrelerin ana performans göstergelerini (KPI - Drop Call, Call Setup, Throughput vb.) günlük/haftalık olarak takip etmek ve "kötü performanslı hücreler" için proaktif çözümler geliştirmek. Şikayetlerin teknik çözüm süreçlerini tamamlayarak, müşteriyle temas kuran ekiplere anlaşılır teknik geri bildirimler sağlamak. Saha operasyon, transmisyon ve Temel şebeke ekipleriyle koordineli çalışarak fiziksel arıza veya altyapı kaynaklı sorunların hızlıca çözülmesini sağlamak. Nitelikler En az ön lisans mezunu, Telekomünikasyon sektöründe, özellikle RF Planlama, Optimizasyon veya Şebeke Müşteri Şikayetleri Yönetimi alanlarında en az 2 yıl deneyimli, 2G, 3G, 4G (LTE) mobil şebeke mimarilerine hâkim (Tercihen 5G teknolojisi hakkında bilgi sahibi), RF Planlama ve Coğrafi Bilgi Sistemleri araçlarını ( Atoll, Planet, MapInfo, Google Earth,TEMS vb.) etkin şekilde kullanabilen, Büyük verileri analiz etme becerisine sahip, tercihen SQL veya ileri düzey MS Excel bilgisi olan, Tercihen Teknik literatürü ve global dokümanları takip edebilecek düzeyde bilgi sahibi olan, Başvuracak adayların Van'da ikamet etmesi gerekmektedir. Seni Neler Bekliyor? Farklı çalışma modeli alternatifleri sunan “Ahenk” ile çalışma fırsatı! (Uzaktan, Hibrit, Ofisten) #buradakariyervar uygulamamız ile otonom kariyer fırsatı! Mesleki ve kişisel eğitim & gelişim fırsatları! (Liderlik Gelişim Programları, Focus Data-RPA-Agile-AI İnovasyon Sertifika Programları) Anlaşmalı üniversite ve dil okulları ile eğitim desteği! Bireysel & takım koçluğu ve mentorluk programları! Takdir ve ödüllendirme uygulamaları! Annelere özel okulun ilk günü/karne günü izni! Online psikolog, sağlık, diyetisyen, veteriner ve bitki danışmanlığı desteği! Sosyal kulüpler ile keyifli, zinde ve mutlu bir çalışma ortamı! Çalışanlara özel indirim ve kampanyalar!
