title: Lead / Senior High Frequency & SI/PI Engineer
company: Numesys | Ansys Part of Synopsys Elite Channel Partner
description: Senior Application Engineer – Electronics (High Frequency & SI/PI) Numesys Hakkında Numesys; Ansys Elite Channel Partner olarak mühendislik simülasyonu, bilgisayar destekli mühendislik (CAE) çözümleri, teknik danışmanlık ve eğitim hizmetleri sunan lider bir teknoloji firmasıdır. Müşterilerimizin ürün geliştirme süreçlerini hızlandırmak, maliyetlerini azaltmak ve inovasyon kapasitelerini en üst seviyeye çıkarmak için teknik mükemmeliyeti iş zekasıyla birleştiriyoruz. Mühendislik ekibimizde görev alarak savunma sanayii, havacılık, otomotiv ve elektronik gibi lider sektörlerdeki öncü firmaların High Frequency (HF)/HFSS ve PCB/SIwave simülasyon süreçlerine yön verecek Senior Application Engineer – Electronics (High Frequency & SI/PI) arıyoruz. Rolün Amacı ve Vizyonu Bu rolde temel göreviniz; Ansys High Frequency ve PCB simülasyon portföyünü ( özellikle Ansys HFSS olmak üzere, Ansys SIWave ile birlikte) kullanarak müşterilerimizin mühendislik problemlerine doğru teknik çözümler sunmak, teknik yetkinliğinizi değere dönüştürmek ve satış öncesinden satış sonrasına kadar uçtan uca müşteri memnuniyetini sağlamaktır. Temel Sorumluluklar Satış Sonrası Teknik Destek & Müşteri Yönetimi (Post-sales Support): Müşterilerin yazılım kullanımı (Ansys HFSS ve SIWave) sırasında karşılaştığı zorlukları, teknik engelleri ve hata mesajlarını e-posta, telefon, uzaktan bağlantı ve yerinde destek yöntemleriyle çözüme kavuşturmak. Müşterilerle olan iletişimde süreci aksatmamak, proaktif bilgilendirme yapmak ve gerçek anlamda sahiplenerek yüksek müşteri empati seviyesi sunmak. Kazanılan kalıcı teknik deneyimleri kurumsal Bilgi Tabanı (Knowledge Base) sistemine aktararak bilginin kurumsallaşmasını sağlamak. Satış Öncesi Hizmetler (Presales & Business Value): Müşterilerin ve potansiyel müşterilerin ürün geliştirme/doğrulama süreçlerini (teknik olarak) analiz ederek Ansys HFSS ve SIwave çözümlerinin entegrasyonunu sağlamak. Satış ekibi ile birlikte MEDDIC tabanlı kalifikasyon süreçlerine katılmak; müşteri ihtiyaçlarını ve teknik faydayı belirlemek ve ilgili süreçlerin eksiksiz tamamlanmasını sağlamak açısından ilgili aktivitelere katılım sağlamak Tanımlanmış hedefler çerçevesinde teknik yönlendirme, deneme sürümü ile ilgili müşterinin öğrenim ve uyumlanma süreci, PoC (Proof of Concept) ve Benchmark çalışmalarını yürütmek. Eğitim Hizmetleri (Customer Trainings): Müşterilerin yazılımları içselleştirmesi ve kullanım seviyelerini artırmak amacıyla canlı sınıf eğitimleri, özel ve genel online eğitimler vermek. Numesys’in e-öğrenme platformu olan Numesys Learning Portal’e ilgili eğitimler ve örnek simülasyon çalışmaları hazırlamak. Numesys Eğitim Yönergesi esaslarına uyarak eğitim öncesi, sırası ve sonrasındaki (KVKK, anket, katılımcı takibi vb.) tüm süreçleri profesyonelce yönetmek. Mühendislik & Proje Hizmetleri: Müşterilerin ihtiyaç duyduğu bilgisayar destekli mühendislik analizlerini değerlendirmek ve gereken eforu (adam*saat) belirlemek, gerekiyorsa teknik teklif metnini oluşturmak, hizmet olarak gerçekleştirmek, detaylı raporlamak ve iyileştirme önerilerinde bulunmak. Teknik Doküman/İçerik Üretimi: Webinarlar, teknik seminerler, makaleler, fuar/konferans sunumları ve sosyal medya teknik içerikleri hazırlamak ve sunmak. Aranan Nitelikler ve Yetkinlikler Eğitim ve Deneyim: Üniversitelerin Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği, Elektronik ve Haberleşme Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun. Yüksek frekans elektromanyetik simülasyonlar – bilgisayar-destekli mühendislik (CAE – computer-aided engineering) alanında en az 4–7 yıl sektör veya teknik uygulama deneyimine sahip olmak (Numesys Kariyer Yönetimi standartları uyarınca ilgili konulardaki Tezli Yüksek Lisans +1 yıl, Doktora +2 yıl kıdem süresi olarak sayılmaktadır). Teknik Yetkinlikler: Ansys HFSS yazılımına ve 3D EM simülasyon prensiplerine ileri düzeyde hakimiyet. Anten Tasarımı & analizi, anten yerleşim analizleri, phased array, radar cross section (RCS), EMI/EMC veya RF/Mikrodalga devre konularından en az birinde derin teknik tecrübe. PCB Düzeyinde Simülasyonlar (Tercihen Ansys SIwave): Signal Integrity (SI), Power Integrity (PI), PCB EMI/EMC konularında tecrübe veya bu alanda kendisini hızlı geliştirmeye açık olmak. Ansys Q3D Extractor, EMIT, EMC Plus veya Ansys Icepak (termal/multiphysics entegrasyonu) konularında bilgi sahibi olmak tercih sebebidir. Elektromanyetik teori (dalga ve alan elektromanyetizması, anten teorisi, radar temelleri) hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak. Yeni mühendislik problemlerine hızlı adapte olmaya ve öğrenmeye açık olmak. Çözüm odaklı olmak. Metodolojik ve Operasyonel Yetkinlikler: Teknik problemleri müşteri hedefleriyle ilişkilendirebilen. Zaman yönetimi, proje takibi ve raporlama disiplinine sahip (CRM sistemi ve Timesheet süreçlerine uyumlu). Proaktif, sorumluluk alan, karmaşık problemleri az yönlendirmeyle bağımsız çözebilen. İletişim ve Kişisel Özellikler: Yüksek müşteri empatisi, dinleme becerisi ve güçlü insan ilişkileri. Sunum yapma, teknik içerik anlatma ve eğitmenlik yetkinlikleri yüksek. İleri düzeyde İngilizce bilen. Yurt içi / yurt dışı seyahat engeli bulunmayan. Size Ne Sunuyoruz? Anova şirketler grubu ve çözüm ortaklarıyla birlikte Türkiye’nin en büyük CAE ekosistemi ve Numesys-Ansys Elite Channel Partner çatısı altında sürekli teknik ve kişisel gelişim imkanı. Şeffaf, tanımlı ve objektif kriterlere dayalı technical path kariyer mimarisi. Türkiye’nin saygın teknoloji ve savunma sanayii projelerinde yer alma fırsatı. Synopsys, Ansys, ve Numesys kaynakları ile beslenen, dinamik, paylaşımcı ve mühendislik kalitesine değer veren bir çalışma ortamı.

Technical Standards: TE products and competitive products have their own nomenclature. Responsible Regions: Your business support is mainly needed in Turkey and working at customer’s field. Exchange with colleagues within Europe is usual. Was Sie Mitbringen Sollten High School or similar Education / Qualification. Experience in technical customer consulting and/or technical sales, ideally in the aviation, defense, or high-tech industry. Solid knowledge of electrical engineering, especially with cables, connectors, heat shrink tubing, and system architecture. Familiar with wiring diagrams, block diagrams, and system designs. Strong in communication, solution-oriented, and confident when dealing with customers. title: Staff Engineer (Core & MLOps)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Engineer (Core & MLOps) based in Turkey. This role offers the opportunity to shape foundational infrastructure powering large-scale web data products and distributed engineering teams. You’ll own the architecture of core control and context planes that enable services and AI-driven workflows to operate reliably and efficiently. Working across Kubernetes, Kafka, Java, Python, gRPC, and multi-cloud infrastructure, you’ll tackle complex distributed systems challenges at production scale. You’ll establish engineering standards, reliability practices, and service contracts that influence multiple product squads. The role combines hands-on architecture with technical leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional alignment. In a globally distributed, remote-first environment, you’ll have significant autonomy to solve challenging infrastructure problems and influence long-term platform strategy. Accountabilities Architect and evolve the control and context planes, advancing service and schema registries, SLO enforcement, health-aware routing, automated canary releases, and operational feedback loops. Own the service chassis and golden path, maintaining and improving multi-language Java and Python client libraries, standardized workload specifications, Helm charts, and deployment pipelines. Define and govern inter-service contracts, including gRPC and Protocol Buffer definitions, API gateway transcoding, versioning policies, and schema evolution standards. Operate and improve the core platform infrastructure across Kubernetes, Terraform, HAProxy/Nginx, Confluent Kafka, real-time billing pipelines, Valkey, and database modernization initiatives. Lead architectural strategy through Requests for Discussion (RFDs) covering workflow orchestration, gateway orchestration, multi-cluster routing, automated failover, and other critical platform initiatives. Establish reliability engineering practices, including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, fault isolation, and automated weighted canary deployments. Participate in shared infrastructure on-call rotations, lead incident post-mortems, and convert operational insights into platform improvements. Mentor engineers across multiple squads, review architectural proposals, and establish engineering practices that make reliable software development more consistent and efficient. Requirements 10+ years of experience building scalable distributed backend systems, with a strong track record of creating internal platforms or core libraries adopted across engineering organizations. Advanced Java expertise, including reactive frameworks such as Vert.x or Netty, combined with strong Python proficiency. Deep experience with gRPC and Protocol Buffers, including schema evolution and backward compatibility in mission-critical systems. Hands-on production experience with Kubernetes at scale, Terraform, and event-streaming platforms such as Kafka. Experience designing automated telemetry pipelines, materialized views, feature stores, or other feedback systems that use production data to dynamically improve system behavior. Strong reliability engineering background, including SLO/SLI definition, blast-radius analysis, fault tolerance, and rigorous service contracts. Exceptional technical writing skills and the ability to communicate complex architectural concepts clearly while driving alignment across teams. Strong written and interpersonal communication skills suited to a globally distributed, remote-first environment. A curious, continuous-learning mindset with an interest in evaluating new technologies, architectures, and engineering approaches. Experience with Temporal, DBOS, or similar durable execution platforms is a plus. MLOps experience, including model serving, performance monitoring, or production drift detection, is advantageous. Familiarity with zero-trust networking and service meshes such as SPIRE, mTLS, Cilium, Istio, or Envoy is beneficial. Experience building developer tooling such as CLIs, SDKs, or project generators is a plus. Experience with large-scale web scraping or crawling, or contributions to distributed-systems and data-extraction open-source projects, is advantageous. Benefits Fully remote, remote-first working environment with flexible working hours. Freedom and flexibility to work from the location where you are most productive. Opportunity to work on core infrastructure supporting large-scale web data pipelines and distributed systems. Svekon works across all stages of product development, including design, construction, technical information, and delivery commitments. The company values experience, competence, and responsiveness, aiming to always deliver on promises without overcommitting. Svekon has offices in Solna and Borlänge and is driven by innovation to create a better tomorrow together with its clients. Role Description As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer at Svekon, you will lead and execute mechanical design projects from concept through detailed design, prototyping, testing, and industrialization. You will be responsible for developing robust mechanical solutions, creating and reviewing 3D models and drawings, selecting materials and production methods, and ensuring that designs meet functional, safety, and quality requirements. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, customers, and suppliers, provide technical guidance to colleagues, and contribute to continuous improvement of design processes and tools. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Solna, where you will work directly with project stakeholders and participate in design reviews and project planning. Qualifications Strong mechanical engineering skills, including mechanical design, structural analysis, and product development. Proficiency in modern CAD tools (e.g., SolidWorks, Creo, Inventor or similar) and experience with 3D modeling and technical drawings. Experience with manufacturing processes, materials selection, and design for manufacturability and assembly. Ability to lead projects, coordinate with cross-functional teams, and mentor less experienced engineers. Good understanding of relevant standards, regulations, and quality assurance practices within mechanical design. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field. Strong problem-solving skills, analytical thinking, and a structured approach to documentation and communication. Ability to work on-site in Solna and collaborate effectively with customers and suppliers; fluency in English, and Swedish proficiency is an advantage.

title: Mekanikkonstruktör
description: Etteplan är ett ledande ingenjörsföretag med en tydlig ambition – att utveckla framtidens industrier genom teknik som gör verklig skillnad. Vi är över 4 000 teknikspecialister globalt som kombinerar djup teknisk kompetens med ett starkt fokus på människor, samarbete och hållbar utveckling. Nu stärker vi vårt team i Karlstad och söker en mekanikkonstruktör som vill arbeta med avancerad produktutveckling i en miljö där erfarenhet, professionalism och långsiktighet värderas högt. Din roll som mekanikkonstruktör Som mekanikkonstruktör hos Etteplan i Karlstad arbetar du med utveckling och konstruktion av mekaniska produkter och system. Uppdragen omfattar både nyutveckling och vidareutveckling, ofta i tekniska miljöer där kraven på funktion, tillförlitlighet och kvalitet är höga. Vi söker dig som kan ta ansvar för konstruktionsarbetet inom ditt område och bidra med tekniska lösningar genom hela utvecklingsprocessen – från koncept och tekniska vägval till färdiga konstruktionsunderlag. Arbetet kan bland annat innebära att: utveckla och konstruera mekaniska komponenter och system ta fram 3D-modeller, ritningar och tekniska underlag bidra i kravarbete, tekniska utredningar och val av lösningar samarbeta med andra teknikområden, produktion och leverantörer. Du arbetar i projekt hos oss eller i kundens organisation, tillsammans med kollegor med olika kompetenser. Uppdragens omfattning och ditt ansvar anpassas efter din erfarenhet, med möjlighet att både fördjupa ditt tekniska kunnande och ta ett större ansvar i projekten. Din erfarenhet Du har några års erfarenhet av mekanikkonstruktion eller produktutveckling och är van att självständigt arbeta fram tekniska lösningar. Du förstår hur en konstruktion går från idé till färdig produkt och kan göra avvägningar mellan funktion, tillverkning och kostnad. Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete, är noggrann och delar gärna med dig av dina kunskaper. Du trivs med att lösa tekniska frågor tillsammans med andra och har ett professionellt förhållningssätt till kunder och kollegor. Vi söker dig som har: en teknisk utbildning inom maskinteknik eller motsvarande kunskaper genom arbetslivserfarenhet goda kunskaper i 3D-CAD, exempelvis SolidWorks, CATIA eller Creo erfarenhet av att ta fram ritningar och konstruktionsunderlag god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift. Erfarenhet av arbete inom försvarsindustrin är meriterande. Vi värdesätter även erfarenhet av komplexa produkter och utvecklingsprojekt med höga krav på dokumentation och spårbarhet. Denna tjänst kan komma att kräva att du genomgår en säkerhetsprövning baserad på gällande regler för säkerhetsskydd. För tjänster som kräver säkerhetsklassning tillkommer ytterligare krav på svenskt medborgarskap. Att vara konsult hos Etteplan Som konsult hos Etteplan får du det bästa av två världar, tryggheten av att vara anställd hos oss och friheten att utvecklas i spännande projekt. Du kan arbeta på plats hos kund, på något av våra kontor eller ibland hemifrån. Upplägget anpassas efter uppdraget och oavsett var du sitter är du alltid en viktig del av ett större sammanhang. Beroende på var i landet du befinner dig kan du bli en del av våra inhouseprojekt eller arbeta direkt i kundens projektteam som en viktig och självklar lagspelare. Hos oss får du chansen att växa, utmanas och bidra till innovativa lösningar – tillsammans med kollegor som stöttar och inspirerar. Ansökan och nästa steg Ansökan sker genom att du laddar upp ditt CV och besvarar några korta frågor kopplade till tjänsten. Rekryteringsprocessen inleds med en telefonintervju och följs av möten med ansvarig konsultchef samt vid behov ytterligare kollegor. Vårt mål är att processen ska vara smidig och respektfull för att vi tillsammans ska kunna ta nästa kliv framåt. Känner du att Etteplan är rätt för dig? Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt team.

title: Design Engineer
description: Fantastic challenges. Amazing opportunities. GKN Aerospace is reimagining air travel: going further, faster and greener! Fuelled by great people whose expertise and creativity sets the standards in our industry, we’re inspired by the opportunities to innovate and break boundaries. We’re proud to play a part in protecting the world’s democracies. And we’re committed to putting sustainability at the centre of everything we do, opening up and protecting our planet. With over 16,000 employees across 32 manufacturing sites in 12 countries we serve over 90% of the world’s aircraft and engine manufacturers and achieved sales of £3.6bn in 2025. There are no limits to where you can take your career. Job Summary Are you an enthusiastic Design Engineer eager to shape the future of commercial aircraft engines? At GKN Aerospace Sweden, our Design and Configuration Management is home to a talented team of engineers who design and develop cutting-edge products for aero engine applications. We’re seeking a motivated and skilled individual to join us—whether you’re early in your career or bring years of experience, your passion for design engineering is what drives us forward. In this role, you’ll work within high-performing teams, contributing to all phases of the product life cycle. You’ll create innovative design solutions that meet GKN Aerospace Sweden’s rigorous standards, Operational Management System (OMS), and technical product requirements. Job Responsibilities As a Design Engineer, you’ll play a key role in delivering world-class engineering solutions. Your responsibilities will include: Design Creation & Management: Develop and update design data, including product drawings, CAD models, and geometrical interfaces, using Siemens PLM (Teamcenter) and NX software. Data Oversight: Store, maintain, and release design data in Siemens Teamcenter. Design Innovation: Conduct design studies, implement changes, and create geometrical interface documentation while justifying updates to requirements. Technical Precision: Perform tolerance stack-ups to ensure robust and reliable designs. We’re looking for someone with exceptional Computer-Aided Design (CAD) skills and a strong understanding of robust engineering principles. You’ll balance performance, cost, quality, and constraints from production and other disciplines to deliver outstanding results. Qualifications & Personal Skills You’re a proactive individual who thrives both independently and as part of a collaborative team. You’re confident communicating with colleagues across the company and external stakeholders, and you excel at analyzing results and presenting them clearly to diverse audiences. Essential Qualifications B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent relevant experience. Proficiency with CAD/PLM tools, specifically Siemens Teamcenter and NX. Knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T) standards (ASME Y14.5 and ISO). Fluency in English and Swedish, both written and spoken. 5+ years of experience as a design engineer. Desirable Qualifications Experience in geometry assurance. Background in product support or product development. Familiarity with manufacturing processes such as investment casting, welding, heat treatment, etc. Application At GKN Aerospace Sweden, you’ll be part of a dynamic team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of aero engine technology. Whether you’re just starting out or bringing seasoned expertise, this is your chance to grow, innovate, and make an impact in a supportive and high-performing environment. title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
description: About The Role We are looking for an experienced Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our R&D team in Cambridge and help shape the next generation of Domino's printing and coding technologies. This is a hybrid role, with an expectation of attending the office at least 3 days per week. This role is ideal for an experienced mechanical engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems, influencing product direction and delivering robust engineering solutions. As a Senior Mechanical Engineer, You Will Lead the design and development of new products, technologies and product enhancements, taking ownership from concept through to production. Develop innovative mechanical solutions and architectures that meet product, customer and business requirements. Create high-quality CAD models, drawings and technical documentation, applying sound engineering principles to mechanisms, materials, manufacturing processes and tolerancing. Lead prototyping, testing and design verification activities, using structured problem solving and root-cause analysis to address technical challenges. Collaborate with Manufacturing Engineering, Operations and suppliers to deliver robust, manufacturable and cost-effective designs, championing Design for Manufacture and Assembly principles. Provide technical leadership and mentoring while working across multidisciplinary teams to deliver innovative product solutions. Projects may involve precision mechanisms, high-speed motion systems, media handling, fluid systems, thermal management, automation and electro-mechanical integration. About You Domino values diversity and is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all candidates; however, only those eligible to work in the UK without the need for additional immigration documentation will be considered for this position. You’ll Have A degree or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. Demonstrated experience in mechanical product design and development within a commercial environment. Proven track record of delivering products through the full development lifecycle, from concept to production. Strong proficiency in 3D CAD design and engineering drawings, ideally using SolidWorks. Sound knowledge of mechanical design principles, materials selection, manufacturing processes, and geometric tolerancing. Experience designing and developing mechanical systems, mechanisms, moving assemblies, or electro-mechanical products. Hands-on experience with prototyping, product testing, verification activities, and root cause investigation. Understanding of Design for Manufacture (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) principles. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical decisions and engage stakeholders effectively. Ability to work independently while collaborating successfully within multidisciplinary engineering teams. Experience in precision engineering, industrial printing, inkjet or fluid systems, automation, robotics, high-speed machinery, media transport, or thermal management systems would be advantageous. What You Can Expect As a talented individual working at Domino, you can expect a competitive salary and a generous benefits package, including: 25 days of basic holiday, plus options to buy or sell additional days, ensuring you have ample time to relax and recharge. A discretionary bonus scheme, a testament to your hard work and dedication. Life insurance, providing security and peace of mind for you and your loved ones. Medical insurance with the option of purchasing a health cash plan, dental insurance, travel insurance and cycle to work scheme, ensuring your health is always a top priority. Join our green car scheme, a step towards a more environmentally friendly commute, with free EV charging onsite. Pension plan, starting with 8% employer contributions. We recognise that flexible homeworking can be beneficial and at Domino we want people to feel able to own the way they work. What this looks like might vary between teams - what’s important is that we enable you to get the best from us and for us to get the best from you, whether that’s from your home office or on site, as long as we continue to collaborate and enable great outcomes for our customers. We are a highly successful company, we’re large enough to offer career development opportunities yet small enough for your contribution to be readily recognised and rewarded. About Us At Domino Printing Sciences we do more. Our expertise isn't just in providing cutting-edge variable data printing technology; it's in revolutionising how manufacturers embrace sustainable packaging and spearhead advancements in coding automation. We’ve been a part of the global variable data printing story for a long time, and our solutions help ensure the success of the world’s leading brands. Our goal is to be the leading global variable data printing brand through applying our expertise and reliable solutions to help the world’s manufacturers be sustainable and cut waste, while attracting, informing, and protecting their consumers. But we also know that it’s not just about the work we do—it’s about fostering a collaborative, dynamic and welcoming environment where everyone can flourish, contributing to Domino not only as a pioneer in the industry but also as an exceptional place to work. Next to predictive maintenance Structural Hull Monitoring (SHM) systems allow verification and optimization of design tools related to hydrodynamic loading and structural resistance. Research in this field is ongoing to make these developments happen and determine how next generation of naval vessels will be equipped with such systems. Some Possible Subjects Are Design and integration of Hull Monitoring Systems (System Architecture). Creating tools for post-processing the Structural Hull Monitoring data (Data Assimilation). Predicting sea state parameters via Hull Monitoring Systems. Coupling of SHM-systems with structural FE-models to predict the remaining fatigue lifetime. Benchmark in-house load prediction tooling’s on a deterministic and or probabilistic way. Comparison of fatigue prediction methods from industry standards versus SHM-system fatigue predictions. A combination of different subjects is part of the possibilities. Damen Naval can provide readily available assignments, but it is also possible to propose your own specific topic of interest. Please indicate your preferences (or research topics of your own making) when sending us your application through our career website. Depending on the assignment, you are expected to select or develop the analysis methods and engineering tools needed to achieve your research goals. You will be responsible from day one for the planning and execution of your research project. You are expected to deliver a detailed in-depth analysis of your research problem and meanwhile be able to communicate the results and conclusions to other departments. Able to use programming tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB). Capable of identifying and communicating with multiple stakeholders. Taking responsibility for your own planning and project management. Proper mentoring at BSc or MSc level will be available throughout the project. The ability to test and enhance your professional- and social skills Acquired experience at a top tier company to add to your reference list. description: Looking to race into your next role? Strap in, we're looking for a Multiphysics Simulation Engineer to join our unique mission! Hosting over 150 races in iconic cities globally and backed by top manufacturers like Porsche, Nissan and Jaguar, we feature elite drivers and cutting-edge EV technology. The Role: As our Multiphysics Simulation Engineer, you will turn complex physical problems into clear, practical recommendations to support the development of next-generation all-electric race cars and trackside technical systems. Using COMSOL Multiphysics® as your principal simulation platform, you will solve coupled electrical, electromagnetic, thermal, fluid, and structural challenges. Beyond component-level modelling, you will connect subsystem models into comprehensive virtual representations of the car, laying the groundwork for Formula E’s future digital-twin capabilities. You will collaborate closely with internal technical teams, the FIA, automotive manufacturers, technical partners, and test teams. Key Responsibilities Multiphysics Modeling: Develop, run, and interpret 3D simulation models in COMSOL Multiphysics across electrical, electromagnetic, thermal, CFD, and structural domains. High-Voltage & Powertrain Analysis: Model and investigate electric machines, battery packs, power electronics, EV charging systems, high-voltage cabling, busbars, connectors, and sensors. Thermal & Fluid Dynamics: Perform thermal and CFD analyses of cooling systems, internal/external airflow, pressure losses, and conjugate heat transfer. Structural Mechanics: Conduct structural analyses covering stress, deformation, stiffness, vibration, fatigue, and thermal loading. Geometry & Meshing: Prepare and simplify CAD geometry and build computational meshes tailored for accurate numerical solving. Test Data Correlation & Optimisation: Correlate virtual models with lab, rig, supplier, and track-test data, running parametric and optimization studies to enhance performance, efficiency, safety, and reliability. System Integration & Digital Twins: Connect component models into larger virtual representations of the race car, helping establish validation and configuration practices for digital-twin development. Technical Communication: Clearly communicate simulation assumptions, solver settings, limitations, and actionable findings during technical reviews. What we're looking for in you: Educational Background: An MEng or MSc in electrical, electronic, mechanical, automotive, aerospace, computational, or mechatronics engineering, applied physics, or a closely related discipline. (Electrical/electronic engineering combined with 3D CAE experience is highly preferred). Simulation Experience: At least 3 years of relevant physics-based simulation experience in industry, applied research, or advanced engineering development. (5+ years of experience is desirable). Technical Domain Expertise: Practical experience in 3D physics-based modeling across electrical/electromagnetics, thermal management, CFD, or structural mechanics. Experience with EV high-voltage systems or electric powertrains is a strong advantage. Tooling & Numerical Methods: Solid understanding of numerical methods, boundary conditions, mesh quality, and solver convergence. COMSOL Multiphysics experience is advantageous, though experience with other major professional CAE tools is welcome. CAD & Data Correlation: Experience preparing CAD geometry and correlating simulation models with physical test/telemetry data. Mindset & Approach: Strong engineering judgment with the ability to translate numerical outputs into concrete design recommendations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills to present methods and findings clearly to technical stakeholders. The closing date for this role is 14th October 2026 , however if we receive a high volume of applications we may close it early. At Formula E, we are building a culture where every voice matters, every perspective accelerates progress, and every individual is empowered to rise, contribute boldly, and shape a better world - together. We will provide equal opportunities regardless of an individuals' protected characteristics. We believe in attracting and retaining diverse talent to strengthen our global vision with a variety of experiences, backgrounds and perspectives. Our mission is clear. The message is simple. Whoever you are. However you live. Whatever you believe. Formula E. For the Future. For Everyone. We’ll see you at the starting line! ¡VAMOS! Virtual and physical demonstration; without defect at curing cycles capable of high-rate production. We are developing a novel approach to traditional composites manufacturing to achieve these goals, where dynamic responses to thermal behaviour are realised. Modelling the physio-chemical performance of parts produced in manufacturing trials; data analysis and presentation of findings. Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering, or equivalent through experience Profound knowledge of manufacturing processes (conventional machining and/or Additive Manufacturing) and quality management principles Familiarity with CAD/CAM software suites and data acquisition systems Fluent communication skills in Dutch and English (spoken and written); knowledge of German is considered a plus Hands-on, creative, and critical thinker who is always looking for a better way to optimize processes Independent worker and reliable team player with strong organizational skills, accuracy, and a cost-conscious, innovative mindset In return, we offer t Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. title: Junior mechanical engineer
description: Wil jij machines, gereedschappen en testopstellingen ontwerpen die daadwerkelijk op de productievloer worden gebruikt? Als junior mechanical engineer werk je aan technische oplossingen voor productie en assemblage. Je leert van ervaren engineers en ziet in de praktijk wat jouw ontwerpen opleveren. Wat ga je doen? Je versterkt de afdeling Engineering van een internationale hightechorganisatie in Almelo. Samen met proces- en line engineers werk je aan het verbeteren van productie- en assemblageprocessen. Daarvoor ontwerp je onder andere speciale gereedschappen, assemblagehulpmiddelen en testopstellingen. Je houdt je bezig met: Ontwerpen van gereedschappen en opstellingen voor productie en assemblage; Aanpassen en verbeteren van bestaande productieapparatuur; Ondersteunen van productie en internationale assemblagelocaties bij technische vraagstukken; Meewerken aan investeringsprojecten voor nieuwe machines en apparatuur; Opstellen van CE-risicoanalyses, handleidingen en verpakkingsinstructies. Je werkt samen met collega’s uit engineering, productie, inkoop, maintenance en safety. Ervaren engineers delen hun kennis en helpen je om het werk en de productieprocessen te leren kennen. Wat breng jij mee? Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in Engineering of een vergelijkbare technische richting, of gelijkwaardig werk- en denkniveau; Kennis van 3D-CAD-software, zoals Siemens NX of Autodesk Inventor; Interesse in fijnmechanische constructies en productie- en assemblagetechniek; Bij voorkeur al enige ontwerpervaring binnen een engineering- of productieomgeving. Wat krijg jij? Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, inclusief vergoeding van je zorgverzekering; Ruimte om je technisch en persoonlijk te ontwikkelen; Mogelijkheden om door te groeien; Vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid in je werk; Afwisseling tussen ontwerpen, samenwerken en technische projecten; Collega’s die hun kennis delen en elkaar helpen; De kans om mee te werken aan de uitbreiding van de productie en de vernieuwing van het machinepark. Over de organisatie Je gaat aan de slag bij een internationale hightechorganisatie die centrifuges en andere geavanceerde technische oplossingen ontwikkelt en produceert. De technologie wordt ingezet voor energieoplossingen die bijdragen aan het terugdringen van CO₂-uitstoot. De organisatie groeit en investeert in uitbreiding van de productie en nieuwe machines. Vanuit Engineering ondersteun je de productie in Almelo en internationale assemblagelocaties. Je werkt in een team met verschillende technische specialismen en veel kennis van ontwerp en productieprocessen. Interesse? Wil je meer weten over het bedrijf en jouw mogelijkheden als junior mechanical engineer? Neem contact op met Maud Wolbert van Talentials via maud@talentials.com of 06 18 83 67 70. Zij vertelt je graag meer over de functie!

La risorsa seguirà progressivamente i progetti lungo tutto il loro sviluppo: dalla progettazione CAD al confronto con la produzione, contribuendo alla risoluzione delle problematiche tecniche e al miglioramento dei prodotti e dei processi. title: Senior R&D Engineer (Mechanical)
description: About the position Exclusively on behalf of our partner, we are looking for a Senior Product Development Engineer. Our client develops and manufactures highly complex, miniaturized electromechanical solutions, where size and reliability are critical. As a technology leader in its niche, the company constantly pushes the boundaries of what's physically possible in small-scale product design. With facilities across multiple countries, colleagues work together across all locations in an international setting. As a Senior Product Development Engineer, you take the lead on mechanical design within the system development team. The current focus is on plug and socket connector development, combining plastic, metal, and small PCB elements. This is a lead engineering role: you own full designs, guide engineering direction within your projects, and are expected to grow toward more senior scope over time. Your tasks and responsibilities You work in project teams on the development of products and are mostly involved in the early stages of the product development process. As you work with industry leading experts and consistently apply Lean tools in your projects, you catch on and learn fast. You thrive in the ambiguity of early-stage development, where you set goals, requirements, and risk-based approaches independently. Other qualities we ask for are: M.Sc in Mechanical Engineering (or equivalent, e.g. Applied Physics with proven industrial mechanical design experience) Senior-level experience in mechanical design for physical products, from concept through prototype and validation toward manufacturing Strong experience with design for manufacturing (DFM), particularly in challenging, tight-tolerance environments Hands-on experience designing physical hardware involving both plastic and metal parts, ideally including miniature or precision components Relevant CAD experience, SolidWorks preferred Knowledge of plastic part design and molding processes Comfortable working directly with external manufacturing suppliers, challenging them on feasibility, tolerances, and process capability Real industrial product development experience, not primarily academic, protocol-driven, or validation/verification work A plus: mechanical modeling/simulation experience, and/or affinity with acoustics or vibration, adding analytical depth to your engineering base Communicating in a simple and effective way Interested? title: H/F - thèse sur l'étude d’alliages d’aluminium obtenus par fabrication additive par friction-malaxage
description: Nouveau Laboratoire de Mécanique des Solides PALAISEAU Essonne CDD Doctorant 36 mois Doctorat This offer is available in English version Cette offre est ouverte aux personnes disposant d’un titre leur reconnaissant la qualité de travailleur handicapé ou travailleuse handicapée. L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Laboratoire de Mécanique des Solides Type de Contrat CDD Doctorant Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 91128 PALAISEAU Durée du contrat 36 mois Date d'Embauche 01/01/2027 Rémuneration La rémunération est d'un minimum de 2300,00 € mensuel Postuler Date limite de candidature : jeudi 22 octobre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Sujet De Thèse La fabrication additive par friction‑ malaxage (AFSD – Additive Friction Stir Deposition) constitue aujourd’hui un procédé émergent prometteur pour la production de pièces métalliques de moyenne et grande taille. L’AFSD repose sur un principe de déformation plastique sévère induite par friction, sans changement d’état du matériau. Le matériau d’apport, généralement sous forme d’une barre solide, est mis en contact avec le substrat et entraîné en rotation par l’outil de dépose. La matière subit une élévation de température, en-deçà de son point de fusion, qui induit un comportement pâteux et permet à la fois le dépôt et le malaxage du matériau. Cette technique permet de réaliser des dépôts denses avec des taux de dépose de l’ordre de 1 – 7 kg/h pour des alliages d’aluminium, exempts de porosité, présentant une microstructure finement recristallisée et des propriétés mécaniques isotropes. Comme l’ensemble des technologies de fabrication additive, l’AFSD permet de réduire la quantité de matière première nécessaire pour la fabrication des pièces et permet en outre une productivité accrue. Cependant, malgré ce potentiel, l’AFSD reste encore peu maîtrisé scientifiquement. Les phénomènes physiques mis en jeu, génération de chaleur par friction, écoulement de matière, mélange mécanique, formation d’interfaces multi‑matériaux, recristallisation dynamique, sont complexes, fortement couplés et difficiles à modéliser. La compréhension de ces mécanismes est pourtant indispensable pour garantir la qualité des dépôts, optimiser les paramètres opératoires et les microstructures, prédire la tenue en service et envisager des applications industrielles critiques. Les enjeux économiques et sociétaux sont également importants. Cette thèse s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet ASTRID FALbALA, pour Fabrication d’ALliages d'ALuminium de manière Additive par friction-malaxage, financé par l’ANR. Le consortium est constitué par l’ONERA (coordination du projet), le LMS (laboratoire de rattachement de la thèse), MATEIS, le CETIM, KNDS France et Constellium. Le principal objectif du projet FALbALA est d’établir le lien entre les paramètres de fabrication du procédé AFSD, la microstructure induite dans les échantillons ainsi fabriqués, et leur comportement mécanique, dans le cas d’alliages d’aluminium à durcissement, l’un structural (7020) et l’autre par écrouissage (5083). La thèse a pour objectif de relier les champs thermiques induits par le procédé AFSD à l’état métallurgique en tout point de la matière, ainsi qu’au comportement mécanique de pièces fabriquées par AFSD, dans le cas d’un alliage d’aluminium aéronautique (nuance 7020). La première étape consiste à établir une compréhension fine de l’état métallurgique de la matière déposée. En effet, l’état de précipitation obtenu localement est à la fois caractéristique de la thermique vue par la matière, et également responsable au premier ordre du niveau de durcissement local obtenu. La caractérisation de l’état de précipitation constitue donc l’un des premiers enjeux majeurs de cette thèse. On s’appuiera sur plusieurs techniques de caractérisation complémentaires : des mesures locales en calorimétrie (DSC) et en microscopie électronique à balayage et à transmission seront mises en regard des caractérisations plus globales obtenues par la mesure du pouvoir thermoélectrique (TEP) et par diffraction de rayons X (DRX). Il s’agira ensuite de relier avec précision l’impact des champs thermiques à l’état de précipitation en tout point du mur, non seulement au moment du dépôt de la matière, mais également suite aux cyclages thermiques provoqués par le dépôt d’une nouvelle couche sur la matière déjà déposée. L’utilisation du modèle en champs moyens PreciSo, développé à MATEIS par Michel Perez, permettra de simuler la croissance des précipités durcissants à partir des champs thermiques. Ces simulations pourront être confrontées aux mesures locales des tailles et fractions volumiques de précipités. Cette tâche a un double rôle, le premier est de caractériser les forts gradients microstructuraux dans la direction du dépôt tels qu’observés dans des travaux antérieurs [Girault, 2026 et Puybras, 2024] et le second, de valider la qualité des prédictions des mesures et simulations thermiques voire thermomécaniques réalisées par les partenaires du projet ANR. La deuxième étape a pour objectif de relier l’état de précipitation et son évolution aux propriétés mécaniques locales. On s’intéressera notamment à la description du comportement (visco)plastique de la matière, et en particulier à la limite d’élasticité et aux paramètres d’écrouissage sous sollicitations thermomécaniques, qui peuvent induire une évolution de l’état de précipitation. La modélisation envisagée sera d’abord macroscopique, c’est-à-dire que la dépendance à l’état de précipitation sera introduite explicitement à travers une évolution spatiale et temporelle des paramètres de la loi de comportement. Cette dépendance à la microstructure a déjà été introduite de cette manière dans des travaux antérieurs [Girault, 2026] dans le cas de la limite d’élasticité, en montrant des résultats prometteurs justifiant une telle approche. Dans le cadre de ce poste, vous rejoignez ARTELIA INDUSTRIE, composé de 850 collaborateurs passionnés, répartis sur plus de 30 implantations en France, Belgique, Suisse et Maroc. Ensemble, nous concevons, adaptons et modernisons les installations industrielles pour répondre aux défis de demain : production, performance économique, transition énergétique et sécurité des installations. Un savoir-faire reconnu : Nous excellons dans la mise en œuvre des différents procédés de production en nous appuyant sur nos expertises pointues en équipements, tuyauteries, mécanique, électricité, instrumentation, automatisme, structures métalliques, génie civil et bâtiment. Une activité diverse avec des projets d’envergure et des projets de proximité : Nos équipes interviennent sur des secteurs stratégiques tels que le Raffinage et recyclage carbone, la Pétrochimie, la Chimie, la Pharmacie, le Nucléaire, le Gaz, l’Offshore, l’Aéronautique, le Ferroviaire, la Construction navale et spatiale, la Sidérurgie, les Mines, la Microélectronique et la Défense. Pour faciliter la lecture, l’écriture inclusive n’est pas utilisée dans le corps de cette annonce, les termes employés au masculin se réfèrent aussi bien aux femmes, hommes qu'aux personnes non binaires. Description Du Poste Votre équipe : En intégrant l’établissement de Paris (Saint-Ouen - 93 ou Melun - 77) , vous rejoignez une équipe dynamique et ambitieuse, où chaque projet est une opportunité de monter en compétences et d’évoluer dans un environnement stimulant. Prêt(e) à relever le défi avec nous ? Vos missions : En tant que Ingénieur / Ingénieure Structure Offshore vos missions consisteront à : Réaliser les calculs de dimensionnement de structures offshore (jackets, topsides, modules, fondations, etc.) en conformité avec les spécifications projet Concevoir et optimiser les structures métalliques offshore, en tenant compte des contraintes techniques, environnementales (vents, vagues, corrosion) et économiques Effectuer la modélisation numérique (éléments finis) et définir les cas de charges (tempête, fatigue, transport, installation…) Analyser et interpréter les résultats selon les codes et normes applicables (API, DNV, Eurocodes…) Rédiger les notes de calcul, rapports techniques et dossiers de justification Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes projets pour intégrer les contraintes structurelles dès la conception Participer aux revues de conception et réunions de suivi avec les parties prenantes internes et clients Contribuer à la veille technologique (nouveaux matériaux, méthodes offshore, évolutions normatives) Participer à l’animation technique du service et au partage des bonnes pratiques Qualifications Vos atouts : Vous êtes le profil idéal si vous possédez une formation Ingénieur structure / génie civil ou niveau équivalent. Vos 5 années d'expérience au minimum en calcul de structures métalliques, idéalement en environnement offshore ou industriel, vous permettront de performer rapidement. Bonne maîtrise des logiciels de calculs et modélisation (SACS, SESAM, ANSYS, Abaqus, Robot, ou équivalent) Connaissance des normes offshore (DNV, API…) appréciée Solides compétences en mécanique des structures et résistance des matériaux Anglais professionnel requis (projets internationaux) Rigueur, esprit d’analyse, capacité à travailler en équipe et sens du résultat Vous êtes une personne rigoureuse, méthodique avec une bonne capacité d’analyse et de synthèse. Vous aimez le travail en équipe et savez facilement vous intégrer à un groupe. L’application des procédures Qualité ISO 9001 et MASE sont votre quotidien. Veiller à la sécurité sur les sites et/ou chez nos clients fait partie de vos priorités. Informations supplémentaires Nous vous offrons : Une entreprise sociale et citoyenne : accords diversité & inclusion, protection sociale et couverture mutuelle de qualité, un engagement via la Fondation Artelia Une organisation du travail efficiente Une politique de partage des résultats : intéressement et participation avec abondement, actionnariat salarié, de nombreux avantages et réductions pour les activités via les œuvres sociales, forfait mobilité durable... title: Design Engineer
description: QUALIFICATIONS AND JOB DESCRIPTION Turkiye Technology Center is looking for “Design Engineers / Lead Design Engineers” and offering them the opportunity to work with state-of-art technologies and applications, specializing in aircraft and industrial engine repair processes, in a technology base located in Kartal, İstanbul which is being established by General Electric Aviation, GE MTC (General Electric Marmara Technology Center) and TEI (Tusaş Engine Industries, Inc.). Expected qualification, requirements and desired characteristics from candidates are as below: Qualifications & Requirements BSc or MSc degree in Mechanical Engineering or Aeronautical Engineering. Minimum 1-5 Years of hands on experience in designing and analyzing structural or rotating parts. Excellent command of written and spoken English. Proficient in the use of engineering software (such as NX and ANSYS). Desired Characteristics Preferably experience in areas such as aviation, gas turbine or internal combustion engine design and analysis. Adaptable to work with teams from various cultures, understand behavioral and communicational differences, open to flex work style as necessary. Have understanding of Lean at Engineering or open to learn and adapt Lean principles. Project management and communication skills, able to monitor project status. Familiarity with GD&T (Geometric Dimensional and Tolerancing). LEAN/Process improvement experience is a plus. (e.g Combustor, Compressor, High Pressure Turbine, Low Pressure Turbine and Fan hardware including blades, vanes, cases, frames, disks, seals and shafts) Work with suppliers to resolve manufacturing relevant problems and engage/lead identified improvements for fielded products. Understand and evaluate the overall effects of engine operations on the hardware, such as thermal effects, vibratory, maneuver and limit loads. Support design reviews at several stages of design and redesigns. Conduct stress and life analyses in support of engine certifications and qualifications, design optimization to meet life goals and test capability assessment of engine hardware. Understand and evaluate Federal Aviation Authority requirements when an engine component is redesigned. Mentoring less experienced engineers in design analysis and hardware procurement. Document technical data generated by assigned projects consistent with engineering policies and procedures. Adaylardan Beklentilerimiz Üniversitelerin Makine Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun, Tercihen büyük ölçekli endüstriyel projelerde tecrübesi bulunan veya görev almaya istekli tecrübeli, Statik, Döner Ekipman, Endüstriyel Boyler, Soğutma kulesi vb. paket ekipmanların montajında görev almış veya bu konuda çalışmaya istekli, MS Office, Autocad ve mesleki bilgisayar programlarına hâkim, Analitik düşünme yeteneğine sahip ve çözüm odaklı, Planlı, programlı, düzenli çalışma disiplinine sahip, Yoğun çalışma temposu ve esnek çalışma saatlerine uyum gösterebilecek, Ekipman kaldırılması işleri konusunda tecrübeli veya bu konuda tecrübelenmek isteyen, Tedarikçi teknik çizimlerini inceleme ve analiz etme konusunda tecrübeli veya öğrenmeye hevesli, Teknik çizim anlama düzeyinde İngilizce dil bilgisine sahip, Erkek adaylar için askerlik görevini tamamlamış, Bu Rolde Seni Neler Bekliyor? Projenin dokümantasyon ve raporlama süreçlerini takip etmek, Gelen malzeme kontrollerinde bulunmak ve tedarikçi çizimlerine uygunluğunu kontrol etmek, Mekanik ekipman montajları öncesi saha uygunluğu kontrolü, takibi, saha mekanik ekip koordinasyon ve yönetimi, Yapım metotlarını inceleyip saha montajının ilgili metotlara uygun olarak tamamlanmasının takibi, İlgili iş izinlerinin, kaldırma planlarının zamanında hazırlanması ve takibi, Kontrol & Test Planına uygun olarak montajı tamamlanan ekipmanların ilgili kontrol taleplerinin takibi, Uygunsuzlukların takibi ve kayıt altına alınması, Üstlerine günlük, haftalık ve aylık gerekli bilgilendirmelerin ve raporlamanın yapılması Sahada diğer disiplinler ile montaj hazırlıkları kapsamında ve sonrasında koordinasyonun sağlanması. Biz Neler Sunuyoruz? Performans ve başarıyı destekleyen prim uygulamaları Kapsamlı yan haklar ve çalışan destek uygulamaları Özel Sağlık Sigortası kapsamında çalışanlarımızı destekleyen sağlık uygulamaları Mesleki ve kişisel gelişimini destekleyen eğitim ve gelişim programları Çeşitlilik ve Eşitlik Beyanımız Rönesans Holding, şirketlere stratejilerini ve operasyonlarını evrensel insan hakları, çalışma, çevre ve yolsuzlukla mücadele ilkelerine uygun hale getirmeye ve toplumsal hedefleri ilerletecek önlemler almaya çağıran BM Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi'nin imzacıları arasında yer almaktadır ve Birleşmiş Milletler Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi çerçevesinde evrensel kabul görmüş beyanlara dayalı ilkeleri benimser. Rönesans Holding, ana ilkeleri olan dürüstlük, rekabetçilik ve yenilikçilikten ödün vermeden şeffaf ve etik değerleri gözeterek insan kaynakları uygulamalarında eşitliği sağlamayı amaçlayan bir işverendir. Tüm başvurular cinsiyet, dil, din, ırk ve etnik kökene bakmaksızın fırsat eşitliğine göre değerlendirilir ve ayırımcılık yapılmaz.

title: Türkiye Machinery Plan Approval Engineer
description: RINA is currently recruiting for a Türkiye Machinery Plan Approval Engineer to join its office in Istanbul within the South Europe Marine Division. Mission This role focuses on supporting the elaboration of detailed plan and design reviews, resolving issues related to conflicting design requirements, ensuring client requirements and applicable standards are met. Projects could include the approval of new building, conversion, and existing vessels and yachts. Key Accountabilities Review and approve drawings of machinery and related systems on ships, offshore units, and marine equipment, in compliance with Class Rules and Statutory Regulations, for new buildings, ships in service, and ship’s conversions. Assist clients during the design and construction phase, providing guidance and support related to machinery and related systems. Provide support for the elaboration of detailed marine engineering plan review, in compliance with applicable RINA rules, international conventions and contractual requirements. Provide support for the resolution of issues related to conflicting design requirements and material standards. Provide direct day-to-day support and oversight of project elements, visit sites to take measurements. Provide direct or indirect support to engineers or engineering teams by gathering data, submitting documentation to officials and other day-to-day duties. Prepare the project deliverables (technical reports, project performance documentations and engineering drawings, etc.) . Take ownership and responsibility over the financial progress of assigned tasks. Understand and apply project management concepts providing feedback to project manager, serve as reference for the escalation of issues. Manage simple projects assigned applying project management concepts and techniques. Assess minor structural problems for internal/external clients to determine solutions with minimal supervision. Answer contractor questions on behalf of the supervising engineer, and serve as liaisons between engineering and construction personnel. Education Master’s Degree in Naval Engineering Qualifications +5 years of experience in marine machinery systems design, installation, and approval, with a focus on machinery plan approval and regulatory compliance. Extensive experience in reviewing and approving machinery plans for various types of vessels (e.g., commercial ships, tankers, offshore vessels, and passenger ships). Hands-on experience in assessing the compliance of propulsion systems, auxiliary machinery, power generation equipment, and safety-related machinery. Strong knowledge of marine machinery systems, including propulsion, auxiliary engines, pumps, HVAC, fuel systems, and other mechanical systems on board vessels. Expertise in reviewing machinery design documents and plans, including technical specifications, machinery layout, and installation drawings. Proficiency in machinery system analysis, including thermal, mechanical, and hydraulic systems. Familiarity with software tools used in machinery design and simulation (e.g., AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or specific marine design software). Fluent in Turkish and Proficient in English, both written and spoken. Analytical skills to identify non-conformities and recommend corrective actions, ensuring compliance with both internal and external regulations. Strong communication skills to interact with stakeholders, explain technical details, and support project goals effectively. Competencies PERSONAL EMPOWERMENT - Ownership for life, work and results, striving to grow professionally and personally. WORKPLACE DYNAMICS - Resourcefulness in shaping progress and working efficiently. FORESIGHT & INSIGHT - Context awareness adopting a systemic perspective and informed decision making. INTERPERSONAL INFLUENCE - Skills and strategies we use to interact effectively with others. DOMAIN & BUSINESS ACUMEN - Applying a scientific approach and critical thinking in operations and solution development within area of expertise. RINA is a multinational company providing a wide range of services in the energy, marine, certification, infrastructure & mobility, industry, research & development sectors. Our business model covers the full process of project development, from concept to completion. At RINA, we endeavor to create a work environment where every single person is valued and encouraged to develop new ideas. We provide equal employment opportunities and are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected and safe from discrimination or harassment of any kind. We are also compliant to the Italian Law n. 68/99.

title: Maintenance Planning Engineer
description: Life tastes better with ice cream With 19.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben & Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry. We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference. What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work. We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done. We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better. The role The Maintenance Planning Engineer is responsible for developing and optimizing preventive maintenance strategies, leading planning & scheduling efforts, and improving equipment reliability to support sustainable production. This role bridges engineering excellence with operational needs, ensuring maintenance activities are executed effectively, cost-efficiently, and in alignment with safety and quality standards. What you'll be responsible for Create, manage, and optimize preventive and predictive maintenance plans. Develop daily, weekly, and shutdown maintenance schedules with cross-functional alignment. Analyze equipment breakdowns and conduct root cause analyses (RCA). Track and control maintenance KPIs (MTTR, MTBF, OEE) and continuously drive improvement. Collaborate with production, engineering, and third-party service providers to ensure high uptime. Manage spare part inventory planning and ensure SAP/CMMS systems are kept up to date. Support TPM (Total Productive Maintenance) initiatives, particularly under PM Pillar. Lead or participate in maintenance-related cost-saving and digitalization projects. Ensure maintenance compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards. SKILLS: Maintenance Expertise: Preventive & predictive maintenance, root cause analysis (RCA), reliability improvement, maintenance cost control Digital Tools: Hands-on knowledge of SAP PM, CMMS tools (e.g. Boysweb, DFOS), Excel-based reporting and KPI monitoring TPM & Lean Understanding: Good understanding of TPM (especially PM Pillar), 5S, Kaizen, and structured problem solving Planning & Prioritization: Strong capability in workload planning, resource allocation, and proactive issue management Analytical Thinking: Ability to interpret technical data, downtime trends, and maintenance performance metrics Communication & Collaboration: Skilled in working with cross-functional teams (production, quality, external suppliers) and reporting to management Leadership & Ownership: Takes initiative, follows up with discipline, and can lead small improvement projects with limited supervision Adaptability: Comfortable working in dynamic factory environments with varying levels of ambiguity We're looking for someone who Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. Working knowledge in FMCG/Manufacturing environments is a strong plus. 1–3 years of experience in maintenance planning, budgeting, and optimization. Solid management, leadership, decision making and influential skills and experience is critical Familiarity with root cause analysis (RCA) and continuous improvement methodologies. Hands-on experience with CMMS systems (e.g. SAP PM, Boysweb, DFOS). Strong communication, collaboration, and influencing skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze data, make decisions, and lead improvement initiatives.Proven track record of implementing improvement ideas. Must have in-depth working knowledge and experience in maintenance optimization and cost saving. Solid understanding of TPM, particularly PM Pillar and Lean tools is desirable. Fluent in Turkish & English required. Living (or willing to live) in Konya What you'll get Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes Market-competitive pay and performance related rewards Flexible ways of working Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work Time off to rest and recharge Ongoing learning and development opportunities Why join us? This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could! You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward. Roles with real accountability and visible impact Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done Continuous learning and development as the business grows Reward linked to performance and contribution. Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business. Ready to build the future of Ice Cream? If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps. If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know. Additional Information The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

Supervising workers, production/ maintenance technicians and all contractors on site Preferably automation experience (PLC/SCADA) Preferably experience in electrical and electronic maintenance. title: Service Engineer
description: We are looking for a Service Engineer for our client, the Türkiye representative of a leading global brand in intelligent water technology and sustainable water solutions. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the regional service partner network, coordinating field service and maintenance activities, supporting customers and partners, and identifying opportunities related to service sales and energy solutions. Requirements University degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline. Preferably a minimum of 3 years of experience in after-sales services, technical service, or field service. Strong technical knowledge and hands-on capability in mechanical and pump/hydronic systems , including maintenance, commissioning, and field measurements. Strong customer and partner communication, coordination, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and reporting skills. Proficiency in MS Office . Willingness and ability to travel and work actively in the field. English proficiency appropriate to the requirements of the role. Main Responsibilities Service Partner Management Manage the assigned regional Service Partner portfolio , including regular communication, visits, and performance reviews. Assess the adequacy of the regional service network based on customer and installed-base density, business volume, geographical coverage, partner capacity, technical competence, and performance. Identify new Service Partner requirements and manage the research, evaluation, selection, and onboarding processes. Evaluate the performance and continuity of existing Service Partners and provide recommendations regarding development needs, territory or scope changes, alternative partner structures, or termination. Monitor partner performance through KPIs and Service Scorecards , manage partner classification and target setting, and conduct periodic reviews. Conduct or participate in Service Partner audits, follow up on non-conformities and improvement actions, and support the development of partners’ technical and operational capabilities. Maintenance & Field Service Plan, coordinate, and execute maintenance activities within the assigned portfolio and participate in field maintenance activities when required. Follow up on maintenance contract renewals and identify new maintenance opportunities. Conduct key customer, critical project, and Service Partner visits. Coordinate communication and activities between customers, Service Partners, and internal company functions. Follow up on recurring field and customer issues and ensure appropriate actions are taken. Energy Solutions & Service Sales Identify energy efficiency and energy solutions opportunities through customer and site visits. Perform required field measurements and carry out or coordinate technical evaluations and reporting. Ensure effective customer follow-up throughout the process. Identify service sales opportunities and follow up on related technical and commercial proposal processes, utilizing shared field and technical support resources when required. Operational & Warranty Processes Validate the operational compliance of Service Partner activities, including scope of work, labor, parts used or replaced, travel, and service records. Provide operational pre-approval for Service Partner payment claims. Review exceptional costs, repeat visits, out-of-scope activities, and other irregularities; obtain necessary clarification or corrections before transferring validated work for payment preparation. Perform preliminary assessments and process follow-up for warranty claims. Ensure that required field findings, service records, and documentation are complete, and route decisions regarding warranty, goodwill, or chargeable scope through the relevant company approval processes. Escalate recurring failures and field issues to the relevant technical and Quality functions and follow up on required actions. Reporting & Continuous Improvement Ensure that customer, partner, maintenance, energy solutions, and service activities are accurately and up to date in the relevant CRM and service systems . Periodically report on portfolio performance, service network status, maintenance and energy solutions activities, service sales opportunities, customer issues, and open actions. Contribute to the continuous improvement of after-sales and service processes.

title: Kalite Güvence ve Kontrol Mühendisi (Borulama/Kaynak)
description: Biz Kimiz? 1993 yılında kurulan Rönesans Holding, bugün Türkiye, Avrupa, Orta Asya ve Afrika’yı kapsayan geniş bir coğrafyada; inşaat, gayrimenkul, enerji, endüstri ve sağlık alanlarında ana müteahhit ve yatırımcı olarak faaliyet göstermektedir. 40.000’i aşkın çalışanı ve 60’tan fazla milletten oluşan güçlü ve çok kültürlü ekibiyle Rönesans, dünyanın en büyük müteahhitlik şirketleri arasında yer almakta; sürdürülebilir bir gelecek inşa etme vizyonuyla yenilikçi ve küresel ölçekteki mühendislik projelerini hayata geçirmeye devam etmektedir. Bu Rolde Seni Neler Bekliyor? ASME B31.3 ve proje spesifikasyonlarına uygun olarak borulama imalat ve montaj faaliyetlerinin kalite kontrollerinin gerçekleştirilmesi. Pipe spool imalatlarında fit-up, görsel muayene (VT), kaynak sonrası ölçüsel (Dimensional) kontrollerin yapılması ve takibi. Sahadaki boru montaj faaliyetlerinde fit-up, VT ve dimensional kontrollerin gerçekleştirilmesi. Kaynak faaliyetlerinin ve kaynak kalitesinin takip edilmesi. RT, UT, MT, PT gibi NDT faaliyetlerinin planlanması, koordinasyonu ve sonuçlarının değerlendirilmesi. Sahada görev yapan QC Inspector ekiplerinin koordinasyonunun sağlanması ve yönlendirilmesi. Line Check faaliyetlerinin hazırlanması, yürütülmesi ve müşteri onay süreçlerinin takibi. Punch listelerin oluşturulması, takip edilmesi ve kapatma faaliyetlerinin yönetilmesi. Hidrostatik ve pnömatik basınç testlerinin kalite kontrol açısından takibi ve gerekli kayıtların hazırlanması. Test paketleri, kalite dosyaları, NCR, site instruction ve teknik dokümantasyon süreçlerinin yönetilmesi. Müşteri, üçüncü taraf denetim kuruluşları ve proje ekipleri ile koordinasyonun sağlanması. Adaylardan Beklentilerimiz Makine Mühendisliği, Metalurji ve Malzeme Mühendisliği veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun. Endüstriyel tesis, petrokimya, rafineri, doğal gaz veya Oil & Gas projelerinde en az 5 yıl deneyimli. Borulama kalite kontrol faaliyetlerinde fiilen görev almış. ASME B31.3, ASME Section V, ASME Section IX ve ilgili uluslararası standartlara hakim. Fit-up, kaynak, VT, dimensional kontrol, line check ve pressure test süreçlerinde tecrübeli. NDT yöntemleri ve raporlarının değerlendirilmesi konusunda bilgi sahibi. Kaynak Mühendisi (IWE/EWE) sertifikasına sahip olması tercih sebebidir. Kaynak mühendisliği bilgisine sahip adaylar öncelikli değerlendirilecektir. Kalite dokümantasyonu, test paketleri ve punch yönetimi konularında deneyimli. İyi seviyede teknik İngilizce bilgisine sahip. MS Office programlarını etkin kullanabilen. Yoğun saha çalışma temposuna uyum sağlayabilecek. Biz Neler Sunuyoruz? Performans ve başarıyı destekleyen prim uygulamaları Kapsamlı yan haklar ve çalışan destek uygulamaları Özel Sağlık Sigortası kapsamında çalışanlarımızı destekleyen sağlık uygulamaları Mesleki ve kişisel gelişimini destekleyen eğitim ve gelişim programları Çeşitlilik ve Eşitlik Beyanımız Rönesans Holding, şirketlere stratejilerini ve operasyonlarını evrensel insan hakları, çalışma, çevre ve yolsuzlukla mücadele ilkelerine uygun hale getirmeye ve toplumsal hedefleri ilerletecek önlemler almaya çağıran BM Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi'nin imzacıları arasında yer almaktadır ve Birleşmiş Milletler Küresel İlkeler Sözleşmesi çerçevesinde evrensel kabul görmüş beyanlara dayalı ilkeleri benimser. Rönesans Holding, ana ilkeleri olan dürüstlük, rekabetçilik ve yenilikçilikten ödün vermeden şeffaf ve etik değerleri gözeterek insan kaynakları uygulamalarında eşitliği sağlamayı amaçlayan bir işverendir. Tüm başvurular cinsiyet, dil, din, ırk ve etnik kökene bakmaksızın fırsat eşitliğine göre değerlendirilir ve ayırımcılık yapılmaz.

Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact on your career and the world around you. The EMEA Packaging Automation Manager plays a key role in ensuring the successful due diligence and detailed design of capital projects across the region, including both greenfield and brownfield developments, low-cost automation initiatives, and master planning and debottlenecking projects. This role provides Center of Excellence (CoE) subject matter expertise across Packaging and Automation technologies to support the regional capital agenda, with a focus on design, scoping, and costing activities. The position will lead next-generation automation innovation initiatives and unlock affordable, efficient, and sustainable solutions across secondary packaging and end-of-line operations to deliver productivity and functional goals across EMEA. The role supports approximately 75 Foods plants and acts as the primary gatekeeper of PepsiCo's engineering specifications, standards, and best practices for Packaging and Automation Technologies, in line with PepsiCo Global Engineering strategies. The position covers all primary, secondary, and multi-pack packaging formats and serves as a key liaison with commercialization teams on new go-to-market initiatives, such as canister and e-commerce developments. Technical design support may also be provided to third-party manufacturers, joint ventures, and FOSO partners on an as-needed basis Responsibilities Provide engineering design expertise across approximately 75 Foods plants operating within seven OU/MUs, plus India. Contribute significantly to the design and scoping of major Foods capital projects. Support the execution team in delivering strategic projects across the region. Support Co-Manufacturers and Joint Venture partners in designing and implementing projects in accordance with PepsiCo engineering standards. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. Minimum 5 years previous product/process development and programme/project management experience, ideally within FMCG environment. First hand in-depth knowledge of Packaging technologies essential. Strong technical understanding of process flow and end of line technologies. Excellent understanding and application of business knowledge across the broader business environment. Exemplary interpersonal skills with ability to influence at senior levels within the organisation. First class presentation skills (written & verbal). Strong analytical skills – ability to interpret complex data and distil into useful and actionable information Ability to explain complex technical issues/solutions to a non-technical audience. Cultural sensitivity/flexibility in responding to different cultures. Self-starter, self-motivating - able to deal with uncertainty and complexity. Knowledge of LEAN systems design principles would be advantageous. International travel to meet business needs ~30-60% Key skills required: Independent Execution: Ability to manage and deliver complex tasks autonomously with strong ownership and accountability. Tactical and Strategic Thinking: Capacity to balance day-to-day execution with long-term strategic alignment to business objectives. Leadership: Skilled in guiding cross-functional teams, influencing without authority, and driving collaboration across diverse stakeholders. Collaboration: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build effective partnerships across Engineering, Operations, and functional teams. Technical Proficiency: Solid foundation in Core Process Engineering, Project Management methodologies, and advanced MS Office skills. Methodical Thinking: Structured, analytical mindset to ensure disciplined project planning, reporting, and execution. Improvisational Agility: Ability to adapt and problem-solve effectively in dynamic and fast-changing project environments.
