title: Junior R&D Engineer Machinebouw
description: Wil jij technische ideeën omzetten in slimme oplossingen voor machines? Als Junior R&D Engineer Machinebouw werk je aan de ontwikkeling en verbetering van technische concepten, onderdelen en systemen. Je krijgt de ruimte om te experimenteren, testen en jouw technische kennis iedere dag verder uit te bouwen. Wat ga je doen? Als Junior R&D Engineer Machinebouw werk je voor onze opdrachtgever aan de ontwikkeling en verbetering van machines en technische systemen. Je vertaalt technische vraagstukken naar praktische concepten en werkt deze verder uit tot een maakbaar ontwerp. Daarbij maak je gebruik van 3D CAD-software en voer je technische berekeningen uit om jouw keuzes te onderbouwen. Ook denk je na over materiaalkeuze, constructies, bewegende onderdelen en de werking van verschillende componenten. Zo ben je vanaf de eerste ideeën betrokken bij het ontwikkelproces. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je werk is het bouwen, testen en beoordelen van prototypes. Je analyseert testresultaten, onderzoekt technische problemen en verwerkt verbeteringen in het ontwerp. Daarbij heb je regelmatig contact met Engineering en Manufacturing om te controleren of een oplossing technisch haalbaar én goed te produceren is. Naarmate je meer kennis opbouwt, krijg je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid binnen R&D-projecten. Zo ontwikkel je jezelf tot een engineer die nieuwe ideeën kan vertalen naar betrouwbare oplossingen voor de machinebouw. Jouw werkzaamheden Ontwikkelen en uitwerken van nieuwe technische concepten voor machines en onderdelen; Maken en aanpassen van 3D CAD-modellen en technische tekeningen; Uitvoeren van technische berekeningen en beoordelen van ontwerpkeuzes; Bouwen, testen en beoordelen van prototypes en nieuwe oplossingen; Analyseren van testresultaten en vertalen van resultaten naar ontwerpverbeteringen; Onderzoeken van materialen, componenten en productietechnieken voor nieuwe toepassingen; Afstemmen met Engineering en Manufacturing over maakbaarheid, kwaliteit en technische haalbaarheid; Vastleggen van ontwerpen, testresultaten en technische wijzigingen in documentatie. Wat heb jij in huis? Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar; Affiniteit met Research & Development, productontwikkeling en machinebouw; Ervaring met 3D CAD-software vanuit je opleiding, stage of eerste werkervaring (Solidworks of Inventor); Kennis van mechanica, materiaalkunde en constructieleer; Een analytische instelling waarmee je technische problemen kunt onderzoeken en oplossen; Een nieuwsgierige en praktische houding waarbij je ideeën graag omzet in werkende oplossingen. Wat bieden we jou Een salaris van €3.000 - €4.450 p.m.; 38 vakantiedagen per jaar; Uitgebreide groene pensioenregeling; Volg kosteloos sessies via het welzijnsplatform empowr; Opleidingsbudget van €2.000; Een persoonlijke Career Coach; Gratis deelname aan bijvoorbeeld de Marathon van Eindhoven of de Strong Viking Run; Werken bij het groenste detacheringsbureau van Nederland; Mogelijkheid tot overname door opdrachtgever. De organisatie & Duurzaamheid Je werkt voor een machinebouwer in de voedingsmiddelenindustrie waar ontwikkeling, engineering en productie dicht bij elkaar staan. title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Energy Dome è una delle aziende più innovative nel settore della transizione energetica. Abbiamo sviluppato la CO₂ Battery , una tecnologia proprietaria di accumulo energetico di lunga durata già operativa e contrattualizzata in diversi Paesi del mondo. Stiamo crescendo rapidamente e costruendo impianti che contribuiranno concretamente alla decarbonizzazione del sistema energetico globale. Qui non lavorerai su progetti teorici: vedrai le tue idee trasformarsi in impianti reali, con un impatto misurabile sulla produzione e sull'utilizzo dell'energia. Se vuoi iniziare la tua carriera in un ambiente dinamico, internazionale e fortemente orientato all'innovazione, questa è l'opportunità giusta per te. Per la nostra sede di Piacenza siamo alla ricerca di un/una Mechanical Design Engineer da inserire nel team Manufacturing. La posizione è pensata per giovani professionisti desiderosi di crescere in un contesto industriale all'avanguardia e di contribuire allo sviluppo di una tecnologia che sta rivoluzionando il mondo dell'energy storage. Affiancato da professionisti esperti, avrai la possibilità di sviluppare competenze tecniche, seguire progetti concreti e collaborare con diversi team aziendali e partner internazionali. Responsabilità: Supporterai lo sviluppo tecnico dei progetti produttivi e delle commesse. Collaborerai con società di ingegneria esterne per la preparazione e revisione della documentazione tecnica. Ti interfaccerai con i team Engineering e Project Management per garantire l'allineamento delle soluzioni progettuali. Contribuirai all'ottimizzazione dei processi produttivi e delle configurazioni di prodotto. Parteciperai alle attività di industrializzazione e miglioramento continuo. Collaborerai con il team R&D nello sviluppo e nell'evoluzione della tecnologia. Predisporrai e aggiornerai documentazione tecnica, distinte base e deliverable ingegneristici. Realizzerai e modificherai disegni tecnici e modelli 3D. Requisiti: Laurea magistrale o triennale in Ingegneria Meccanica, Energetica, Industriale o discipline affini. Forte curiosità tecnica e voglia di imparare. Attitudine al lavoro di squadra e alla collaborazione. Capacità organizzative e gestione delle priorità. Buona conoscenza della lingua italiana e inglese. Conoscenza di software CAD 3D come SolidWorks, Creo, Inventor, Solid Edge o equivalenti. Familiarità con AutoCAD o software analoghi per il disegno 2D. Conoscenza del disegno tecnico, GD&T e documentazione di ingegneria. Interesse per processi produttivi industriali, impiantistica ed energia. Esperienze universitarie, tesi, progetti o stage in ambito meccanico o industriale. Retribuzione e benefit: Contratto a tempo indeterminato e a tempo pieno. Retribuzione allineata all'esperienza maturata (RAL indicativa: 30.000 € – 40.000 € lordi annui ). Energy Dome promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e valorizza la diversità in tutte le sue forme. Tutte le candidature saranno valutate nel rispetto delle pari opportunità, indipendentemente da genere, età, origine, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, religione o altre caratteristiche personali.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Spacecraft Structures & R&D - jouwtechniekbaan.nl
description: Je komt terecht in een ambitieus R&D-team in Delft waar je werkt aan mechanische structuren voor de volgende generatie ruimteschepen. Dagelijks ontwerp je draagconstructies en onderdelen met nauwkeurige CAD-modellen en bereid je productie- en testdocumentatie voor. Je voert ontwerpanalyses uit, neemt deel aan ontwerpreviews en stemt af met disciplines zoals thermal, avionics en systeemengineering. Je rol combineert hands-on ontwerpwerk met verantwoordelijkheid voor productisering en het begeleiden van prototypes richting vluchtklare hardware. Met jouw ervaring van minimaal zeven jaar breng je engineering fundamentals en een praktische blik op maakbaarheid samen. Engels is de voertaal; je werkt meestal op kantoor in Delft en af en toe met partners of leveranciers. Functie-inhoud Ontwerpen van mechanische structuren voor ruimtevaartuigen met aandacht voor massa, stijfheid en interface-eisen. Opstellen en onderhouden van gedetailleerde CAD-modellen, tekeningen en samenstellingsbestanden voor productie en testen. Organiseren en leiden van ontwerpreviews, afstemmen met systeem-, thermal- en elektronica-teams en leveranciers. Ondersteunen van productisatie en prototype-activiteiten tot en met verificatie en integratie van vluchthardware. Functie-eisen Degree in Mechanical Engineering (BEng, BSc of MSc) met aantoonbare kennis van engineering fundamentals. Minimaal zeven jaar ervaring in mechanisch ontwerp, bij voorkeur voor complexe of kritische systemen. Zeer bedreven met CAD-software en ervaring met ontwerpdocumentatie voor productie en testen. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Engels en de capaciteit om multidisciplinaire afstemming te begeleiden. Wij bieden Een marktconform brutosalaris van circa €5.000 tot €6.000 per maand afhankelijk van ervaring. 32 tot 40 uur per week in een fulltime functie binnen een gedreven R&D-omgeving. Directe impact op next-generation ruimtevaartprojecten en zichtbare bijdrage aan productisering. Ruimte om technisch leiderschap te nemen, prototypes te begeleiden en je expertise verder te ontwikkelen. #Jobster

title: Mechanical Engineer R&D
description: Als R&D Mechanical Engineer speel je een belangrijke rol in de ontwikkeling van innovatieve mechanische producten en systemen voor de internationale markt van beMatrix. Je vertaalt technische uitdagingen, markt- en klantbehoeften naar slimme, maakbare en duurzame oplossingen. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's binnen R&D, Product Management, Operations, Productie, Aankoop en Quality en zorgt ervoor dat nieuwe ideeën niet alleen technisch sterk zijn, maar ook effectief geproduceerd en toegepast kunnen worden. Productontwikkeling → Ontwikkelen van nieuwe mechanische oplossingen voor indoor- en outdoor toepassingen. → Ontwerpen met focus op modulariteit, snelle montage, stabiliteit, transporteerbaarheid en duurzaamheid . → Optimaliseren van bestaande producten en systemen op vlak van functionaliteit, kostprijs en productie-efficiëntie. Engineering en validatie → Uitwerken en detailleren van mechanische ontwerpen in 3D CAD, bij voorkeur Autodesk Inventor . → Maken en ondersteunen van technische berekeningen en analyses. → Opstellen en uitvoeren van testplannen en analyseren van testresultaten. → Uitwerken van technische documentatie, handleidingen, test- en kwaliteitsrapporten. Prototyping en industrialisatie → Ontwerpen vanuit een Design for Manufacturing & Assembly-principes, met aandacht voor productie, montage, aankoop en kostprijs. → Ondersteunen van prototypes en eerste productieruns. → Samenwerken met productie en leveranciers om ontwerpen succesvol te industrialiseren. → Praktisch analyseren en oplossen van technische problemen en bijdragen aan verbeteringen van producten en productieprocessen. Wie zoeken we → Je hebt een masterdiploma Industrieel Ingenieur Mechanica, Productontwikkeling of een gelijkwaardige technische achtergrond. → Je hebt ongeveer 5 jaar relevante ervaring in mechanische R&D, productontwikkeling of engineering. → Je hebt een sterk analytisch vermogen, technisch inzicht en goed ruimtelijk inzicht. → Je hebt ruime ervaring met 3D CAD en bij voorkeur met Autodesk Inventor . → Je hebt kennis van mechanische constructies en technische berekeningen. → Je bent hands-on, pragmatisch en probleemoplossend ingesteld: je vindt het leuk om een ontwerp ook daadwerkelijk tot leven te zien komen. → Je werkt zelfstandig en proactief, maar zoekt ook actief de samenwerking op met collega's uit andere disciplines. → Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands en Engels . Dit is een plus → Ervaring met aluminium, staal en kunststof en de bijhorende bewerkings- en productietechnieken. → Ervaring met statische berekeningen van metalen constructies. → Affiniteit met nieuwe technologieën, materialen en productietechnieken. → Ervaring met productontwikkeling in een productieomgeving. Wat hebben we te bieden Bij bematrix werk je niet aan standaardproducten. Je ontwikkelt modulaire systemen die wereldwijd worden gebruikt in de live communicatie- en eventsector . Dat betekent dat je mechanische kennis rechtstreeks impact heeft op producten die dagelijks worden gemonteerd, getransporteerd en gebruikt. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelf oplossingen te bedenken, te testen en te verbeteren en werkt mee aan producten die innovatie, gebruiksgemak, duurzaamheid en efficiëntie combineren.

title: Mechanical Engineer R&D Medical Devices (m/f/d)
description: X-Therma is a fast-moving and innovative startup from San Francisco with an office and hardware R&D branch in Innsbruck, Austria. We are developing breakthrough technology to improve modern medicine and save billions of lives. With our subzero storage and transport solutions, we are enabling global access to organ transplants as well as cell and gene therapy products and engineered tissues. To strengthen our growing team in Innsbruck, we are looking for a Mechanical Engineer (m/f/d). In this position, you will play a key role in the technical leadership of development projects across various maturity stages – from ideation to prototyping to full-scale production. You will be part of a multidisciplinary and international team, ensuring innovations are implemented effectively and on target. Specifically, your responsibilities include: Tasks Providing technical leadership on development projects at different maturity levels Defining and steering development strategies and priorities in coordination with management Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, such as product management, production, and quality assurance Analyzing technical requirements and implementing regulatory standards in medical technology Ensuring milestone and budget targets are met Fostering a culture of innovation within the team and actively mentoring team members Overseeing quality control and risk management, especially in the development of medical products Contributing to the development and optimization of product concepts and prototypes Design and development of new medical devices in accordance with regulatory requirements (e.g., MDR, FDA). Create and review technical specifications, design documents, and manufacturing instructions. Conduct error analysis and problem-solving to continuously improve product and process quality. Monitor production metrics and develop measures to increase efficiency and reduce costs. Report to management on the status of projects and production processes as well as on quality and process improvements. Requirements Degree in medical technology, mechanical engineering, mechatronic engineering, physics, or a related field Several years of experience in medical product development and technical project leadership Solid knowledge of medical technology regulations and standards (e.g., MDR, ISO 13485) Proven experience in team leadership and collaboration with cross-functional departments Analytical mindset with a strategic approach and a solutions-oriented work ethic High degree of initiative, decisiveness, and excellent communication skills Fluent in both German and English Benefits A responsible role in an innovative and dynamic work environment Attractive compensation and flexible work models, including home office options Opportunities for professional development and career growth The chance to contribute to projects that directly impact the health and well-being of people worldwide Minimum salary 55.000,00 p.a. depending on qualifications and work experience on a negotiable basis. International team with the opportunity to travel frequently. If you’re an accomplished technology leader ready to shape the future of medical technology, we would love to hear from you! Apply now to join us in advancing healthcare through technology and innovation.

title: Principal Researcher in Materials (Shape Memory Alloys)
location: San Cristobal de La Laguna, Kanarya Adaları, İspanya
description: ARQUIMEA , we are a technology company operating globally and providing innovate solutions and products in highly demanding sectors. Our areas of activity are Aerospace, Defense & Security, Big Science, Biotechnology and Fintech. Main function and scope: Launch and lead ARC’s research line in Shape Memory Alloys (SMAs) in Tenerife. This is a hands-on postdoctoral position for an independent, energetic and adaptable researcher who connects advanced materials science with engineering applications and future space technologies. Primary Functions: Define the SMA research roadmap, priorities, hypotheses and experimental plans. Design, process and characterise SMA specimens, components and prototypes. Investigate composition, processing, microstructure and functional performance relationships. Study transformation behaviour, shape-memory effect, superelasticity, fatigue, hysteresis and environmental stability. Establish experimental methods, test benches, instrumentation and data-analysis workflows. Develop and validate application-oriented demonstrators. Collaborate with mechanical, electronics, systems and manufacturing teams. Identify funding opportunities, academic collaborations, industrial partnerships and technology-transfer opportunities. Prepare technical reports, research proposals, scientific publications, presentations and IP disclosures where appropriate. Contribute to laboratory organisation, documentation, configuration control and good laboratory and safety practices. Mentor junior researchers and support the future growth of the research line. Other reasonable duties as required. Required experience and candidate profile: Ph.D. in Materials Science, Metallurgy, Mechanical Engineering, Physics or a closely related scientific or engineering discipline. Postdoctoral research experience, or equivalent evidence of independent research capability after the Ph.D. Early- to mid-career postdoctoral profile with demonstrated independent research in SMAs and experimental materials science. Specific Training / Knowledge Required in: Direct research or industrial experience with Shape Memory Alloys (SMAs), such as NiTi, Cu-based, Fe-based or emerging SMA systems. Understanding of martensitic/austenitic transformations, the shape-memory effect and superelasticity. Hands-on experience with SMA processing, heat treatment, mechanical testing, thermal analysis, microscopy, diffraction or related techniques. Strong experience in experimental design, materials characterisation and scientific data analysis. Ability to connect material behaviour with component-level performance and application requirements. Excellent written and oral communication skills in English. Desirable Experience: Application of SMAs or smart materials to space systems, spacecraft, launch systems, mechanisms, thermal control or deployable structures. Experience with vacuum, thermal cycling, vibration, shock, radiation-related constraints, outgassing or long-duration reliability. Additive manufacturing, joining, coatings, thin films, miniaturised actuators or functional composites involving SMAs. Prototypes or demonstrators beyond laboratory-scale material samples. Finite-element modelling, multiphysics simulation or digital image correlation. European/international R&D funding, proposal writing or technology transfer. Supervision of junior researchers and scientific leadership. This position will be based at the Nanotec Building in San Cristóbal de La Laguna, Tenerife. We're looking for curious, creative, tenacious and collaborative people , eager to do things and unafraid to tackle challenges in order to contribute to improving the society in wich we live. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or other protected factors by law. All candidates will be considered equally based on their skills and experience

title: Post-doctorat : chimie des polymères, lignine et matériaux biosourcés Développement d'un liant biosourcé à base de lignine industrielle pour les biomatériaux
description: Description du poste Le poste de post-doctorat porte sur le développement d’un liant biosourcé à base de lignine industrielle pour des biomatériaux, au sein de Reed Material. À temps plein et basé sur site à Bordeaux, la personne recrutée travaillera à la conception, l’optimisation et la caractérisation de formulations de liants biosourcés pour des applications matériaux. Les activités quotidiennes incluent la synthèse et la modification de polymères et dérivés de lignine, la mise en œuvre de protocoles de mise en forme des biomatériaux, ainsi que la réalisation de tests physico-chimiques et mécaniques. Le ou la post-doctorant·e participera à la planification expérimentale, à l’analyse des résultats, à la rédaction de rapports scientifiques et à la valorisation des travaux (publications, présentations). La collaboration avec les équipes R&D internes et, le cas échéant, des partenaires académiques ou industriels sera centrale pour faire avancer le programme de recherche et favoriser le transfert vers des applications concrètes. Qualifications Doctorat en chimie des polymères, chimie des matériaux, chimie verte ou discipline proche, avec une spécialisation souhaitée en matériaux biosourcés ou lignine. Solides compétences expérimentales en synthèse et caractérisation de polymères, résines ou liants (techniques de laboratoire, mise au point de formulations, contrôle de qualité). Maîtrise des techniques de caractérisation physico-chimique et structurale (par exemple spectroscopies, chromatographie, analyse thermique, tests mécaniques) appliquées aux matériaux et aux biomatériaux. Capacité avérée à concevoir un plan d’expérience, analyser des données, interpréter des résultats et rédiger des rapports scientifiques ou articles. Aptitude à travailler en équipe multidisciplinaire, sens de l’organisation, autonomie, rigueur, et intérêt marqué pour l’innovation durable et l’économie circulaire. Bonne communication orale et écrite en français ou en anglais ; la maîtrise des deux langues est un atout pour les collaborations et la diffusion des résultats.

title: Beräkningsingenjör inom Strukturanalys
description: Företagsbeskrivning AFRY is a European leader in engineering, design, and advisory services, with a global reach. We accelerate the transition towards a more sustainable society. We are more than 19,000 devoted experts in infrastructure, industry, energy and digitalization. We accelerate the transition towards a sustainable society for generations to come. AFRY is among engineers rated as one of the most popular employers in Sweden. Jobbeskrivning Vi vill bli fler och söker nu en beräkningsingenjör inom strukturanalys till vårt team i Trollhättan! Hos oss får du arbeta med spännande och tekniskt utmanande beräkningsuppdrag för både svenska och globala kunder. Vi är ett team med lång erfarenhet av både implicita och explicita FEM‑analyser för kunder inom försvar och fordonsutveckling. Rollen Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av hållfasthets- och livslängdsanalys mha implicit FEM, gärna från försvars- eller fordonsindustrin. Som beräkningsingenjör hos oss får du: Driva projekt där vi har ett helhetsansvar för analysleveranser. Jobba nära kund, ibland på plats, ofta i en hybridlösning. Utveckla system tillsammans med konstruktörer, inom både fordon och försvarsprodukter. Bli en del av ett team med stark sammanhållning och hög teknisk kompetens. Arbetet är varierat, omväxlande och erbjuder stor möjlighet att både fördjupa och bredda din tekniska kompetens. Ibland jobbar vi efter kundens befintliga metoder, lika ofta hjälper vi kunden att utveckla metoder. Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som har en MSc med inriktning mot strukturmekanik och som har erfarenhet av FEM‑beräkningar, gärna från fordons- eller försvarsbranschen. Du är van att arbeta i verktyg som ANSA och OptiStruct/Nastran eller Ansys och har du dessutom kunskap i Abaqus ser vi det som ett stort plus. Vi ser gärna att du bor i eller är på väg att flytta till Trollhättan eller närområdet, och att du vill bygga vidare på din karriär här på längre sikt. Körkort är meriterande då vissa kunduppdrag kan kräva resor. Din bakgrund & personliga egenskaper Du har några års erfarenhet inom området och är van att jobba självständigt. Du är kommunikativ och har lätt för att skapa starka, professionella relationer både internt och externt. Du trivs i team och gillar att samarbeta för att nå bästa resultat. Du är nyfiken, engagerad och kan snabbt sätta dig in i nya teknikområden och arbetsmetoder. Du representerar AFRY på ett tryggt och professionellt sätt och välkomnar nya typer av uppdrag. Du har god förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt, och kan presentera analysresultat på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt. Ytterligare information Vi söker dig som vill vara en del av AFRY’s framgångssaga och bidra till utvecklingen av framtidens produkter. Vi vill erbjuda dig karriärmöjligheter på en modern arbetsplats med utmanande arbetsuppgifter och spännande projekt världen över. Vår sektion i Trollhättan är ett öppet team som vill att alla ska trivas på jobbet, utvecklas och ha roligt tillsammans. Urval sker kontinuerligt så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag! Skriv ett personligt brev och bifoga CV. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Kontaktuppgifter: Annika Aleryd, sektionschef, annika.aleryd@afry.com Robin Kristiansson, team lead, robin.kristiansson@afry.com Anders Kristiansen, rekryterare, anders.kristiansen@afry.com På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen

title: Ingénieur Calcul H/F
description: Ingénieur Calcul H/F Nancy (54) Construisons ensemble le monde de demain Chez Vulcain Engineering Group, nous accompagnons les leaders industriels dans la conception et la réalisation de projets innovants à forte valeur ajoutée. Grâce à l'expertise de nos collaborateurs, nous intervenons sur des projets stratégiques dans les secteurs de l'énergie, des transports, de l'industrie, de la défense et des infrastructures. Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités dans le Grand Est, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur Calcul H/F afin de renforcer nos équipes sur des projets industriels d'envergure. Vos missions : En tant qu'Ingénieur Calcul, vous intervenez sur les études de dimensionnement et de justification mécanique d'équipements et de structures industrielles. À ce titre, vous serez amené(e) à : Réaliser les notes de calcul et les analyses mécaniques. Effectuer des calculs par éléments finis (FEM) sur différents types de structures et équipements. Participer au dimensionnement mécanique en phase conception et validation. Analyser les comportements en statique, fatigue, dynamique et tenue aux chargements. title: Utilities Engineer - Bandırma
description: How about continuing to develop your career at one of the world’s largest food companies? We want your next step to be with MBRF . At our company, we believe in and actively promote the growth of our internal talent. By applying, you take an important step in your professional journey. Would you like to join Banvit MBRF and nourish life as part of a global food giant? Since 1968, Banvit MBRF has been one of Turkey's leading food manufacturers, known for its sustainability mindset and quality-oriented approach. We count on our 5,000 employees and stakeholders all around Turkey, especially in Bandırma, İzmir and Elazığ, where our production facilities are located. In 2017, Banvit joined forces with MBRF, one of the world's leading food manufacturers. Thanks to a legacy spanning 90 years, together we are more confident in our future than ever. Serving more than 125 countries, MBRF is a global company that operates 44 facilities and employs more than 100,000 people around the world. At MBRF, nourishing life is our commitment. We focus not only on production, but also on animal welfare, social development, and sustainable consumption within our communities. What will you be doing at Banvit MBRF? Manage the utilities team and ensure uninterrupted supply of cold, water, energy, and steam Ensure availability, reliability, and integrity of utilities systems and assets while maintaining safety and quality standards Manage utilities and maintenance costs, ensuring budget control and efficiency Monitor and manage utilities performance indicators (KPIs) Implement and follow maintenance routines and corporate maintenance standards in the assigned area Ensure compliance with HSE standards, safe working procedures, and environmental regulations Lead and support the team through training on utilities and maintenance standards Develop, engage, and retain talent within the maintenance and utilities team Control and ensure proper use of tools, equipment, and maintenance devices Support risk assessments and report HSE hazards, incidents, and issues Ensure readiness for emergency and evacuation procedures What kind of profile are we looking for? Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field Minimum 2 years of experience in utilities operations Good level of English Based in Bandirma or open to relocation Experience in utilities systems (boiler, ammonia, pressure vessels, etc.) Required certification/permission to work with boiler, ammonia, or pressure vessels (if applicable) Knowledge of maintenance and utilities cost management What competencies are key to this role? Strong technical knowledge of industrial equipment and utilities systems Good understanding of maintenance practices (preventive, predictive, corrective) and efficiency concepts Knowledge of MS Office tools (Excel, Word) Strong analytical and problem-solving skills (PDCA, root cause analysis, etc.) Leadership skills with the ability to develop and manage teams Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across all levels of the organization Proactive mindset with ownership and initiative Strong organizational skills and ability to work under pressure Flexibility to work in shifts and dynamic environments Ability to work in multicultural environments High level of integrity, reliability, and professionalism What can you expect from Banvit MBRF? Being part of a global, collaborative and dynamic working environment Strong corporate culture with commitments to customers, employees & environment we serve Vertical, horizontal, and cross-functional growth opportunities Competitive compensation package Apply now and develop your career at MBRF ! #BRFBanvit

title: Field Engineer
description: Turn technical expertise into real impact on the jobsite. We are looking for a Field Engineer from engineering background to join our team. This is no ordinary engineering job, as ours is a uniquely high performing and supportive working culture. What You'll Do As a Field Engineer, you’ll be working with our customers, sales teams, contractors and designers to drive the sales of specific products. This involves educating key influencers on construction projects about the proper use, advantages and value of Hilti products, with a view to securing their specification in the designs. You’ll then communicate these product specs from design teams to sales teams, assigning account managers with their conversion into sales. It means visiting job sites to assess design problems as well as opportunities - giving technical advice, solutions and support, and adding value through the use of Hilti products. It might also mean looking into new business prospects by running customer surveys for product development and working with sales teams to develop local strategies. What You’ll Bring Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or Mechanical Engineering, 3+ construction experience both on site and engineering in related sectors, Competitive in English and native in Turkish, Technical knowledge and strong presentation skills will be an asset, AutoCAD, BIM, Revit or related software, Profis Engineering knowledge, Strong Microsoft Office knowledge and usage, High performer who has an achiever mentality, career driven, self-disciplined and supportive team player with high ethical values, Well-developed business acumen understanding, Open to travel inside Turkey, Active driver, Resident in Ankara What’s In It For You We really value our people, and we've worked hard to develop a reward package that reflects this, creating your future to be just how you would want it. Some of our benefits include: A caring and performance-oriented culture. A recognised Great Place to Work 2025, which celebrates our commitment to a culture that values care, performance, and innovation for our greatest strength, our people. Comprehensive career development opportunities that ensure your success is our priority. Why Hilti Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork. Commitment to Inclusion At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

title: Üretim Vardiya Mühendisi
description: Yıldız Holding Hakkında: 1944 yılında İstanbul'da bisküvi üretimi ile başlayan Yıldız Holding'in hikayesi, bugün 300'den fazla marka ile 5 kıtada 4 milyar kişiye ulaştığımız gıda-atıştırmalık ürünlerimiz ve Türkiye'nin dört bir yanındaki perakende şirketlerimizle devam ediyor. Çoğunluğu Türkiye'de bulunan 80 bin çalışanımızla durmadan daha iyiye ulaşmayı hedefliyor, 20'i yurt dışında olmak üzere toplam 45 fabrikada bisküviden çikolataya, dondurulmuş gıdadan ambalajlamaya kadar geniş bir ürün yelpazesi üretiyoruz. Ekonomik katkı, istihdam, ihracat, sosyal dayanışma ve sürdürülebilirlik alanlarında çıtayı her zaman yükseltiyoruz. "Mutlu Et Mutlu Ol" ilkesi ile toplumsal katkıya öncelik veriyor, ürün, hizmet ve sürdürülebilir sosyal sorumluluk anlayışımız ile 80 yılı aşkın süredir mutluluk üretiyoruz. Besler Hakkında: Yıldız Holding'in halka açık ikinci büyük gıda şirketi olan Besler, 16 farklı kategoride yaklaşık 1500 ürün ve 57 markası ile her yıl yaklaşık 61 milyon tabakta 19,5 milyon haneye misafir oluyor. Kurulduğumuz ilk günden bu yana, şirketimiz ve bağlı ortaklıklarımızla birlikte faaliyet gösterdiğimiz dondurulmuş, konserve gıda ve margarin pazarında müşterilerimize kaliteli, sağlıklı ve güvenilir ürünler sunmak adına çalışıyoruz. 1977’de su ürünleri ihracatı ile başlayan yolculuğumuza, bugün yıllar içinde yaptığımız yatırımlarla gıda sektörünün önde gelen şirketlerinden biri olarak ve 6 kıtada 60’tan fazla ülkede tüketicilerle ürünlerimizi buluşturarak emin adımlarla devam ediyoruz. Dondurulmuş ürün kategorisinde; unlu mamuller, sebze ve meyve ürünleri, patates ve kroket ürünleri, et ürünleri, tatlı ve donuk fırıncılık ürünleri üretirken, konserve ürün kategorisinde ise ton balığı konserveleri ve sebze konserveleri üretiyoruz. Türkiye’de dondurulmuş gıda alanında yurt içi pazarda tüm kategorilerde ürünü olan tek şirket olarak taze dondurulmuş gıda pazarına liderlik etmeye devam ediyoruz. Yağ kategorisinde ise tüketici margarin, ev dışı tüketim, yemeklik yağ ve peynirli sürme ürünlerimiz ile müşterilerimizle buluşuyoruz. Bugün, tüketici margarin, EDT (Ev Dışı Tüketim-Pastacılık, Catering ve Endüstriyel Yağlar) ve yemeklik ana kategorileri altında Bizim Yağ, Teremyağ, Luna, Ona, Ustam ve Evet başta olmak üzere üretim ve satışını yapıyoruz. İştiraklerimizden Marsa, Ev Dışı Tüketim ürünleri, pastacılık yağları kategorisinde “Ustam Pastacılık Yağları” ile pazarın lider markası konumunu sürdürüyor. title: Specialist IV - Repair & Maintenance
description: Job Purpose JOB DESCRIPTION Repair & Maintenance Specialist IV has responsibility for coordinating and leading the day-to-day shop operations of Repair and Maintenance activities. The role enforces the proper implementation of company guidelines, technical work instructions, test procedures, schematics, engineering notices, and best practices. Further responsibilities include ensuring that direct reports are trained and competent to perform specific related tasks, preserving a healthy and safe environment, and maintaining top-quality control over all maintenance activities. In addition to the inspection, testing and qualification, repair and maintenance of field tools, the R&M Specialist IV role performs preventive & corrective maintenance, retrofit and upgrade to electronic, mechanic, pneumatic, and hydraulic equipment, data acquisition systems, downhole tools & communication equipment. As the senior R&M Specialist, the employee will lead and oversee these tasks carried out by other R&M employees. While this is a generic job description covering the different levels of the R&M Specialist position, all aspects of the roles and responsibilities are relevant. More senior roles may lead and oversee tasks carried out by other R&M employees. Participates in all daily operations & safety meetings, toolbox, Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) and reports any issues promptly using the appropriate tools Maintains equipment, facilities, and work area in a presentable and safe working condition Repairs machines, equipment, or structures, using tools such as hammers, hoists, cranes, drills, wrenches, or equipment such as precision measuring instruments or electrical or electronic testing devices Assembles, installs, or repairs wiring, electrical or electronic components, pipe systems, plumbing, machinery, or equipment Inspects used parts to determine changes in dimensional requirements, using rules, callipers, micrometres, or other measuring instruments. This includes troubleshooting equipment issues, implementing corrective actions, and providing access to all relative R&M documented policies, procedures, work instructions, and technical manuals allowing the R&M team to complete their work effectively and efficiently Senior roles will ensure all field and workshop personnel follow the corrective and preventative maintenance procedures, ensuring all failures are followed up to closure with a proper root cause analysis and with the implementation of predetermined corrective action(s) Senior roles will lead the workshop and/or the electronic lab, defining and distributing the work assignment schedules while evaluating the quality, proficiency, and efficiency of the works being carried out through performing regular inspections to ensure compliance with standard operating procedures Orders parts, supplies, or equipment from catalogues or approved suppliers according to Weatherford’s guidelines and procedures Supports and complies with the LEAN initiatives and participates in the continuous efficiency improvement program of the facility. title: Mekanik Montaj Ekip Lideri
description: Milvus Robotics Hakkında Milvus Robotics olarak, sadece teknolojik trendleri takip etmekle kalmayıp aynı zamanda öncü olmayı hedefliyoruz. Otonom mobil robotların geleceğini şekillendirme ve önemli bir etki yaratma konusunda hazır hissediyorsanız, sizinle iletişime geçmek için sabırsızlanıyoruz! Misyonumuz, endüstrileri yeniden tanımlamak, operasyonları optimize etmek ve inovasyonu daha hızlı pazara sunmak için mobil robot teknolojisi ve yapay zekanın gücünden yararlanmaktır. Milvus Robotics olarak, gerçek iş ve toplumsal sorunlarla başa çıkan sofistike, güvenli ve verimli robotlar geliştirmekte gurur duyuyoruz. Milvus Robotics, robot teknolojisi ve ticari uygunluk arasındaki boşluğu kapatıyor. Otomasyonun, mobil robotların ve Yapay Zeka'nın (AI) teknolojik potansiyelini endüstriler arasında kullanarak üretimi, operasyonları ve pazara çıkış süresini iyileştirmeyi hedefliyoruz. Milvus Robotics olarak, iş ve toplumsal ihtiyaçları karşılamak için gören, düşünen ve hareket eden yüksek kaliteli robotlar geliştirmekten gurur duyuyoruz. Bu Rolde Sizi Neler Bekliyor? Firma bünyesinde yürütülen farklı projelerin günlük üretim planını son teslim tarihleri doğrultusunda iş istasyonlarına ve yönettiği ekibe dağıtmak; iş başlangıcında malzeme, iş talimatı, ekipman (tool), fikstür ve kalibrasyon durumunu kontrol etmek. Robot projelerinin mekanik montaj, demontaj ve parça değişim işlemlerini güncel iş talimatlarına göre yürütmek, yürütülmesini sağlamak; tork, bağlantı sabitleyici, gevşeme işareti, hizalama ve ölçü kontrollerinin eksiksiz uygulanmasını sağlamak. Uygunsuzluk durumunda operasyonu durdurmak, şüpheli yarı mamulü (WIP) ayırmak, uygunsuzluk raporu (NCR) için bilgi sağlamak ve onaylı yeniden işleme (rework) adımlarını yetkili personele uygulatmak. Çalışma alanının düzen, tertip ve temizliğini sağlatmak; el aletleri ve takımların bakımlarının yapılmasını sağlamak, Ekibe işbaşı eğitimi vermek ve yeni teknisyenleri yetki seviyelerine uygun işlerde görevlendirmek. Montaj sırasındaki tekrarlayan hata, süre ve uygulanabilirlik sorunlarını ilgili üretim proses mühendisine ve AR-GE birimine geri bildirmek; ilk ürün ve proses değişikliği kontrollerine katılmak. Çalışma alanının 5S düzenini, el aletlerinin bakımını, kaldırma yöntemlerini ve iş sağlığı ve güvenliği kurallarını uygulatmak; gerektiğinde diğer teknik ekiplerle iş birliği yapmak. Sizde Aradığımız Nitelikler Üniversitelerin (ön lisans) veya teknik liselerin Makine, Mekatronik, Otomotiv Teknolojisi veya Endüstriyel Otomasyon bölümlerinden mezun, Genel bilgisayar bilgisi sahibi olan ve MS Office programlarını kullanabilen, Mekanik ve elektromekanik montaj alanında en az 5 yıl; ekip veya vardiya koordinasyonunda en az 1 ila 2 yıl deneyimli, Teknik çizim ve şemaları okuyup yorumlayabilen; AC/DC motorlar, torklu bağlantılar, bağlantı sabitleyici uygulamaları ve pnömatik montaj ekipmanları konusunda bilgi sahibi, Kılavuz çekme, pafta, havşa, taşlama ve tesviye işlerinde yetkin; yüksek hassasiyet gerektiren işlerde pratik el becerisine sahip, Kumpas, açı ölçer, mikrometre, iç çap kompratör gibi ölçüm aletlerini etkin kullanabilen ve tolerans kontrolü yapabilen, İş dağılımı, işbaşı eğitim verme, kayıt disiplini ve problem eskalasyonu konularında liderlik becerisine sahip.
category_reasons: 2+ yıl deneyim isteniyor - staj ve projelerinle stretch
Profilinde görünmüyor: Yalın üretim / Kaizen, Hidrolik / Pnömatik

title: Design Engineer- Accommodation
description: Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability in a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding. Operating in more than 20 countries with more than 3.000 employees from 30 different nationalities and having an installed capacity of more than 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity on 4 continents with its fleet of 45 Powerships™ and 11 LNG vessels provides employment for more than 10 thousand people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages the Powership™ fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meets 10%-100% of the electricity needs of the countries it operates in Europe, Africa, America and Asia. With its high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership™, land-based plants and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership assists countries and companies in their energy transition processes. We are looking for a Design Engineer- Accommodation. Qualifications Graduate of a relevant associate or bachelor’s degree program, such as Naval Architecture, Industrial Design, Visual Communication Design, Architecture, Animation, or a related field, Technical knowledge of ship geometry, hull forms, general arrangement, exterior modeling, and industrial design, Advanced proficiency in at least one of the following software programs: Rhinoceros, Blender, or 3ds Max, with experience in 3D modeling, Ability to produce photorealistic renders and animations using one or more of the following: V-Ray, Corona, KeyShot, Lumion, or Unreal Engine, Ability to realistically animate sea and water simulations as well as the physical movements of vessels while underway, Strong aesthetic perspective and knowledge of camera angles, lighting, PBR materials, texture management, and cinematic composition, Preferably proficient in After Effects or similar video editing and post-production software, Knowledge or experience in preparing technical drawings within the scope of ship accommodation and outfitting projects, including Accommodation Plans, Panel Arrangements, Fire and Safety Plans, Fire Integrity and Insulation Plans, Door Plans, etc., Experience in checking the compliance of relevant technical drawings with international and local regulations and following up on material procurement processes related to these drawings, Strong analytical and visual perspective, with the ability to transform technical engineering data into visual design outputs, Well-organized in task follow-up and time management, with the ability to quickly adapt to project and design revisions, Strong communication skills and ability to work in coordination with different disciplines, For male candidates, completion of or exemption from compulsory military service. Job Description Interpretation of technical project data received from engineering and design teams and transformation of such data into presentation-ready 3D models, Preparation of photorealistic renders and promotional animations reflecting the site appearance, general arrangement, and operational structure of Powership projects, Creation of sea/water simulations and vessel navigation animations for ship and Powership projects, Preparation of visual materials and digital promotional content for international client presentations, site visits, trade fairs, and other events, Creation of photorealistic and cinematic visual outputs through the management of camera angles, lighting, materials, textures, and environmental elements, Coordination with Engineering, Business Development, and Corporate Communications teams to reflect project updates and design revisions in visual works, Preparation of technical drawings such as Accommodation Plans, Panel Arrangements, Fire and Safety Plans, Fire Integrity and Insulation Plans, Door Plans, etc., Verification of the compliance of prepared technical drawings and projects with international and local regulations, Creation of material purchase requisitions based on technical drawings and follow-up and management of the relevant procurement processes, Incorporation of design and engineering changes made throughout the projects into 3D models, renders, and animations in an up-to-date manner, Consistent maintenance of established visual quality and corporate presentation standards across projects. WHAT DO WE OFFER? One day off on your birthday, Comprehensive Private Health Insurance, Professional and personal training & development opportunities, Exclusive discounts and campaigns for employees. In line with our "One World" philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.

title: Silah Teknisyeni
description: Savunma Sanayi sektöründe öncelikle silah ve silah sistemleri alanında maliyet, kalite ve teslimat performansı ile ilk akla gelen güvenilir bir stratejik partner olmak vizyonuyla yola çıkan ve Türk Silahlı Kuvvetleri'nin üretim ve ürün geliştirme ihtiyaçlarının milli imkanlarla karşılanmasına yönelik stratejinin güçlendirilmesi maksadı ile kurulan Aselsan Konya, Türkiye’nin en güçlü sanayi kuruluşlarından biri olma yolunda hızla ilerlemektedir. Aselsan Konya – Silah ve Silah Sistemleri Tasarım Müdürlüğü Konya fabrika lokasyonumuz bünyesinde Yerli ve Milli Savunmamızın gücüne güç katacak tutkulu yetenekleri arıyoruz. Eğer hayal gücünü ve teknik bilgini birleştirerek bu alanda fark yaratmak istiyorsan, bu fırsat tam sana göre! Bu rol için aradığımız nitelikler neler? Meslek Yüksekokulları'nın veya Meslek Liselerinin ilgili bölümlerinden mezun (Silah Sanayi Teknikerliği, Makine, Mekatronik vb.). Silah ve silah sistemleri ile bunlara ait mekanik alt sistemlerin montajı, söküm-takımı ve ayar süreçlerinde tecrübeli. Teknik resim okuma, yorumlama ve ölçülere uygun çalışma konusunda yetkin. Mekanik toleranslar, montaj sıraları, sıkma torkları ve temel ölçüm teknikleri (kumpas, mikrometre vb.) hakkında bilgi sahibi. El aletleri ile manuel ve pnömatik ekipmanları, temel atölye makinelerini güvenli ve doğru şekilde kullanabilen. İş sağlığı ve güvenliği kurallarına uygun çalışma disiplinine sahip. Takım çalışmasına yatkın, sorumluluk bilinci yüksek ve disiplinli. Esnek çalışma saatlerine, saha görevlerine ve atışlı test faaliyetlerine uyum sağlayabilecek. Tercihen askeri standartlar, kalite gereklilikleri veya test süreçleri hakkında temel bilgi sahibi (tercih sebebidir). Konya'da ikamet eden/edebilecek olan. Görev ve Sorumluluklar Silah ve silah sistemlerine ait mekanik alt sistemlerin montaj, söküm, ayar ve kontrol faaliyetlerini; teknik resimler, talimatlar ve prosedürler doğrultusunda gerçekleştirmek. Montaj sonrası fonksiyonel kontrolleri yapmak, tespit edilen uygunsuzlukları ilgili mühendislik ekiplerine bildirmek. Atışlı test faaliyetlerinin hazırlık, icra ve değerlendirme aşamalarında aktif görev almak. Test, atış, bakım ve iyileştirme çalışmalarına katılarak sistem performansının doğrulanmasına destek vermek. Test ve saha faaliyetleri sırasında ortaya çıkan teknik problemlerin tespiti ve çözümüne yönelik çalışmalarda bulunmak. Test ve faaliyet sonuçlarına ilişkin teknik raporlama süreçlerine katkı sağlamak. Silah sistemlerinin bakım, ayar ve fonksiyon kontrollerini periyodik olarak gerçekleştirmek. Tasarım, imalat, üretim ve kalite birimleri ile koordineli şekilde çalışmak. Ürün üzerinde gerçekleştirilen tüm işlemleri kayıt altına alarak izlenebilirliğin sağlanmasına katkıda bulunmak. Atölye düzeninin korunması, ekipman ve ölçüm cihazlarının doğru ve güvenli kullanımından sorumlu olmak. Gerekli durumlarda montaj ve test süreçlerinin iyileştirilmesine yönelik geri bildirimlerde bulunmak. Planlı, dikkatli ve kalite odaklı bir çalışma anlayışıyla görevlerini zamanında tamamlamak. Tüm başvurular, başvuruların gizliliği ilkesi çerçevesinde değerlendirilecektir. Başvurunuz sonrası niteliklerinizin aranılan niteliklerle örtüşmesi durumunda sizinle irtibata geçileceğini bildirir, Aselsan Konya Silah Sistemleri A.Ş.’ye göstermiş olduğunuz ilgi için teşekkür ederiz.

title: Güç Sistem Tasarım Mühendisi

title: Mechanical R&D Engineer
description: Location: Denmark, Copenhagen Team: R&D Reports to: Head of Innovation and RD Lead About The Role We are looking for a Mechanical R&D Engineer to become a key technical force in Levitate's R&D team. But we are not simply looking for someone with many years of mechanical engineering experience; we are looking for an inventor at heart. The kind of engineer who encounters a difficult mechanical problem during the day and catches themselves still thinking about it later. Someone who sees an interesting mechanism and immediately wants to understand how it works, why it was designed that way, where its limitations are, and whether there is a better way to do it. Maybe your hobbies somehow always become engineering projects. You rebuild motorcycles, work on cars or bicycles, machine parts, build robots, 3D-print things, restore old machinery, make test rigs, or take products apart simply because you want to understand what is happening inside. Mechanical engineering doesn't have to literally be your hobby. But we are looking for the level of curiosity where it very easily could be. The R&D Team You'll join a team of design engineers, mechanical engineers, product developers, and specialists in materials, prototyping, testing, and manufacturing. Our process is hands-on and user-driven: we work closely with clinicians and, especially, the people who actually use our products — testing, observing, and turning real-world feedback into better solutions. You'll work across the full development process, from early concepts through prototyping, testing, verification, and production. What You'll Work On You'll take a technical role in our Mechanics product area, covering: mechanical systems and mechanisms, load-bearing/structural components, interfaces and connection systems, lightweight high-performance structures, new mechanical principles, materials and manufacturing technologies, and custom test equipment. This work supports our broader product portfolio wherever strong mechanical engineering, materials knowledge, and testing/verification are needed. You won't just turn finished requirements into CAD. You'll investigate technologies, explore principles, build and break prototypes, understand failures, and iterate until something is ready to become a product. Your Responsibilities Exploring and developing new mechanical concepts and technologies Mechanical design, CAD, and mechanism development Materials selection and structural engineering Rapid prototyping and proof-of-concept builds Designing test fixtures and dedicated test machines Static, fatigue, functional, and durability testing; verification and validation Working with relevant ISO standards Failure analysis and root-cause investigation Design for manufacturing and assembly; working directly with suppliers Supporting other engineers and helping strengthen testing/verification practices R&D-wide Taking concepts from whiteboard idea to something manufacturable and trustworthy Who you are You have strong mechanical fundamentals, but what sets you apart is intuition and curiosity, about forces, movement, mechanisms, materials, and how physical things interact. You get excited by elegant mechanical solutions, want to know what's inside things, and don't accept "that's how it's normally done" as a real answer. When something fails, your first instinct is curiosity, not frustration, and you can pair that curiosity with the discipline to turn an invention into a reliable product. Your background Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related field Significant experience developing physical products, with excellent CAD and mechanical design skills Strong understanding of mechanics, materials, and structural behavior Experience with mechanisms/moving assemblies, hands-on prototyping, CNC machining, and other manufacturing processes Experience with fatigue/static/functional testing, and designing test setups or fixtures Understanding of verification and validation, and experience moving products toward manufacturing Strong analytical and root-cause problem-solving skills Ability to work directly with suppliers Proven experience developing highly loaded mechanical products (e.g., prosthetics, medical devices, bicycles, sporting goods, automotive components, robotics, or similar) Demonstrated, repeated experience taking products through the full lifecycle, concept through engineering, testing, industrialization, launch, and post-market optimization, multiple times in your career, with concrete evidence of what you've personally built and solved Why Levitate? At Levitate, the distance between an engineering idea and its real-world impact is unusually short. We build products people walk, run, train, and live their lives on; meaning they must be dynamic yet predictable, lightweight yet strong, sophisticated yet manufacturable, and able to survive millions of load cycles. We're looking for someone who doesn't just want to engineer our next product, but can't help wondering what it should be. You’ll join a small, ambitious and highly collaborative team where you’ll have real influence on both the products we build and how we build them. Your work won’t disappear into a large organization, you’ll be able to take ideas from early concepts through testing and development to products that make a tangible difference in people’s everyday lives. We offer a competitive salary package including pension and insurance, lunch at the office, and an informal and flexible working environment in Copenhagen. Application & process Submit your application on The Hub. We review them on a continuous basis. The recruitment process consists of a practical engineering-focused interview and a concrete mechanical development case. Invited candidates will receive more information beforehand.

title: R&D & Workshop Technician
description: Location: Denmark Employment: Full time About Us We are a Denmark based defence technology startup developing advanced autonomous systems for security and defence applications. Our team combines expertise across engineering, AI and defence technology, with a strong focus on turning advanced concepts into robust, deployable products designed for real operational and commercial use. About the Role As our R&D & Workshop Technician, you will take ownership of the operational, documentation, procurement and workshop activities surrounding our engineering work. Your objective is to enable our engineers to spend their time designing, building, testing and solving technical problems. At the same time, you will bring structure to a fast moving R&D environment, ensuring that prototypes, configurations, components, tests and engineering learnings are properly documented and can be understood and reproduced by others. This is not an administrative or workshop maintenance position. It is a hands on technical support role, working directly alongside engineers and prototypes. We are looking for someone who is practical, technically curious, structured and hands on. We value people who take ownership, spot what needs to be done and are comfortable operating in an environment where priorities can change quickly as prototypes evolve. Key Responsibilities Prototype & Engineering Support Support the preparation, assembly and integration of prototypes under the direction of our engineers. Prepare components, wiring, connectors and hardware for builds. Support soldering, mechanical assembly and basic rework where appropriate. Operate 3D printers and manage print queues. Prepare prototypes, batteries, tools and equipment for bench and field testing. As your technical knowledge develops, take increasing ownership of routine assembly and preparation activities. Engineering Documentation & Configuration Control Maintain clear and practical documentation of our prototypes and their evolution. Create and maintain Bills of Materials, component references, hardware specifications and relevant technical documentation. Keep track of prototype revisions and document what changed between configurations. Maintain simple build records connecting each prototype with its BOM, configuration, modifications, photos, test results and known issues. The objective is simple, another engineer should be able to understand what was built, how it was built and what changed without relying on knowledge held by one individual. Testing & Engineering Knowledge Capture Support engineers during bench, subsystem and field testing. Prepare test equipment and test sheets, record configurations and conditions, and capture observations, failures and results. Organise test data, photos and videos so that results remain accessible and linked to the relevant prototype. Help turn engineering notes, test observations and design changes into structured records, with technical conclusions validated by the responsible engineer. Procurement & Supply Chain Support Take ownership of the operational side of component procurement so engineers spend minimal time searching, ordering and following deliveries. Source standard components based on engineering requirements, identify potential suppliers and alternative sources, prepare and place approved orders, track shipments and follow up on delays or backorders. Receive components, verify deliveries and maintain appropriate purchasing and component records. Parts, Stock & Tool Control Maintain visibility of components, consumables and raw materials. Know what is in stock, what has been ordered and what is missing for upcoming builds. Monitor critical consumables and frequently used components and anticipate replenishment requirements. Maintain shared tools and test equipment so that engineers have what they need when they need it. Workshop & Equipment Operations Help maintain an organised, safe and efficient R&D environment. Keep assembly areas, soldering stations, tools and equipment operational and ready for use. Maintain 3D printers and other workshop equipment. Manage safe battery storage, charging, inspection and disposal records and support implementation of appropriate workshop safety procedures.

title: Additive Manufacturing Technician
description: Job Description Additive Manufacturing Technician i Enabling&Operations – Daghold på LEGO® Jobbet som Additive Manufacturing Technician består i at sikre effektiv drift med produktion af udstyrsdele i den rigtige kvalitet samt bidrage til høj udnyttelse af produktionsapparatet og skabe løbende forbedringer. Det forventes, at du kan arbejde med udvikling og optimering af processer i et miljø hvor der ofte implementeres ændringer. Additive Manufacturing arbejder med teknologier, hvor både plast og metal-elementer bygges med materialer lag på lag. I vores udviklings- og produktionsområde på Kornmarken kører vi to programmer, som er fremstilling af henholdsvis LEGO-elementer og udstyrselementer til produktionen i form af bla. jigs og fixtures til bla. vores bearbejdningsafdelinger. Denne stilling henvender sig til drift af vores udstyrsproduktion på forskellige teknologier der omfavner både DLP, SLM og SLS. Dine opgaver bliver Sikre høj effektivitet på udstyr og maskiner. Varetage fejlfinding, optimering og justering af maskiner og processer. Deltage aktivt i forebyggende aktivitet, som rengøring, kvalitetskontrol og vedligehold. Udføre testkørsler og undersøgelser af materialer og udstyr i samarbejde med relaterede områder og samarbejdspartnere. Yde problemløsning samt deltage i analysearbejde. Opnå stor procesforståelse og knowhow for at opnå den bedst mulige kvalitet. Give feedback på partkvalitet og udstyrsperformance til samarbejdspartnere. Udgående kvalitetskontrol. Bliv en del af et team, hvor kvalitet er i højsædet Du bliver en del af vores team, som i dag består af dedikerede specialister fra forskellige steder i verden. Området er kendetegnet af kreativitet og innovative medarbejdere, hvor vi hele tiden forsøger at hæve barren på vores løsninger. Vi ved at den bedste måde at gøre det på, er at er at samarbejde , så vi udnytter idéer og innovative tanker fra alle funktioner. I jobbet forventes der, at du bidrager til udvikling af processer og bidrager til at løfte disse til et højere niveau. Jobbet forudsætter, at kundens behov holdes i centrum og udnyttelse af egne erfaringer og kompetencer på tværs af organisatoriske tilhørsforhold. Det gode match Du er uddannet Plastmager, Værktøjsmager, Industriteknikker eller har en lignende faglig uddannelse. Du er open-minded i forhold til nye teknologier og klar til sidemandsoplæring i opsætning og indkøring af AM-maskiner. Desuden har du et grundlæggende kendskab til og forståelse for kvalitet, da du skal besidde beslutningskompetence ifm. kvalitet Vurdere den visuelle kvalitet, og ved konstatering af afvigelser eller kvalitetsbrist skal disse håndteres i henhold til gældende eskaleringsprocedurer. Derudover forventes det at du har Kendskab til LEAN (LEGO Continuous Improvement – LCI). Stor teknisk indsigt i arbejde med maskiner og materialer. IT-kendskab på brugerniveau. Gode Engelsk kundskaber både mundtlig og skriftlig. Dit mindset er altafgørende, da hverdagen er fuld af forandringer og mange samarbejdspartnere - så nøgleordene for din profil skal derfor være ’’forandringsparat, proaktiv og initiativrig’’ Som person er du Forandringsparat og villig til at lære nyt. Interesseret i at opsøge ny viden og dele den med andre. Analytisk, selvstændig og teamorienteret. Ansøg & kontakt Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte områdets leder, Mike Gadgaard på mike.gadgaard@lego.com For at søge stillingen skal du klikke på APPLY/ANSØG . Husk at vedhæfte dine dokumenter. Bliv en del LEGO® familien I LEGO Koncernen skaber vi succeser sammen, og du kan se frem til at blive en del af en global familie og et tæt fællesskab. Vi ser meget frem til at modtage og læse din ansøgning. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, please note we do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to any advertised closing date. So, if you're interested in this role we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. What’s in it for you? Here is what you can expect Family Care Leave - We offer enhanced paid leave options for those important times. Insurances – All colleagues are covered by our life and disability insurance which provides protection and peace of mind. Wellbeing - We want our people to feel well and thrive. We offer resources and benefits to nurture physical and mental wellbeing along with opportunities to build community and inspire creativity. Colleague Discount – We know you'll love to build, so from day 1 you will qualify for our generous colleague discount. Bonus - We do our best work to succeed together. When goals are reached and if eligible, you'll be rewarded through our bonus scheme. Workplace - When you join the team you'll be assigned a primary workplace location i.e. one of our Offices, stores or factories. Our hybrid work policy means an average of 3 days per week in the office. The hiring team will discuss the policy and role eligibility with you during the recruitment process. Children are our role models. Their curiosity, creativity and imagination inspire everything we do. title: Senior mekanikkonstruktör till Svekon
description: Vill du kombinera hands-on konstruktion med tekniskt ledarskap? Då kan du vara rätt person för rollen som senior mekanikkonstruktör hos Svekon i Solna. Läs mer och sök rollen redan idag! Vilka är Svekon? På Svekon får du vara med där det händer - från ett behov och en prototyp till en färdig lösning. Med sina 50 år i branschen fortsätter Svekon sin framgångsresa som ingenjörsbyrån som jobbar för en bättre morgondag. Idag erbjuder de tjänster inom bland annat mjukvaruutveckling, elektronik- och mekanikkonstruktion, industridesign och regulatorisk- och teknisk dokumentation. Svekon huserar i moderna och livfulla lokaler i Solna, där både kontor och verkstad finns under samma tak. På så sätt hamnar du aldrig långt från tekniken – oavsett vilken roll du har på Svekon. Vad ingår i rollen? Som senior mekanikkonstruktör blir du en viktig del av Svekons utvecklingsprojekt. I rollen kombinerar du avancerad mekanikkonstruktion med tekniskt ledarskap och ansvarar för både den tekniska lösningen och kvaliteten i projektens mekanikarbete. Du arbetar i projekt inom flera produktområden som konsumentprodukter, automation samt försvarsbranchen. Uppdragen kan variera från mindre utvecklingsinsatser till större tvärfunktionella projekt. I vissa projekt driver du konstruktionen självständigt, medan du i andra fungerar som konstruktionsledare och tekniskt stöd till projektledare och kollegor. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter: Utveckla och konstruera produkter och tekniska system från koncept till industrialisering Ansvara för mekaniska lösningar och kvalitetssäkring inom utvecklingsprojekt Driva och samordna konstruktionsarbete i rollen som konstruktionsledare Stötta projektledare med teknisk kompetens och vägledning Handleda och utveckla andra konstruktörer Rollen passar dig som vill arbeta med fortsatt hands-on konstruktion samtidigt som du tar ett större ansvar för helhet, teknisk riktning och kunskapsöverföring inom teamet. Vi söker dig som har: Civil- eller högskoleingenjörsutbildning inom mekanik, produktutveckling eller motsvarande Minst 8 års erfarenhet av mekanisk konstruktion och produktutveckling Erfarenhet av hela produktutvecklingsprocessen, från kravställning och konceptutveckling till verifiering och industrialisering Erfarenhet av att leda eller samordna tekniskt arbete inom produktutveckling God kunskap om design för olika tillverknings- och monteringsmetoder Avancerade kunskaper i 3D-CAD (gärna SolidWorks) samt erfarenhet av PDM-system God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift Vi tror att du är van att ta initiativ, skapa struktur i ditt arbete och stötta andra i tekniska frågeställningar, samtidigt som du är prestigelös och tycker om att dela med dig av kunskap. Det är meriterande om du har: Praktisk erfarenhet från tillverkande verksamhet Erfarenhet av plåtbearbetning, maskinbearbetning, formsprutning, gjutning eller monteringsprocesser Erfarenhet av flera olika material och tillverkningsmetoder Avancerade kunskaper i ytmodellering i SolidWorks Erfarenhet av konstruktion i kompositmaterial Erfarenhet från konsultverksamhet Erfarenhet av att handleda och utveckla juniora kollegor Kunskap om materialval och hållbarhetsanpassad produktutveckling Om du har läst så här långt är chansen stor att du är rätt person för rollen. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Observera att Envoke Talent ansvarar för rekryteringsprocessen, men du blir anställd hos Svekon. Så här ser rekryteringsprocessen ut: Vi ser över hur din ansökan matchar mot rollen du sökt Matchar du profilen? Då är nästa steg en intervju med oss på Envoke Talent! Intervju med rekryterande chef på Svekon följt av ev. arbetsprov Rätt match? Grattis till nya jobbet! Om du får besked att det inte var rätt match denna gång så sparar vi gärna dina uppgifter och presenterar andra tjänster som matchar din profil. Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

title: Design Engineer Pump Product Engineering till Metso i Sala
description: Metso helps build a more sustainable future by developing solutions that transform the world's essential raw materials-the foundation of modern infrastructure, electrification, renewable energy, and digital development. With nearly 18,000 employees worldwide, the company combines innovation, safety, inclusion, and collaboration to drive positive change. At Metso, you'll have the opportunity to grow, make an impact, and contribute to a more sustainable world. Introduktion Vi söker en erfaren Design Engineer till vår R&D-avdelning för slurrypumpar i Sala. I rollen arbetar du med mekanikkonstruktion och produktutveckling för produkter som används i krävande industriella miljöer. Tillsammans med kollegor inom konstruktion, produktutveckling och andra specialistområden driver du utvecklingsprojekt från idé till färdig lösning. Med din tekniska kompetens bidrar du genom hela utvecklingsprocessen och säkerställer att konstruktioner möter högt ställda krav på kvalitet, funktion, säkerhet och prestanda. Rollen innefattar även tekniska beräkningar och analyser, bland annat inom hållfasthet och säkra lyft. Arbetet sker i nära samverkan med funktioner som inköp, kvalitet, HSE, test och produktion. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team i Sala samtidigt som du samarbetar med kollegor och specialister runt om i världen. Som Design Engineer spelar du en viktig roll i vår fortsatta utveckling och bidrar till att skapa innovativa och hållbara lösningar som möter framtidens behov. Du rapporterar till Engineering R&D Manager, också placerad i Sala. Tjänsten är hybrid, men du förväntas vara fysiskt på plats minst två dagar i veckan. Allt för att skapa ett sammanhang där människor samarbetar, utvecklas och lyckas tillsammans. Teamet du tillhör Ditt närmaste team utgörs av nio personer med gedigen expertis inom design och FEA. Vi stöttar varandra och jobbar tillsammans mot gemensamma mål. Vissa av oss har jobbat länge inom Metso medan andra är relativt nya. Vi värdesätter mångfald och ser varandras olikheter som en styrka. Vad du ska göra Som Design Engineer R&D kommer du i huvudsak Skapa tekniska ritningar och modeller som motsvarar standardkrav för funktion och kvalitet. Självständigt, eller tillsammans med andra, ansvara för produktutveckling inklusive designprototyputveckling. Utföra hållfasthetsberäkningar med särskild betoning på säkerhet och säkra lyft. Bidra med ingenjörsexpertis och designkompetens både inom specifika produktutvecklingsprojekt och kontinuerligt utvecklingsarbete. Analysera uppkomna problem och bidra med tekniska lösningar. Jobba tight tillsammans med andra för att säkerställa framdrift och måluppfyllelse. Säkerställa att designen uppfyller kvalitets- och säkerhetsstandarder och vid behov utföra riskbedömningar, initiera testning, revideringar eller andra typer av verifieringsmetoder. Skapa och underhålla teknisk dokumentation som ritningar, specifikationer och rapporter och tillse att dessa granskas innan deadlines. För att lyckas För att vara framgångsrik i rollen behöver du vara drivande och självgående men också uppskatta att samarbeta och interagera med andra. Du är en ingenjör med öga för detaljer och analytisk förmåga men också förståelse för vikten av att hitta balansen mellan framdrift och hållbara lösningar över tid. Följande punkter stämmer också in på dig Examen inom maskinteknik eller annat relevant område. Tidigare erfarenhet från liknande arbete inom tillverkande industri. Bekväm med att kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Van användare av Office-paketet samt designprogramvaror. Specifik erfarenhet från Inventor och Teamcenter är meriterande. I den bästa av världar har du också Erfarenhet av simulering och analys av konstruktioners hållfasthet och prestanda med hjälp av FEA-verktyg. title: Mechanical Design Engineer
description: About Dalkia UK At Dalkia, we're driven by a shared purpose: tackling climate change and building a better, more sustainable future. We bring together talented people who share knowledge, challenge each other and grow together. Backed by EDF, Britain's biggest generator of low carbon electricity, we're a people-first culture. With 5,000+ employees and £600m+ turnover, we combine the strength of a major group with a great culture, innovative mindset and inclusive values making Dalkia a great place to work and grow your career. Mechanical Design Engineer Design innovative energy and decarbonisation solutions. Deliver projects that make a real impact. We're looking for a talented engineer to join our growing design team, delivering innovative decarbonisation and energy infrastructure projects across complex, live operational environments such as hospitals, universities, and industrial sites. This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge energy technologies while helping organisations achieve ambitious net-zero goals. From large-scale energy centres and heat pumps to district heating, chilled water systems and plant rooms, you'll play a key role in developing high-quality engineering solutions that improve performance, resilience and sustainability. This is an exciting opportunity to work on a diverse portfolio of projects involving energy centres, heat pumps, CHP, steam and hot water systems, chilled water systems, BMS, standby generation and other critical infrastructure. You'll be involved throughout the project lifecycle, from concept development and detailed design through to construction support and commissioning. What you'll be doing: Developing mechanical designs from concept through to detailed design Producing and reviewing specifications, schematics and technical documentation Coordinating designs with internal engineering teams and external consultants Supporting the delivery of low-carbon and energy efficiency projects Ensuring designs are practical, buildable and compliant with relevant standards Participating in site surveys, inspections and client meetings Supporting construction, commissioning and handover activities Identifying and helping to mitigate technical and operational risks Working collaboratively with project, electrical and controls engineers to deliver integrated solutions What we're looking for: Degree qualified in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering 3–5+ years' experience within building services, energy, infrastructure or M&E environments Experience with HVAC, steam, heating, chilled water and domestic water systems Knowledge of major plant including heat pumps, boilers, CHP and chillers Ability to produce engineering schematics and concept layouts using AutoCAD Understanding of commissioning, testing and engineering documentation Strong communication and problem-solving skills Experience working within live operational environments would be advantageous Why join us? This is an opportunity to work on challenging projects that directly contribute to sustainability, energy efficiency and Net Zero goals. You'll gain exposure to a wide range of technologies and work alongside experienced engineers in a collaborative and supportive environment where professional development is encouraged. If you're passionate about engineering, sustainability and delivering practical solutions to complex challenges, we'd love to hear from you. Our Values People First – It starts with health, safety and wellbeing Better Together – A collaborative team Trusted Partners – Dedicated to our clients' success Taking Responsibility – Making a positive difference Equity, Diversity & Inclusion We're committed to an inclusive and fair recruitment process. If you need any adjustments please let us know, in confidence, our team is here to support you.
