title: PhD Position in the Fatigue Performance and Weldability of Next-Generation Structural Steels
description: Do you want to contribute to the scientific and engineering foundations of the next generation of sustainable structural steels? Job Description The steel industry is undergoing a major transformation to reduce its environmental impact. New production routes based on hydrogen direct reduced iron (DRI), electric arc furnaces (EAF), and the increased use of scrap are expected to play a key role in the decarbonization of the steel sector. However, important questions remain regarding the performance of these next-generation sustainable steels in fatigue-critical infrastructure and structural applications. In this PhD project, you will investigate the fatigue performance and weldability of next-generation structural steels, with the aim of enabling their safe application in infrastructure and construction. Specifically, the research will examine how "greener" steel production routes and varying levels of scrap content affect the fatigue behaviour and the weldability of these sustainable structural steels. You will combine experimental testing with advanced numerical modelling to evaluate both the base material and welded joints. The project will also assess whether existing fatigue design methods developed for conventional steels remain applicable to these next-generation sustainable steels. As a PhD candidate, you will be part of the Grow with Green Steel (Groeien met Groen Staal) programme and work within a multidisciplinary consortium of leading universities, research institutes, and industrial partners. This unique collaboration offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge research while working closely with stakeholders across the steel value chain. The outcomes of the project will support the safe implementation of the next-generation structural steels in fatigue-critical infrastructure and structural applications. Furthermore, the research will help reduce technical uncertainties associated with the transition towards a more sustainable and circular steel industry. The Steel & Composites section at TU Delft conducts research on the behaviour, design, and assessment of steel and composite structures under both static and fatigue loading. Its research is built on a strong combination of experimental and numerical approaches, ranging from material characterization and component testing to full-scale structural demonstrators supported by advanced modelling techniques. title: Trading Systems Performance Engineer – EMO – Experienced Hire
description: Overview As a pioneer in low latency trading, Susquehanna is at the forefront in advances in the technology used to trade markets all around the world. As a Low Latency Trading Systems Research Engineer, you will be instrumental in driving enhancements and optimizations in how Susquehanna trades global markets in an extremely competitive environment. At Susquehanna, we don't believe in silos, we've proven that people do their best work when they have the freedom to explore, experiment and collaborate with other brilliant minds and as such this role engages close partnership with Traders, Trading and Quantitative Researchers, FPGA Developers, System and Network Engineers to continually analyze and optimize our trading systems, using data from lab experimentation, production data and the candidates own experiences and intuitions. The work done here has a direct impact on our trading business, and every single aspect of the environment is pulled apart and scrutinized, from physical cabling, fiber optics, transceivers, network stacks, all the way up to exchange level protocol specifications. What You Will Do Work with the very latest innovative and cutting edge technologies used in financial trading. Recreate complex low latency trading topologies and scenarios in our dedicated lab environment. Provide critical thinking to challenging problems and work as part of a team to help solve them. Work with stakeholders to identify and formulate lab testing scenarios. Use the dedicated lab and tools you develop to explore and test innovative trading scenarios to prove/disprove hypothesis. Identify, recommend, implement and drive optimizations in the production trading environment from the results of the testing. In depth analysis of production trading and lab network data, from many sources and formats. Become an expert on all aspects of the low latency trading environment. Drive testing automation efforts. Work with external vendors and companies on new products, features and technologies to keep Susquehanna at the forefront of Ultra Low Latency Trading. What We're Looking For Highly motivated, meticulous, articulate and deeply curious about all aspects of technologies used in a trading environment. Excellent software development, testing, trouble shooting and analysis skills using C/C++ and C#. Extensive knowledge of computer internals, operating systems and networking. Data analysis experience in Python using Jupyter Notebooks. Python and Powershell scripting experience. Great If You Also Have Experience in a low latency trading environment. Practical knowledge of the following network protocols BGP, IGMP, PIM, Ethernet, IP, UDP, TCP, LLDP etc Experience using FPGA's and technologies used in a Low latency networking environment. (Solarflare, Kernel bypass, etc) Knowledge or experience of DC operations. Susquehanna does not post salary information, so any salary information you find online may not be accurate because it was not provided or verified by Susquehanna. Susquehanna does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or search firms. Any resume or referral submitted in the absence of a signed agreement will become the property of Susquehanna and no fee will be paid.

title: Process Engineer - New Manufacturing Technologies

You will work with both conventional manufacturing methods (milling, turning, grinding) and advanced innovative techniques like Additive Manufacturing (3D printing). Managing machine selection, CAD/CAM integration, and data acquisition, you ensure high quality, short lead times, and optimal process efficiency. You will work via our hybrid model at our production facility in Wilrijk. To succeed, you will need At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position. Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Process Engineering, or equivalent through experience Profound knowledge of manufacturing processes (conventional machining and/or Additive Manufacturing) and quality management principles Familiarity with CAD/CAM software suites and data acquisition systems Fluent communication skills in Dutch and English (spoken and written); knowledge of German is considered a plus Hands-on, creative, and critical thinker who is always looking for a better way to optimize processes Independent worker and reliable team player with strong organizational skills, accuracy, and a cost-conscious, innovative mindset In return, we offer t Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave, retirement benefits, and flexible hybrid working arrangements. At Atlas Copco Group, we encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, philosophy, disability, age, sexual orientation, or identity. Job location This role requires you to work on-site at our office in Anwterp, Belgium. You will be part of a dynamic team and enjoy the benefits of face-to-face collaboration. Uniting curious minds Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

title: Senior Process Engineer
description: Company Description Всичко започна с една проста идея: ами ако хирургията можеше да бъде по-малко инвазивна, а възстановяването по-малко болезнено? Близо 30 години по-късно, този въпрос все още е в основата на всичко, което правим в Intuitive. Като световен лидер в роботизирано-асистираната хирургия и минимално инвазивните грижи, нашите технологии – като хирургическата система da Vinci и Ion – трансформираха начина, по който се предоставят грижи за милиони пациенти по целия свят. Ние сме екип от инженери, клиницисти и новатори, обединени от една цел: да направим хирургията по-интелигентна, по-безопасна и по-хуманна. Всеки ден нашата работа помага на екипите за грижи да работят с по-голяма прецизност, а пациентите да се възстановяват по-бързо, подобрявайки резултатите по целия свят. Проблемите, които решаваме, изискват креативност, строгост и сътрудничество. Работата е предизвикателна, но дълбоко смислена – защото всяко подобрение, което правим, има потенциала да промени живота. Ако сте готови да допринесете за нещо по-голямо от себе си и да помогнете за трансформирането на бъдещето на здравеопазването, ще намерите своята цел тук. Специфицира, документира, квалифицира и внедрява производствени приспособления и оборудване. Дефинира и изпълнява тестове (като DOE, валидиране), за да провери дали процесите са стабилни и способни да предоставят последователни и надеждни резултати. Подпомага проектирането за определяне на критични характеристики на дизайна по отношение на приложимата технология на сглобяване и оптимална технологичност. Определя и включва инспекция на критични функции и тестови контролни точки в процеса. Разработва и валидира процеси на сглобяване и производство от първия прототип до преминаването към серийно производство. Идентифицира, разработва и подпомага внедряването на потенциални подобрения по отношение на сглобяването, намаляване на времето на цикъла, надеждност на продукта и намаляване на разходите по време на краткосрочни, средносрочни и дългосрочни проекти за производствено инженерство. title: PhD position in circular silicon and silicon carbide for additive manufacturing
description: Job Description We offer a fully funded, four-year PhD position at the University of Twente focused on developing circular production routes for silicon and silicon carbide, key materials for high-temperature and high-performance applications. The project brings together materials science, powder technology, additive manufacturing, and data science. Silicon carbide is widely used in demanding thermal, structural, and electronic applications, yet its production is energy-intensive and relies on global supply chains. At the same time, the photovoltaic and semiconductor industries generate large volumes of silicon-rich waste: up to 75% of silicon can be lost across the value chain, while recycling rates remain around 5%. Existing recycling routes largely downcycle this material into lower-value compounds and do not produce powders with the quality required for advanced manufacturing. This PhD project aims to address that gap. You will develop and optimise routes for converting silicon-rich waste streams into high-purity powders. Using mechanochemical processing, you will investigate and control phase formation, particle size distribution, morphology, and flowability. You will then establish additive manufacturing process windows for these circular powders using both binder-free and binder-based additive manufacturing approaches, investigating melt behaviour, densification, defect formation, and microstructure in materials. A distinctive element of the project is its data-driven approach. Together with colleagues at Saxion University of Applied Sciences, you will contribute to the development of machine-learning models that connect powder characteristics and process parameters with the properties of the final components. These models will support faster feedstock qualification and enable predictive quality control. You will work in an interdisciplinary and international environment alongside academic researchers and industrial partners spanning the full value chain—from waste recovery and silicon processing to powder qualification, additive manufacturing, and advanced ceramics. The project offers strong opportunities to publish high-impact research while developing technologies with immediate industrial relevance and clear potential for sustainability impact. Your profile We are looking for a highly motivated, enthusiastic, and self-driven researcher who meets the following qualifications: A Master's degree in Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or another relevant engineering/science discipline. Strong interest in powder technology, ceramics, and additive manufacturing. Experience with materials characterisation techniques an mechanical and thermal testing is highly desirable. Familiarity with additive manufacturing processes is an advantage. Knowledge of ceramic processing, powder metallurgy, or mechanochemistry is beneficial. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within an interdisciplinary research environment. Strong analytical, experimental, and problem-solving skills. Motivation to contribute to both fundamental research and industrially relevant technology development. Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English, both spoken and written. Our offer A fully funded 4-year PhD position in an ambitious and internationally recognized research environment. Excellent working conditions, an exciting scientific environment, and a green and lively campus with lots of sports facilities and an international scientific community. The terms of employment are in accordance with the Dutch Collective Labour Agreement for Universities (CAO) and include: Gross salary between € 3.204,- and € 4.051,- per month depending on experience and qualifications; Excellent benefits include a holiday allowance of 8% of the gross annual salary, a year-end bonus of 8.3%, and a solid pension scheme. You can make use of excellent facilities for professional and personal development and a training program in which you and your supervisor will make up a plan for additional suitable education and supervision. You will receive good secondary conditions, in accordance with the collective labor agreement CAO-NU for Dutch universities. We encourage a high degree of responsibility and independence while collaborating with close colleagues, researchers, and other university staff. Information and application Are you interested in being part of our team? Please send your application by October 22, 2026 , via the "Apply Now" button and include the following documents: A cover letter (maximum one A4 page) outlining your motivation, relevant expertise, and interest in the project. A detailed CV, including academic achievements, research experience, publications (if applicable), and the contact details of at least three references. Academic transcripts from your Bachelor's and Master's studies. An abstract of your Master's thesis, briefly describing the research objectives, methodology, main findings, and key conclusions. For more information about this position, you are welcome to contact Dr. Davoud Jafari at davoud.jafari@utwente.nl. screening is part of the procedure About The Department The project at the University of Twente brings together scientists from the Faculties of Engineering Technology (ET). ET: The Faculty of Engineering Technology engages in the education and research of Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, and Industrial Design Engineering. We enable society and industry to innovate and create value using efficient, solid, and sustainable technology. We are part of a ‘people-first' university of technology, taking our place as an internationally leading center for smart production, processes, and devices in five domains: Health Technology, Maintenance, Smart Regions, Smart Industry, and Sustainable Resources. As a Mechanical Engineer you will support on key activities within HVAC/ Mechanical Services design. title: Junior Mechanical Engineer Energiesystemen
description: Organisatie- en afdelingsomschrijving Sta jij te popelen om mee te bouwen aan een duurzamer Nederland? Voor een toonaangevende landelijke speler zoeken wij een Junior Mechanical Engineer Energiesystemen die een actieve rol wil spelen in de energietransitie. Je komt terecht bij een mooi Noord-Brabant bedrijf met een sterke focus op innovatie, duurzaamheid en samenwerking. Hier werk je aan de technische ruggengraat van de toekomst: duurzame energiesystemen die helpen bij het oplossen van netcongestie en het versnellen van de energietransitie. De afdeling Energieontwerp is volop in ontwikkeling. Je maakt onderdeel uit van een hecht team met een duidelijke missie: Nederland voorzien van toekomstbestendige energie-infrastructuur. Met een solide onboarding en buddy-traject zorgen we dat jij een vliegende start maakt. Functie-informatie Als Junior Mechanical Engineer Energiesystemen werk je aan het ontwerp en de technische uitwerking van mechanische componenten binnen complexe energieprojecten. Denk aan de aanleg van warmtenetten, ondergrondse energieopslag en grootschalige kabel- en leidingsystemen. Jij zorgt ervoor dat energie efficiënt, veilig en duurzaam van A naar B komt. Je werkt nauw samen met engineers, tekenaars en uitvoerders aan een grote diversiteit van projecten. Je krijgt volop ruimte om ervaring op te doen en jezelf te ontwikkelen in meerdere richtingen, zoals werkvoorbereiding, uitvoering of zelfs EMVI- en ontwerpcoördinatie. Aanbod Startsalaris tussen €3.000,- en €3.600,- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van opleidingsniveau en ervaring. 20 vakantiedagen, 13 ADV-dagen en uitstekende secundaire voorwaarden (cao Bouw & Infra of Metaal) Daarnaast krijg je toegang tot praktijkgerichte trainingen via een interne academie, flexibele werktijden en natuurlijk inspirerende collega’s die jou graag verder helpen. Functie-eisen Afgeronde mbo niveau 4, hbo of wo-opleiding in werktuigbouwkunde, energietechniek of mechanical engineering. Ervaring met teken- en modelleersoftware is een pré (zoals AutoCAD, Inventor of Revit) It is necessary to speak and write Dutch fluently. Je bent leergierig, pakt graag door en hebt een fascinatie voor duurzame technologie. Je kijkt verder dan vandaag en denkt mee over de energiesystemen van morgen. Solliciteren bij Ben jij klaar om te werken aan projecten die Nederland duurzamer en toekomstbestendiger maken? title: Mechanical Engineer - Image Quality
description: ABOUT THE ROLE Have you ever wanted to understand what happens between light entering a lens and a high-quality image being produced? Are you interested in how optical design, mechanical precision, manufacturing processes, and environmental conditions shape the performance of advanced imaging systems? FRAMOS is looking for an Image Quality Engineer to join our growing team in Čakovec. Working at the intersection of optics, precision mechanics, and manufacturing, you will help validate, optimize, and improve camera modules used in cutting-edge applications worldwide. This is an excellent opportunity for recent graduates and early-career mechanical engineers who want to build expertise in optics, imaging systems, precision mechanics, advanced manufacturing, and embedded technologies. WHAT WILL YOU WORK ON? You don't need prior experience in optics or imaging – you will learn with us. You will start with clear tasks such as: Running tests that help us understand the mechanical and optical behavior of camera modules during product onboarding and validation. Evaluating how optical alignment, mechanical assembly, and tolerances affect image quality performance. Learning to operate and configure specialized laboratory and measurement equipment such as optical benches, calibration devices, and environmental test systems. Investigating the effects of manufacturing variation, mechanical tolerances, vibration, temperature changes, and other environmental conditions on product performance. Supporting process automation and continuous improvement initiatives that help us manufacture camera modules with the highest quality standards. Performing root cause analysis and solving engineering problems using measurement data, statistical methods, Python, SQL, and other engineering tools. Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to improve product robustness, manufacturability, and production yields. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR? We're looking for someone who is: Curious about how complex products are designed, built, tested, and improved. Interested in optics, imaging systems, precision engineering, manufacturing processes, product validation, and quality improvement. Comfortable working with measurements, technical analysis, and engineering problem-solving. Open to learning new technologies, tools, and methods. Motivated, reliable, and proactive. Enjoy collaborating with engineers from different technical disciplines. Able to work on-site in Čakovec. Comfortable communicating in English on a daily basis. A degree in Mechanical Engineering is especially relevant for this role. Graduates from Electrical Engineering, Physics, Mechatronics, Materials Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or similar technical fields are also encouraged to apply. About us FRAMOS is the leading camera module design and manufacturing expert. Founded in Munich, Germany over 40 years ago, FRAMOS has empowered companies worldwide to make drones fly safely, enable robots to see and think, make diagnostics faster and more affordable, boost athletic performance with AI, and countless other innovations. Today, FRAMOS has 160+ employees worldwide, bringing together global expertise to support customers across industries and continents. FRAMOS stands for best-in-class image quality, an open-source approach, and fast, easy integration – helping customers launch products quicker and stay ahead of the competition. With strong expertise in electronics design, optics and optical assembly, camera calibration, image tuning, and software integration, FRAMOS provides off-the-shelf camera modules and customized embedded vision solutions. At our technology campus strategically located in Europe, we combine R&D and manufacturing services under one roof and provide scalable manufacturing capacities for up to millions of pieces. OUR CORE VALUES: PASSION We give our best every day and push ourselves to go the extra mile. INNOVATION We constantly seek new ideas and embrace unconventional solutions. TEAM SPIRIT We support each other, share knowledge, and build trust through feedback. FAIL FORWARD We try new things, learn from failure, and grow with each experience. CUSTOMER 1ST We put our customers at the heart of everything we do.

title: Junior werktuigbouwkundig engineer installatietechniek
description: De toekomst vraagt om koplopers “Als junior werktuigbouwkundig engineer krijg je bij ons de kans om mee te werken aan complexe installatietechnische projecten en jezelf te ontwikkelen in het vak. Je werkt aan bijzondere gebouwen, zoals operatiekamers, laboratoria, onderwijsgebouwen, theaters en monumentale gebouwen. Je krijgt de ruimte om jouw technische kennis in te zetten en te leren van ervaren collega's. Wil jij bijdragen aan duurzame en toekomstbestendige gebouwen? Je hebt de kennis van ruim 24.000 collega's met één druk op de knop binnen handbereik. Binnen de business unit Building Services werken meer dan 100 projectmanagers, consultants en engineers aan installatietechnische projecten van initiatief tot realisatie en nazorg. Je kunt bijvoorbeeld werken aan de transformatie van utiliteitsgebouwen of aan nieuwe gebouwen en specialistische ruimten, zoals operatiekamers, gevangenissen, laboratoria en productielocaties. Duurzaamheid en financiële haalbaarheid zijn daarbij steeds belangrijke aandachtspunten. De kracht van Building Services zit in de multidisciplinaire aanpak. Je werkt samen met engineers, 3D-modelleurs, projectleiders, adviseurs en andere technische specialisten binnen Sweco. De business unit bestaat uit zes teams, verspreid door Nederland. Daardoor kun je voor complexe vraagstukken steeds de juiste expertise verbinden en bijdragen aan oplossingen die niet alleen technisch goed werken, maar ook passen bij het gebouw, de gebruiker en de toekomst. Als junior werktuigbouwkundig engineer werk je vanaf de conceptfase tot en met de inbedrijfstelling mee aan projecten. Je vertaalt schetsen, aanwijzingen, een programma van eisen of functionele specificaties naar een technisch ontwerp voor aanbesteding of uitvoering. Daarbij denk je vanuit jouw vakgebied mee over de technische uitwerking en zoek je naar oplossingen die passen bij de eisen van het gebouw en de gebruikers. Je werkt onder andere samen met 3D-modelleurs en projectleiders en kunt ook aansluiten bij collega's buiten je eigen team of business unit. Naarmate je ervaring opdoet, krijg je meer zicht op de keuzes die gedurende een project worden gemaakt en hoe een ontwerp uiteindelijk wordt gerealiseerd. Ervaren collega's ondersteunen je daarbij inhoudelijk, zodat je jouw kennis van werktuigbouwkundige installaties verder kunt verdiepen en steeds zelfstandiger aan projecten kunt bijdragen. De uitdaging ligt in het vertalen van technische uitgangspunten naar een goed onderbouwd en uitvoerbaar ontwerp. Bij Sweco kun je je ontwikkelen in een vakgebied waarin techniek, duurzaamheid en gebouwgebruik samenkomen. Door aan verschillende projecten en gebouwtypen te werken, ontdek je welke onderwerpen binnen de installatietechniek het beste bij je passen. De kennis van collega's binnen Building Services en de bredere organisatie helpt je om je expertise verder uit te bouwen. Je krijgt bovendien de gelegenheid om ervaring op te doen met andere disciplines en zo jouw blik op het ontwerpproces te verbreden. Daarmee ontwikkel je niet alleen je technische kennis, maar ook de vaardigheden die je nodig hebt om later een grotere rol in projecten te vervullen. Spreekt jou dit aan? Reageer dan snel!

description: 1948 yılında temelleri atılan Karadeniz Holding, enerji ve gemi inşa başta olmak üzere geniş bir sektör yelpazesinde inovasyonu ön planda tutarak büyümeyi ekonomik ve çevresel sürdürülebilirlik açısından destekleyen, vizyoner sektör lideridir. 30 farklı milletten 3.000’den fazla çalışanı ile 20’den fazla ülkede faaliyet gösteren, 8.000 MW’tan fazla kurulu güce sahip Grup, 45 Powership™ ve 11 LNG gemisinden oluşan filosuyla 4 kıtada güvenilir ve temiz elektrik üretirken dünya genelinde 10 bini aşkın kişiye istihdam alanı sağlamaktadır. Powership™ filosunu, uluslararası markası Karpowership altında yöneten Karadeniz Holding; Avrupa, Afrika, Amerika ve Asya kıtalarında faaliyet gösterdiği ülkelerin %10-%100 oranındaki elektrik ihtiyacını karşılamaktadır. Powership™, kara elektrik santralleri ve aynı zamanda yüzen LNG altyapısının dahil olduğu yüksek kapasiteli enerji çözümleriyle, Karpowership ülkelere ve şirketlere enerji geçişi süreçlerinde yardımcı olmaktadır. Yalova’da bulunan Bakım Birimi, Mekanik departmanımızda görevlendirilmek üzere; Bakım Planlama Mühendisi aramaktayız. NE BEKLİYORUZ? Tersane genelindeki endüstriyel sistem ve diğer tüm ekipmanların periyodik ve arızi bakım planlarının hazırlanması ve ilgili birimlere raporlanması, Bakım faaliyetleri kapsamında ihtiyaç duyulan malzeme, yedek parça ve teknik hizmetlerin belirlenmesi ve satın alma süreçlerinin takip edilmesi, Makine, ekipman ve demirbaşların periyodik akredite muayeneleri ile elektrik (trafo, jeneratör vb.), asansör ve yangın sistemlerinin planlı bakım, test ve periyodik kontrol süreçlerinin yetkili servisler/kuruluşlar koordinasyonunda planlanması ve yürütülmesi. Akredite test ve muayene kuruluşları ile yetkili servislerin koordinasyonunun sağlanması ve raporların teknik açıdan kontrol edilmesi, 3 aylık periyodik renk kodu uygulamasının planlanması ve takibinin yapılması, Teknik şartname, teknik rapor, bakım planı, prosedür, talimat ve kontrol listelerin hazırlanması ve güncel tutulması, Dış servis ve yüklenicilerin bakım ve onarım faaliyetlerinin teknik olarak takip edilmesi ve yapılan işlerin kontrol edilmesi, Yeni makine ve ekipmanların teknik değerlendirme, satın alma, devreye alma, test ve kabul süreçlerine katkı sağlanması ve bakım gerekliliklerinin belirlenmesi, Ana ekipman ve teknik hizmet alımlarında piyasa araştırması yapılması, teknik tekliflerin değerlendirilmesi ve tedarikçilerin teknik yeterliliklerinin değerlendirilmesi, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 ve ISO 50001 kapsamında ve diğer iç-dış denetimlere hazırlık yapılması, denetimlerde bakım süreçlerinin temsil edilmesi ve uygunsuzluklara yönelik düzeltici faaliyetlerin QDMS üzerinden takip edilmesi ve aksiyon alınması, Bakım faaliyetlerine ilişkin KPI ve performans göstergelerinin takip edilmesi ve yönetime raporlanması. NE SUNUYORUZ? Doğum gününde 1 gün izin hakkı, Kapsamlı Özel Sağlık Sigortası, Mesleki ve kişisel eğitim & gelişim fırsatları, Çalışanlara özel indirim ve kampanyalar Çalışma arkadaşlarımız, adaylarımız ve tüm paydaşlarımızla “Tek Dünya” felsefemiz doğrultusunda başarılarımıza başarı katıyoruz. İlanlarımıza başvuru yapan tüm adaylarımıza ırk, din, dil, cinsiyet gözetmeksizin fırsat eşitliği sağlamayı ilke edinerek; farklılıklarımızla başarılarımızı taçlandırıyoruz.

title: Üretim Takım Üyesi
description: KoçMedical I Bıçakcılar Hakkında Pandeminin en yoğun dönemlerinde yaşanan yoğun bakım solunum cihazı eksikliğine çözüm olarak, Mart 2021’de Sağlık Bakanlığı ile Sanayi ve Teknoloji Bakanlıklarının talepleri doğrultusunda, Nisan 2021’de 100 adet ve Haziran 2021’de 5000 adet ventilatör üretimi sağlanmıştır. Bu kısa sürede gerçekleşen üretim süreci, KoçMedical hikayesinin başlangıcını oluşturmuştur. Koç Topluluğu’nun sağlık teknolojileri alanında faaliyet gösteren Hollanda merkezli şirketi olarak, sağlık alanındaki ihtiyaçlara yenilikçi çözümler sunmak, sağlığa erişimi geniş kitlelere ulaştırmak ve bölgesel bir sağlık teknoloji gücü haline gelmek amacıyla kurulduk. KoçMedical olarak, tek kullanımlık tıbbi sarf malzemeler ve tıbbi cihazlar olmak üzere iki ana ürün grubunda faaliyet göstermekte, medikal cihaz ve sarf malzemelerinin tasarımı ve üretimine odaklanmaktayız. Temmuz 2023’te KoçMedical bünyesine katılan Bıçakcılar Tıbbi Cihazlar Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş., 60 yılı aşkın deneyimiyle tıbbi cihazlar alanında pazar lideridir. Medikal sarf malzemeler kategorisinde kateter ve tüp setlerinde Türkiye’nin lider üreticisi olan Bıçakcılar, ameliyathane ve yoğun bakım ünitelerine yönelik geniş ürün portföyüyle Türkiye’de 150’den fazla bayiye, 1.500’den fazla hastaneye ve dünya genelinde 100’den fazla ülkeye hizmet sunmaktadır. Bünyesinde bulunan akredite Ar-Ge merkezinde ürün geliştirme çalışmalarını sürdürürken aynı zamanda kaliteli ve yenilikçi ürünlerin Türkiye ve yakın coğrafyalar distribütörlüğünü üstlenmektedir. KoçMedical | Bıçakcılar, bu güçlü birleşimle sürdürülebilir büyüme hedefini benimseyerek Avrupa merkezli bir global firma olmayı, sağlık teknolojilerinde ürün yelpazesini genişletmeyi ve ihracat pazarlarını büyüterek sektöre uluslararası düzeyde katkı sağlamayı hedeflemektedir. KoçMedical I Bıçakcılar’ın Sundukları KoçMedical | Bıçakcılar, Fortune Global 500'de yer alan güçlü bir grubun parçası olarak, yenilikçi bir şirket ruhu ve dinamik bir çalışma ortamı sunuyor. Çevik, eğlenceli ve esnek yapısıyla, profesyoneller için hem kurumsal bir düzen hem de yenilikçi bir kariyer yolculuğu vadediyoruz. Eşitlik ve birlik ilkelerini her fırsatta vurgulayarak çalışanlarımızın değerli hissetmesini sağlıyoruz. “Sağlığa yenilik, hayata iyilik katmak” misyonuyla çıktığımız bu yolda kalite ve inovasyonu ön planda tutarak sektörün geleceğini şekillendiren bir vizyonla ilerliyoruz. Bizimle çalışmak, sadece bir iş değil; insanı odağına alan bir ortamda gelişim, öğrenme ve başarıya ulaşma yolculuğudur. Çalışma anlayışımız, bireysel katkıyı desteklemek ve güçlü bir takım ruhu oluşturmak üzerine kuruludur. Şirket içi etkinlikler, sosyal sorumluluk projeleri, takım çalışmaları ve düzenli toplantılar ile hem birlikte öğreniyor hem de büyüyoruz. Çalışanlarımızın fikirlerine değer veriyor ve her seviyede katılımı teşvik ediyoruz. Koç Grubu’nun “Koç’lu Olmak” kültüründen ilham alarak, çalışanlarımıza eşitlik ve değer odaklı bir deneyim sunuyoruz. Onların gelişimlerini desteklemek ve kariyer yolculuklarında ilerlemelerine olanak tanımak için yanlarında oluyoruz. Eğer siz de bu heyecan verici, yenilikçi ve gelişim odaklı ortamda bizimle çalışmak istiyorsanız, Üretim ekibimize katılacak bir Üretim Takım Üyesi arıyoruz. Rol Sorumlulukları Üretim süreçlerinin planlanması, izlenmesi ve iyileştirilmesi, Günlük üretim hedeflerinin gerçekleştirilmesinin sağlanması, Üretim verimliliğini artırmaya yönelik süreç iyileştirme çalışmalarının yürütülmesi, Kalite standartları ve prosedürlerine uygun üretim yapılmasının sağlanması, Üretimde karşılaşılan problemlerin kök neden analizlerinin yapılması ve gerekli çözümlerin üretilmesi Kalite, Ar-Ge, Üretim Teknolojileri, Bakım ve Planlama ekipleriyle koordineli çalışılması, Üretim faaliyetlerinin İş Sağlığı ve Güvenliği kurallarına uygun gerçekleştirilmesi. Aranan Nitelikler Üniversitelerin Mühendislik fakültelerinden, tercihen Makine Mühendisliği bölümünden mezun, Üretim sektöründe, tercihen medikal / tıbbi ürün ve ekipman üretiminde en az 3 yıl deneyimli, Üretim süreçleri ve proses iyileştirme teknikleri bilgisine sahip, Kalite yönetim sistemlerine hakim, tercihen ISO 13485 hakkında bilgi sahibi, Süreç ve kök neden analizi (5 Why, Fishbone vb.) becerisine sahip, Makine performans ölçümü, duruş analizi ve OEE takibi hakkında bilgi sahibi, Teknik resim okuma, ölçüm ekipmanları ve temel ölçüm teknikleri üzerine bilgi sahibi, ERP programları, tercihen SAP kullanabilen, İleri derece İngilizce ve MS Office bilgisine sahip Ayrıca şunlara sahipseniz: Güçlü analitik ve proje yönetimi becerileri, Yenilikçi zihniyet odaklı, Güçlü iletişim ve sunum becerileri, Öğren-öğren-yeniden öğren çevikliği, Değişim için esneklik.

Aradığımız Profil * Makine, Mekatronik, Elektrik-Elektronik veya ilgili teknik bölümlerden mezun, * Üretim tesislerinde bakım alanında güçlü saha tecrübesine sahip, * Mekanik bakım konusunda güçlü teknik bilgiye sahip, * Elektrik, otomasyon, pnömatik ve hidrolik sistemler konusunda arıza ve problemi anlayabilecek teknik yeterliliğe sahip, * Plastik ekstrüzyon, geri dönüşüm veya seri üretim makinelerinde deneyim tercih sebebidir, * Önleyici ve kestirimci bakım sistemleri konusunda bilgi ve tecrübe sahibi, * Bir arıza karşısında yalnızca “ustaya bırakalım” yaklaşımı göstermeyen; problemi teknik olarak anlayabilecek ve doğru çözümü sorgulayabilecek, * Ekibini doğru organize edebilen ve iş takibi güçlü, * Planlama, kayıt ve raporlama disiplinine sahip, * Gerektiğinde sahaya inebilecek ancak esas olarak bakım sistemini ve ekibini doğru yöneterek fabrikanın sürekliliğini sağlayabilecek, * Sorumluluk alan, sonuç odaklı ve üretim kaybını kendi problemi olarak gören bir çalışma anlayışına sahip.

Support preventive and predictive maintenance activities to improve equipment reliability and availability. Monitor, troubleshoot, and support Siemens PLC (Step 7 / TIA Portal) and SCADA systems. Identify improvement opportunities and contribute to the optimization and continuous improvement of electrical and automation systems. Ensure maintenance and breakdown-related documentation is accurately maintained in the maintenance management system. Ensure maintenance activities are carried out in compliance with safety, quality, and maintenance standards. Collaborate with production, maintenance, and engineering teams to ensure the continuity and reliability of manufacturing operations. Participating in Process Safety and HAZOP activities with safety team. Support to improvement of facilities electrical infrastructure. Being responsible for conducting mandatory electrical inspections. What makes you a good fit Bachelor’s degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering is required. 3 to 5 years of maintenance experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment. Hands-on experience in electrical maintenance and industrial automation systems. Practical knowledge and experience with Siemens PLC (Step 7 / TIA Portal) and SCADA systems. Knowledge of troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and preventive/predictive maintenance practices. Experience with packaging, filling, or preparation processes is preferred. Good command of written and spoken English. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. title: Grafik Tasarım Stajyeri
description: BİZ KİMİZ? Kaliteli kahveye ulaşmak herkesin hakkı olmalı dedik ve 2019 yılında hayata geçerek hayalimizi gerçekleştirdik. İlk günden bu yana kahve kültüründe yeni bir model yaratmayı hedefledik. Bunda başarılı da olduk. Yaptığımız doğru yatırımlarla kısa zamanda temelleri sağlam bir büyüme yakaladık. Bugün, Türkiye’nin dört bir yanından şubelerimizle hizmet vermeye ve hızla gelişmeye devam eden tek fiyatlı kahve noktasıyız! Benzersiz fiyat stratejimiz ve yenilikçi hizmet anlayışımızla açıldığımız her noktada çok seviliyoruz. Sektöre öncülük eden uygulamamız “Coffy App”le misafirlerimizin siparişlerini App üzerinden alıyor, lezzetlerimizi hızlıca sunuyoruz. Kaliteli kahvemizi herkese ulaştırabilmek için en yaygın online sipariş kanallarında da varız! Yaratıcı, aktif ve yeniliklere açık ekibimizle kahve kültürünün geleceğini hep birlikte şekillendirmeye devam ediyoruz. Özenle seçilmiş kahve çekirdekleriyle hazırlanan lezzetli içeceklerimizi ve her zaman taptaze, lezzetli tuzlu ve tatlılarımızı özel Coffy hizmet deneyimiyle harmanlayarak misafirlerimize en iyi şekilde sunacak kahve tutkunları arıyoruz. Sen de kahve kültürüne ilgiliysen, işini severek yapan, her gün daha iyisi için keyifle çalışan takımımıza katılmak istiyorsan hemen başvur! ARADIĞIMIZ POZİSYONDA SENİ ÖNE ÇIKARACAK KRİTERLER NELER? Üniversitelerin Grafik Tasarım, Görsel İletişim Tasarımı veya ilgili bölümlerinde lisans öğrenci, Haftanın 3 günü staja devam edebilecek, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects gibi video programlarını iyi derecede kullanabilen, Çekilen fotoğraflarda dekupe ve retouch işlemlerini yapabilecek, Görsel yönü güçlü, iletişim yönü kuvvetli. BU POZİSYONDA NELER YAPILIR? İç ve dış iletişimde kullanılan baskılı ve dijital tüm pazarlama materyallerinin uyarlamalarının yapılmasına destek, Franchisee ihtiyaçları doğrultusunda promosyon ve reklam faaliyetlerinde kullanılacak tüm katalog, broşür, flyer, store banner tasarımlarının hazırlanması, Banner, gif, sosyal medya ileti ve mailing gibi dijital iletişim görsellerinin tasarlanması, Coffy App içerisindeki kampanya ve ürün görsellerinin hazırlanması. COFFY SANA NASIL BİR ÇALIŞMA ORTAMI SUNUYOR? Alacağın sorumluluklarla kendini geliştirme, inisiyatif alma ve çokça öğrenme imkanı, Arkadaşlık bağlarının da güçlü olduğu bir çalışma ortamında takım çalışmasıyla Coffy’de potansiyelini ve güçlü yönlerini keşfetme fırsatı, Rahat, heyecanlı ve eğlenceli bir çalışma ortamı, Çevik takımlarımızla e-ticaretteki yenilikleri uygulama şansı. Coffy ailesine katılmak ister misin? Hadi hemen başvuru yaparak bize CV’ni gönder!

title: Mechanical Engineer - jouwtechniekbaan.nl
description: Als Mechanical Engineer in Zwolle werk je vanuit een modern kantoor in een informele, technisch gedreven omgeving aan innovatieve en duurzame maakindustrieprojecten. Je specificeert en ontwerpt zelfstandig constructies, machines en producten en vertaalt concepten naar volledige engineeringspakketten die geschikt zijn voor realisatie door productie en assemblage. Binnen jouw projecten draag je medeverantwoordelijkheid voor de technische en constructieve uitvoering en lever je de analytische onderbouwing die nodig is om sterkte, functionaliteit en integriteit te garanderen. Je zoekt naar optimale oplossingen op het gebied van maakbaarheid, kosten, sterkte, monteerbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid en voert berekeningen en validaties uit met moderne methoden zoals FEM-analyses. In je dagelijkse werk wissel je zelfstandig werken af met samenwerken in multidisciplinaire teams en onderhoud je projectgericht contact met klanten. We vragen een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur Werktuigbouwkunde of Mechatronica, minimaal twee jaar relevante ervaring en vertrouwdheid met 3D-ontwerpsoftware en analysetools. Je hebt een scherp conceptueel vermogen, technische nieuwsgierigheid en je communiceert gemakkelijk met collega’s en opdrachtgevers in het Nederlands en Engels. Deze rol biedt ruimte om je technische signatuur uit te bouwen binnen hightech en duurzame projecten met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden en ontwikkelmogelijkheden. Functie-inhoud Specificeren en zelfstandig ontwerpen van constructies, machines en producten voor realisatie in productieomgevingen. Opstellen van volledige engineeringspakketten inclusief tekeningen, stuklijsten en montagematerialen voor uitvoerende teams. Uitvoeren van sterkte- en integriteitsanalyses met FEM om functionele eisen en veiligheid te borgen. Zoeken naar oplossingen gericht op maakbaarheid, kostenreductie, monteerbaarheid en lange termijn betrouwbaarheid. Overleggen met klanten en interne teams om technische keuzes en projectafstemming te waarborgen. Functie-eisen Afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in de techniek, bij voorkeur Werktuigbouwkunde of Mechatronica. Minimaal twee jaar aantoonbare ervaring als mechanical engineer of constructeur binnen vergelijkbare projecten. Ervaring met FEM en 3D CAD-software zoals NX, Ansys, SolidWorks of Inventor is gewenst. Sterk conceptueel vermogen en kunde in technisch-constructieve onderbouwing van ontwerpen en berekeningen. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels; kennis van Duits is een pré. Wij bieden Werken aan hightech en duurzame projecten met veel ruimte voor technische innovatie en eigen inbreng. Een informele, vakinhoudelijke werksfeer met enthousiaste en deskundige collega’s om kennis mee te delen. Regie op je loopbaan en toegang tot interne ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en opleidingen binnen de organisatie. Prima faciliteiten voor thuiswerken en een thuiswerkvergoeding voor flexibel werken tussen kantoor en thuis. Aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals 35 vakantiedagen, reiskostenvergoeding, goede pensioenregeling en collectieve zorgverzekering. #Jobster

description: Want to build technology that can help make heavy industry a little greener? At Ammisorb, you won’t just be sitting behind a screen designing concepts. You’ll help build, test and improve the actual hardware behind a new way of recovering ammonia more efficiently. We’re a DTU spinout working on technology that can support smaller, more flexible green ammonia systems, and we’re looking for a Development Engineer who wants real ownership from day one. Your designs will be built. Tested. Challenged. Improved. And ultimately put into the field. About Ammisorb We develop sorption-based technology for separating and recovering ammonia more efficiently. Our Sorption Booster captures ammonia in solid sorbents and releases it in a controlled way for recovery as a concentrated product. It achieves 99% ammonia extraction (vs. <70% for conventional chillers) at below 50 bar. The technology targets lower-pressure ammonia production, helping make smaller and more flexible green ammonia systems possible. Find more info on our webpage: https://www.ammisorb.com/ Role Purpose The Development Engineer will lead the design, development, assembly, integration, and testing of next-generation Sorption Booster systems. The role combines practical engineering work with system development activities, including mechanical and process design, component selection, prototype integration, troubleshooting, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. for assigned subsystems and engineering challenges Support project coordination activities related to prototype development and testing Desired Profile and Competencies MSc or BSc in mechanical SolidWorks / Inventor) and practical engineering design Hands-on experience with mechanical assembly, piping, workshop activities, and experimental systems Experience with prototype or pilot-scale systems is considered an advantage Experience working with safety-critical laboratory setups and pressurized process equipment (e.g. HAZOP/risk assessment, PED, ATEX, hazardous gas handling) is considered an advantage What We Offer Real ownership of core hardware at an early stage – your designs go into the field A close-knit team rooted in DTU’s research environment, supported by advisors Post-Sales Support & Troubleshooting: Provide expert-level post-sales support to resolve complex technical issues in the field, ensuring customer satisfaction and system reliability. What We're Looking For We would expect you to demonstrate: University degree in a relevant engineering discipline, such as Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or Systems Engineering, alongside relevant experience as an Application Engineer, Systems Engineer, Field Application Engineer or similar, preferably within the Defense, aerospace, automotive, or heavy-duty mobile machinery sectors. Direct experience with Danfoss Power Solutions products, especially the PLUS+1® platform, is highly advantageous. Familiarity with military and industrial standards for electronics and software (e.g., MIL-STD-810, MIL-STD-461, ISO 26262, IEC 61508). EU citizenship or legal eligibility to work on Defense-related projects under national security laws. title: Konstruktionsingeniør hos Value Engineering – med plads til faglig fordybelse
description: Hos Value Engineering får du mulighed for at arbejde i dybden med bærende konstruktioner sammen med kolleger, der vægter faglighed og sparring højt. Vi søger en erfaren konstruktionsingeniør, der brænder for sit fag, motiveres af komplekse konstruktionsopgaver og har lyst til at udfordre løsninger og bidrage til den faglige dialog. Konstruktionsingeniør er din titel – rollen skifter med opgaven Hos os er titlen ikke det afgørende. Vi går mere op i at sætte de rette kompetencer til opgaven. På én sag kan du være projektleder, på en anden specialist eller projektmedlem og på en tredje være sagsansvarlig. Rollen afhænger af opgaven, dine kompetencer og interesser. Så hvis du i dag arbejder som projektleder, statiker eller specialist – måske som certificeret statiker – er der plads til at bringe både din erfaring og faglighed i spil i forskellige roller. Value Engineering i praksis Value Engineering er specialiseret inden for bærende konstruktioner. Vores spidskompetence er at analysere og optimere konstruktive løsninger med fokus på bygbarhed og værdi for projektet. Vi arbejder for og sammen med bygherrer, entreprenører, rådgivende ingeniører og arkitekter om bl.a. Value Engineering, designoptimering, granskning, certificering og komplekse specialistopgaver. Dine opgaver kan bl.a. være: Value Engineering og designoptimering af bærende konstruktioner granskning af konstruktioner og løsninger komplekse specialistopgaver certificeringssager i KK2-KK4 samt tredjepartskontrol samarbejde med rådgivere, entreprenører og kolleger indimellem projektering af særligt udfordrende konstruktioner eller konstruktionsafsnit. Opgaverne varierer i både indhold og varighed. Nogle sager strækker sig over få uger, mens andre løber over længere perioder. Hvem søger vi? Du kan være generalist med en bred konstruktionsfaglig profil eller specialist med solid erfaring inden for dit område. Det afgørende er dit faglige niveau, din nysgerrighed og lysten til at bringe din viden i spil på tværs af forskellige opgaver. Vi forestiller os, at du: er uddannet konstruktionsingeniør eller civilingeniør med en stærk faglig baggrund inden for bærende konstruktioner har minimum tre års relevant erfaring – gerne 5-10 år eller mere – men dit faglige niveau betyder mere for os end antallet af år på CV'et har en stærk forståelse for statik og konstruktioners virkemåde og erfaring med beregning, projektering og/eller granskning kan arbejde selvstændigt med en opgave og ved, hvornår det giver mening at inddrage andre kompetencer i huset. Har du lyst til kundekontakt og til at styre egne sager, er der gode muligheder for det. Er du certificeret statiker i KK3/KK4 eller tredjepartskontrol, er det et stort plus – men ikke et krav. Et stærkt fagligt og socialt fællesskab Hos Value Engineering arbejder vi tæt sammen og supplerer hinanden fagligt. Og rammerne er gode: ✔ Attraktiv lønpakke, pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring ✔ Lækre, nyindrettede lokaler i Silkeborg og en sund frokostordning ✔ Massage på kontoret flere gange om måneden ✔ Stor fleksibilitet og mulighed for hjemmearbejde ✔ Faglige og sociale arrangementer ✔ Bordtennis, kolde drikke i køleskabet – og plads til at have det sjovt sammen Interesseret? Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte rekrutteringsansvarlig Trine Sangill fra Human Talent på telefon 2990 0025. I rekrutteringsprocessen har vi kun brug for dit CV. Du søger via nedenstående link, hvor du i forbindelse med upload af dit CV også vil blive bedt om at besvare nogle få supplerende spørgsmål. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende, så søg gerne allerede i dag. Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt, men vi venter selvfølgelig på den rette kandidat. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Your tasks may include: Structural analysis and calculations for modular architectural systems Wind load analysis for temporary and outdoor structures Load calculations for scaffolding-based stages, installations and spatial structures Evaluation of structural stability, stiffness and load-bearing capacity Analysis of connections, nodes, tubes and structural components Supporting the optimisation of material use, dimensions and structural performance Contributing to prototype testing, technical documentation and validation Supporting the structural development of systems that move from early concept to physical implementation You may also contribute to the testing and development of experimental spatial structures created through reuse and upcycling strategies, where existing materials and components are given new architectural applications. Who we are looking for You may be studying or recently graduated in: Structural Engineering Civil Engineering Architectural Engineering Building Engineering or a related field Experience with structural analysis software is an advantage. Knowledge of tools such as Karamba3D, FEM software, RFEM, SAP2000 or similar tools is welcome. We are especially interested in someone who enjoys working between engineering, architecture, product development and experimentation, rather than only following predefined structural solutions. What you will gain This is an unpaid internship , but the role is designed to provide meaningful professional experience and direct involvement in real projects. You will: Work in an interdisciplinary environment together with architects, product designers, business and commercial profiles Contribute to products, installations and structures that are intended to be physically produced and implemented Gain hands-on experience with structural development from concept and calculation to prototyping and real-life testing Work with both permanent and temporary structural applications Gain experience with scaffolding-based structures, modular systems and experimental construction methods Learn about circular design, material reuse and upcycling strategies in architecture and product development Be able to document and use your calculations, analyses and project contributions in your portfolio and future professional applications Have flexibility in organising your working hours and responsibilities The internship can be part-time or full-time , with flexibility for remote work , although occasional collaboration with the team in Copenhagen is very welcome. About mellow designs mellow designs works at the intersection of architecture, product development, temporary structures and circular construction . We develop adaptable spatial systems, installations and architectural products while exploring how existing materials and construction components can be reused, reconfigured and given new applications. Our projects range from modular wall systems and product development to scaffolding-based stages, temporary structures and experimental spatial installations . If you are interested in combining structural engineering with architecture, circular design, product development and real-world experimentation , we would be happy to hear from you. Please send us a short introduction, your CV and, if relevant, examples of previous structural or technical work to tg@mellowdesigns.dk

Vi erbjuder en stimulerande arbetsmiljö där du kommer att få möjlighet att utvecklas och växa inom området. Du kommer att vara del av ett team som stöttar dig och din personliga utveckling. Din profil För att trivas på Saab tror du på en kultur av nyfikenhet, tillit och lagarbete. Det spelar ingen roll om du är i början av din karriär eller är expert inom ditt område, det viktigaste är att du delar vår passion för utveckling och ny spännande teknik! Som en del av vårt team kommer du att få möjlighet att arbeta med de senaste verktygen och teknologierna inom branschen. Våra team är mångsidiga och vi tror på att olika perspektiv och erfarenheter kan bidra till att skapa ännu bättre lösningar. Så oavsett tidigare erfarenhet och arbetsbakgrund är du mer än välkommen att vara med och forma framtidens teknologi. På vårt kontor i Karlskoga erbjuder vi en bred variation av spännande roller inom meka. Oavsett om du är mekanikkonstruktör, mekanikingenjör, verktygskonstruktör, elmekanikkonstruktör eller projektledare inom området finns det möjligheter för dig att växa och utvecklas tillsammans med oss! Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Det du blir en del av Bakom våra innovationer finns alla de som har gjort det möjligt. Modiga pionjärer och kluriga tänkare. Vardagshjältar och kreativa problemlösare. De som delar djup kunskap och de som utforskar nya områden. Och alla däremellan. Här har du chansen att påverka och bidra på ditt unika sätt. Allt från att utveckla kod och bygga imponerande försvars- och säkerhetslösningar till att ta en kaffe med en kollega. Varje bidrag räknas. Vi ger dig möjlighet att anta utmaningar och skapa smarta innovationer. I vår vänliga och tekniksmarta värld finns plats för dig att växa. Vi finns här för att tillsammans skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här. Vad innebär en spontanansökan? Detta är en öppen ansökan för dig som är nyfiken på vår verksamhet i Karlskoga. Om du vill bli en del av vår framtida resa är du varmt välkommen att skicka in en spontanansökan. Genom att göra det visar du att du är öppen för jobbmöjligheter hos oss – och om vi längre fram får in en roll som stämmer överens med din bakgrund och dina intressen, kan vi komma att kontakta dig. Vi vill dock tydliggöra att en spontanansökan inte är detsamma som att söka en tjänst. För att maximera dina möjligheter uppmanar vi dig att visa oss vad som lockar dig mest, genom att aktivt söka de specifika tjänster som du är intresserad av! Du kan alltid dra tillbaka din spontanansökan genom att logga in på din Workday-profil. Läs mer om dina rättigheter och hur du kontaktar Saabs dataskyddsombud här.

You will work across ceramic paste formulation, processing, additive manufacturing, sintering and electrochemical device fabrication , taking materials and processes from laboratory development through to production-scale manufacturing. The role You will be responsible for developing the manufacturing processes underpinning Nernst's next-generation oxygen production technology. This includes: Developing and optimising ceramic paste formulations, including powders, binders, solvents and additives. Developing processes for the fabrication of ceramic reactors by additive manufacturing. Investigating defects, failure modes and variability and developing robust process controls. Working closely with electrochemical engineers to optimise the reactors and production process Scaling laboratory processes towards pilot and commercial manufacturing. Establishing manufacturing specifications, quality-control methods and process windows. Working with external equipment, materials and manufacturing partners where required. Leading technical projects and contributing to Nernst's intellectual property portfolio. You will have significant responsibility and autonomy, working directly with the founding team to develop materials and manufacturing processes that will form the basis of Nernst's commercial products. The role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of ceramics, electrochemistry and advanced manufacturing , with a clear path from fundamental materials development through to commercial-scale production.

title: Ingénieur R&D Thermomécanique H/F
description: Au sein du groupe de recherche Performance Industrielle, vous apporterez votre expertise en modélisation thermomécanique et comportement des matériaux. Vos travaux se concentreront sur la prédiction de durée de vie et l'optimisation de certains composants des installations industrielles. How will you CONTRIBUTE and GROW? L’équipe “Materials Integrity” comprend une quinzaine de collaborateurs dont une des missions principales consiste en la réalisation d’expertises métallurgiques et mécaniques afin d’accroître la compréhension des mécanismes de dégradation de matériaux métalliques et/ou céramiques dans des unités aux conditions opératoires sévères (nature du gaz, pression, température, impuretés). L’équipe travaille ainsi à la fois sur des programmes de compréhension long terme et des expertises court terme en lien avec les entités opérationnelles tant sur des matériaux issus de conditions opératoires conventionnelles que des conditions plus innovantes. Analyse et Modélisation Thermomécanique : Analyse de la flexibilité : Étudier les conséquences de la modulation de la demande client (baisse/augmentation de la consommation de gaz) sur la tenue mécanique des équipements, en s'appuyant sur les retours d'expérience récents et les analyses effectuées. Cette flexibilité peut se traduire par une opération dynamique des équipements. Basé sur ces analyses, participer au développement d'outils industriel d'intégrité : Concevoir et développer des modèles et outils industriels pour évaluer l'impact des changements de paramètres opératoires sur la durée de vie des équipements notamment des parties chaudes des installations de type craqueurs NH3 et unités de vaporéformage. Participer au design des unités par la modélisation de l'interaction thermomécanique entre des matériaux de natures différentes (tubes revêtus et milieu granulaire de type catalyseur). In fine, vous devrez déterminer en collaboration avec l’entité Ingénierie du groupe des valeurs de design pour garantir une opération safe, fiable pendant à minima 10 ans. Restituer les résultats aux différents clients internes (Direction Industrielle, E&C) et participer à la capitalisation des connaissances (notes, mémos). Expertise et Support Opérationnel Piloter des expertises pour identifier les causes racines de défaillances thermomécaniques sur sites industriels Restituer les résultats aux différents clients internes (Direction Industrielle, E&C) et participer à la capitalisation des connaissances (notes, mémos). Innovation Proposer des stratégies de prévention pour concevoir les "assets" du futur. Contribuer au rayonnement scientifique d'Air Liquide et participerez à des projets collaboratifs avec des partenaires académiques. Une forte implication dans la création de propriété industrielle est attendue. Vous serez force de proposition pour proposer et défendre de nouveaux sujets de R&D en lien avec les feuilles de route technologique et d'innovation du groupe Air Liquide. Pour cela, vous mettrez à profit de la R&D votre réseau, pour construire des collaborations et échanges avec des partenaires académiques et industriels (participation au montage et / ou au pilotage de projets collaboratifs et / ou internationaux). Une implication dans la gestion de projet pourra vous être demandée. Aussi, dans ce cadre, vous serez le garant de la bonne réalisation des études et projets qui vous seront confiés par la tenue des objectifs qualité/coûts/délais. Vous pilotez les expertises en coopération avec des laboratoires externes, tout en faisant monter en compétences l’équipe. Par votre implication quotidienne, vous participez à l’amélioration continue de l’équipe et à l’appropriation et la retranscription des exigences en matière de qualité et sécurité. Vous serez accompagné-e- pour votre montée en compétences. Votre expérience dans ce poste pourra vous ouvrir des opportunités d'évolution professionnelle vers d'autres métiers du groupe. Are you a MATCH? Vous êtes titulaire d'un Doctorat (PhD) complété par une première expérience industrielle, ou d'un diplôme d'Ingénieur avec 3 à 6 ans d'expérience significative en milieu industriel. Vous possédez une spécialisation en modélisation thermomécanique, et en analyse comportementale des matériaux sous contraintes thermiques (fatigue, fluage, rupture) et du calcul par éléments finis (FEA). Outils : Une excellente maîtrise du logiciel Abaqus est un atout majeur pour être rapidement opérationnel. Une grande agilité sur des logiciels équivalents (ANSYS) couplée à une forte capacité d'apprentissage est également acceptée. La maîtrise de Python pour le développement de modèles est attendue. Savoir-être : Vous faites preuve de pragmatisme industriel. Doté(e) d'un excellent relationnel, vous savez vulgariser des concepts physiques complexes pour convaincre des décideurs techniques. L'anglais professionnel est indispensable. Informations complémentaires : Possibilité d'aménagement individualisé pour des raisons de santé et/ou handicap: discutons en ! Poste basé aux Loges-en-Josas. title: Head of Manufacturing / Microfabrication, Brain-Computer Interfaces

Bringe unsere Fertigung von den Prototypen hin zu reproduzierbarer Qualität. Du hast Dein Studium oder Deine Promotion in Neuroengineering, Mikrosystemtechnik, Elektrotechnik, Physik, Biomedical Engineering oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen und gehörst zu den Besten Deines Jahrgangs. title: Junior engineer werktuigbouwkunde
description: Toon lef voor een mooiere wereld “"Wil jij jouw technische kennis inzetten voor een onderwerp dat iedereen raakt: water? Schoon water, duurzame energie, CO₂-reductie en klimaatadaptatie komen steeds vaker samen in één vraagstuk. Als junior engineer werktuigbouwkunde krijg je bij ons de ruimte om hierin te leren, mee te denken en samen met ervaren collega’s aan oplossingen te werken die ertoe doen. Je ontwikkelt je technisch én als adviseur, terwijl je bijdraagt aan projecten voor onze klanten en de maatschappij. Ik ben benieuwd welke bijdrage jij wilt leveren. Ik maak graag kennis met j e!" — Jeroen Bakker - teammanager Afvalwater Werken bij Sweco betekent dat je onderdeel wordt van het grootste architecten- en ingenieursnetwerk van Europa. Je hebt de kennis van ruim 24.000 collega's met één druk op de knop binnen handbereik. Binnen de business unit Watertechnologie werk je samen met ongeveer zestig waterprofessionals vanuit De Bilt, Middelburg en Rotterdam. We adviseren en engineeren installaties voor drink-, proces- en afvalwater, oppervlaktewater en infratechniek. Onze opdrachtgevers zijn onder andere drinkwaterbedrijven, waterschappen, gemeenten, provincies, aannemers en industriële partijen. Zo werken we aan drinkwaterinstallaties, rioolwaterzuiveringsinstallaties, gemalen, sluizen, bruggen en industriële waterinstallaties. Daarbij verbinden we water en energie en werken we aan vraagstukken rond energietransitie, assetmanagement en circulaire economie. Juist de combinatie van technische kennis en verschillende disciplines maakt ons interessant: je werkt niet alleen aan elektrotechniek, maar zoekt samen met collega’s naar integrale oplossingen voor de wateropgaven van vandaag en morgen. Daarmee draag je bij aan voorzieningen die voor onze samenleving essentieel zijn. Je kunt bijvoorbeeld bijdragen aan de renovatie van de rioolwaterzuivering in Spijkenisse of de capaciteitsvergroting van de AWZI Almere. Als junior engineer werktuigbouwkunde ondersteun je collega's bij verschillende fasen van een project. Je werkt mee aan ontwerpen en schetsen en leert hoe je programma's van eisen en functionele specificaties opstelt. Ook maak je kennis met technische advisering, begrotingen en planningen. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met ervaren engineers en andere disciplines binnen het projectteam. Naarmate je meer ervaring opdoet, krijg je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid voor onderdelen van een ontwerp. Je leert jouw technische kennis vertalen naar oplossingen die niet alleen op papier kloppen, maar ook uitvoerbaar zijn. Bij Sweco krijg je de ruimte om jouw ontwikkeling samen met collega’s vorm te geven. Via de Sweco Academy, vak- en kennisgroepen en begeleiding binnen projecten bouw je stap voor stap aan je expertise. Je kunt je verder specialiseren in elektrotechniek, procesautomatisering of watertechnologie en doorgroeien richting bijvoorbeeld medior of senior adviseur elektrotechniek of projectleider. Tegelijkertijd werk je samen met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines en business units, waardoor je een brede blik op projecten ontwikkelt. Digitalisering, data en automatisering spelen daarbij een steeds grotere rol. Je kunt flexibel werken vanuit kantoor, thuis of bij de klant en deelnemen aan vakinhoudelijke sessies en activiteiten die verbinding tussen collega’s stimuleren. Omdat je aan verschillende projecten en met verschillende disciplines werkt, ontdek je gaandeweg welke onderwerpen jou het meest aanspreken. Vanuit daar kun je je verder specialiseren en meer verantwoordelijkheid nemen. Zo ontwikkel je je op een manier die past bij jouw ervaring, interesses en ambities. Reageer dan snel!

title: Ingénieur Développement de Produit Aéronautique - Mécanique & Matériaux
description: TerX est un partenaire stratégique spécialisé dans le conseil en ingénierie et la mise à disposition de compétences techniques pour l'industrie. Né du terrain — des ateliers, laboratoires et bureaux d'études — TerX connecte les meilleures expertises aux enjeux concrets des entreprises industrielles, avec rigueur, méthode et une compréhension fine des réalités opérationnelles. Fondée en 2018, l'entreprise compte aujourd'hui 160 collaborateurs et a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 13,5 millions d'euros en 2025, confirmant sa trajectoire de croissance et la confiance de ses clients industriels. Mission : Mobiliser les meilleures compétences pour répondre aux enjeux concrets des entreprises industrielles. Vision : Contribuer à une industrie française et européenne plus autonome, plus exigeante et créatrice de valeur durable. Le poste : Objectif : Développer et qualifier un produit mécanique critique destiné à un environnement aéronautique exigeant, en intégrant de fortes contraintes matériaux et vibratoires. Missions clés : Concevoir un produit mécanique conforme au cahier des charges aéronautique : architecture, géométrie, choix matériaux, justification. Intégrer les contraintes typiques du secteur : vibrations rotor, fatigue, sollicitations multi-axes, tenue en environnement sévère. Analyser et modéliser le comportement matériau : rigidité, amortissement, fluage, vieillissement, comportement non-linéaire (élastomères notamment). Rédiger les dossiers : notes de justification, rapports de qualification, échanges techniques client. Assurer les interactions régulières avec l'hélicoptériste + déplacements sur Etrépagny et Essonne. Profil : Ingénieur mécanique confirmé, autonome, avec une forte expertise en matériaux et comportement mécanique (métaux, polymères, élastomères). À l'aise avec les problématiques dynamiques aéronautiques : vibrations, fatigue, amortissement (une expérience directe en aéronautique n'est pas indispensable mais est un vrai plus). Connaissances appréciées : élastomères (formation type Élanova / IFoca). Bon communicant, capable d'échanger avec un donneur d'ordre aéronautique ; anglais professionnel requis. Maturité, capacité à gérer des journées terrain et un relationnel client exigeant.

title: Research And Development Engineer
description: About the Company REEMOON is a global leader in the design, manufacture, and supply of cutting-edge fruit and vegetable sorting, grading, and packing equipment. With a well-established international presence, REEMOON is expanding its operations into the global market, bringing a reputation for technological innovation and excellence in agricultural automation. About the Role This is a full-time role for a Mechanical Design & R&D Engineer at REEMOON. In this position, you will engage in various research and development tasks, being responsible for the mechanical design, development and implementation of automated machinery for the fruit and vegetable industry. You will participate in the development of new products from the initial concept through design, prototyping, testing and validation, working closely with the automation and engineering teams in Italy, Spain and China. Responsibilities • Develop and optimize automated machinery and mechanical systems for a variety of projects in the Europe fruit and vegetable industry. • Lead mechanical development projects from the initial concept, taking responsibility for the design, development and technical implementation of new products. • Create 3D models, assemblies and manufacturing drawings using SolidWorks . title: PhD position: Multi-scale Modelling and Experimental Assessment of Volumetrically Prestressed Concrete
company: EPFL CED Centre d'Employabilité et de Développement / Employability and Development Center
description: Empa 100% Académique: Doctorant Suisse Description Facebook Twitter LinkedIn Materials science and technology are our passion. With our cutting-edge research, Empa's around 1,100 employees make essential contributions to the well-being of society for a future worth living. Empa is a research institution of the ETH Domain. Smart and Sustainable Resilient Performance-based Cementitious Composites for Adaptive Strengthening and Repair System (SURPASS) is an EU Horizon Research and Innovation project (2027-2031) which aims to develop adaptive strengthening and repair strategies for ageing infrastructure in aggressive environments. The project endeavours to develop intervention procedures that can help reduce maintenance costs and increase circularity over the life cycle of a structure. The SURPASS solutions combine eco-efficient UHPFRC containing CO2-negative SCMs, bio-based self-healing, hybrid fiber architecture, Fe-SMA-based self-prestressing, and integrated structural health monitoring into one coherent system for thin, durable structural interventions. It can be deployed through conventional casting for standard applications and through 3D printing for complex or non-planar geometries. In parallel, circular end-of-life strategies will recover fibres, upcycle fines into new low-carbon constituents, and enable structural reuse. The project comprises 11 partners across the globe, including partners from Europe, Canada and Japan PhD position: Multi-scale Modelling and Experimental Assessment of Volumetrically Prestressed Concrete Your tasks The tasks of the PhD at ETHZ and Empa within the framework of SURPASS are as follows: Volumetric prestressing of cast and 3D-printable SURPASS overlays using Fe-SMA fibres. Meso-scale finite element modelling of volumetric prestressing mechanisms with Fe-SMA fibres, including activation, recovery stress, prestress transfer, and reactivation. Structural-scale simulation of SURPASS overlays in strengthened members, including parametric finite element analyses for surrogate-model development and digital-twin support. Large-scale experimental assessment of volumetrically prestressed SURPASS overlays for non-planar structures, including representative applications such as tunnel linings, arch intrados, and curved bridge soffits. Your profile The candidate should have a Master's degree in Structural Engineering (or related engineering) with a strong back-ground in nonlinear finite element modeling, structural mechanics, and concrete structures. Experience or interest in 3D concrete printing is also important. Additional skills, including experience in small and large-scale experimental investigations and knowledge of shape memory alloys, would be an advantage. A strong desire and motivation to find cutting-edge and innovative solutions in the field of structural engineering are essential. Excellent knowledge of English (oral and written) is mandatory. Knowledge of German would be an advantage. Our offer We offer a multifaceted, challenging, and fully funded Ph.D. position for 48 months in a modern research environment with excellent infrastructure supported by regular supervision. The thesis director of the PhD student will be Prof. Dr. Eleni Chatzi, who heads the Chair of Structural Mechanics and Monitoring at ETH Zurich. The candidate will be based at Empa Dübendorf, where the day-to-day research will be supervised by Prof. Dr. Moslem Shahverdi and Dr. Saim Raza. The position is available as soon as possible but should be filled by no later than 1 March 2027. We look forward to receiving your complete online application including a letter of motivation, CV, certificates, diplomas and contact details of two reference persons. Please submit these exclusively via our job portal. Applications by e-mail and by post will not be considered. description: RÜZGÂR TÜRBİNİ MEKANİK TEKNİSYENİ ARIYORUZ | KURULUM & MCE MYWIND ENERJİ olarak Türkiye genelinde ve yurt dışında rüzgâr türbinlerinde servis, bakım, kurulum ve ana komponent değişimi (Major Component Exchange – MCE) hizmetleri sunuyoruz. Ekibimizde tam zamanlı görev alacak deneyimli Rüzgâr Türbini Teknisyeni arıyoruz. Görev ve Sorumluluklar Kurulum ve/veya MCE operasyonlarında gearbox, ana yatak (main bearing), jeneratör ve kanat yatağı (blade bearing) gibi ana komponentlerin mekanik montaj, demontaj, tork ve tensioning (cıvata germe) işlemlerini ilgili prosedürlere ve üretici talimatlarına uygun gerçekleştirmek. Vinç ve kaldırma operasyonlarında rigging, yük bağlama ve yönlendirme çalışmalarını saha ekibi ve vinç firmasıyla koordineli yürütmek. Operasyon öncesinde komponent, ekipman ve takım kontrollerini yapmak. JSA (İş Güvenliği Analizi) ve LOTO (Kilitleme/Etiketleme) uygulamaları dâhil iş sağlığı ve güvenliği prosedürlerine tam uyum sağlamak; emniyetsiz durumları zamanında bildirmek. Yapılan işleri, gerçekleştirilen kontrolleri ve tespit edilen uygunsuzlukları kayıt altına almak; saha raporlamasına ve dokümantasyonuna katkıda bulunmak. Aranan Nitelikler Rüzgâr türbini kurulum (installation) veya MCE operasyonlarında 3 yıl deneyimli olmak. Yurt içi ve yurt dışı seyahat engeli bulunmamak. B sınıfı sürücü belgesine sahip olmak. Teknik dokümanları, montaj talimatlarını ve kontrol listelerini okuyup uygulayabilmek. Saha ekibi, süpervizör ve vinç ekibiyle etkin iletişim ve koordinasyon sağlayabilmek. İngilizce bilgisi tercih sebebidir. Başvuru LinkedIn üzerinden başvurabilir veya özgeçmişinizi hr@mywindenerji.com adresine gönderebilirsiniz. CV'nizde çalıştığınız türbin marka/modellerini ve görev aldığınız kurulum veya MCE operasyonlarını belirtmenizi rica ederiz.

Maintaining and ensuring the functionality of critical codebases and managing shared repositories for knowledge transfer and collaborative development. Additional Required Qualifications A strong background in computational fluid dynamics (CFD) and multi-physics modeling, demonstrated through significant project contributions and publications. Proficiency in scientific programming and code development, with a track record of maintaining and contributing to complex codebases and integrating new features effectively. Excellent oral and written communication skills for presenting research findings at scientific meetings and authoring peer-reviewed publications. Ability to lead and influence across organizational boundaries, facilitating collaborations across multiple disciplines. Experience and interest in mentoring and contributing to talent development within the research group. Interest in expanding research domains to new areas.
