title: Procurement Engineer (Located in Liberia)
description: About Us Avesoro is a leading gold mining company operating in West Africa, committed to maintaining the highest standards of safety, operational excellence, and sustainable business practices. As part of our commitment to ensuring efficient and cost-effective procurement operations, we are seeking an experienced Procurement Engineer to join our team. Key Responsibilities Plan and manage the procurement of spare parts, maintenance and repair materials, equipment, technical consumables, and service purchases for the light vehicle and heavy equipment fleet. Evaluate requests received from site operations from a technical perspective and determine the correct part numbers, brands, alternatives, dimensions, and quality requirements. Conduct supplier research, develop alternative supplier portfolios, obtain quotations, prepare comparison analyses, and support purchasing decisions based on cost, quality, and delivery performance. Monitor pricing, quality, delivery schedules, warranty conditions, and supply risks for critical spare parts, and identify cost improvement opportunities. Coordinate purchase orders, supplier confirmations, delivery tracking, goods receipt, and invoicing processes with relevant departments. Regularly evaluate supplier performance in terms of cost, quality, delivery, and service levels, and conduct supplier and site visits when required. Follow up on return, warranty, replacement, and quality processes related to non-conforming or defective parts and materials. Maintain purchasing reports, price analyses, supplier records, and contract/quotation archives in an organized and up-to-date manner. Execute procurement activities in compliance with occupational health and safety requirements, quality standards, company procedures, and budget objectives. Perform additional duties assigned by management in a timely and professional manner. Qualifications Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering is preferred. Experience Minimum 5 years of experience in light vehicles, heavy-duty vehicles, mobile equipment, automotive spare parts, maintenance and service operations, technical procurement, or supply chain management. Hands-on experience in field operations involving vehicles, equipment, workshops, maintenance, repair, or service activities, with the ability to evaluate spare part requirements based on actual operating conditions and failure causes. Familiarity with technical terminology related to engines, drivetrains, undercarriage systems, brakes, suspension systems, hydraulic and pneumatic systems, electrical components, and technical consumables. Ability to evaluate OEM and alternative spare parts, technical specifications, quality standards, brands, warranty conditions, and service life considerations. Experience in supplier sourcing, quotation collection, price comparison, negotiations, supplier evaluation, and procurement reporting. Experience in inventory management, order tracking, goods receipt processes, lead time monitoring, quality compliance verification, and critical spare parts control. Experience coordinating with maintenance teams, service departments, warehouses, accounting teams, and suppliers. Experience conducting supplier and site visits when required to support procurement activities. Ability to analyze procurement risks and support continuous improvement initiatives related to cost and supply reliability. Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of automotive and heavy equipment spare parts, maintenance materials, procurement processes, supplier management, inventory control, cost analysis, technical documentation, and purchasing best practices. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel. Ability to read technical catalogs and interpret part numbers. Language Skills: Excellent command of French and English communication skills Soft Skills : Strong analytical thinking, negotiation, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills. Detail-oriented, results-driven, and capable of building effective relationships with internal stakeholders and external suppliers. Additional Requirements: Willingness to travel for supplier and site visits as required. Ability to work in a dynamic operational environment while maintaining compliance with company procedures, quality standards, budget objectives, and occupational health and safety requirements.

Beschikken over een afgeronde hbo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting, of gelijkwaardig; Hebben van ervaring met Autodesk Inventor, of bereid zijn dit softwarepakket snel eigen te maken; Beschikken over kennis van, of aantoonbare affiniteit met, Python en automatisering binnen een productieomgeving; Uitstekend beheersen van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk; Enthousiast zijn om samen te werken binnen een klein, hecht en multidisciplinair team. Wat bieden we jou? Wij hanteren Gelijkwaardig Belonen. Vestas Technology & Operations > Blade > Manufacturing The Maintenance department at our Component plant in Lem is seeking an ambitious and technically strong Maintenance Engineer. This role is for someone who is motivated by hands-on problem solving close to production, data-driven maintenance and the opportunity to create measurable improvements on advanced manufacturing equipment. You will play a key role in reducing downtime, strengthening reliability and developing the future of maintenance at Vestas. Responsibilities Analyze downtime patterns, MTTR, MTBF and operational data and translate insights into concrete improvement actions Reduce equipment-related downtime through structured problem solving, root cause analysis and data-driven decisions Drive technical improvements on machines, equipment and maintenance processes together with Production, Process, Quality and global specialists Contributes to the development of more proactive, intelligent and data-driven maintenance using AI-supported analytics and predictive maintenance methods Ensure that EAM master data, spare parts structures and technical documentation are accurate, useful and compliant Engage early in equipment changes, investments or introduction of new equipment to ensure maintainability, safety and reliability are built in from the start Work closely with local and global teams on performance, productivity, standards and continuous improvement Qualifications Technical background within mechanical, electrical, automation, production technology or a related field Experience in maintenance, manufacturing, technical projects or a similar role in an industrial environment Interest in Reliability Engineering, TPM, Asset Management, AI or predictive maintenance. Experience with EAM, spare parts data, technical documentation or equipment structures is an advantag OEM training on key equipment or certification within TPM/Reliability is preferred but not required. Ability to work independently while also creating results through cross-functional collaboration Good communication skills in both Danish and English Competencies Technical expertise: Solid understanding of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic or automated production systems Data and analysis: Ability to use data, trends and performance indicators to prioritize the right improvements Problem solving: Strong ability to diagnose complex issues and drive robust solutions Improvement mindset: Motivated by OEE, uptime, standardization and continuous optimization of maintenance processes Collaboration: Able to connect Maintenance, Production, Process, Quality, Projects and global specialists Adaptability: Comfortable in a dynamic production environment with both daily challenges and long-term improvements Technology curiosity: Interest in AI, digitalization, Industry 4.0 and the future of maintenance What We Offer This is a visible role close to production where your improvements can be measured directly on uptime, OEE and performance. There are opportunities to develop within Reliability Engineering, TPM, Asset Management, data analysis and AI-supported maintenance. We have a strong technical environment with experienced colleagues, local stakeholders and global networks. A collaborative and inclusive work environment where professionalism, ownership and helpfulness are highly valued. You will also have access to advanced production equipment, modern tools and technologies that support your professional development. There will be the opportunity to contribute to Vestas’ work with sustainable energy solutions and the green transition and career opportunities in a global organization with more than 30,000 employees worldwide. Additional Information Your primary work location will be DK, Lem, Smed Hansens Vej 17. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future. title: Metrology Specialist - EHS & Metrology, Centre of Excellence, R&D
description: Help Shape The Future Of Our Calibration Capabilities Would you like to be part of setting the direction for the calibration of our R&D laboratory equipment? And are you passionate about enabling your colleagues across R&D to work with reliable, high-performance equipment? If so, this could be the right opportunity for you. Join us and make a meaningful contribution to ensure that we can test and deliver high-quality products that improve life for end-users with intimate health care needs around the world. You will become part of a team of 12 experienced colleagues who value professionalism, collaboration, and open knowledge sharing. Together, we exchange perspectives, learn from one another, and continuously strengthen the way we work. Join us in building a competence center At our HQ in Humlebæk, you will join the established EHS & Metrology team, which is part of the Test & Analysis organization in the Centre of Excellence within R&D. You will be part of building a competence center in Metrology, Qualification, Compliance, and Safety. We aim high and are looking forward to defining the key objectives and focus areas that will help us work smarter, more efficiently, and with even greater impact. We are looking for a specialist who, in addition to solid technical expertise, also has a strong sense of collaboration and the ability to engage with both colleagues and stakeholders. You are passionate about building a dynamic, knowledge-sharing environment where everyone works in the same direction toward common goals. Your responsibilities will include: Defining calibration requirements while also acting as a key sparring partner for colleagues across the R&D organization. Acting as a subject matter expert for calibration. Writing and reviewing internal calibration instructions and procedures to ensure compliance. Handling and reviewing calibration-related deviations (NCs) and supporting actions. Investigating and evaluating nonconforming calibration events, including trend analysis and root cause analysis (RCA). Handling equipment related change controls and actions. Collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to ensure documentation aligns with Coloplast guidelines and external standards. A structured specialist with quality mindset and technical insight Your strong sense of structure, detail, and quality is essential, as will your ability to work proactively and accurately while managing several deadlines. Just as important are your communication and collaboration skills, which will enable you to engage in meaningful sparring and knowledge-sharing. We imagine that you: Have good technical know-how in terms of equipment, processes and systems. Bring experience with audits, documentation and compliance. Have experience from a similar role, e.g. defining calibration requirements for test equipment and handling quality events. Are fluent in English, both written and spoken. It is an advantage if you speak Danish. Interested ? If you would like to know more about the position, please contact Julie Tanderup, Team manager, EHS & Metrology, Centre of Excellence by mail dkjta@coloplast.com . Please note that due to the summer holiday period, response times in the recruitment process may be slightly longer than usual. Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things. Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability. Visit us on Coloplast.com. Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn. 61771

title: Faglært medarbejder til Mekanikværksted, nathold
description: Radiometer fremstiller medicinsk udstyr, der hjælper læger rundt om i verden med at stille hurtige og præcise diagnoser for kritisk syge patienter. Vores apparater og tilbehør udvikles og fremstilles bl.a. i Brønshøj (København). I hovedkontoret hos Radiometer Medical, Brønshøj, søger vi en faglært medarbejder med indsigt og erfaring i CNC fræse- og drejebænke. Du kommer til at arbejde i Radiometers Mekanikværksted, der producerer emner til Radiometers velkendte blodgas-analyseapparater, som sælges globalt. Det er en unik mulighed for at arbejde i en medicoteknisk virksomhed, hvor videndeling og faglig respekt er med til at gøre det sjovt og meningsfyldt at gå på arbejde. Opslået stilling vil være en del af natholdet. Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling og arbejdstiden ekskl. frokost, er 34 timer per uge. Oplæring kan finde sted på andre skift. Jobbet Dine Primære Arbejdsopgaver Du vil indgå i vores faste nathold. Produktionsforberedelse og klargøring af værktøjer. Opstilling, indkøring og kørsel af produktion på CNC-maskiner og enkelte manuelle håndteret processer Løbende procesovervågning. Ansvarlig for fremstilling af komponenter fra start til slut, inklusiv rapportering i IT-systemer og deltagelse i daglig troubleshooting. Udføre vedligehold af maskiner. Kvalifikationer Uddannelse som maskinarbejder, industritekniker, automatiktekniker, finmekaniker eller lign. Flair og lyst til at arbejde efter GMP og LEAN principper, og med fordel allerede erfaring indenfor produktionsfremstilling til medico industrien. IT-kendskab på brugerniveau, evt. MS Office. Fortrolig med såvel skærende- som måleværktøj. Du kommunikerer godt på dansk, både skriftligt og mundtligt. Engelsk kendskab er en stor fordel. Du brænder for det, du beskæftiger dig med, og kendetegnes ved at være: Stolt af dit fag, og leverer kvalitet. Fleksibel og uformel: trives godt i en forandringsfyldt hverdag. Udadvendt, positiv og imødekommende; kan lide at kommunikere med andre, Ansvarsbevidst, initiativrig og selvdrevet. Du har en ’Can-do’ attitude, dvs. du er ikke bange for at smøge ærmerne op og udføre opgaverne til højeste kvalitet. Du tager fat og får tingene gjort, enkle som komplicerede opgaver. Du er god til at samarbejde og sikre fremdrift. Vi indkalder til samtale løbende Vil du vide mere, er du velkommen til at kontakte Senior Value Stream Manager, Anne Wichmann, Anne.Wichmann@radiometer.dk Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life. For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Systemingenjör inom mekanik
description: Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld. Din roll Vår sektion System Engineering inom mekanik söker en driven och tekniskt kompetent systemingenjör. Som medlem i vårt team kommer du att vara delaktig i hela utvecklingskedjan för mekaniska system och hårdvara, från koncept till färdig produkt samt produktvård. Krav och verifieringsarbete kräver en bred teknisk kompetens då våra produkter spänner över flera teknikområden. Inom sektionen bedrivs teknikutvecklingsprojekt som du kan komma att involveras i. Detta innebär exempelvis förbättringsprojekt avseende förbättrad arbetsmetodik eller projekt kopplade till förstudier av nya produkter, nya material och tillverkningsmetoder. Projekt- eller ärendeledare är också vanligt förekommande arbetsuppgifter. Hos oss får du möjlighet att vara med och utveckla framtidens teknik inom ett dynamiskt och utvecklingsinriktat område. Arbetet är både stimulerande och varierande, och du kommer att ingå i ett team med hög kompetens. Hos oss får du också möjlighet till personlig och professionell utveckling. Din profil Vi söker dig som är en initiativrik och problemlösande person med ett intresse för mekanik. Du trivs i samarbetet med andra, men har även förmågan att självständigt kunna driva arbetsuppgifter på ett strukturerat sätt. Genom att samarbeta över gränsytor med andra funktioner och samtidigt vara lyhörd och nyfiken gör du det möjligt. Koordinering och uppföljning är A och O. Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för komplexa tekniska produkter. Du har högskole- eller civilingenjörsutbildning med inriktning mot maskinteknik eller liknande. Tjänsten passar både dig som nyligen har tagit examen och dig med några års erfarenhet av mekanikkonstruktion och produktutveckling. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av en ledande roll inom tekniska yrken och är van att arbeta i utvecklingsprojekt. Har du tidigare erfarenhet från försvarsindustri eller från Saabs produkter så är det meriterande. Eftersom vi samarbetar med både lokala och internationella leverantörer samt kollegor från olika delar av organisationen, är flytande svenska och engelska en förutsättning för att kunna arbeta effektivt och upprätthålla hög kvalitet i våra processer. Tjänsten innebär även regelbundna kontakter med verksamheter på olika platser inom organisationen, vilket gör att B-körkort är ett krav. Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut. Vad du blir en del av Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.

I vårt jobb utreder, projekterar, samordnar, beräknar, dokumenterar, kontrollerar och besiktar vi tekniska system inom segmenten Fastighet, Industri och Energi. Projekten är bland annat skolor, sjukhus, kontor, industri, forskning och kommersiella fastigheter. Vi jobbar i nära samarbete med övriga teknik-avdelningar i regionen och på WSP i stort. Och vi jobbar även i nära samarbete med övriga installationsavdelningar i regionen och på WSP i stort. Hos oss får du en ansvarsfull och utvecklande roll i ett expansivt företag. Det viktigaste för oss är du! Är du bosatt på annan närliggande ort utgör inget hinder för att söka denna tjänst. WSP finns runt om i Sverige varför placeringsort är flexibel, både vad gäller kontorsplacering och hemarbete. Projekten bedrivs både i team och självständigt. Dina arbetsuppgifter innefattar uppritning och dimensionering av sprinklersystem åt våra kunder. Du ingår i en grupp bestående av andra konstruktörer, projektörer och behöriga ingenjörer inom vattensprinkler där vår ambition är att ska växa och bli en egen grupp inom sprinkler då vi idag ingår i installationsgruppen. Till vardagen hör teknisk problemlösning, tidsuppskatta en arbetsuppgift och rapportera till uppdragsledaren hur du ligger till i arbetet, samt kontakt med kund/entreprenör och beställare. Uppdragen omfattar både ombyggnationer och nybyggnationer. Kvalifikationer Du har erfarenhet av att jobba som sprinklerkonstruktör och behärskar AutoCAD med applikation MagiCAD. Vidare är det ett krav att du behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Om du vill vara med på en spännande resa med oss på WSP där du har möjligheten att verkligen kunna bidra, påverka och i högsta grad vara delaktig – då är denna roll något för dig. Kontakt Har du frågor kring tjänsten eller vill veta mer om WSP som bolag och arbetsgivare kontakta gärna oss. Välkommen till WSP! Joel Näslund, avdelningschef, joel.naslund@wsp.com Sofie Nordin, HR-rekrytering, sofie.nordin@wsp.com Sista ansökningsdag Urval sker löpande men vi vill senast få in din ansökan 2026-01-07 Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan alltså komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. title: Projektingenjör
description: Projektingenjör till Malmö Vill du kombinera teknik, projektering och kundkontakt i en roll där du får vara med från idé till färdig lösning? Hos Walraven Nordic får du arbeta med marknadsledande produkter inom infästnings- och upphängningssystem. Arbetsuppgifter Som projektingenjör ansvarar du för att ta fram tekniska lösningar, ritningar och beräkningar som hjälper kunder att genomföra sina projekt på ett effektivt och säkert sätt. Du arbetar nära både kollegor och kunder och fungerar som länken mellan teknik och affär. Rollen är varierad och innebär att du följer projekten genom hela processen, från förstudie och projektering till färdig installation hos kund. I rollen kommer du bland annat att: Ta fram lösningsförslag, tekniska ritningar och projekteringsunderlag Arbeta med Revit-modellering och tekniska beräkningar Delta i tekniska kundmöten och fungera som specialist tillsammans med säljarna Vara kontaktperson för entreprenörer, konsulter, beställare och installationsföretag Hålla uppstartsmöten och tekniska presentationer för kunder i Norden Vad säger Mattias Roth, Project Engineer Manager, om företaget och rollen? "Jag valde att börja på Walraven eftersom företaget har en familjär kultur där människor står i centrum. Det finns en närhet mellan kollegor, ledning och produktion som gör att man känner sig delaktig och kan påverka verksamheten på riktigt. Det är också ett företag med korta beslutsvägar, starka värderingar och en vilja att utvecklas, vilket tilltalade mig redan från första början. För att trivas i denna roll tror jag att man behöver vara nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och tycka om att samarbeta med andra människor. Det är också viktigt att ta eget ansvar, vara strukturerad och uppskatta kontakten med kunder, kollegor och andra intressenter. Har man ett intresse för teknik och samtidigt vill bidra till att utveckla både människor och verksamheter finns det mycket goda möjligheter att lyckas och trivas hos Walraven." Din profil Vi söker dig som har en teknisk bakgrund och trivs med att arbeta i gränslandet mellan konstruktion, projektering och kunddialog. Du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och tycker om att kombinera tekniskt arbete med att skapa relationer och affärsmöjligheter. Du gillar att ta ansvar, arbetar strukturerat och trivs i en roll där ingen dag är den andra lik. Du har en förmåga att omsätta kunders behov till tekniska lösningar. Vi tror att du har: Utbildning som byggingenjör, maskiningenjör, VVS-ingenjör eller motsvarande Erfarenhet av projektering och tekniska ritningar Goda kunskaper i Revit Erfarenhet från bygg-, installations- eller annan teknisk B2B-verksamhet är meriterande Svenska och engelska i tal och skrift Rollen är hybrid och du utgår från kontoret i Malmö minst 3 dagar per vecka. Övriga dagar finns goda möjligheter att arbeta på distans. Tjänsten innebär ett begränsat resande med cirka 5 övernattningar per år, främst i samband med utbildningar och kundaktiviteter i Norden. Du rapporterar till Project Engineer Manager. Peggie Tran, Business Support Manager, berättar om hur det är att jobba på Walraven. "Att jobba på Walraven är varierande, utvecklande och händelserikt. Eftersom vi är ett relativt litet nordiskt team får man arbeta nära både kollegor och verksamheten, samtidigt som man har många kontaktytor inom den internationella koncernen. Det finns stort utrymme att ta ansvar, komma med idéer och påverka hur vi arbetar. Tempot kan stundtals vara högt, men det gör också arbetet både lärorikt och omväxlande. At ABB, we have the clear goal of driving diversity and inclusion across all dimensions: gender, LGBTQ+, abilities, ethnicity and generations. Together, we are embarking on a journey where each and every one of us, individually and collectively, welcomes and celebrates individual differences. At ABB, you can be sure you are helping to create a better world. Why not take the chance to do this while working in one of the most fascinating technology areas in modern industry – Robotics! ABB Robotics is a leading supplier of industrial robots and robot software, in addition to its equipment, and complete application solutions. We are found in 53 countries and have installed more than 500,000 robots, supported by the broadest service network, and offering in the industry. Now we are offering an exciting master thesis within Mechanical Analysis R&D. Within ABB Robotics R&D, the Mechanical Analysis team configures Manipulators by choosing gears, motors, kinematics and arms and analyzing them with FEM. To do even better we constantly evolve our methods to produce faster, more accurate and better-quality products. All the parts of the manipulator must be dimensioned against the loads occurring during motion and to make the best optimized product we must have control over the input for these calculations. In this project you get the chance to do FEM dimensioning in different ways in our manipulators and get the chance to develop the next step. The goal of this thesis is to help develop and prove new concepts of mechanical dimensioning. With the help of both mechanical analysis team and motion control team we dive deeper into ways to make predictive maintenance easier. The new features might even arrive in next generation of manipulators to provide better and more robust industry robots. Your background Engineering student in Mechanical engineering, Engineering Physics, Engineering Mechanics, Applied and Computational Mathematics or similar profile. Basic knowledge of mechanics, Finite element method and machine elements Fluent English in speaking and writing, English is the corporate language and used for all documentation. Ability to work independently while collaborating with the team. Join ABB and harness the power of our diverse global network, as you collaborate with and learn from our world-class teams. Above all, challenge yourself every day. Let’s write the future, together. title: Senior / Lead Structural Engineer
description: Bilfinger is een toonaangevende internationale leverancier van industriële diensten die efficiëntie en duurzaamheid voor de procesindustrie stimuleert. Met meer dan 31.000 medewerkers en een omzet van meer dan € 5.4 miljard in 2025 bieden we oplossingen op het gebied van consulting, engineering, productie, onderhoud, turnarounds en digitale toepassingen in belangrijke sectoren zoals energie, chemie, farmacie en olie & gas. Bilfinger België en Nederland levert geïntegreerde industriële diensten, waarbij we klanten ondersteunen gedurende de volledige levenscyclus van hun installaties. Dit doen we van engineering en nieuwbouw tot onderhoud, inspectie en renovatie. Dankzij onze multidisciplinaire aanpak bieden we alles onder één dak, wat kosten, tijd en complexiteit vermindert Bij Bilfinger bieden we een fijne omgeving waar je kunt leren en groeien. Doe mee en maak deel uit van een team dat de toekomst vormgeeft! Structural engineer bij Bilfinger Engineering & Consultancy, wat is dat eigenlijk precies? Er wordt wel eens gezegd dat dit gelijk staat aan constructeur zijn, maar eigenlijk is het veel breder dan dat. Het maken van constructieve berekeningen hoort er zeker bij als onderdeel van je werk. Dat kan zijn een berekening voor een gebouw of een deel van een fabriek, maar het kan ook een klein onderdeel zijn als een machinefundering of een leidingsteun. Bij dit alles kom je wat andere krachten tegen dan bij een gewoon gebouw. Denk hierbij aan belastingen door explosies, dynamische belastingen of stresskrachten uit leidingen. Je bent onderdeel van het team dat constructieve ontwerpen maakt voor nieuwe gebouwen of delen van fabrieken, maar vaak ook aanpassingen in bestaande fabrieken. Samenwerken met collega's blijft belangrijk, en je moet op locatie kijken wat wel of niet past. Dit kan een leuke puzzel zijn, waardoor zelfs kleinere opdrachten uitdagend zijn. Daarnaast ben je ook bezig met: Het aansturen van constructeurs en modelleurs en daarin speel je als Lead Engineer een coachende rol. Je bent er om je team te ondersteunen en te begeleiden, zodat iedereen kan groeien en excelleren. Ben je betrokken bij het project van ideefase tot aan oplevering. Ga je opzoek naar informatie over bestaande constructies. Maak je beschrijvingen van ontwerpen. Waar ga je werken? Als Senior/ Lead Engineer binnen Bilfinger Engineering Eindhoven of Elsloo maak je onderdeel uit van de afdeling ASB (Architectural Structural & Buidlings) dat bestaat uit globaal 25 collega's. Je werkt vanuit jouw vakdiscipline aan projecten die zich afspelen in de volle breedte van de industrie. Vandaag werken we aan een nieuwe chemische installatie en morgen weer aan een kantoorgebouw. Afwisseling genoeg dus. Wat heb jij te bieden? Als krachtige gesprekspartner en relatiebouwer win je moeiteloos vertrouwen. Je speelt in op veranderingen zonder kwaliteit te verliezen. Met jouw kennis van streng gereguleerde omgevingen vorm je cruciale besluitvormingsprocessen. Als teamspeler neem je iedereen mee in jouw visie. Je straalt passie uit en inspireert anderen om hetzelfde te doen. Ook ben je de persoon met: Een afgeronde technische HBO- en/of WO opleiding richting Bouwkunde, Civiele Techniek of aanverwant; Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met multidisciplinaire technische projecten; Meerdere kwaliteiten zoals enthousiasme, passie, samenwerken en sparringpartner. Wat bieden we jou? Naast een mooi salaris en een mooi secundair arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket: Een passend thuiswerkbeleid met de mogelijkheid om je werkweek flexibel in te richten. Een organisatie en team waar je jezelf kan zijn en we naar elkaars kwaliteiten kijken. Jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling staat bij ons voorop via het Personal Empowerment Plan. Samen met je manager stel je een persoonlijk ontwikkelingsplan op en krijg je coaching en begeleiding om te groeien binnen of buiten je vakgebied. Door opleidingen en trainingen kun je je zowel persoonlijk als vakinhoudelijk ontwikkelen. Binnen het plan kun je ook je beroepservaringsperiode volgen. Gezond leven: Vitaliteitsprogramma, fietsregeling en fitnessregeling. Tijdelijke acties zoals gratis sportkleding en deelname aan de Ommetje app. Actieve personeelsvereniging: Leuke en inspirerende activiteiten naast het werk. Voor vragen kunt u contact opnemen met Annemarie Rossingh via annemarie.rossingh@bilfinger.com . Wij verwelkomen sollicitaties van alle gekwalificeerde personen, ongeacht geslacht, leeftijd, handicap, etnische afkomst, religie of levensbeschouwing, seksuele identiteit of andere wettelijk beschermde kenmerken. Gebruik voor uw sollicitatie uitsluitend de knop “Nu solliciteren”.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Job Description: Airbus Netherlands B.V. is looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join our Design & Analysis Engineering Team based in Leiden, The Netherlands. Airbus Netherlands makes a vital contribution to the international Space industry in the current operational areas of Solar Arrays, Launcher Structures, and Laser Satellite Communication. In these areas we belong to the world top and seek to achieve the same level with future products and services. Airbus Netherlands designs and builds structures for European launchers serving the commercial and institutional satellite markets. These structures must be lightweight but still capable of carrying the heavy and complex set of applied loads. The combination of our long heritage and continually expanding expertise have equipped us with the capability to meet the ever-developing demands in this field. You will be part of the team that supports the mechanical analysis and verification of our complex structures for the Ariane 6 launcher. Based on Finite Element modeling, the full set of technical requirements of our customer must be satisfied. This is conducted in close collaboration with the Lead and Systems Engineers, our Thermal Engineering team, the Design Office, the Material & Process department, our Assembly & Integration Team as well, of course, fellow mechanical engineers. Meet the team: Our Engineers have the privilege of working on complex products at the forefront of aerospace technology. We welcome those who are interested in joining our team effort to shape the present and future of Airbus Netherlands products. Your challenges: Understand and design lightweight metallic structures, subjected to complex mechanical loading. Finite element modeling and analysis of Airbus Netherlands B.V. Space products, in particular lightweight structures of the Ariane 6 launcher. This shall be performed with FEMAP and NASTRAN. Model and analyze the performance of structural components and assemblies which are optimized in terms of mass, cost and production / assembly requirements while highest safety of the Product is assured using appropriate Design tools. Define, perform and report tests to qualify structures, subcomponents or processes. Liaise with the Design Office, manufacturing engineers and Assembly, Testing and Integration team, and other appropriate Airbus departments to come up with optimum design solutions. Participate and/or provide technical support during Design Reviews. Select materials and processes appropriate to each design element, in close collaboration with our Materials & Processes Engineering Team. Ensure that final design can bear mechanical stresses and satisfies the required stiffness and fracture control requirements. Accept broad objectives with agreed deadlines, but establish the tasks required and how they should be completed. Effective reporting of the engineering work in technical documents that satisfy the needs of the configuration control, design reviews, the treatment of NCR’s during production, enquiries from the customers and act as an efficient spring-board for future developments. Your boarding pass: Masters Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Aeronautical) with a strong curriculum emphasis on structural analysis or lightweight structures. Minimum of 3 years of experience as mechanical engineer, preferably in the aerospace sector. Experience with mechanical design, verification and understanding of lightweight structures is a plus. Minimum of 3 years of experience using finite element method. Minimum of 3 years of experience in using FEMAP and NASTRAN Experience working with ABAQUS. In-depth knowledge of linear and nonlinear mechanics. Experience in mechanical testing, qualification campaigns including reporting. Nice-to-have, experience in ECSS, NASM and ASTM standards Nice-to-have, in-depth knowledge of (aerospace) manufacturing and assembly, integration and testing. Nice-to-have, knowledge of Python and VBA programming. Nice-to-have, knowledge of statistics, machine learning and AI. Nice-to-have, a PhD preferably in structural engineering and design. Nice-to-have, knowledge of MSC Nastran Implicit Non-Linear (SOL 400) Analysis. Nice-to-have, knowledge of CATIA or similar CAD programs. Capable of working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment both independently and collectively. Able to independently solve complex problems, for which they may not know the approach in advance. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, & PowerPoint) required. Nice-to-have, proficiency with Google Suite (GMail, Docs, Sheets, Slides). Team player with a positive & collaborative attitude. Good interpersonal skills, flexibility and adaptability. Demonstrated a high level of problem-solving ability. Must be able to communication effectively in English (verbal and written). Conversational in Dutch is a plus, but not required. Available 1 FTE, preferably starting as soon as possible. Residency in the Netherlands. Providing a VOG (certificate of good behavior) and background screening are part of the procedure. What's in it for you? We offer a challenging job in a dynamic and international working environment, with extensive opportunities for personal development and attractive working conditions such as: Competitive salary including participation PME pension fund 27 holidays + 13 ADV days per year based on full time employment Flexibility in working hours and work location Easily accessible head office near Leiden Central Station Commuting allowance or NS Business card Bicycle plan and company fitness plan Are you ready for this challenge? Upload your application letter and resume via our online application button. Unsolicited services or offers from recruitment agencies or intermediaries will not be responded to. This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. title: Process Development & Integration Engineer
description: Back to Careers Process Development & Integration Engineer We are seeking a Process Development & Integration Engineer to build the manufacturing route for our advanced superconducting interconnects, from first concept to working prototype assemblies. Reporting to our Chief of Engineering, you will work hands-on with specialist providers in flip-chip bonding, bumping, and packaging to establish a reliable prototype process. You will also help us select, install, and operate the in-house equipment that brings this capability home. As the link between our external partners and our quantum, radiofrequency, and mechanical engineers, you will turn system requirements into a practical, fast-moving development plan. About Isentroniq At Isentroniq, we are building the future of computing, not in theory, but in hardware. We enable quantum computing at scale by developing superconducting circuit solutions that increase qubit count by more than 100x at fixed cost and infrastructure size. We share knowledge openly, challenge ideas constructively, and stay focused on what matters. Our values (gritty ambition with humility, radical candor, surgical audacity, and self-accountable teamwork) are at the core of how we work and grow. If you’re passionate about transformative innovation and ready to build the interconnects that make quantum computing at scale possible, join us. Key Responsibilities Define the process and its roadmap. Develop practical process flows, work instructions, and acceptance criteria for prototype builds. Shape a scalable process roadmap as the technology moves from early prototypes toward production-intent hardware. Build the prototype manufacturing route. Work with external partners to develop a rapid path to prototype assemblies, coordinating process trials for cryo-compatible bump bonding with superconducting metal, flip-chip bonding, substrate handling, and related assembly steps. Build productive technical relationships with suppliers, and make sure process learning is captured and retained in-house. Bring process capability in-house. Define requirements for the bonding, metrology and inspection equipment we bring in-house. Support its selection, purchase, commissioning and day-to-day operation. Review prototype results and drive improvements. Assess prototype builds with partners and internal teams, and support inspection, testing and failure analysis where required. Identify issues, resolve them quickly and refine the process with each build. Integrate across engineering teams. Work closely with our quantum, RF and mechanical engineers so that every assembly meets system requirements. Who you are We’re looking for a hands-on process engineer who knows how advanced packaging really gets done: in the cleanroom, at the supplier’s facility, and on the bonder. You have taken assemblies from requirements to working hardware through external partners, and you know how to keep a programme moving when a process misbehaves. You are comfortable with the ambiguity of deep tech and the pace of an early-stage prototype programme, where progress comes through iteration. Key Qualifications Background in advanced packaging or assembly. PhD or relevant Master's degree, with at least 5 years of hands-on experience in semiconductor packaging, microelectronics assembly, MEMS packaging, photonics assembly, or a related field. Hands-on process knowledge in one or more of: flip-chip bonding, solder bumping, die attach, wafer-level processing, or precision alignment. Experience working with external partners. You have run process work with fabrication, bumping, bonding or packaging vendors. Process equipment experience. You have used or specified equipment such as flip-chip bonders, optical inspection tools, profilometers or X-ray systems. Comfortable working hands-on in a lab, cleanroom or supplier facility. Strong communication skills to work effectively across internal engineering teams and external partners. Communication proficiency in English Bonus Experience with Cryo-compatible superconducting interconnects or low-temperature / cryogenic hardware. Familiarity with superconducting, radiofrequency, microwave or quantum-device packaging. Experience setting up a new process line, laboratory capability or equipment suite. Experience with compliant substrates, flex circuits, thin substrates or fragile MEMS devices. Knowledge of process qualification, metrology or failure analysis. Proficiency in French Personal Attributes You are a builder. You are hands-on and not afraid to make things from scratch: process flows, equipment setups, supplier relationships. You are pragmatic. You balance technical quality with the urgency of an early-stage programme. You deliver working prototypes first, rather than chasing perfection on the first attempt. You embody an engineer’s mindset, with meticulous attention to detail, a systematic approach to solving process issues, and a drive for continuous process improvement. You are autonomous and organized, and enjoy driving a development plan across several partners at once. You embody radical candor. You surface problems early, with partners and internally. You welcome having your ideas challenged, and speak openly about both achievements and mistakes. You thrive in an environment of high expectations, turning uncertainty into structured action. What We Offer A unique opportunity to build the process capability of a cutting-edge quantum hardware start-up, from first prototypes to production-intent hardware. The chance to shape Isentroniq’s interconnect manufacturing route and in-house equipment from the ground up. A collaborative, mission-driven culture with a focus on personal and professional growth. Competitive salary and equity package. Job Type Permanent position Location St-Germain-en-Laye (FR) Start Date Now Apply now

title: Engineer Shipbuilding
description: Your Work Context At Jan De Nul Group, we are on the lookout for new talent! We thank our position as a global player to the know-how and innovative ideas of our employees. To stay top of mind, we continuously invest in our fleet. Our Technical Department follows up the construction of new ships from the preliminary design stage. On the other hand, it is responsible for the maintenance and equipment of existing ships. Every maritime project is different and each time the optimal configuration is put together. And if it doesn't exist, we make it ourselves! Your Role As Technical Superintendent Vessel Construction , you will collaborate on the preliminary design, specifications for and follow-up of construction or conversion of a vessel or other large offshore or dredging equipment. Your main duties and responsibilities: Studying and collaborating on the specifications, construction plans and all relevant documents regarding the construction; Help follow up, adjust and approve the design work and technical purchases, both from the shipyard and internally; Help support the design, construction and/or purchase of specific dredging and offshore equipment supplied to the shipyard, or manufactured by JDN; Help follow up the construction and construction supervision and ensure coordination with the shipyard of work and deliveries by JDN; Helping to monitor the testing programme and commissioning of the newly built ship; Helping to equip a ship with the necessary tools and spare parts; For some (sub)projects, these activities are carried out independently and under your own responsibility. You will work from the office in Aalst. Occasionally you will travel abroad to monitor and inspect the work on site. What do you need? You hold a Master's degree in Mechanical/Electromechanical Engineering option Maritime Engineering. You have just graduated or possess a first work experience. You have a thorough basic technical knowledge and a passion for engineering. You have an analytical mind to design, assess and improve systems. You are an organiser and can work efficiently independently. You have strong communication skills and can express yourself fluently in both Dutch and English. Working at Jan De Nul Working at Jan De Nul means contributing to solutions to some of the biggest challenges of our time: from the energy transition to rising sea levels to smart mobility. It means learning and working together every day to preserve the global quality of life for generations to come. What We Offer A permanent training path via our JDN Academy The opportunity to practice sports at work via our FIT programme An open-ended permanent contract Competitive wages with thirteenth month and double holiday pay When you work in Belgium: Meal vouchers and eco-vouchers Possibility to take part in the Flex Reward programme, including bike and car leasing, including fuel card or charge pass in Belgium Employer’s contribution in public transport and bicycle expenses Group and hospital care insurance Optional iPhone with subscription Miscellaneous staff discounts T he world is what you make it Jan De Nul Group shapes water and land around the world, addressing some of the most important challenges of our time. We boost the energy transition with infrastructure for renewable offshore energy. We focus on nature-inclusive dredging solutions to build harbours and protect our coastlines from the rising sea. We develop innovative construction projects for smart mobility and durable buildings. And we invest in planet redevelopment, giving new purpose to polluted sites. At Jan De Nul, the world is what you make it. Jan De Nul Group promotes diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We are an equal opportunities and anti-discrimination employer. title: Propulsion AIT Engineer
description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation. We want you as a highly talented Propulsion AIT Engineer to help us in our mission by leading Assembly, Integration and Test activities on Huracan, our cryogenic engine. This is a hands-on role at the interface between engineering, manufacturing, quality, and test operations. You will help turn propulsion designs into flight-relevant hardware by supporting the build-up and verification of thrust chamber assemblies and complete engines. Key Responsibilities In your capacity as a Propulsion AIT Engineer , your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include: Lead the assembly and acceptance testing of Huracan subcomponents, in particular the thrust chamber assembly Participate in full engine builds, integrating the thrust chamber assembly with the engine structure, fluid components, valves, instrumentation, pumps, piping, and other propulsion subsystems. Develop detailed assembly procedures, work instructions and manufacturing documentation Define tooling, fixtures and ground support equipment required for engine assembly Ensure assemblies comply with cleanliness, contamination control and configuration management requirements Perform leak checks, pressure testing, functional checks, instrumentation checks, and other verification or acceptance activities under approved procedures and relevant safety controls Support hot-firing test campaign preparation, including hardware readiness reviews, tooling and equipment checks, procedure walk-downs, and test article closeout Record build data, inspection results, non-conformities, deviations, rework, and as-built information in the ERP system Help investigate assembly or integration issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions in collaboration with engineering and quality teams Contribute to the continuous improvement of assembly processes, work instructions, tooling, ergonomics, and production readiness Qualifications Young graduate in aerospace engineering, mechanical engineering, or another related field (master's and above preferred), preferably with rocketry experience or individual projects What We Would Love To See From You Experience assembling or integrating mechanical systems in a laboratory, workshop, production, or test environment, ideally related to propulsion, pressure systems, fluidic assemblies, or complex hardware Familiarity with CAD, PLM, ERP, manufacturing execution, or technical documentation systems Understanding with torque-controlled assembly, cleanliness practices, FOD prevention, leak testing, pressure testing, or dimensional inspection Understanding of configuration management, non-conformance management, root-cause analysis, and quality documentation Exposure to manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, welding, additive manufacturing, surface treatments, inspections) and their impact on tolerances and performance is highly valued Rigor and attention to detail are core values in everything we do: you take the time to understand requirements, follow procedures precisely, check your work, and maintain accurate records. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, taking ownership of getting the hardware ready Fluency in English, both written and verbal Experience working with multidisciplinary teams and communicating clearly about hardware status, risks, and constraints A passion for space exploration and the motivation to see propulsion hardware move from drawings to tested engines Why you should join us! What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is: We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge? We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable. All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible. If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

title: Ingegnere Progettista Meccanico
description: Per potenziare la propria struttura, società di ingegneria di Roma incentrata sulla fornitura di consulenze a organizzazioni governative e militari, coprendo tutte le fasi di progetto, dallo studio di fattibilità al collaudo di accettazione, è alla ricerca di un INGEGNERE ENERGETICO O MECCANICO con esperienza nella progettazione di impianti meccanici e termotecnici, maturata presso studi di progettazione. Requisiti: Laurea Magistrale in Ingegneria Energetica o Meccanica con ottimo curriculum studiorum; Almeno 1-2 anni di esperienza in attività di progettazione impiantistica, preferibilmente presso studi di ingegneria o società di progettazione; Esperienza nella progettazione e dimensionamento di impianti meccanici, dalla fase preliminare fino alla progettazione esecutiva; Capacità di lavorare autonomamente nella redazione di elaborati grafici, relazioni tecniche e calcoli di dimensionamento; Software CAD e BIM: Utilizzo di AutoCAD (2D/3D) e, sempre più frequentemente, di Revit o altri software (Edilclima, Primus) per la progettazione integrata; Normativa tecnica: Conoscenza delle linee guida nazionali ed europee sull'efficienza e sulla certificazione energetica; Candidato di seria moralità, responsabile, di assoluta fiducia, con spiccate attitudini al lavoro in team e capacità di relazionarsi con i terzi; Massima flessibilità e disponibilità; Capacità di lavorare per obiettivi, sotto stress ed in tempi ridotti, assertività e proattività; Senso pratico, apertura all’innovazione e creatività; Massima disponibilità a trasferte sul territorio nazionale/estero; Inglese buono. Mansioni Principali: Il ruolo unisce attività analitiche sul campo e lavoro tecnico alla scrivania utilizzando software dedicati Progettazione impianti HVAC: Dimensionamento di sistemi di riscaldamento, ventilazione e condizionamento dell'aria. Energie rinnovabili: Sviluppo di schemi tecnici per impianti fotovoltaici, solari termici, pompe di calore e biomasse. Pratiche edilizie ed energetiche: Redazione di Attestati di Prestazione Energetica (APE) e relazioni tecniche ex Legge 10. Modellazione energetica: Calcolo delle prestazioni termiche dell'involucro degli edifici per ridurne i consumi. Verifica conformità: Controllo del rispetto delle normative vigenti in materia di sicurezza ed efficienza energetica. Seguire lo sviluppo tecnico ed implementazione, interfacciandosi secondo necessità e richieste con fornitori, clienti ed interlocutori interni all’Azienda; Gestire la documentazione tecnica; Altre attività definite dal management. Sede di lavoro: Roma, Gregorio VIII Inquadramento e retribuzione indicativi: contratto di lavoro subordinato a tempo indeterminato, full-time, con adeguato periodo di prova; retribuzione da concordare in base alle capacità ed alle esperienze effettivamente maturate. Si tratta di una boutique di ingegneria snella (circa 10-24 dipendenti), il che garantisce un'esposizione diretta a progetti di altissimo livello e una crescita rapida rispetto alle grandi multinazionali. È possibile candidarsi immediatamente alla posizione RIF IEP inviando il proprio curriculum vitae a consulting@clementinasaturno.com La selezione rispetta il principio delle pari opportunità (L. 903/77). Aut. Min. 1314 RS.

title: Spécialiste spécification et analyse d'essais mécaniques et climatiques F/H
description: Chez MBDA, le sens de notre mission est ce qui nous unit : contribuer à la souveraineté des nations et préserver notre sécurité et notre liberté en Europe. Pour y parvenir, la collaboration et la confiance sont essentielles. MBDA doit relever des défis uniques pour répondre aux besoins des forces armées face à de nouvelles menaces. Motivés par les challenges technologiques, nous repoussons les limites de l’innovation, de la science et de la technologie pour développer des solutions au meilleur niveau. Nous encourageons le dépassement de soi dans un environnement unique qui offre des opportunités à chacun d’entre nous. Ensemble, nous sommes fiers du rôle que nous jouons. La Direction Engineering soutient nos programmes dans la conduite des activités d’ingénierie et des essais, met en œuvre les méthodes d’optimisation de notre excellence technique et garantit un service optimal auprès de nos clients. Au sein du Service Synthèse Environnement de EEF (Environmental Engineering and Facilities), votre mission consiste à spécifier les contraintes d'environnement mécanique et climatique applicables aux systèmes et élaborer la logique de qualification en environnement avec les équipes projet. Dans un premier temps, vous serez en charge de travaux sur plusieurs systèmes en cours de développement pour évoluer par la suite vers une prise en charge complète des activités d'ingénierie environnement pour de nouveaux projets. Être Spécialiste spécification et analyse d'essais mécaniques et climatiques chez MBDA, c'est : Établissez des spécifications de contraintes d'environnement mécanique/climatique et thermique et en assurez la cohérence d'ensemble tout au long du développement, Définissez, avec le projet et les Responsables de Maîtrise d'Ouvrage (RMO) des équipements, la logique de qualification en environnement, Rédigez le Plan Général de Qualification en Environnement sol (PGQE), Définissez, avec le projet et les RMO, les essais sol à réaliser, Assurez le suivi et exploitez les essais en environnement réalisés dans les différents laboratoires d'essais, Rédigez les comptes rendus de synthèse des essais sol, Exploitez les essais en vol et rédigez les comptes rendus associés (une participation aux essais en vol pourra éventuellement être demandée), Apportez un soutien technique permanent aux équipes projet, aux RMO et aux équipes d'essais. Diplômé d'une école d'ingénieur généraliste ou équivalent, vous avez des compétences en mécanique (dynamique des structures, statique, aérodynamique) et en thermique. Vous justifiez d'une première expérience (stage inclus) en bureau d'études ou dans les domaines des simulations numériques (mécanique, thermique, aérodynamique) ou des essais. Vous avez également des connaissances en traitement du signal et maîtrisez les logiciels associés. La connaissance du logiciel Dynaworks serait un plus. Compte tenu de l'environnement international de notre société, un bon niveau d'anglais est nécessaire (B2 minimum). Travail sur différents projets Beaucoup d'interactions avec les équipes projets Proximité avec les équipes essais Opportunités de développement et d’évolution Notre rémunération comporte un salaire fixe et des éléments additionnels individuels (une part variable pour nos salariés cadres et une prime d’ancienneté ainsi qu’une prime annuelle pour nos salariés non-cadres) ou collectifs dépendant de la performance et des résultats de l’entreprise (participation, intéressement). De nombreux services/avantages sont également proposés : restaurant d’entreprise, épargne salariale (PEG, PERCOL), protection sociale (mutuelle et prévoyance), comité social et économique, infirmerie et service de santé au travail interne...

title: R&D Mechanical Engineer - HVAC
description: Questa è un’interessante opportunità per entrare a far parte di un prestigioso gruppo multinazionale operante nella progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni di climatizzazione professionale customizzate ed all’avanguardia in termini di standard tecnologico, qualità costruttiva e sostenibilità energetica. title: Fatigue & Damage Tolerance Stress Engineer (F/M)
description: Job Description: Fatigue & Damage Tolerance Stress Engineer As part of Airbus’s ambition to grow a proficient and competitive Engineering organisation, we are launching a Commercial Aircraft Engineering Centre in Poland. This initiative aims to leverage Poland’s talent pool and technological ecosystem, specifically in the field of Propulsion systems and overall structure analysis, while supporting our broader Engineering workload and competitiveness requirements, and reinforcing Airbus’ strategic engagement with Poland. Role Overview Y ou will join the Design Office in charge of the design, integration, and support to our major structural components (eg. pylons and engine mounts, fuselage, wing...) for all our commercial and military programs. The Environment: Presence in Toulouse Saint-Eloi and Saint-Martin (FR), Filton (UK), Getafe (Spain) and Hamburg (Germany) You will gain an end-to-end understanding of the product life cycle, from production support to in-service topics, reinforcing the concrete impact of your work. Multidisciplinary Collaboration: close collaboration with numerous partners (aerodynamics and loads, systems, manufacturing, customer services, etc.). Future Challenges: We are actively involved in defining future components and the decarbonization roadmap. Our mission involves advanced projects and continuous product improvement (recurring cost, weight, ramp-up, operability). In this frame, the engineering domain needs you to improve and develop our products and our dynamic stress structure community ! Key Responsibilities As an Experienced F&DT (Fatigue & Damage Tolerance) Stress Engineer, your main mission is to actively participate in F&DT stress activities for major structural components (e.g. pylons and engine mounts, fuselage, wing...) across all serial programs. 🎯 Main Tasks: Justification and Certification: Actively contribute to F&DT certification and maintenance activities : calculations, Stress Dossiers, SSR (Section Summary Report), IRD (Inspection Requirement Document), etc... Justify design modifications. Sign concessions in support of production. Technical Expertise & Support: Support the team with damage correlation for full-scale fatigue tests, mitigation on complex F&DT calculations. Participate on airworthiness subjects through OCC and, if necessary, present subjects to certification authorities. Support continuous product improvement. Community and Knowledge Capitalization: Be an integral part of the F&DT community within the design office. Be accountable for capitalization of knowledge within your perimeter. Be part of the up-skilling of F&DT community Ensure adherence to processes and contribute to their continuous improvement (feedback based on activity). Develop your signatures rights (DOA / Design Organisation Approval) 📋 Main Deliverables: F&DT certification stress dossiers. Modification Structural Justification. Stress Summary Report Production support (concessions). Capitalization cards and transformation subjects. OCC support. Workload estimation / Budget plan (support). The Ideal Profile: Master's degree in Aeronautical, Mechanical, or Civil Engineering, or a related field. Proven experience in Fatigue and Damage Tolerance (F&DT) Experience within an aeronautical structure environment would be a plus. Fluency in English is required Knowledge of tools such as Nastran, Hypermesh, ISAMI, Abaqus would be a significant advantage. Leadership and good communication and listening skills You demonstrate strong team spirit and are recognized for being dynamic, curious, and proactive. You are results-oriented and driven by technical excellence. title: Structural Engineer - Solar Arrays
company: Zero to One Search | Recruitment Agency
description: Structural Engineer - Solar Arrays Location: Germering, on-site About the hiring company: Dcubed is a fast-growing space engineering company with the mission to make space engineering and exploration easy and accessible. What makes Dcubed special is that each of us is a space explorer at heart. At Dcubed, we enable the future of space missions with high-performance, flight-proven release mechanisms and deployable structures. From cutting-edge Release Actuators to scalable Deployable Solar Arrays and innovative Deployable Antennas, our technologies are designed for user friendliness, availability, and reliability — whether for smallsats in LEO or large missions to Moon, Mars and beyond. About the role Space hardware must survive launch before it can perform its mission. Your analyses and tests will prove that it can. As Structural Engineer - Solar Arrays (f/m/d) , you will verify the structures and mechanisms that enable Dcubed's solar arrays to survive launch and deploy successfully in orbit. Through a combination of advanced simulation, first-principles engineering, and hands-on testing, you will turn ambitious designs into flight-ready hardware. If you enjoy understanding the physics behind complex systems, challenging assumptions, and validating your work through testing, this role is for you. Responsibilities Perform structural analyses of solar arrays, deployable structures, mechanisms, and hold-down and release systems. Develop and validate FEM models for static, dynamic, thermoelastic, buckling, and non-linear analyses. Size composite and metallic structures, bonded joints, bolted interfaces, and inserts, and calculate structural margins of safety. Use analytical calculations and engineering judgement to cross-check simulation results and verify model assumptions. Support the design of lightweight structures and mechanisms capable of surviving launch loads and deploying successfully in orbit. Define and lead structural test campaigns, including vibration, static load, deployment, and thermal testing. Define loads, instrumentation, notching approaches, test predictions, and pass/fail criteria. Participate in test execution, investigate anomalies, correlate models, and support verification closure. Build and test coupons, prototypes, and representative hardware to generate material data and validate analytical models. Prepare structural analyses, test reports, and verification documentation, and support internal and customer reviews. Candidate Requirements Experience & Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related discipline. 3+ years of experience in structural analysis and testing of aerospace, space, or other high-performance structures. Experience taking hardware from analysis through testing and verification. Experience with composite structures, deployable systems, mechanisms, or spacecraft hardware is highly desirable. Technical Skills Strong understanding of structural mechanics, dynamics, vibration, and load-path analysis. Advanced FEM knowledge and strong experience with FEMAP and Nastran NX. Experience with Ansys and LS-Dyna is considered an advantage. Experience performing static, modal, random vibration, transient, buckling, thermoelastic, and non-linear analyses. Experience sizing composite and metallic structures, bolted joints, inserts, and bonded interfaces. Ability to assess structural margins and independently verify simulation results using first-principles calculations. Experience defining and executing structural test campaigns, including instrumentation, notching, and model correlation. Python, MATLAB, or similar tools for engineering calculations and data analysis. Familiarity with ECSS, NASA, or equivalent aerospace structural standards. Personal Attributes Analytical, rigorous, and driven to understand the physics behind the results. Strong sense of ownership from analysis through successful test execution. Hands-on mindset with a willingness to prototype, instrument, and test hardware. Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Effective communicator and team player in a multidisciplinary environment. Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment. Excellent English language skills. Eligibility to work in Germany What we offer We want you to feel welcome and have the best possible tools for your work here at Dcubed. Therefore, we have selected a set of benefits to support your work days and everyday life, today and longer term. Commute: Deutschlandticket Wellbeing: EGYM Wellpass, recovery toolkit ETF-based pension program offering 30-50% company contribution Modern work equipment, based on your role and needs: laptop, phone, headphones, electric desk, wide screens, state-of-the-art workshop equipment Office environment: kitchen and break areas; lunch offering, beverages & snacks at the office; small exercise area, Space Bar Work-life balance & activities: hybrid work arrangements (location and working hours), company events and trips, launch parties Professional development: 70-20-10 thinking, training budget, training library, regular performance reviews Company swag: hoodie, t-shirt, stickers, water bottle, notebook etc. Interested? Apply here: https://dcubed.teamtailor.com/jobs/8434380-structural-engineer-solar-arrays-f-m-d

title: HGenius Long Term Internship Program
description: HGenius 2026 Long Term Internship Program Ready to start your growth journey with us? We would like to welcome you to our long-term internship program HGenius. What is HGenius? HGenius is a unique 9-month internship program designed for 4th year undergraduate or master’s students, where they can experience real business life in an international environment. What’s in it for you? Hands-on work experience in a global automotive company A chance to get to know Korean culture and collaborate in a multicultural workplace Professional and personal development opportunities Exposure to advanced production technologies in the automotive industry A platform to showcase your skills through project assignments What is required to be HGenius? 4th year undergraduate or master’s students from related fields (Engineering, Business Administration, Social Sciences and etc.) Previous internship experience is a plus Ability to attend the program at least 3 days a week (on-site) Strong communication and analytical skills with advanced English proficiency What do we offer to HGenius? Accommodation & transportation support Priority consideration for full-time positions after graduation Competitive intern salary Access to personal development and technical training programs via Hyundai Gelişim Akademisi I n which locations and departments can HGenius work? İzmit Plant: Production (Press, Assembly), Production Operation, Production Support (Maintenance, Facility), Quality, Information & Communication Technologies (ICT), People & Culture, Finance (Cost Accounting, Cost Analysis), Corporate Communication, HSE (Health, Safety and Environment), Part Development, After Sales (Warehouse Management), Business Strategy, Audit İstanbul Office: People & Culture, Domestic Sales, After Sales, Marketing (Marketing & Brand Communication, Product), Field Service (for architecture students) Finance (Corporate Accounting, Tax Accounting), General Affairs, Import Join HGenius and take the first big step in your career journey with Hyundai! Don't forget! The last application date is 18.10.2026! Hyundai Motor Türkiye: Hyundai Motor Türkiye is one of Türkiye’s leading automotive manufacturers. Production at its İzmit plant began on September 20, 1997, making it Hyundai Motor Company’s longest-serving overseas manufacturing facility outside South Korea. HMTR’s İzmit plant has 230,000 capacity annually, while its cumulative production has exceeded 3.3 million units. Employing a total of 2,400 people, HMTR exports vehicles primarily to Europe, as well as to markets in the Middle East and Africa. The company works with a network of 17,600 suppliers. Hyundai Motor Türkiye: Hyundai Motor Türkiye, Türkiye’nin önde gelen otomotiv üreticilerinden biridir. İzmit fabrikasında üretim 20 Eylül 1997 tarihinde başlayan bu tesis Hyundai Motor Company’nin Güney Kore dışındaki en uzun süredir faaliyet gösteren yurt dışı üretim tesisi olma özelliğini taşımaktadır. HMTR’nin İzmit fabrikası yıllık 230.000 adetlik üretim kapasitesine sahipken, toplam üretim miktarı 3,3 milyon adedi aşmıştır. Toplam 2.400 kişiye istihdam sağlayan HMTR; başta Avrupa olmak üzere Orta Doğu ve Afrika pazarlarına araç ihraç etmektedir. Şirket, 17.600 tedarikçiden oluşan bir ağ ile çalışmaktadır.

Gerçek değişime öncülük eden cesur fikirleri benimseyerek kendi yolunuzu aydınlatma gücünü elinize alın. Çünkü bizler, tek bir takım olarak bireysel gücümüzü ortak bir etkiye dönüştürüyor; sınırları aşıyor, zorlukların üstesinden geliyor ve mobilitenin geleceğini inşa ediyoruz. title: Proje Bazlı Stajyer - Scania Gebze Satış ve Servis
description: Doğuş Otomotiv, Türkiye’nin lider otomotiv ithalatçısı ve en büyük otomotiv distribütörlerinden biridir. İş planlarını “beklentilerin üzerinde yaratıcı hizmet” vizyonuyla oluşturan Doğuş Otomotiv, kurumsal stratejisini “müşteri memnuniyeti odaklı çalışma” hedefi üzerine inşa etmektedir. Doğuş Otomotiv, sektöründe Türkiye’nin en ge¬niş marka ve hizmet ağına sahip şirketidir. Binek araç, hafif ticari araç, ağır vasıta, endüstriyel ve deniz motorları, soğutma sistemleri alanlarında, her biri kendi sektörünün lideri konumundaki 18 uluslararası marka ve bağlı 19 ürün grubunun temsilcisi olan Doğuş Otomotiv, bireysel ve kurumsal müşterileri¬ne Volkswagen Binek Araç, Audi, SEAT, CUPRA, Škoda, Bentley, Lamborghini, Porsche, Volkswagen Ticari Araç, Scania, Meiller, Thermo King, Wielton, Novamarine, Aerofoils, MATE.Bike, Riviera, Linssen Yatchs markalarından ve bu markaların 80'in üzerinde modelden oluşan geniş bir ürün portföyü sunmak¬tadır. Doğuş Otomotiv Servis ve Ticaret A.Ş’nin Scania Gebze işyeri'nde görevlendirilmek üzere Proje Bazlı Stajyer (5+5 Ay) ekip arkadaşı arıyoruz. Üniversitelerin Mühendislik, İşletme, İletişim, İktisadi ve İdari Bilimler Fakültesi’nde son sınıf öğrencisi veya mezun, 5 iş günü Gebze'de çalışabilecek, İletişim ve organizasyon becerileri yüksek, Takım çalışmasına yatkın, İyi derecede İngilizce bilen, Microsoft Office programlarını (Word, Excel, Powerpoint) kullanabilen, İş Tanımı: Belirli kriterlere göre raporlama ve arşivleme süreçlerinin yürütülmesi, Satış süreçlerine destek ve takip süreçlerinin yönetilmesi, Marka değerlerini temsil ederek; müşteri memnuniyeti odaklı olunması, Geliştirme önerileri, devam eden ve yeni projelerde aktif rol üstlenilmesi.

title: Makine Mühendisi
description:
Kamu ilanı: B Grubu Memur - TÜRKİYE BELEDİYELER BİRLİĞİ - Makine Mühendisi Alımı
Aranan nitelikler: Lisans düzeyinde eğitim veren fakültelerin makine mühendisliği bölümünden mezun olmak.
Değerlendirme: KPSS, Sözlü Sınav
TÜRKİYE BELEDİYELER BİRLİĞİ BAŞKANLIĞINA İLK DEFA ATANMAK ÜZERE MEMUR ALIM İLANI 

Ankara ili Türkiye Belediyeler Birliği bünyesinde, 657 sayılı Devlet Memurları Kanununa tabi olarak istihdam edilmek üzere; Mahalli İdarelere İlk Defa Atanacaklara Dair Sınav ve Atama Yönetmeliği hükümlerine göre aşağıda unvanı, sınıfı, derecesi, adedi, nitelikleri, KPSS puan türü, KPSS taban puanı ve diğer şartları taşımak kaydıyla belirtilen boş kadroya açıktan atama yoluyla memur alınacaktır. 


 TABLO (https://kariyerkapisi.gov.tr/Ups/Evraklar/TBBTablo17092026.pdf)



 BAŞVURU GENEL VE ÖZEL ŞARTLARI 
Birliğimizin yukarıda belirtilen boş memur kadrosu için yapılacak başvurularda aranan genel ve özel şartlar aşağıdadır. 

 1. BAŞVURU GENEL ŞARTLARI: 
İlan edilen memur kadrosuna atanmak için başvuracak adayların, 657 sayılı Devlet Memurları Kanununun 40 ıncı ve 48 inci maddesinin (A) fıkrasında belirtilen aşağıdaki genel şartlara sahip olmaları gerekmektedir;
a) Türk vatandaşı olmak,
b) Kamu haklarından mahrum bulunmamak,
c) Türk Ceza Kanununun 53 üncü maddesinde belirtilen süreler geçmiş olsa bile; kasten işlenen bir suçtan dolayı bir yıl veya daha fazla süreyle hapis cezasına ya da affa uğramış olsa bile devletin güvenliğine karşı suçlar, Anayasal düzene ve bu düzenin işleyişine karşı suçlar, zimmet, irtikâp, rüşvet, hırsızlık, dolandırıcılık, sahtecilik, güveni kötüye kullanma, hileli iflas, ihaleye fesat karıştırma, edimin ifasına fesat karıştırma, suçtan kaynaklanan malvarlığı değerlerini aklama veya kaçakçılık suçlarından mahkûm olmamak,
d) Erkek adaylar için askerlik durumu itibariyle; askerlikle ilgisi bulunmamak veya askerlik çağına gelmemiş bulunmak ya da askerlik çağına gelmiş ise muvazzaf askerlik hizmetini yapmış yahut ertelenmiş veya yedek sınıfa geçirilmiş olmak,
e) Görevini devamlı yapmasına engel olabilecek akıl hastalığı bulunmamak,
f) İlan edilen kadrolar için aranan diğer başvuru şartlarını taşımak, 

 2. BAŞVURU ÖZEL ŞARTLARI: 
a) İlan edilen unvan için mezun olunan okul itibari ile öğrenim şartlarını taşımak ve bu öğrenimle ilgili olarak 2024 yılı Kamu Personeli Seçme Sınavına (KPSS (B) grubu) girmiş olmak ve alım yapılacak unvanın karşısında belirtilen puan türünden yukarıdaki tabloda belirtilen asgari KPSS puanını almış olmak,

 3. BAŞVURU ESNASINDA ADAYLARDAN İSTENİLEN BELGELER: 
Sınava girmek isteyen adaylar, Birliğimizin www.tbb.gov.tr adresi veya Kariyer Kapısı Platformu üzerinden temin edecekleri başvuru formunu (https://kariyerkapisi.gov.tr/Ups/Evraklar/TBBBasvuruFormu17092026.pdf) doldurup imzalayarak aşağıdaki belgeleri ekleyeceklerdir;

a) Kimlik bilgileri (e-Devlet Kapısı’ndan otomatik olarak aktarılacaktır.)
b) Diploma veya mezuniyet belgesi (e-Devlet Kapısı’ndan otomatik aktarılacaktır, aktarılmaması durumunda noter onaylı mezuniyet belgesi veya e-Devlet Kapısı’ndan alınacak barkotlu mezuniyet belgesinin PDF formatında sisteme yüklenmesi gerekmektedir.)
c) Yurt içindeki veya yurtdışındaki öğretim kurumlarından mezun olup bu ilanda aranılan öğrenim durumuna ilişkin denkliği olan adayın, diploma veya mezuniyet belgesi yerine denklik gösterir pdf formatında noter onaylı belgenin “Denklik Gösterir Belge” alanına yüklemesi gerekmektedir.
d) KPSS Sonuç Belgesi (e-Devlet Kapısı’ndan otomatik aktarılacaktır.)
e) Sınav başvurusu, sistem üzerinde ilgili alanların kaydedilmesi ve e-Devlet Kapısı üzerinden çekilemeyen belgelerin sisteme yüklenmesi suretiyle tamamlanacaktır. Adayların mezuniyet bilgilerinde hata/eksiklik varsa veya mezuniyet bilgileri sistemden gelmediyse başvuru formunda ilgili kutucuğu işaretleyip güncel bilgilerini kendilerinin girmeleri, diploma veya mezuniyet belgelerini (.pdf) ya da (.jpeg) formatında sisteme yüklemeleri gerekmektedir.
f) Milli Savunma Bakanlığının e-Devlet üzerindeki verilerinden gelen askerlik bilgilerinde hata olan erkek adayların, herhangi bir askerlik şubesinden bilgilerini güncelledikten sonra başvuruda bulunmaları gerekmektedir.
