title: QA Engineer
description: About AppNation We build AI-powered mobile apps that reach millions of users worldwide. Since 2021, AppNation has been creating products across AI, productivity, and mobile experiences. Our apps, including Genie, Translate AI, and Arch, have reached 90M+ users globally and ranked among the top apps in 30+ countries. We are a team of builders, designers, and engineers who move fast, take ownership, and create products used by millions. About the Role We're looking for a QA Engineer to join Genie Studio and ensure the quality and reliability of Genie, our AI-powered assistant used by millions worldwide. You’ll own testing end-to-end across iOS, Android, and Web, covering AI-powered experiences, revenue-critical flows, releases, and A/B tests. Working closely with Product and Engineering, you’ll combine hands-on testing, automation, and strong user perspective to catch issues early and help us ship reliable experiences at scale. What You’ll Do Own Testing Across Platforms: Plan and execute functional, exploratory and regression testing for Genie on iOS, Android and Web. Test AI-Powered Experiences: Validate chat flows, streamed responses and model updates, and catch quality issues in non-deterministic outputs that traditional test cases miss. Guard Every Release: Run smoke and regression cycles, validate release candidates, and give a clear go/no-go signal for every build. Test Revenue-Critical Flows: Ensure subscriptions, paywalls, trials, renewals and web checkout work correctly across platforms and pricing configurations. Validate A/B Tests: Verify that experiments are set up correctly, users land in the right variants, and each variant behaves and tracks as expected. Detect, Report and Track Bugs: Write clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira, prioritize them with Product and Engineering, and follow them through to verification. Be Part of the Sprint: Join planning and grooming, review requirements early, surface edge cases and risks, and help define acceptance criteria. Automate & Improve: Build and maintain automated tests for web and mobile, keep test plans and regression suites up to date, and drive practical improvements to our QA process and tooling. What We Look For Experience: 3+ years of hands-on QA in consumer mobile and/or web products, ideally in a fast-paced environment. Mobile & Web Testing: Strong experience testing iOS and Android apps and web applications across devices, OS versions and browsers. Release Ownership: Proven experience running regression cycles and validating releases, including App Store and Google Play release processes (TestFlight, internal testing tracks). Subscription & Payment Testing: Hands-on experience with StoreKit and Google Play Billing sandbox environments and/or web payment flows. Technical Skills: Comfortable with API testing (e.g., Postman), reading device logs, network debugging tools (e.g., Charles, Proxyman), Jira and test management tools. Test Automation: Hands-on experience with Playwright, and with Appium or Selenium. Ownership & Communication: Able to work as the sole QA in a team, set your own priorities, make sound quality judgments without close supervision, and communicate risks clearly to Product and Engineering. User Perspective: You think like an end user and care about delivering reliable experiences to millions of people. Nice to Have Experience testing AI/LLM-based products Familiarity with A/B testing tools and analytics event validation Why AppNation? Build and scale products reaching millions of users globally. Work with talented people in a fast-moving AI-first environment. Take ownership and see your impact directly in the products you build. Grow quickly with opportunities to lead projects and shape technical decisions. Enjoy competitive compensation and benefits, including private health insurance, meal and commute support, relocation support, and flexible working options. Our Hiring Process Application Review → Interview → Technical Assessment → Final Interviews At AppNation, we set ambitious goals and challenge ourselves to build products that reach millions of people. We value curiosity, ownership, and continuous growth. If this role excites you and you're ready to make an impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now—we're excited to meet you.

title: Senior AQA Engineer
description: We are seeking a skilled Senior QA Automation Engineer With 5+ years of experience to join our Gaming Hub team. This role focuses on backend and API testing for player-facing platform services in an iGaming environment. You will design, develop and own automated test solutions that ensure reliable, secure and performant backend systems. Experience in iGaming (or similar real-time/transactional domains) is strongly preferred. Responsibilities Design, develop and maintain automated testing frameworks and scripts focused on backend services and APIs Identify and prioritise test cases for automation (smoke, regression, integration, contract and non-functional) Build and maintain automated API tests, contract tests and integration test suites for microservices and platform components Develop and run performance, load, stress and stability tests; analyse results and drive remediation with engineering teams Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and gating flows; own flakiness reduction and test reliability; and be responsible for test outcome reporting and stakeholder communication Work closely with developers, SREs and product to reproduce, triage and resolve issues; drive observability improvements to aid root-cause analysis Define and maintain test data and environment strategies (sandbox tenants, testing flags, user configuration profiles) Participate in design refinements, feature planning, team ceremonies and product releases Mentor and collaborate with QA peers to raise automation maturity and testing practices Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience Strong experience with automation frameworks and tools for backend/API testing (examples: pytest, Postman/Newman, Cypress, Playwright) Proficient in one or more programming languages used for automation: Python or JavaScript/TypeScript Experience testing RESTful APIs, including contract/schema validation and end-to-end integration testing Familiarity with service virtualisation / mocking tools and containerised test environments; basic knowledge of orchestration (Kubernetes) is a plus Hands-on with CI/CD (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar) and automation integration into pipelines Strong understanding of software testing best practices and methodologies (including test design, flaky test mitigation, CI gating) Knowledge of observability and monitoring tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, New Relic) to validate behaviour in staging/production Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams Excellent problem-solving, analytical and communication skills; fluency in English (written & verbal) Experience designing and executing performance/load tests (k6, JMeter, Locust, or similar) Benefits Private health insurance Company wide social and team building activities Hybrid & Remote work arrangements Flexible working hours Wellbeing day; Training and Development opportunities Logifuture operates across seven countries, with headquarters in Malta and additional offices in the UK (London), Italy (Parma & Lecce), Austria (Innsbruck), Serbia (Kragujevac), Romania (Bucharest) and UAE (Dubai). The majority of our roles listed on our careers page are not restricted by location, giving prospective employees the flexibility to choose any of our offices. Furthermore, we also collaborate with consultants based outside these locations, broadening our talent pool and allowing us to remain agile and competitive in the global market. In addition at Logifuture we embrace equality and diversity. We do not discriminate and our values of delivering results together support this statement. We are determined to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to contribute their unique skills and experiences.

title: Lider Test Mühendisi
description: STM Savunma Teknolojileri Mühendislik ve Ticaret A.Ş. olarak, savunma teknolojilerinin geleceğini şekillendiren projelerde görev alacak; uzmanlığını geliştirmek, sorumluluk alanını büyütmek ve gerçek etki üretmek isteyen profesyonellerle tanışmak istiyoruz. İleri teknoloji projelerinde sorumluluk alabileceğiniz, teknik uzmanlığınızı yönetsel ve kişisel gelişim olanaklarıyla destekleyebileceğiniz bu yolculukta; çalışan gelişimini ve deneyimini merkeze alan yapımız ile sürdürülebilir başarıyı ve sürekli gelişimi esas alan bir kariyer fırsatı sunuyoruz. Bu anlayışla; bilgi ve deneyimini geliştirmek isteyen, katkı sunmaktan heyecan duyan adaylarımızı Kalite, Test ve Süreç Yönetimi Müdürlüğü projelerinde görev almak üzere Lider Test Mühendisi pozisyonunda ekibimizin bir parçası olmaya davet ediyoruz. Bu Rolde Seni Neler Bekliyor? Sistem, alt sistem ve entegrasyon seviyesinde doğrulama ve geçerli kılma faaliyetlerinin planlanması ve yürütülmesi Sistem gereksinimlerinden test senaryoları, test prosedürleri ve kabul kriterlerinin oluşturulması Yazılım, donanım ve sistem seviyesinde fonksiyonel testlerin gerçekleştirilmesi HIL (Hardware In the Loop), SIL (Software In the Loop) ve simülasyon tabanlı test altyapılarının kullanılması ve geliştirilmesine katkı sağlanması Uçuş kontrol sistemleri, görev bilgisayarları, sensörler ve haberleşme alt sistemlerinin doğrulanması Laboratuvar ve saha testlerinde aktif görev alınması Test sonuçlarının analiz edilmesi, hata yönetimi ve doğrulama raporlarının hazırlanması Geliştirme ekipleriyle koordineli çalışarak ürün kalitesinin ve güvenilirliğinin artırılmasına katkı sağlanması MIL-STD-810H standardına uygun çevresel şartlar (titreşim, şok, sıcaklık, nem, yağmurlama vb.) testlerinin planlanması, yürütülmesi, analiz edilmesi ve raporlanması. Kimi Arıyoruz? Elektrik-Elektronik, Bilgisayar, Yazılım, Mekatronik, Havacılık ve Uzay veya ilgili mühendislik bölümlerinden mezun İlgili pozisyonlarda minimum 8 yıl tecrübeli, Sistematik düşünme ve analitik problem çözme yetkinliğine sahip Gereksinim bazlı test yaklaşımı konusunda bilgi sahibi Yazılım ve donanım test süreçlerine ilgi duyan Takım çalışmasına yatkın, sorumluluk sahibi ve öğrenmeye açık Gereksinim yönetimi, gereksinim izlenebilirliği ve konfigürasyon yönetimi süreçleri ile bu süreçlerde kullanılan Jira, Xray, Git, SVN veya benzeri araçlar hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak Test otomasyonu, Python, C++ veya benzeri programlama dillerinden en az birini kullanabiliyor olmak Seyahat engeli bulunmayan. Tercih Sebebi Olabilecek Yetkinlikler Savunma sanayii projelerinde görev almış olmak Tercihen İHA-1 Sertifikasına sahip Haberleşme sistemleri, RF veri linkleri, sensör teknolojileri ve gömülü sistemler konusunda bilgi sahibi olmak İnsansız Hava Araçlarının (İHA) temel çalışma prensipleri, alt sistemleri ve görev konseptleri hakkında bilgi sahibi olmak MIL-STD-810H standardı kapsamında çevresel testler konusunda bilgi veya uygulama deneyimine sahip olmak. #MilliMühendislikteSenVarsın #BuKariyerdeSenVarsın

title: Kalibrasyon Mühendisi
description: Merhaba! Biz; anlam dolu ve çalışmaktan gurur duyduğumuz bir iş yapıyoruz. GÖKBEY’i, HÜRJET’i, KAAN’ı, ANKA-III'ü, GÖKTÜRK-Y'yi ve daha nicelerini üretiyoruz! Birbirimize saygı duyduğumuz, gelişim fırsatlarıyla dolu iş ortamımızda hem kendimizi hem de havacılık ve uzay geleceğini şekillendiriyoruz. Aramıza katılarak, keşif tutkunu ve merak duygunu, gurur ve cesur hamlelerle tamamlayacak; son teknolojiyle alanında öncü ürünler geliştirirken anlam ve gelişim dolu bir geleceğe adım atacaksın. Bitmek tükenmek bilmeyen keşif tutkusu, merak, azim ve cesaretle yüksekleri hedefliyorsan, seninle # GÖZÜMÜZYÜKSEKLERDE! Sen? Elektrik, Elektronik, Makine, Mekatronik veya Fizik Mühendisliklerinden Lisans derecesine sahipsen, İyi derecede İngilizce biliyorsan, (TOEFL IBT 84+, IELTS 6.5+, TOMER 79+, ITEP 4+) ISO/IEC 17025 akreditasyon süreci konusunda bilgi sahibiysen, Ölçüm teknikleri ve bunlara ilişkin ölçüm belirsizliği hesapları konusunda bilgi sahibiysen, MS Office programlarına hakimsen, Ekip çalışmasına uyumluysan, Aşağıdaki konulardan en az bir tanesinde tecrübe sahibiysen, Kuvvet ölçüm cihazları/tezgahları kalibrasyonu, Tork kalibrasyonu, ISO 7500-1, ISO 376 standartlarına göre kalibrasyon, Yük hücresi (load cell) kalibrasyonu, Sıcaklık kalibrasyonu, Sıvı akış ölçer kalibrasyonu, SAE AMS2750 standardına göre kalibrasyon, aradığımız yetenek SENSİN Bize Ne Katacaksın? Metroloji ve Kalibrasyon yönetimi alanında, Kalibrasyon talimatları ve prosedürlerini hazırlayacak, Kalibrasyonun icrası, sertifikasının hazırlanması ve gözden geçirilmesi, kalibrasyon sonuçlarının yorumlanması, cihazın etiketlenmesi ve sisteme işlenmesi sürecinde aktif katılımı olacak, Kalibrasyon sertifikalarının güncelliğini sağlayacak ve ölçüm belirsizliği hesabını gerçekleştirecek, Yerli ve yabancı pek çok müşteri tarafından yapılan denetimlere hazırlanacak / katılacak, Gereken noktalarda eğitim verecek, yatırımlar için teknik komisyonlara dahil olup metrolojik destek verecek, Kalibrasyon taleplerini gözden geçirip değerlendirme yapacak, İlgili bölümlere metrolojik destek verecek, Kalibrasyon sürecinin herhangi bir aşamasında karşılaştığı sorunları çözecek ve gereken iyileştirmeleri yapacak, Revizyon ihtiyacı olan kalibrasyon yönergelerini belirleyip revizyon işlemini yapacak, Kalibrasyonların belirlenen takvim içerisinde ilerlemesini koordine ve kontrol edecek Sorumluluk alanındaki personel ve cihaz kapasite planlamalarını yapacak, Laboratuvar referanslarının dış kalibrasyon ihtiyacını belirleyecek, gereken hizmet alımı sürecini gerçekleştirecek, Kabiliyetimiz dışındaki cihazların kalibrasyonu için dış kalibrasyon hizmet alım sürecini işleterek takip edecek, Ekip içinde çalışıp ekibi yönlendirecek, bu katkılarınla havacılık ve uzay geleceğini şekillendireceksin. Seni Ne Güçlendirir? Kalibrasyon süreçlerinde deneyime sahip olman, İyi ve akıcı bir İngilizce’ye sahip olman, Denetim deneyimine sahip olman, ISO 7500-1, ISO 376 standartlarına ve AMS 2750 standardına göre kalibrasyon deneyimine sahip olman, ISO/IEC 17025 akreditasyon süreci konusunda bilgi sahibi olman, MS Office programlarına hakim olman, Kariyerine Ne Katacağız? title: Senior Design Engineer
description: Shape the Future of Tissue Technology as a Senior Design Engineer Are you ready for the next step in your engineering career? Join a highly skilled team in Karlstad where you will help design market-leading tissue machines used by customers around the world. In this role, you will work closely with colleagues throughout the delivery chain, turning customer needs into tailored technical solutions. You will have the opportunity to develop both your design expertise and your involvement in customer projects while contributing to innovative, sustainable industrial solutions. Your Responsibilities You will create detailed drawings and technical documentation that support purchasing, manufacturing, and assembly of tissue machines. You will collaborate with engineers, project managers, production teams, and pre-assembly functions to deliver high-quality customer solutions. You will contribute to the ongoing development, maintenance, and improvement of products, machine sections, and components. You will translate customer requirements into practical and effective mechanical design solutions. You will support customer projects from design through delivery and occasionally travel when required. Expectations for you You hold a B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Mechanical Engineering and have experience in mechanical design. You have experience and a strong interest in mechanical product development and design engineering. You communicate confidently in written and spoken English. Experience from the paper, tissue, or process industry is considered a strong advantage. Some travel may be required as part of the role. To succeed in this role You enjoy combining technical expertise with a collaborative mindset and take ownership of your work from concept to delivery. Strong communication skills, problem-solving ability, and a structured approach will help you succeed in a role that involves close interaction with colleagues across engineering, production, and project teams. You are comfortable working both independently and as part of a team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve products and processes. We Also Expect You To Align With Valmet’s Leadership Principles, Practical Behaviours That Guide How We Lead, Collaborate, And Succeed Together Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value We offer You will join one of four engineering teams consisting of approximately 60 engineers working on world-leading tissue machine technology. The team combines expertise in mechanical design and technical project management, creating excellent opportunities for professional growth and knowledge sharing. As your experience grows, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of specific machine sections and components, becoming a key technical expert within your area. The role provides close collaboration with production and pre-assembly teams, giving you a valuable end-to-end understanding of the products you help create. At Valmet, you'll work in an international and people-focused environment where innovation, sustainability, and teamwork are at the heart of everything we do. We value continuous learning and offer opportunities for professional development, modern work tools, and a supportive culture where your ideas and contributions matter. Want to know more? Please send your application as soon as possible via the link provided, but no later than October 2nd, 2026. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Lars Gustavsson, Manager Dry End Section, at lars.o.gustavsson@valmet.com. Please note that we do not accept applications via email. We perform background checks and alcohol/drug testing for all employees in Sweden, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace. When everything works together Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. Join the team and lead the way with us! www.valmet.com/careers

description: Syngenia est à la recherche d’un Ingénieur Calcul Structure - ABAQUS H/F sur Bouguenais (44). Missions Vous réalisez des simulations numériques par éléments finis sur des structures métalliques dans le cadre du projet EPR2. Vous développez et exploitez des modèles complexes sous ABAQUS en calcul implicite. Vous modélisez des éléments coques, poutres et connecteurs, en intégrant des comportements non linéaires. Vous gérez les non-linéarités de contact ainsi que les problématiques de grands déplacements et de grandes déformations. Vous pilotez la convergence de calculs fortement non linéaires, notamment en présence de phénomènes de flambement. Vous définissez, réglez et contrôlez les paramètres nécessaires à la robustesse des simulations. Vous gérez et structurez les jeux de données ABAQUS à partir de fichiers texte et de modèles paramétriques. Vous utilisez HYPERMESH pour la définition des géométries et la création des maillages. Vous développez ou exploitez des scripts Python pour la préparation des calculs et l’analyse des résultats. Vous rédigez la documentation technique et les livrables associés en français Profil Vous êtes ingénieur en mécanique des structures avec une spécialisation en simulation numérique par éléments finis. Vous maîtrisez le logiciel ABAQUS, notamment en calcul implicite et en modélisation non linéaire complexe. Vous possédez une première expérience significative, ou plus de 7 ans d’expérience, sur des calculs industriels complexes. Vous avez une bonne connaissance de l’architecture des jeux de données ABAQUS, des mots-clés associés et de la modélisation paramétrique. Vous faites preuve d’une grande rigueur dans la gestion de multiples configurations de calcul et disposez de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles en français. Offre Travailler chez Syngenia ou pour ses partenaires, c’est travailler votre talent et votre expertise.Nous vous offrons la possibilité de travailler sur des projets stimulants dans le monde entier et de conseiller vos clients en fonction de vos connaissances. En collaboration avec vos collègues, vous aurez la chance d’investir dans votre carrière. En outre, vous pouvez compter sur un package salarial attractif en fonction de vos connaissances et de votre expérience. Prenez en main votre carrière et développez votre réseau d’ingénierie, devenez un consultant Syngenia

title: Ingeniero de Simulación de Cálculo Estructural (m/f/d)
description: PARA QUÉ LE BUSCAMOS Desde Rheinmetall Expal Munitions, nos encontramos en búsqueda de nuevos perfiles para nuestro departamento de Simulación. En este puesto, realizarás el análisis de la respuesta mecánica de estructuras bajo cargas extremas, aceleraciones transitorias y fenómenos no lineales. El trabajo consiste en estudiar el comportamiento estructural de los productos de la empresa y el utillaje utilizado en pruebas de ensayo teniendo en cuenta las cargas, la elevada rotación y los problemas asociados a momentos clave de la operativa del producto. Competencias Clave en ANSYS: ANSYS Mechanical / LS-DYNA / Autodyn: Dominio de trabajo de solucionadores explícitos (explicit dynamics) para problemas de choque, impacto, penetración o altas aceleraciones. Modelado de Materiales No Lineales: Manejo de modelos de plasticidad dependiente de la tasa de deformación (ej. Johnson-Cook), criterios de fallo/daño, hiperelasticidad y gran deformación. Contactos Complejos: Configuración de contactos no lineales (fricción, erosión de elementos, autodetección de contacto en malla deformada). Transitorios Térmicos y Termomecánicos: Análisis de acoplamiento térmico-estructural transitorio (gradientes térmicos severos, tensiones térmicas) Para abordar con éxito los casos multifísicos acoplados (FSI o Fluid-Structure Interaction), deseable: Manejo de ANSYS System Coupling / Workbench: Definir interfaces de transferencia de datos (cargas aerodinámicas/presiones > estructura, desplazamientos > malla CFD, campos de temperatura > tensiones térmicas). Estrategias de Acoplamiento: Criterios para determinar cuándo emplear acoplamiento unidireccional (one-way, ej. CFD estacionario/transitorio exportado como carga térmica o de presión a Mechanical) o bidireccional (two-way, transitorio acoplado paso a paso para aeroelasticidad o flutter). Infraestructura HPC: Conocimientos prácticos en configuración de licencias, particionado de malla y paralelización en entornos de supercomputación/clusters para simulación intensiva. Ubicación: Presencialidad en Via de Dublin, Madrid. QUÉ DEBE APORTAR Máster o Grado en Ingeniería Aeronáutica, Mecánica o Industrial Al menos 3 años de experiencia en análisis dinámico no lineal. Inglés B2 Necesario. Deseable C1 ANSYS Mechanical / Autodyn Matlab / Simulink Python Deseable: Simulación estructural avanxada, no lineal y dinámica SpaceClaim/Discovery (preparación y simplificación de geometría) Manejo de código APDL o scripting en Python para automatización de postproceso.

Jobbeskrivning Vi ser potential att växa inom strukturmekanik och söker nu en ny medarbetare till vår beräkningsenhet i Linköping. Som Beräkningsingenjör hos oss får du chansen att arbeta med beräkning mot några av världens ledande industriföretag. Du kommer att bli inblandad i många spännande produktutvecklingsprojekt och ställas inför utmaningar från flera olika branscher. Projekt och uppdrag kan variera i storlek och innehåll samt utföras antingen in-house i våra egna lokaler eller ute på plats hos våra kunder. Fokus är mot tekniska beräkningar inom strukturanalys, både med hjälp av FEM och analytiska metoder. Du kommer få ett personligt ansvar för dina leveranser och möjlighet att driva dina egna projekt framåt. En av anledningarna att våra konsulter trivs så bra är att vi alltid försöker individanpassa rollen som konsult för att stämma med dina förutsättningar. Det betyder att dina möjligheter att vara med och påverka din egen utveckling är stora. Genom täta avstämningar och utvecklingssamtal kommer du och din chef tillsammans sätta såväl långsiktiga som kortsiktiga karriärsmål, som stimulerar just dig, och du sitter själv i förarsätet för din kompetensutveckling. Utöver grymma kollegor, teknisk framkant, kontinuerlig utveckling och stimulerande uppdrag kan vi erbjuda dig mycket mer som Arbetsgivare. Club AFRY är vår personalklubb som arrangerar sociala aktiviteter på och utanför kontoret. Urval sker kontinuerligt så du är välkommen med din ansökan redan idag! Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som vill utvecklas till en hängiven beräkningsingenjör, med stort intresse för teknik i olika former och har ett stort engagemang för hållfasthetsanalyser. Som medarbetare hos oss behöver du snabbt kunna sätta dig in i nya sammanhang och läsa in dig på nya tekniker om så behövs. Som person är du engagerad, ödmjuk och en genuin lagspelare som trivs med att arbeta i team där ni tillsammans uppnår goda resultat. Det är en stor tillgång om du har lätt att skapa goda relationer både med kunder och kollegor. Du är en skicklig kommunikatör och kan enkelt förmedla både dig och dina analysresultat på engelska och svenska, i både tal och skrift. Du har en akademisk utbildningsbakgrund inom hållfasthetslära och vi ser gärna att du har en hög känsla för kvalitet i leveransen och kundvärdet. Det är meriterande om du har en erfarenhet från någon av de vanligaste FE-programvarorna. Ytterligare information Vi söker dig som vill vara en del av AFRYs framgångssaga. Brinner du för teknisk utveckling? Gillar du att samarbeta för att hitta den bästa lösningen? Då kan vi erbjuda dig karriärmöjligheter på en modern arbetsplats med utmanande arbetsuppgifter och spännande projekt världen över. AFRY är rankat som en av Sveriges mest populära arbetsgivare bland ingenjörer. Hos oss är du med och utvecklar innovativa och hållbara lösningar inom infrastruktur, energi och industri. Just nu söker vi marknadens vassaste kompetens som tillsammans med oss vill skapa framtidens samhälle. Vi hoppas också att du kommer lära dig lika mycket av oss som vi kommer göra av dig. Kontaktuppgifter för frågor: Teamledare Kristina Nilsson, kristina.nilsson@afry.com Sektionschef Thommy Nilsson, thommy.nilsson@afry.com På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen

title: Ingénieur(e) calcul en mécanique des structures H/F/D F/H
description: Travaillant au sein de l’équipe « Technology » de l’ingénierie Produit, l’ingénieur(e) calcul pour l’intégrité mécanique devra réaliser des études statiques et dynamiques des composants et assemblages des produits nucléaires, et contribuera au développement des outils et méthodes associés. Les produits nucléaires incluent la turbine à vapeur, les échangeurs thermiques, l’alternateur, les pompes et leurs systèmes auxiliaires. Ce rôle consiste principalement à évaluer l’intégrité mécanique de produits nucléaires (turbine, alternateur, pompes, échangeurs de chaleur, etc.) et à développer des méthodes et outils pour les analyses d’intégrité mécanique statique, dynamique et thermomécanique. Les principales activités sont les suivantes : Réaliser des analyses d’intégrité mécanique par la méthode des éléments finis sur des composants, conformément aux critères de dimensionnement et aux règles et instructions internes. Modéliser des structures complexes à l’aide du logiciel de maillage HyperMesh et effectuer des simulations par éléments finis sous ANSYS. Personnaliser les modèles, automatiser les cas de charge et effectuer des post-traitements avancés à l’aide du langage APDL (Ansys Parametric Design Language). Réaliser des analyses statiques et dynamiques (modales, sismiques, harmoniques, transitoires), ainsi que des études de durée de vie (fatigue, nocivité, propagation de fissures). Effectuer des calculs mécaniques linéaires et non linéaires (non-linéarités de contact, de comportement matériau et de géométrie). Intégrer les exigences des codes (CODAP, EN 13445, ASME, RCC-M) dans les études de dimensionnement des appareils à pression. Prendre en charge les analyses mécaniques dans le cadre de l’exécution des projets et/ou du développement produit. Rédiger les rapports d’analyse d’intégrité mécanique conformément aux exigences qualité et aux plannings définis. Vérifier les calculs et analyses réalisés par d’autres membres de l’équipe. Assurer le suivi technique des activités sous-traitées. Contribuer au développement et à l’harmonisation des outils, processus de calcul et à la capitalisation du savoir-faire. Respecter les règles et instructions EHS propres à l’entreprise. Diplôme d’ingénieur ou doctorat dans le domaine du calcul d’intégrité mécanique. Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans le domaine du calcul mécanique de structures par éléments finis. Excellente maîtrise des outils ANSYS (APDL) et HyperMesh ; la connaissance de CATIA est un atout. Bonne connaissance des codes et standards applicables aux appareils à pression (CODAP, EN 13445, ASME, RCC-M). Connaissance des machines tournantes Capacité à lire, analyser et interpréter des plans de fabrication et des documents d’ingénierie. Aptitude à travailler dans un environnement motivant et exigeant. Leadership et capacité à piloter des activités techniques complexes. Bon relationnel, esprit d’équipe et capacité à représenter le service dans un environnement multidisciplinaire et international. Disponibilité pour des déplacements occasionnels en France ou à l’étranger (principalement en Europe). Bon niveau d’anglais.

VOTRE PROFIL Diplômé·e d'une formation Bac+5 en mécanique, génie civil, structures, calcul scientifique ou équivalent, vous disposez d'une première expérience en calcul de structures dans un environnement industriel, nucléaire, aéronautique, ferroviaire, énergétique ou de construction. title: Structures Analysis Engineer, Launch Vehicle Structure (m/f/d)
description: Mission Brief You will be responsible for the structural analysis of entire assemblies belonging to our rocket’s primary and secondary structures. From trading design concepts to sizing and validating design iterations and examining the impact of manufacturing deviations, you will play an important role in guiding design decisions and pushing performance and reliability of our structures forward. As a Mid-Level Structures Analysis Engineer, you will support the analysis, verification and development of launch vehicle structures throughout the entire lifecycle, from concept to qualification. Your Role in Our Space Mission: Perform detailed stress analysis of aerospace structures and components using both classical hand calculations and advanced finite element methods (FEM), mostly of CFRP structures. Identify failure scenarios and collaborate with design engineers to review and optimize structural designs. Define applicable load cases, addressing the impact of thermal, quasi-static loads (arising from random vibrations) etc. Analise and provide possible solutions to manufacturing non-conformities. Develop test plans and support physical testing of components to verify sizing assumptions and qualify hardware. Prepare comprehensive stress analysis reports and documentation for internal/external use. Improve our standards and toolchain for structural verification. Be familiar with classical design standards and have experience in the use of CAD software Operate independently with moderate guidance. Qualification Checklist Degree in the field of Engineering, Aerospace, Mechanical or (Computational) Mechanics, or any other related field. At least 3 years of experience in analysing aerospace structures. Good knowledge in classical hand-calculations and advanced FE Modelling of aerospace structures (Hypermesh, Optistruct, Nastran etc). Self-motivated, collaborative, and capable of working independently with moderate guidance. Good engineering intuition with regards to load paths and failure mechanisms. Strong teamwork skills to contribute to team goals and support large projects, including interaction with other departments. Fluent English Bonus Skills Practical experience in the space sector (preferably in launch vehicle development program). Previous experience using CAD, preferably with Siemens NX. Good understanding of composite structures’ behaviour over a wide range of temperatures. Practical experience with Material Qualification and composite manufacturing techniques. title: Process Engineer
description: At Materialise Medical, we believe that better healthcare starts with solutions designed around the individual patient. If you’re passionate about bringing personalized care to every patient, you’ll love being a part of this team. Through the technology we develop, researchers, engineers, and clinicians are revolutionizing personalized treatment — helping improve and save lives daily. To further drive & support our Medical Production activities Materialise Medical is looking for a Process Engineer to join the HQ Process Engineering team (Leuven). What You Will Be Doing You will be stepping into a cross-functional agile team which focuses on CMF product development as well as manufacturing process development and implementation. With your strong engineering mindset, you develop thorough expertise in additive manufacturing, post-processing, cleaning and quality inspection technologies, allowing you to become the technical expert and GoTo for both development & operational questions. Next to that, you also gain a solid understanding of CMF product specifics, enabling you to effectively connect product requirements to the corresponding process needs. You take the lead in managing and driving larger process development, implementation and validation projects, ensuring alignment across different teams and timely delivery of results. You are involved early in the development of new or updated devices, assessing manufacturability and process validation needs. In close collaboration with the device development team, you assist in the definition of a clear and comprehensive set of product specifications which will serve as input for the process validation and implementation after design transfer. You own the validation programs for the manufacturing processes and corresponding equipment. You create these validation programs from scratch for new products and processes or update them for each product and process change, after which you execute (or coordinate the execution of) the corresponding equipment validations (IQOQPQ). Where required for process or product changes, you set up, execute and analyze process characterization studies to understand the impact of process parameters on process and product output. You continuously evaluate process performance and identify opportunities to standardize, streamline and automate process steps, contributing to operational excellence and scalability. You drive process development and operational roll-out of various process changes and translate this into operational success by providing the right process documentation, including work instructions, operator training and support. You guarantee compliance with Quality Management System requirements by meticulously documenting all phases of the process characterization, validation and operational implementation per internal quality procedures. As a member of the Process Engineering team, you will enjoy close cooperation with stakeholders from operational, device development, biosafety, research, quality and regulatory teams. Through involvement in a variety of activities and projects, we set up a growth trajectory in which you can shape your own future within Materialise. Your profile You have a master’s degree in engineering You have at least 2 years of experience working in a process (validation) engineering role within highly regulated industries such as the medical devices, pharmaceuticals or aerospace industries. Experience with Design Transfer activities and/or Additive Manufacturing is considered a strong plus You are quality oriented and have an eye for detail, but you also don’t get stuck on this. You are able to think out of the box when needed You are good at troubleshooting and problem solving You have a strong and versatile work ethic and you’re eager to learn You are proactive and self-organized. You take initiative and demonstrate full ownership of your tasks. You value and uphold impeccable coordination Strong English verbal & written skills required Note: A motivation letter is requested when applying for this position. What’s Waiting For You Work that matters The technology we build at Materialise pushes the boundaries. You’ll find pride in building something that matters, whether you designed it, printed it, or shipped it. No matter your role, we unlock new possibilities to build a better and healthier world every day. At Materialise, we expect you to think about the customer, not just the task. You push for better solutions and care about the difference your work makes. A people-centered space When you join Materialise, you join a group of colleagues invested in you, not just your work. From your own team to a department across the world, you’ll find a sense of belonging with people who help without being asked, challenge you, and have your back. At the same time, we expect you to invest in the people around you — not just your own work — to make the group stronger than the sum of its parts. An environment of trust As a company of innovators, we know how crucial autonomy is in your work. When we hire you, we trust in your expertise, giving you space to organize your tasks, work flexibly, and make your own calls. At Materialise, we expect you to deliver on that trust and keep your commitments. A career ready to build When you see opportunities for your career to grow at Materialise, we encourage you to go for them. People shape a fulfilling career at their own pace here. At Materialise, we expect you to take initiative in your own development. Don’t wait for someone else to plan your career. Step into the space and make it count. Make a difference together with the Medical team.

Execute qualification and certification activities for AM hardware in accordance with aerospace requirements and internal quality processes. title: Metal Additive Manufacturing Research Lead
location: San Cristobal de La Laguna, Kanarya Adaları, İspanya
description: ARQUIMEA is a global technology company that develops innovative solutions and products for highly demanding sectors. Our areas of activity include Aerospace, Defense & Security, Big Science, Biotechnology, and Fintech. ARQUIMEA Research Center (ARC) , part of ARQUIMEA , was established in 2019 with the ambition of inventing the technologies of tomorrow. It is a European-level environment of innovation and excellence where senior and junior researchers from around the world work together to develop disruptive technologies and business models that will drive socio-economic growth in the medium and long term. This is a strategic position for both ARQUIMEA Research Center and ARQUIMEA New Tech. The objective is to build internal capabilities in metallic additive manufacturing, reduce dependence on external suppliers, accelerate the development of advanced components, and create a technological advantage in high-performance materials and manufacturing processes. We are looking for a Metal Additive Manufacturing Research Lead to join the Materials Research Line within ARC. The position is linked to a strategic R&D area with high relevance for ARQUIMEA New Tech. Main Function and Scope We are seeking a Metal Additive Manufacturing Research Lead to drive a strategic R&D line focused on metallic additive manufacturing for high-performance industrial and aerospace applications. This role is intended for a postdoctoral researcher with strong hands-on experience in metal 3D printing, additive manufacturing process development, materials characterization, and experimental research. The successful candidate will lead the technical development of metal additive manufacturing capabilities applied to advanced metallic components, complex geometries, porous structures, lightweight parts, and functional hardware designed for demanding environments. The position combines applied research, experimental development, technology maturation, and industrialization-oriented thinking. The objective is not only to explore new manufacturing routes but also to build a real technological capability that can be transferred into products, processes, and sustainable competitive advantages for ARQUIMEA . Required Skills, Experience And Candidate Profile Responsibilities Lead the R&D line focused on metallic additive manufacturing for high-performance applications. Define and execute experimental plans for metal additive manufacturing processes. Develop and optimize process parameters for metallic 3D printing technologies. Investigate manufacturing routes for complex metallic components, porous structures, lightweight parts, and functional hardware. Work on materials selection, process-property relationships, and manufacturability. Coordinate design, manufacturing, post-processing, inspection, and testing activities. Define characterization plans, including microstructure, porosity, mechanical performance, thermal performance, cleanliness, and repeatability. title: Materials Engineer
description: What We Do At Blykalla Blykalla is developing the next generation of nuclear technology with our Small Modular Reactor (SMR) based on innovative fuel, materials, and reactor designs. As Sweden’s only SMR developer, we are on a mission to decarbonize industries and enable safe, scalable, and sustainable energy solutions. Our technology uses uranium nitride fuel and lead coolant, creating novel challenges and opportunities for the fuel cycle and supporting systems. This role is pivotal in advancing our materials knowhow, focusing on the development, qualification, and industrialization of powder materials and additive manufacturing crucial for our SMR technology. Key Responsibilities: Materials Expertise and Advancement: Drive the transition of new powder materials from concept to industry, navigating challenges from lab to application. Harness deep knowledge in alloying concepts, powder steel production processes, and additive material processes such as 3d printing and HIP, to guide material qualification and industrialization. Strategic Qualification Planning and Execution: You will spearhead the strategic planning and meticulous execution of technical material qualifications in collaboration with our suppliers and partners. Your leadership in this area will ensure that our material development efforts are not only innovative but also compliant and tailored to meet the exacting demands of our projects. Regulatory Compliance: Apply an in-depth understanding of nuclear industry regulations to the material qualification process, ensuring compliance and translating regulatory requirements into actionable company-specific steps. Collaborative Cost Management: Work closely with the supply Chain team to maintain a Design-to-Cost approach throughout development and industrialization, balancing cost efficiency and quality assurance. Who You Are You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personal chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. Experience within the steel industry preferably in product development and industrialization. Qualifications: Engineering degree with specialization relevant to material science. Background in advanced steel alloys, corrosion, testing, welding and additive manufacturing. Experience in the steel industry working closely with suppliers on material development and a practical understanding of material qualification processes. Fluency in Swedish and English, spoken and written. Location This position is for our office in Stockholm. We do not offer any relocation support for this role. So, what do you think? Don't miss the chance to be at the forefront of revolutionizing nuclear power. Join our team and help shape the energy landscape of tomorrow. title: Junior mechanical engineer
description: Ontwerp wat beweegt, tilt en draait Als junior mechanical engineer werk je aan techniek die letterlijk in beweging is. Denk aan containerkranen van honderd meter hoog, het beweegbare dak van de Johan Cruijff ArenA of offshore windplatforms midden op zee. Jij ontwerpt en rekent aan onderdelen die onder zware omstandigheden moeten blijven functioneren. Binnen infra en water werk je aan beweegbare bruggen, sluizen, gemalen en waterzuiveringen. Je ontwerpt aandrijvingen en bewegingswerken die elke dag betrouwbaar moeten functioneren. In offshoreprojecten werk je aan hijsvoorzieningen en mechanische onderdelen van windplatforms. Binnen de industrie ontwerp je constructies voor fabrieken en procesinstallaties. En in de maritieme sector werk je mee aan de mechanica van onderzeeboten en marineschepen. Je werkt ontwerpen uit van concept tot detail. Je maakt berekeningen op sterkte, stijfheid en vermoeiing, toetst aan normen en denkt mee over maakbaarheid en onderhoud. Je stemt af met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines zoals civiele techniek, elektrotechniek en procestechnologie. Je ziet hoe jouw ontwerp onderdeel wordt van een groter geheel. Bij Iv werken we aan projecten die anderen soms voor onmogelijk houden. We houden van ingewikkelde vraagstukken, maar niet van moeilijk doen. De lijnen zijn kort, de lat ligt hoog en je krijgt snel verantwoordelijkheid. Je start met begeleiding, maar groeit snel door naar zelfstandige taken. This is an excellent opportunity for recent Mechanical Engineering graduates who want to build a career with a leading international mechanical and electrical contractor. You will gain hands-on experience across live projects, working alongside experienced engineers, project teams, commercial teams and site leadership. As a Graduate Mechanical Engineer, you will support the delivery of mechanical building services across a range of projects, which may include commercial, industrial, pharmaceutical, data centre, residential, energy and infrastructure environments. You will be exposed to both office-based and site-based work, giving you a strong practical understanding of how mechanical systems are designed, coordinated, installed, tested and commissioned. Designer Group’s graduate programme is designed to support early-career professionals through practical project experience, mentoring, structured development and exposure to major engineering projects across Ireland, the UK and Europe. The existing graduate programme is positioned as a two-year programme providing hands-on experience across core teams and project environments. Key Responsibilities Will Include Supporting project teams with the delivery of mechanical services from early-stage planning through to installation, testing and commissioning. Assisting with technical reviews, drawings, specifications, submittals and project documentation. Working with engineers, supervisors, subcontractors and site teams to support safe and efficient project delivery. Supporting quality, safety and compliance requirements across mechanical works. Assisting with progress tracking, reporting, materials coordination and issue resolution. Developing practical knowledge of M&E contracting, construction sequencing, programme requirements and client expectations. Building your technical understanding of mechanical systems, site coordination, project delivery and engineering best practice. Participating in training, mentoring and continuous professional development as part of your graduate journey. Requirements Requirements Minimum Requirements Level 7 or Level 8 qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Energy Engineering or a related discipline. Strong interest in mechanical building services, M&E contracting and construction project delivery. Good communication, organisation and problem-solving skills. Ability to work well as part of a team and take direction from experienced engineers and project leaders. Proactive attitude, strong work ethic and willingness to learn. Comfortable working in both office and site-based environments. Available to start immediately or at short notice. Preferred But Not Essential Previous placement, internship or site experience within construction, M&E, building services, utilities, energy, pharma, commercial or data centre environments. Basic understanding of mechanical drawings, schematics, technical specifications or construction documentation. Exposure to AutoCAD, Revit, BIM, Microsoft Project, Excel or other engineering/project tools. Interest in progressing toward professional development, CPD and chartership. Benefits Benefits At Designer Group, our people are central to our continued growth. We invest in graduates through structured development, mentoring and exposure to real project delivery from the beginning of their careers. Benefits Include Full-time permanent employment. Structured graduate development. Mentoring from experienced engineering professionals. Exposure to major M&E projects. Pathway to chartership. CPD training, including Engineers Ireland-accredited development. International project opportunities. Competitive salary. Pension plan. Health plan. Life cover. Travel and subsistence allowances where applicable. Bike to Work scheme. Social committee and employee events. Third-level education grant support. Designer Group is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates.

title: Mechanical Engineer
description: About Osbit: We’re Osbit. We design and build cutting-edge engineering systems to make offshore wind happen at scale. We supply engineering equipment across many technology areas, to enable key offshore operations such as wind turbine foundation installation, burial and installation of subsea cables, and the lifting & handling of wind turbine components. We’re here to redefine what’s possible offshore, to drive the clean energy sector, and our planet, forward. We combine decades of collective experience in developing offshore equipment with fresh and innovative approaches, and we are passionate about enabling a more sustainable world for us all. We're proud to be a formative member company in game-changing offshore wind services business Venterra Group. Role Description: This role is the sturdy foundation underpinning Osbit’s success. An Osbit Mechanical Engineer is technically capable, and driven, in equal measure. You're an energetic all-rounder, owning your project from start to finish, and collaborating closely with your colleagues to overcome any obstacles thrown your way. The offshore wind industry is growing fast, and our projects are too. There’s lots to work on, with opportunities to take ownership and make a genuine difference to our business outcomes. You must be willing to get stuck in, combining your technical nous with strong communication, and lateral thinking, to ensure that we deliver On Spec, to Budget and In Time - OSBIT, every time. Your Responsibilities: You'll be part of a live project team, working closely with your teammates to design and build each engineering system. You may be assigned different roles project-to-project, and your core responsibilities include: Helping design innovative systems from first principles, from concept through to detailed design, while maintaining technical excellence. Supporting on schedule delivery by effective management of your project deliverables. Managing supplier progress, holding regular meetings and in-person support. Preparing technical documentation & design calculations for peer review, and checking third party documentation. Preparing for and carrying out testing, commissioning and mobilisation activities. Liaising with other business functions, including finance and HSSEQ, for support and guidance. Supporting your teammates by sharing your knowledge and insights in working groups and presentations, where applicable. About You: Open minded with a keen to learn attitude. First rate communicator. Self-motivated and persistent in getting from A to B. Diligent in attention to detail. Adaptable when unexpected challenges crop up. Your Experience: We welcome a range of qualification levels, from graduates onwards. In this role, as a basis you'll need: A degree-level qualification, or equivalent, in a technical field, such as Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Marine Engineering, or Naval Architecture. The ability to work with Autodesk Inventor software. Proficiency in hand calculations, through to Staad and FEA. Further Information: Successful applicants be based at our Netherlands headquarters, in Rotterdam, working on site as required. Working abroad may be required at times to visit customers, suppliers, and support assembly programmes. We can offer hybrid working in this role. What we offer: It's really important to us that Osbit is a fun and supportive place to be. This is why we offer a range of benefits. In the Netherlands, these include: Company pension scheme. Opportunities to take part in UK inhouse training. Lunch and refreshments provided daily. Access to a UK Myers Briggs practitioner & counsellor, and tailored coaching. Annual summer party celebration and Christmas walk, lunch, and festivities. About Venterra Group: Venterra Group is a dedicated wind energy services group at the forefront of driving the clean energy transition. Together, we engineer, build and support the operations of major wind developments around the world by providing specialist, technical and comprehensive services at every stage of the project lifecycle. Our vision is to become the global services champion and strategic partner supporting the wind industry’s rapid expansion. At Venterra, we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, respected and valued. We believe that diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives make us stronger and help us achieve better outcomes. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to succeed and thrive.

title: 2027 Ireland Graduate Mechanical Engineering Career Path: Water
description: Before making an application, please browse all graduate opportunities available as we will only accept one application per candidate. Once you have made an application you will not be able to make changes to your selection or make a new application. The exception is if we open new vacancies in the new year. To avoid missing out on your preferred role, we recommend applying as early as possible, as positions will close once filled. Application process Upload CV and cover letter, detailing motivations and suitability for the opportunity. Online strengths-based assessment This opportunity uses a single-stage strengths-based interview as part of the selection process. Start your career with a global, employee-owned consultancy where your work can make a real difference. At Mott MacDonald, you'll work alongside experts, contribute to meaningful projects, and have the support, learning opportunities, and experience needed to grow your career from day one. Job Description Engineer the Future of Water. Empower Communities. Protect the Planet. At Mott MacDonald, we’re not just building infrastructure we’re shaping the systems that deliver clean water, protect public health, and support sustainable living. As a Graduate Mechanical Engineer in our Water Division, you’ll be part of a team that’s transforming the entire water cycle from abstraction and treatment to distribution and disposal. You’ll work on high-profile, innovative projects, including advanced resilience schemes at some of the largest wastewater treatment works in the UK, helping protect the River Thames and surrounding communities from pollution and flooding. This is your opportunity to contribute to meaningful change, supported by a culture that values your growth, wellbeing, and ideas. What You’ll Be Doing Design with purpose: Contribute to mechanical designs across the full water cycle potable water systems, wastewater treatment, and more. Innovate and collaborate: Work alongside multidisciplinary teams to deliver sustainable, forward-thinking solutions for complex challenges. Learn and grow: Gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies and engineering practices, supported by mentoring and training. Make an impact: Help deliver projects that improve lives, protect ecosystems, and respond to the climate emergency. Candidate Specification At Mott MacDonald, we’re looking for curious, motivated graduates who want to make a real difference. Join our purpose-driven teams where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your work enhances the world we live in. To be eligible for this opportunity, you will have less than 12 months’ relevant experience (excluding placements ) and have a masters degree (obtained no earlier than 2025) or expected to achieve one of the following degree disciplines: Mechanical Engineering In your application, you should aim to demonstrate your genuine interest in both the opportunity and in joining Mott MacDonald. You can do this by highlighting any relevant experience or interests - such as modules you've studied, previous work experience, or any research you've undertaken about our company, values, and projects. We personally review every completed application form we receive as this part of our selection process is entirely human led – we do not use AI tools at this stage and kindly ask you not to either. We want you to answer each application question with authenticity so we can get to know the real you. Joining us as a graduate is your opportunity to shape your own story. We are looking for graduates with the following strengths: Proactively takes initiative to complete tasks efficiently and independently. Communicates effectively and clearly with clients and colleagues. Delivers high quality written work with strong attention to detail and clarity. Demonstrates a structured and analytical approach to problem solving. AI Usage At Mott MacDonald, we see the value AI can bring, but we take a people-first approach to hiring. While AI tools can help candidates prepare and build confidence, every application and hiring decision is reviewed by our recruitment and hiring teams. We encourage the responsible use of AI while ensuring we get to know the real person behind the application. Accessibility We want you to feel supported and able to perform at your best throughout our recruitment process. If there is anything we can do to make applying or interviewing with us more accessible, please contact us at reasonable.adjustments@mottmac.com and we'll be happy to discuss how we can help. About Your Development A graduate position should be more than just a job. We know this and so do you. That’s why with our graduate roles we aim to give you the experience and technical knowledge you need to progress your career. From the moment you join us, you’ll receive the training you need. You will be assigned a mentor, who will guide you to meet the objectives of your professional training needs. You will join our three-year early careers soft skills development programme – Accelerating your Future, which is designed to give you the skills and tools necessary for a long-lasting successful career here at Mott MacDonald. Our social side Being part of Mott MacDonald means more than just work; there’s a huge range of fun and exciting things that you can get involved in. From the moment you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your social and professional network, whether it’s meeting other graduates or joining forces with other members of staff from around the company at our annual sports day. Each of our offices have a sports and social committee which will give you the chance to be part of a variety of sports, social and charity events. We’re committed to promoting a strong culture of social responsibility and encourage our staff to play active roles in the local community. title: Mechanical Engineer
description: Van net afgestudeerd tot ervaren engineer: bouw met ons mee aan techniek die je niet iedere dag tegenkomt. Royal SMIT groeit. Daarom breiden we ons Engineering-team in Nijmegen flink uit en zoeken we meerdere Mechanical Engineers. Of je nu aan het begin van je carrière staat, al een paar jaar ervaring hebt of toe bent aan een volgende stap als ervaren engineer: bij ons krijg je de ruimte om op jouw niveau in te stappen én verder te groeien. Je werkt aan indrukwekkende vermogenstransformatoren voor klanten over de hele wereld. En omdat Engineering en Productie bij ons op dezelfde locatie zitten, blijft het niet bij een ontwerp op je beeldscherm. Wat jij ontwerpt, zie je hier daadwerkelijk gebouwd worden. Wat ga je doen? Als Mechanical Engineer werk je aan het mechanische buitenwerk van onze vermogenstransformatoren. Denk aan de tank, koeling, expansievaten, ventilatoren, pompen en het complete oliecircuit. Geen project is hetzelfde. Van aardbevingsbestendigheid en transport tot koeling, geluid en extreme weersomstandigheden: jij vertaalt technische eisen naar slimme, veilige én maakbare oplossingen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Ontwerpen en construeren in 3D CAD; Uitvoeren en beoordelen van technische berekeningen; Ontwerpen toetsen op kwaliteit, veiligheid, maakbaarheid en kosten; Samenwerken met collega’s binnen Engineering en Operations; Oplossen van technische vraagstukken binnen projecten; Bijdragen aan innovatie en verbetering van onze ontwerpen. Hoe snel je verantwoordelijkheid krijgt, hangt af van jouw ervaring en ontwikkeling. Iedere engineer start bij ons met een inwerktraject waarin je ons unieke product, onze processen en onze manier van werken leert kennen. Als starter krijg je daarbij intensieve begeleiding van ervaren collega’s. Breng je al relevante ervaring mee, dan zul je het inwerktraject op onderdelen sneller doorlopen en eerder zelfstandig technische vraagstukken en projecten oppakken. Naarmate je groeit in je rol, krijg je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid en ruimte om complexere uitdagingen aan te pakken. Wat breng je mee? We zoeken vooral engineers die enthousiast worden van techniek en graag willen blijven leren. Je hebt: Je hebt een afgeronde technische opleiding op mbo-, hbo- of wo-niveau, waarbij relevante werkervaring binnen engineering voor ons minstens zo belangrijk is als je opleidingsniveau Kennis van of ervaring met 3D CAD en mechanisch construeren; Affiniteit met constructieleer en technische berekeningen; Oog voor kwaliteit, veiligheid en maakbaarheid; Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Ervaring met transformatoren is niet nodig. Ervaring binnen bijvoorbeeld machinebouw, staalconstructies, energie, offshore of zware industrie is mooi meegenomen. Wat bieden wij jou? Of dit nu je eerste baan als engineer wordt of je al jaren ervaring hebt: we kijken naar jouw kennis, ervaring en het niveau waarop je bij ons instapt. Voor de functie van Mechanical Engineer hanteren we, afhankelijk van jouw niveau, de volgende salarisranges: Junior Mechanical Engineer: €3.400 – €4.300 bruto per maand; Medior Mechanical Engineer: €4.200 – €5.500 bruto per maand; Senior Mechanical Engineer: €5.400 – €6.797 bruto per maand. De uiteindelijke inschaling bepalen we op basis van jouw kennis, relevante werkervaring en de verantwoordelijkheden die je binnen de functie kunt oppakken. Daarnaast krijg je: 27 verlofdagen en 13 ADV-dagen, waarbij je ADV kunt omruilen voor extra salaris; Een PME-pensioenregeling; Reiskostenvergoeding; Een bonusregeling gebaseerd op bedrijfsdoelstellingen; Fiscale voordelen via FiscFree; Een fietsstimuleringsprogramma via Trappers; Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf technisch en persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen. Dit is werken bij Royal SMIT Transformers B.V. Bij Royal SMIT Transformers B.V. stap je in de wereld van de toekomst, waar we ons richten op vermogenstransformatoren en secundaire installaties. Onze moderne productiefaciliteit in Nijmegen is een toonbeeld van innovatie en kwaliteit. We dragen wereldwijd bij aan de opwekking en distributie van elektrische energie, en dat maakt impact! In onze professionele en collegiale werkomgeving voel je je meteen thuis. We zijn trots op ons ambacht van morgen en kijken ernaar uit om samen met jou verder te bouwen aan een duurzame toekomst. Je werkt samen met verschillende technische disciplines aan transformatoren die wereldwijd worden ingezet. Het bijzondere? Onze Engineering en Productie zitten op dezelfde locatie. Je kunt de productie inlopen, overleggen met de collega’s die jouw ontwerp bouwen en met eigen ogen zien hoe jouw technische keuzes werkelijkheid worden. Zo bouwen we niet alleen aan transformatoren, maar ook aan ons Engineering-team voor de toekomst. Op de afdeling engineering werken we met ongeveer 80 engineers verdeeld over zes disciplines vol passie aan transformator ontwerpen. Om de transformator ontwerpen zo te maken dat de transformatoren succesvol geproduceerd, geassembleerd, getest, getransporteerd en uiteindelijk bij de klant in bedrijf genomen kunnen worden, wordt multidisciplinair samengewerkt tussen de disciplines. Dit is een team van elektrische en mechanische specialisten op verschillende vakgebieden. Zin in een uitdaging? Net afgestudeerd, al een paar jaar aan het werk of inmiddels een ervaren engineer? We komen graag met je in contact. Heb je vragen over deze functie of wil je solliciteren? Neem contact op met Niek Sterenborg via +31 6 12 35 72 40 of niek.sterenborg@sgb-smit.group. Klaar om te solliciteren? Klik op de sollicitatiebutton! X

title: Junior Mechanical Engineer

Zo ontdek je niet alleen waar jouw kracht ligt, maar bouw je ook snel ervaring op bij verschillende opdrachtgevers. De ideale start voor engineers die willen leren, groeien en zichzelf blijven ontwikkelen. Dit ga je doen Als Junior Mechanical Engineer Werk Je Aan De Ontwikkeling Van Mechanische Systemen Voor Uiteenlopende Projecten Binnen De Machinebouw, Industrie, Productie En Hightech. Via Wepro Zet Je Jouw Kennis Direct In Bij Verschillende Opdrachtgevers. Samen Met Ervaren Engineers Bouw Je Aan Slimme Technische Oplossingen En Krijg Je Stap Voor Stap Meer Verantwoordelijkheid. Jouw Werkzaamheden Bestaan Onder Andere Uit Ontwerpen en modelleren van machines, apparaten en industriële systemen in 3D CAD-software. Opstellen van 2D-werktekeningen, stuklijsten en technische documentatie. Vertalen van technische vraagstukken naar praktische, veilige en betrouwbare oplossingen. Meewerken aan productontwikkeling en het verbeteren van bestaande machines en installaties. Afstemmen met opdrachtgevers, leveranciers en collega-engineers om projecten succesvol te realiseren. Ondersteunen van de werkplaats bij de realisatie en doorontwikkeling van ontwerpen. Je bent fit for the job als je... Daarnaast Breng Je Het Volgende Mee Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechanical Engineering of een vergelijkbare technische richting, zoals Automotive, Mechatronica of Aviation Engineering. Ervaring met engineeringprojecten vanuit stages, afstudeeropdrachten of werkervaring. Kennis van CAD-software en FEM-analyses, bijvoorbeeld SolidWorks, Inventor of vergelijkbare systemen. Een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. De ambitie om projectmatig te werken en ervaring op te doen binnen verschillende organisaties en industrieën. description: Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 100 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 27,3 milliards d'euros en 2024, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés. Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2024 » du magazine TIME. Safran Aerosystems est l'un des leaders mondiaux des systèmes aéronautiques dédiés à la sécurité des avions et hélicoptères ainsi qu'à la gestion des fluides et du carburant. La société est un acteur clé dans le domaine de la sécurité des vols (oxygène, évacuation, flottabilités) et participe à la décarbonation de l'aviation grâce aux carburants alternatifs durables et aux nouvelles architectures moteurs. Elle compte 5200 collaborateurs répartis dans 7 pays. Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi Vous souhaitez intégrer un grand Groupe aéronautique leader sur ses marchés avec de grands défis à relever ? Vous intégrerez la Business Unit Oxygen Systems, qui conçoit des systèmes et équipements oxygène destinés à assurer la sécurité des équipages et des passagers à bord des avions civils et militaires et des hélicoptères. En tant qu'Ingénieur-e Produit, vous serez en charge de concevoir, de justifier et de maintenir la définition des équipements Oxygène développés pour l'aviation civile et militaire (masques à oxygène pour pilotes, systèmes de distribution et de régulation...). Vous serez en charge des étapes clés du développement de nouveaux produits et d'évolutions de systèmes existants. Ce poste pourrait être évolutif vers un rôle de manager hiérarchique. Vous savez gérer des projets de développement Produit et déployer une approche basée sur la gestion du risque, des coûts et du respect des délais ? Vous serez amené-e, lors de faits techniques, à appliquer les méthodes d'expertise et de résolution de problèmes. Vous avez un diplôme Bac+5 et possédez une forte expérience (supérieure à 8 ans) dans le développement d'équipements mécaniques ou pneumatiques pour l'éronautique ? Les compétences techniques recherchées : - Expériences réalisées dans le développement d'équipements aéronautiques civils (DO-160) - Bonnes compétences en mécanique et matériaux (résistance, lois de comportement, tenue en statique et en fatigue, lecture de plan, chaîne de cote...), ainsi qu'en pneumatique. - Maîtrise des méthodes d'analyses fonctionnelles et de Fiabilité et Sécurité de Fonctionnement (AMDEC, évènements redoutés, arbres de défaillance...). - Des connaissances en CAO (Catia v5), en simulations numériques structure, vous seront nécessaires pour échanger avec les membres de l'équipe. description: The PhD research will be carried out in the Advanced Ceramics and Powder Metallurgy team at the Department of Materials Engineering of KU Leuven. KU Leuven (University of Leuven) has been a center of learning for nearly six centuries since 1425, making it one of the oldest and most renowned universities in Europe. Today, it is Belgium’s highest ranked university (QS 2025 : 60), ranked among the top 4% universities in the world and consistently ranked in the top 10 most innovative universities in Europe. The university caters to over 60,000 students from more than 140 countries. KU Leuven's three doctoral schools provide internationally oriented PhD tracks for more than 4,000 doctoral students. KU Leuven and affiliated knowledge institutes provide fertile ground for innovation and high-tech entrepreneurship in the Leuven region. This favorable climate for knowledge-driven innovation makes the Leuven region an attractive location for many high-tech companies. KU Leuven website: https://www.kuleuven.be/english/kuleuven/ Project KU Leuven seeks a highly motivated PhD candidate for a fully funded, four-year international doctoral position within the Marie Sklodowska-Curie Doctoral Network (MSCA-DN) project TURBO-IMPACT (TURBOmachinery Innovative Manufacturing, Processing, Analysis, Characterization, and Topology ; Website: https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101311350). The TurboImpact project, funded by Horizon Europe – MSCA-DN, tackles challenges in designing, optimizing, selecting materials, and manufacturing small-scale turbomachinery for applications in heat pumps, fuel cells, organic Rankine cycles, or gas turbines. This project develops robust system and component design methods, an integrated manufacturing platform, and multi-material joining techniques to efficiently produce small-scale turbomachinery. In this EU project, this PhD researcher (DC8) will focus on the complete indirect DLP/SLA additive manufacturing route for silicon nitride turbomachinery components. This involves the development of a UV-curable Si3N4 slurry, optimization of DLP/SLA printing strategies for reference parts and complex components such as impellers, and the post-printing debinding and sintering process to obtain fully dense complex near-net-shaped ceramic components. The AM parts will be microstructurally, mechanically and geometrically characterized. Simple geometries will be used for the evaluation of joining and machining performances, whereas the complex near-net-shaped components will be applied in turbomachinery. The Doctoral Candidate Will Develop a UV-curable Si3N4 slurry and optimize DLP/SLA printing strategies for reference parts and complex components Realize post-printing debinding and sintering processes to obtain fully dense complex near-net-shaped ceramic components Elucidate the processing – microstructure – mechanical properties – geometrical accuracy correlations. The project includes potential international secondments at EPFL (Switzerland), Admatec Additive Solutions (The Netherlands) and IFW (Germany). The researcher is supervised by Prof. Jozef Vleugels (https://www.kuleuven.be/wieiswie/nl/person/00006337), head of the Functional Materials Division (FUNMAT) and coordinator of the Advanced Ceramics and Powder Metallurgy research group at the Department of Materials Engineering. The research group has a long track record (>35 years) on the powder metallurgical development, processing and characterisaton of ceramics, cermets, metcers and metals.
